papers.title: SciCodePile: A 128GB Corpus and Executable Benchmark for Challenging Scientific Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) excel at general-purpose code generation, yet how well they handle scientific code remains an open question. Existing datasets and benchmarks are limited in scale, domain coverage, or executable verification, leaving the true gap between current LLMs and reliable scientific code generators inadequately assessed. To address these limitations, we present SciCodePile, the largest scientific code corpus to date, constructed from 37,737 public repositories and collectively comprising 128GB of code that spans multiple computational science disciplines. From this corpus, we further curate an executable benchmark of 200 tasks, each equipped with a sandboxed execution environment and an automated test harness for functional verification. We evaluate 15 LLMs from both open-source and closed-source families on three tasks: prefix-to-suffix completion, fill-in-the-middle infilling, and executable code generation. Results show that scientific code generation remains highly challenging: The best CodeBLEU reaches only 38.13 and 38.37 on the two completion tasks, while the strongest model achieves just 12.30\% Pass@1 on the executable benchmark, underscoring how far current models remain from reliable scientific code generation. To demonstrate the training utility of SciCodePile, we further show that continued pretraining on our corpus improves CodeBLEU by $\times$2.84 on scientific code completion, and instruction tuning on our data improves Pass@1 by $\times$4.79 on the executable benchmark. All code and data are available at https://huggingface.co/SciCodePile.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了迄今为止最大的科学代码语料库 SciCodePile（128GB，来自37,737个公开仓库），并从中筛选出200个可执行基准任务，每个任务配有沙盒环境和自动化测试。评估15个开源和闭源LLM在三种生成任务上的表现，发现科学代码生成极具挑战：最佳CodeBLEU仅38.13/38.37，可执行基准Pass@1最高12.30%。在语料库上继续预训练可使CodeBLEU提升2.84倍，指令微调使Pass@1提升4.79倍。
Motivation: 现有科学代码数据集和基准在规模、领域覆盖或可执行验证上存在局限，无法充分评估LLM在科学代码生成上的真实能力。
Method: 从37,737个公共仓库收集128GB科学代码，覆盖多学科；从中精选200个任务构建可执行基准，每个任务提供沙盒执行环境和自动测试脚本。
Result: 15个LLM评估显示：前缀-后缀补全任务最佳CodeBLEU为38.13和38.37，可执行代码生成Pass@1仅12.30%；继续预训练提升CodeBLEU 2.84倍，指令微调提升Pass@1 4.79倍。
Conclusion: 当前LLM在科学代码生成上远未达到可靠水平，SciCodePile语料库和基准为后续研究提供了大规模资源和评估标准。

papers.title: Translation as Augmentation: Effect of Translated Data on Assessment of Difficulty
papers.abstract_en: Reliable Text Difficulty Assessment is a prerequisite for valid text simplification workflows and personalized learning applications. However, the development of robust assessment models is severely hindered by a critical bottleneck: the scarcity of expert-annotated corpora containing fine-grained difficulty levels (e.g., CEFR), particularly for lower-resource languages. This paper addresses this data scarcity problem in the context of a low-resource European language. We propose a cross-lingual data augmentation strategy that leverages machine translation to transfer labeled resources from high-resource languages to the target low-resource language. We train BERT-based regression models to predict difficulty scores and investigate whether synthetic, translated data can effectively supplement native training sets. Our experiments demonstrate that augmenting scarce native data with machine-translated corpora significantly improves the accuracy of difficulty estimation, offering a viable solution for languages lacking extensive expert annotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低资源语言中细粒度文本难度评估（如CEFR）的训练数据稀缺问题，提出利用机器翻译将高资源语言的标注数据迁移到目标低资源语言的跨语言数据增强策略。实验表明，用机器翻译的合成数据增强本地训练集能显著提高难度估计的准确性。
Motivation: 文本难度评估需要大量专家标注的细粒度难度等级语料，但低资源语言此类数据极为稀缺，严重制约模型鲁棒性。
Method: 提出跨语言数据增强策略：使用机器翻译将高资源语言的标注数据翻译到目标低资源语言，训练基于BERT的回归模型预测难度分数，并评估合成翻译数据对本地训练集的补充效果。
Result: 实验表明，用机器翻译语料增强稀缺的本地数据可显著提升难度估计的准确性。
Conclusion: 该增强策略为缺乏专家标注的低资源语言提供了可行的解决方案。

papers.title: FlexiAvatar: Unified 3D Gaussian Human Avatars Under Arbitrary Body Visibility
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing animatable 3D human avatars from monocular video is a fundamental problem in computer vision with broad applications in AR/VR and digital content creation. Existing approaches typically couple parametric body models with neural rendering or 3D Gaussian splatting and optimize all body regions jointly from short videos, which often degrades fidelity in the visible areas. To overcome this limitation, we introduce FlexiAvatar, a unified framework that explicitly optimizes only the visible body regions, effectively eliminating artifacts arising from unobserved limbs. Our method integrates occlusion-robust SMPL-X tracking with part-specific residual refinement to capture high-frequency geometric and appearance details. To complete entirely unseen regions (e.g., back views), we leverage a diffusion-based approach to generate texture consistent with the observed appearance. Experiments on full-body (NeuMan, ZJU-MoCap, WildAvatar), upper/half-body (talk-show clips), and head-only (INSTA) inputs show that FlexiAvatar delivers consistently higher reconstruction quality, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by an average PSNR improvement of approximately 3% across datasets. Finally, by restricting optimization to observed regions, our method reduces the effective number of Gaussians that must be optimized and rendered, leading to reduced runtime and memory overhead in partial-visibility scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlexiAvatar，一个从单目视频重建可动画化3D人体头像的统一框架。该方法仅优化可见身体区域，避免未观察肢体产生的伪影，结合遮挡鲁棒的SMPL-X跟踪与部件级残差细化捕捉高频细节，并对完全不可见区域使用扩散模型生成纹理。在全身、半身及仅头部输入上，平均PSNR提升约3%，同时降低部分可见场景下的运行时和内存开销。
Motivation: 现有方法联合优化所有身体区域，导致可见区域保真度下降，且无法有效处理未观察肢体带来的伪影。
Method: 提出FlexiAvatar，仅优化可见身体区域；集成遮挡鲁棒的SMPL-X跟踪与部件级残差细化以捕获高频细节；对完全不可见区域采用扩散模型生成与观测外观一致的纹理。
Result: 在NeuMan、ZJU-MoCap、WildAvatar等全身、半身及头部数据集上，平均PSNR提升约3%，并减少部分可见场景下的运行时间和内存消耗。
Conclusion: 通过限制优化到可见区域，FlexiAvatar在保持高质量重建的同时降低了计算开销，适用于多种可见性场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Supra Cognitive Modes: A Routed Architecture for Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Agent-memory workloads mix direct factual lookup, relation-chain and current-state reasoning, and broad synthesis over long histories. We describe Supra Cognitive Modes (SCM), an architecture that maps explicit or automatically selected per-query modes to retrieval and synthesis payloads over one shared ingest substrate. A frozen semantic classifier and runtime gates dispatch queries among fused lexical and dense lookup, graph or iterative multi-hop handling, and stratified long-form synthesis. The substrate combines multi-granularity embeddings, extracted triples, fact-version metadata, and optional asynchronous enrichments. We characterize the deployed configuration on three benchmarks: Long-term Conversational Memory (LoCoMo; n = 1,986), MemoryAgentBench (MAB; n = 3,671), and LongMemEval (n = 500). The reference run records 84.87% on LoCoMo factoid categories and 68.61% on adversarial abstention, 61.49% on MAB across two repetitions, and 86.00% on LongMemEval. A repository-backed reproduction produces similar aggregate scores and supports task- and mode-conditioned failure analysis. Raw baseline outputs, aligned end-to-end timing for LoCoMo and LongMemEval, and complete token ledgers are unavailable; stored rows also omit some final runtime decisions. The results characterize one implemented routed configuration and its diagnostic failure patterns, while source inspection verifies the per-query control interface and shared-substrate design. Causal routing effects, efficiency gains, and statistical significance remain outside the available evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Supra Cognitive Modes (SCM)架构，用于代理记忆工作负载，通过路由机制将查询分配到不同的检索与合成模式（融合词汇与密集查找、图或多跳推理、分层长文本合成）。在Long-term Conversational Memory (LoCoMo)、MemoryAgentBench (MAB)和LongMemEval三个基准上评估，分别取得84.87%、61.49%和86.00%的准确率。该架构支持基于查询模式的调度，但因果路由效果、效率提升和统计显著性尚未验证。
Motivation: 代理记忆工作负载需要高效处理多种推理类型（直接事实查找、关系链推理、长历史综合），现有方法缺乏灵活路由机制。
Method: 提出SCM架构，包括冻结语义分类器和运行时门控，将查询路由到融合词汇与密集查找、图或多跳迭代推理、分层长文本合成等不同模式，底层共享多粒度嵌入、三元组、事实版本元数据等存储。
Result: 在LoCoMo基准上事实类准确率84.87%，对抗性回避68.61%；MAB上两次重复平均61.49%；LongMemEval上86.00%。
Conclusion: 该架构实现了查询级别的控制接口和共享存储设计，但因果路由效果、效率提升及统计显著性尚未有证据支持。

papers.title: An unsupervised clustering analysis of breast cancer data derived from electronic health records enhanced through UMAP dimensionality reduction
papers.abstract_en: Breast cancer is one of the most widespread types of cancer, affecting approximately 8 million women worldwide. Electronic health records of patients diagnosed with this disease can serve as valuable datasets for computational analyses, enabling the discovery of new insights about the pathology. Unsupervised clustering, in particular, can identify groups of patients with medically significant features, revealing data trends that might otherwise go unnoticed by medical doctors. In this study, we first applied the DBSCAN density-based clustering method to three independent datasets derived from electronic medical records of patients with mammary carcinoma. Subsequently, to enhance our results, we preceded the DBSCAN application with a dimensionality reduction phase using UMAP. We evaluated our clustering outcomes using three statistical indices (DBCV, DCSI, and DISCO). Our results confirm the effectiveness of combining UMAP with DBSCAN for clustering data derived from electronic health records, paving the way for the medical interpretation of the patient groups identified by our approach.
papers.comment: Accepted at the CIBB 2026 conference ( https://cibb2026.teralab.ai/ )
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对三个乳腺癌电子健康记录数据集进行无监督聚类分析。先单独使用 DBSCAN 聚类，再结合 UMAP 降维后再次进行 DBSCAN 聚类，并通过 DBCV、DCSI 和 DISCO 三个统计指标评估结果。结果表明 UMAP 与 DBSCAN 的组合能有效识别电子健康记录数据中的患者群组，为后续医学解释奠定基础。
Motivation: 乳腺癌电子健康记录包含有价值的病理信息，但其中的数据趋势可能被医生忽略。无监督聚类能够自动识别具有医学意义的患者分组，从而发现新的疾病见解。
Method: 先对独立的数据集应用 DBSCAN 密度聚类，然后引入 UMAP 进行降维后再执行 DBSCAN 聚类，并使用 DBCV、DCSI 和 DISCO 三个指标评估聚类质量。
Result: 结果表明，UMAP 与 DBSCAN 的组合能够有效提升乳腺癌电子健康记录数据的聚类效果，使识别出的患者群组具有潜在的医学解释价值。
Conclusion: 该研究证实了 UMAP 降维结合 DBSCAN 聚类在电子健康记录分析中的有效性，未来可对识别出的患者分组进行医学意义的深入解读。

papers.title: DAIS: Dependency-Aware Intermediate QA Supervision for Complex Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision exposes intermediate rationales, but flat rationale targets usually optimize a single reasoning sequence and provide limited supervision on how local conclusions should support later decisions. We introduce Dependency-Aware Intermediate QA Supervision (DAIS), a training-time framework that converts filtered teacher rationales into stage-level QA records. Each intermediate record predicts a local answer conditioned on the previous states needed for that decision, while the final-answer record keeps the original task format; evaluation therefore uses only the original input and optional context. Across GDPR, AIACT, MedQA, and FOLIO with multiple Qwen backbones, DAIS improves average final-answer accuracy over answer-only, flat chain-of-thought, and independent-QA baselines. On policy-compliance benchmarks, it achieves a largest gain of 5.6% and an average gain of 4.2% over the strongest non-DAIS baseline. Controlled ablations show that valid previous-state conditioning contributes beyond longer targets or additional intermediate text, supporting dependency-conditioned intermediate QA as a lightweight auxiliary supervision signal for standard final-answer inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DAIS框架，将过滤后的教师推理链转换为阶段级QA记录，每个中间预测依赖前序状态，增强复杂推理中的中间监督。在GDPR、AIACT、MedQA、FOLIO等基准上，使用Qwen骨干，DAIS相比基线方法提升了最终答案准确率，最高提升5.6%，平均提升4.2%。
Motivation: 链式思考（CoT）监督提供中间推理，但扁平的目标序列只优化单一推理链，对局部结论如何支持后续决策的监督有限。
Method: DAIS将教师推理链分割为阶段级QA记录，每个中间QA预测条件于前序状态，最后答案保持原格式；训练时使用这些记录作为辅助监督信号。
Result: 在多个复杂推理基准上，DAIS优于仅答案、扁平CoT和独立QA基线，其中政策合规基准上最高提升5.6%，平均提升4.2%。
Conclusion: 依赖条件化的中间QA监督是一种轻量级辅助信号，能有效提升标准最终答案推理，其收益源于有效的前状态条件化而非单纯增加文本长度。

papers.title: Advancing Multimodal Fusion on Heterogeneous Medical Data with Hybrid Geometry Attention
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal fusion learning (MFL) has shown great potential in the medical domain, where we are faced with disparate data modalities such as imaging, clinical records, and omics. However, existing MFL strategies face several major challenges. First, they struggle to capture complex cross-modal interactions effectively, which in turn limits performance improvements. Second, they incur high computational costs, restricting their applicability in resource-constrained healthcare AI applications. Finally, they are often designed and evaluated for narrow, fixed modality configurations (e.g., imaging-only, or specific pairs such as image and omics), which limits evidence of their adaptability and generalizability to broader collections of heterogeneous medical modalities. To address these challenges, we propose a novel MFL framework - Cascaded Unified Representation Learning for Efficient Fusion Network (CURE) - a lightweight and scalable framework that progressively integrates various modalities through a novel efficient Hybrid Geometry Aware Fusion layer (HyFuse), where each HyFuse layer is sequentially learned for each modality, making the framework adaptable and generalizable. Within HyFuse, an efficient residual convolution module captures rich multi-scale features to ensure cost-effective learning, while a hybrid-space aware attention mixer learns coarse-to-fine structural cues to better preserve cross-modal relationships. Complementary learnable late-fusion and shared information refinement modules are then employed to learn robust modality-order-invariant shared representations, which in turn yields consistent performance improvements. Extensive evaluations on 16 public datasets show that CURE outperforms leading multimodal fusion methods, boosting performance by up to 3.97% and lowering computational costs by up to 87.8%, ensuring more effective and reliable predictions.
papers.comment: ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CURE 框架，通过混合几何注意力机制（HyFuse）高效融合影像、临床记录和组学等异构医疗数据，在16个公共数据集上性能提升最多3.97%、计算成本降低最多87.8%，且框架轻量可扩展，支持多种模态组合。
Motivation: 现有多模态融合方法难以有效捕获复杂跨模态交互、计算成本高，且通常针对固定模态组合设计，泛化性不足，限制其在资源受限的医疗AI中的应用。
Method: 提出级联统一表示学习框架CURE，核心是HyFuse层：残差卷积模块提取多尺度特征，混合空间注意力学习粗到细的结构线索，再通过互补的后期融合和共享信息精炼模块学习模态顺序不变的鲁棒共享表示。
Result: 在16个公共数据集上，CURE优于现有方法，性能提升最高3.97%，计算成本降低最高87.8%。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该框架轻量、可扩展，能适应多种异构模态，实现一致性能改进，适用于资源受限的医疗场景。

papers.title: GEqTrain: A Configuration-Driven Framework for Retargeting Equivariant Graph Neural Networks Across 3D Scientific Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Equivariant graph neural networks provide a powerful modeling language for three-dimensional scientific data, but their reuse is often limited by implementations tied to specific tasks, outputs, and training regimes. We present GEqTrain, a configuration-driven framework that separates dataset semantics, model composition, and training objectives. Raw data are mapped to typed node-, edge-, and graph-level fields, while model stacks, losses, and training workflows are assembled declaratively through Hydra configurations. A shared equivariant backbone and training infrastructure can therefore be retargeted to a new task primarily through configuration. We demonstrate this flexibility on three different problems handled within one software stack: coarse-grained-to-atomistic backmapping of biomolecular systems, prediction of NMR chemical shifts in molecular solids, and equivariant generative modeling. Our aim is not to surpass individually optimized task-specific systems, but to show that a shared representation and training infrastructure can achieve competitive accuracy across qualitatively different tasks at the cost of a configuration change. We further introduce GEqDiff, a generative extension based on equivariant flow matching. GEqDiff treats user-defined equivariant fields as first-class generation targets, jointly transporting Cartesian positions and non-scalar node fields spanning representations up to l=3 within a single equivariant flow. We validate this capability on a controlled synthetic benchmark inspired by protein secondary-structure motifs, showing that fields with heterogeneous transformation properties can be reconstructed jointly and with high fidelity. By reducing the software overhead of moving between predictive and generative, scalar and tensorial settings, GEqTrain aims to make equivariant modeling more reproducible, extensible, and reusable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GEqTrain是一个配置驱动的框架，通过分离数据集语义、模型组合和训练目标，使得等变图神经网络（equivariant GNN）能够在不同3D科学任务间重用。框架使用Hydra配置声明式地组装模型栈、损失函数和训练流程，并在粗粒化到原子尺度的生物分子反映射、分子固体NMR化学位移预测和等变生成建模三个任务上展示了灵活性。此外，还引入了GEqDiff，一种基于等变流匹配（equivariant flow matching）的生成扩展，能够联合处理笛卡尔位置和非标量节点场。
Motivation: 等变图神经网络在3D科学数据上很强大，但其实现往往与特定任务、输出和训练模式绑定，导致重用受限。
Method: 提出GEqTrain框架，将原始数据映射到类型化的节点、边和图级字段，通过Hydra配置声明式地组合模型、损失和训练工作流，使得共享的等变主干和训练基础设施通过配置即可重定向到新任务。同时推出GEqDiff，基于等变流匹配，将用户定义的等变场作为一等生成目标，联合传输Cartesian位置和非标量节点场。
Result: 在三个不同任务（生物分子反映射、NMR化学位移预测、等变生成建模）上展示了竞争性精度。在受控的合成基准（模拟蛋白质二级结构基序）上，GEqDiff能高保真地联合重建具有异构变换性质的场。
Conclusion: GEqTrain旨在通过减少在预测与生成、标量与张量设置之间切换的软件开销，提高等变建模的可复现性、可扩展性和可重用性。

papers.title: Wavefront Parallelization for Efficient Learned Image Compression
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive context models are foundational for learned image compression,but they suffer from slow serial inference. Existing acceleration methods such as checkerboard context require architectural changes and retraining, thus are inapplicable to pre-trained models. We propose a completely training-free inference-time acceleration algorithm inspired by wavefront parallelism in video coding standards. Our method reorganizes inference into an optimal ``staggered'' wavefront order, minimizing sequential steps while maintaining exact autoregressive dependencies. Experimental results show our approach accelerates pre-trained autoregressive models (e.g., Cheng et al.) by more than $13\times$ while preserving the original rate-distortion performance. We also demonstrate that faster decoding is possible by trading off precise context dependencies. Source code will be available at https://github.com/tokkiwa/compressai-wavefront.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练、仅修改推理顺序的加速方法，将波前并行（wavefront parallelism）思想引入自回归学习图像压缩模型，在保持率失真性能的前提下实现超过13倍的加速。
Motivation: 自回归上下文模型虽效果好但串行推理慢，现有加速方法如棋盘格上下文需要修改架构和重新训练，无法直接应用于预训练模型。
Method: 借鉴视频编码标准中的波前并行，设计最优“交错”波前顺序，在最小化串行步骤的同时保持精确的自回归依赖关系。
Result: 在Cheng等人的预训练自回归模型上，该方法实现超过13倍加速，且率失真性能完全保持不变；进一步放宽上下文依赖可实现更快解码。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种即插即用的推理加速方案，兼容现有预训练模型，无需额外训练，并且可通过折中上下文精度换取更高解码速度。

papers.title: Context-structured Video Anomaly Detection with Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Training video anomaly detectors is challenging due to the difficulty and cost of annotating diverse and rare abnormal events. Although recent large vision-language models enable training-free inference, existing approaches mostly rely on holistic inference over sampled video and may miss context-specific anomaly cues. In this paper, we present CSI-VAD, a training-free video anomaly detector that identifies abnormal events across diverse contexts. The key idea is to decompose each video into three distinct contexts (environment, objects, time) and perform context-specific inference in separate branches. Because we ground anomaly judgments solely in context-specific visual cues, we do not require predefined text prompts describing abnormal events or dataset-specific tuning. Experiments on UCF-Crime and UBnormal show that CSI-VAD consistently improves over the direct holistic baseline and achieves competitive performance against existing methods, showing the advantage of structured context decomposition for training-free video anomaly detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CSI-VAD，一种无需训练的视频异常检测方法，通过将视频分解为环境、物体和时间三种上下文，分别进行特异性的异常推断。在 UCF-Crime 和 UBnormal 数据集上，该方法优于直接整体推断的基线，并与现有方法性能相当，展示了结构化上下文分解在无训练视频异常检测中的优势。
Motivation: 训练视频异常检测器需要大量标注异常事件，成本高且困难。现有基于大视觉语言模型的无训练方法通常对视频进行整体推断，可能遗漏上下文特定的异常线索。
Method: 将视频分解为环境、物体和时间三种上下文，并在独立分支中进行上下文特异性的推断，无需预定义异常事件的文本提示或数据集调优。
Result: 在 UCF-Crime 和 UBnormal 数据集上，CSI-VAD 一致优于直接整体推断基线，并达到与现有方法竞争的性能。
Conclusion: 结构化上下文分解对于无训练视频异常检测有效，能更好地捕捉上下文特定的异常线索。

papers.title: From Operations to Elderly Care Outcomes: A Thematic Review of Industrial Engineering and Decision-Support Approaches
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of the global aging population presents severe challenges to healthcare systems, necessitating efficient, equitable, and patient-centered care models. While Industrial Engineering and Operations Research (OR) provide robust optimization and decision-support tools to address these multidimensional complexities, current applications often remain fragmented. This paper presents a thematic review of 30 seminal studies at the intersection of OR and elderly care, categorizing the literature into home healthcare operations, polypharmacy management, and clinical chronotherapy. Our analysis highlights a significant methodological evolution from static, deterministic models toward dynamic and stochastic frameworks integrated with artificial intelligence (AI). Despite these advancements, a critical translational gap persists: the current OR literature is heavily dominated by process-level optimizations, such as staff routing, and struggles to translate these operational efficiencies into measurable clinical outcomes. Furthermore, holistic models bridging the transition between hospital and community care remain critically underexplored. To develop resilient and smart healthcare systems, this study proposes a conceptual framework that shifts the research focus from isolated operational tasks to integrated, multi-level decision-making. We emphasize the critical need for robust systems analysis, human-inclusive design, and the smartification of care through emerging digital technologies - including digital twins and large language models - to successfully bridge the gap between theoretical operational metrics and tangible patient-level health outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对工业工程与运筹学（OR）在老年护理中的应用进行了主题综述，涵盖家庭医疗运营、多药管理及临床时间疗法三大领域。研究发现该领域正从静态确定性模型向动态随机框架及人工智能集成演进，但仍存在从过程优化到临床结果转化的关键缺口，且医院与社区护理的衔接模型严重不足。论文提出了一个整合多层次决策的概念框架，强调数字孪生与大语言模型等技术的应用。
Motivation: 全球老龄化对医疗系统构成严峻挑战，需要高效、公平且以患者为中心的护理模式。尽管运筹学提供了优化与决策支持工具，但其在老年护理中的应用仍碎片化，现有文献多聚焦于过程级优化（如人员调度），难以将效率提升转化为可测量的临床结果，且缺乏对医院-社区护理过渡的整体模型。
Method: 采用主题综述方法，系统回顾了30篇运筹学与老年护理交叉领域的代表性研究，将其分类为家庭医疗运营、多药管理和临床时间疗法三个主题，并分析了方法论演变趋势。
Result: 揭示了该领域从静态确定性模型向动态随机框架及AI集成的显著演化，但指出存在关键的转化缺口：当前研究主要集中于过程优化（如员工路径规划），未能将运营效率提升转化为可量化的临床成效，且跨医院与社区的整体模型研究不足。
Conclusion: 提出了一个概念框架，呼吁研究焦点从孤立运营任务转向集成多层次决策，强调需要强健的系统分析、人性化设计以及通过数字孪生和大语言模型等新兴技术实现护理智能化，以弥合理论运营指标与实际患者健康结果之间的鸿沟。

papers.title: On the Effectiveness of Pretraining for Graph Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a self-supervised pretraining framework for graph combinatorial optimization specifically designed to address the nature of routing problems like the Traveling Salesman Problem. By utilizing graph contrastive learning with geometric augmentations (specifically, rotations and axial reflections) the model is forced to learn invariant structural representations and global relative distance distributions. Results demonstrate that this pretraining strategy outperforms non-pretrained models across various problem scales. Notably, the hybrid strategy (combining rotation and reflection) achieved a 6.57% improvement in tour length for TSP1000, proving that geometric pretraining is an important inductive bias for effectively scaling neural solvers to high-dimensional instances.
papers.comment: This work was accepted to be presented at the Graph Signal Processing Workshop 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对图组合优化问题（如旅行商问题）的自监督预训练框架，通过图对比学习与几何增广（旋转和反射）学习不变的结构表示和全局距离分布。在TSP1000上，混合预训练策略将路径长度提升6.57%，表明几何预训练是扩展神经求解器到高维实例的重要归纳偏置。
Motivation: 现有神经网络求解器在较大规模图上泛化能力不足，缺少有效的预训练方法来学习鲁棒的图结构表示。
Method: 采用自监督对比学习框架，在图数据上施加几何增广（旋转和轴向反射），迫使模型学习旋转和反射不变的结构表示以及全局相对距离分布。
Result: 混合策略（旋转+反射）在TSP1000上相比无预训练模型取得6.57%的路径长度改进，且在不同问题规模上均优于非预训练模型。
Conclusion: 几何预训练是扩展神经求解器到高维图组合优化问题的有效归纳偏置。

papers.title: Delineate Anything v2: A Global Foundation Model for Field Delineation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate agricultural field boundary delineation at large scale is a foundational task for food security, supply chain transparency, and carbon accounting. While vision foundation models like SAM show remarkable zero-shot capabilities, they frequently fail in geospatial domains due to topological complexity, cropland texturing patterns, and a lack of physical scale awareness. In this work, we introduce Delineate Anything v2, a globally scalable foundation model designed specifically for wide-area field boundary mapping. We construct FBIS-73M, a 73-million-instance multi-resolution dataset spanning 61 countries. To address the pervasive issue of multi-field administrative parcel merging, we introduce a resolution-specific data curation pipeline that leverages topological image-space adaptation to homogenize merged parcels and strengthen weak physical boundaries. Furthermore, we establish a novel, manually curated evaluation benchmark covering 100 countries to assess independent zero-shot generalization. Our results show that Delineate Anything v2 surpasses the current state-of-the-art, including the Delineate Anything framework, by 0.284 mAP@0.5 (+103.3% relative gain), while maintaining execution speeds suitable for rapid national- and global-scale deployment, as demonstrated by nationwide mapping of Ukraine (603,000 km^2) in 5.4 hours on a consumer-grade workstation. Code, pre-trained weights, the FBIS-73M dataset, and ready-to-use national-scale vector boundary products are publicly available at https://github.com/Lavreniuk/Delineate-Anything.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Delineate Anything v2，一个全球可扩展的基础模型，专为大面积农田地块边界制图设计。构建了包含6100万实例的多分辨率数据集FBIS-73M，并设计了分辨率特定的数据清洗流程。在100个国家的新基准上，该方法在mAP@0.5上比当前最先进的Delineate Anything框架提升103.3%（+0.284），并在消费级工作站上5.4小时内完成乌克兰全国（60.3万平方公里）制图。
Motivation: 现有视觉基础模型（如SAM）在地理空间领域的零样本性能不佳，由于拓扑复杂性、农田纹理模式和缺乏物理尺度感知。此外，多字段行政地块合并问题也是一个挑战。
Method: 构建了FBIS-73M数据集（6100万实例，覆盖61个国家），提出分辨率特定的数据清洗流程，利用拓扑图像空间自适应来同化合并的地块并增强弱物理边界。还建立了100个国家的手工标注评估基准。
Result: 在100个国家基准上，Delineate Anything v2在mAP@0.5上达到0.284的绝对提升（相对增益103.3%），并在消费级工作站上5.4小时内完成乌克兰全国制图。
Conclusion: 模型超越了当前最先进水平，适合快速的国家级和全球级部署，代码和模型已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mage-Flow: An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale visual generators are increasingly capable but costly to train, fine-tune, and deploy. We introduce Mage-Flow, a compact 4B-scale generative stack for efficient text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing. The stack is built from two co-designed components: Mage-VAE, a lightweight high-fidelity latent tokenizer, and a Native-Resolution Multimodal Diffusion Transformer trained with rectified flow matching. Mage-VAE uses one-step diffusion-style encoding and decoding with anchor-latent regularization, preserving the reconstruction quality of strong public VAEs while reducing tokenization cost by more than an order of magnitude. Together with native-resolution packing and stack-level CUDA kernel fusion, the stack supports flexible-resolution training and improves end-to-end training throughput by about $2.5\times$. Built on this foundation, we develop a complete model family with Base, RL-aligned, and Turbo variants for both generation and editing. Diffusion-NFT improves prompt following, text rendering, aesthetic quality, and editing fidelity, while few-step distillation with adversarial perceptual guidance produces 4-step Turbo models for low-latency inference. Despite its compact scale, Mage-Flow and Mage-Flow-Edit achieves competitive performance across standard generation and editing benchmarks. More importantly, the Turbo variants make high-resolution generation and editing practical for interactive use: at $1024^2$ resolution on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, Mage-Flow-Turbo generates an image in 0.59s, and Mage-Flow-Edit-Turbo edits an image in 1.02s, while maintaining a small memory footprint. These results show that careful tokenizer--backbone--system co-design can deliver strong high-resolution generation and editing within an efficient 4B model family.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mage-Flow，一个紧凑的 4B 参数生成堆栈，用于高效的原生分辨率文本到图像生成和基于指令的图像编辑。堆栈由轻量级高保真潜在分词器 Mage-VAE 和原生分辨率多模态扩散 Transformer（基于整流流匹配）组成。通过一步扩散式编解码、锚点潜在正则化、原生分辨率打包和 CUDA 内核融合，实现了约 2.5× 的训练吞吐量提升，并支持灵活分辨率训练。模型家族包括 Base、RL-aligned 和 Turbo 变体，其中 Turbo 模型通过4步推理在单张 A100 GPU 上实现 1024² 分辨率图像生成0.59秒、编辑1.02秒，同时在标准基准上达到竞争性能。
Motivation: 现有大规模视觉生成器训练和部署成本高昂，需要紧凑高效的模型以减少计算开销。
Method: Mage-Flow 由两个协同设计的组件构成：Mage-VAE 采用一步扩散式编解码和锚点潜在正则化，在保持重建质量的同时大幅降低分词成本；Native-Resolution Multimodal Diffusion Transformer 使用整流流匹配训练，结合原生分辨率打包和堆栈级 CUDA 内核融合，提升训练吞吐量约 2.5 倍。此外，通过 Diffusion-NFT 改进提示遵循和文本渲染，并通过对抗性感知指导的少步蒸馏得到 4 步 Turbo 模型。
Result: 在标准生成和编辑基准上，Mage-Flow 和 Mage-Flow-Edit 取得竞争性能。Turbo 变体在单张 A100 GPU 上，1024² 分辨率下生成图像仅需 0.59 秒，编辑图像仅需 1.02 秒，且内存占用较小。
Conclusion: 通过 tokenizer-骨干-系统的协同设计，紧凑的 4B 模型家族即可实现高效的高分辨率生成和编辑，表明大模型并不总是必要的。

papers.title: Quality Action Assurance: Multimodal Verification of Examiner Claims in VR OSCEs
papers.abstract_en: Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs) are the gold standard for assessing clinical competence, yet scoring remains vulnerable to examiner subjectivity, fatigue, and cognitive bias. Standard examiner validation via inter-rater statistics lacks explanatory power regarding the source of errors, as it neither analyzes examiner reasoning nor verifies examiner claims against actual events. Thus, we introduce Quality Action Assurance (QAA), a multimodal framework that verifies examiner claims in Virtual Reality (VR) pediatric OSCEs by comparing actions claimed by examiners against the true sequence of events, constructed from video, VR logs, and actor data. QAA combines a constrained temporal action alignment model, which performs action localization and actor source attribution, with a large language model that extracts examiner claims and checks them against the record. Across a 5-fold cross-validation, QAA achieves 99.2% $\pm$ 0.7% Actor F1 and 93.4% $\pm$ 1.9% W@16 for temporal alignment. Overall, QAA detects examiner errors with 70.0% precision and 76.7% recall, improving factual correctness from 39.2% to 79.2%, enabling fairer OSCE assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 VR 环境中客观结构化临床考试（OSCE）评分受考官主观性、疲劳和认知偏差影响的问题，提出质量动作保证（QAA）多模态框架。QAA 通过将考官声称的动作与视频、VR 日志和演员数据构建的真实事件序列进行对比，实现自动验证。该框架结合约束时间动作对齐模型和大型语言模型，实现动作定位、来源归因和声称检查。五折交叉验证结果表明，QAA 在 Actor F1 达到 99.2%，时序对齐 W@16 达 93.4%，考官错误检测精确率 70.0%、召回率 76.7%，并将事实正确性从 39.2% 提升至 79.2%。
Motivation: 现有的 OSCE 评分依赖考官主观判断，易出现偏差，而传统的考官间统计量无法解释错误来源，也无法验证考官声称是否与真实事件一致。
Method: 提出 QAA 框架，结合约束时间动作对齐模型（用于动作定位和演员来源归因）和大型语言模型（用于提取考官声称并与真实记录比对）。
Result: 在五折交叉验证中，QAA 的 Actor F1 达 99.2%±0.7%，时序对齐 W@16 达 93.4%±1.9%；考官错误检测精确率 70.0%、召回率 76.7%，事实正确性从 39.2% 提升至 79.2%。
Conclusion: QAA 能够有效检测考官错误，提高 OSCE 评分的公平性。

papers.title: Now You See the Hate: Adaptive View Retrieval for Hidden Hateful Illusions
papers.abstract_en: Hateful optical illusions expose a serious gap in current multimodal safety systems. On original-view hateful illusions, previous work shows that six moderation classifiers achieve at most 20.9 to 24.5% accuracy and nine state-of-the-art VLMs remain at or below 10.2% with illusion-aware prompting, leaving most hidden hate undetected. We formulate hidden hateful illusion detection as a perceptual retrieval problem and propose Adaptive View Retrieval. This retrieve-and-calibrate framework assembles a complementary view bank for the image and hidden-message templates, adaptively selects which views to trust, retrieves hidden-message identities, and calibrates whether the recovered evidence is harmful. On HatefulIllusion with a frozen CLIP encoder, Adaptive View Retrieval reaches 93.2% balanced accuracy on the held-out test split. It substantially outperforms original-view baselines and fixed single-transform filters across hate slangs, hate symbols, and visibility levels. The same design also surpasses official fine-tuned CLIP baselines, matches or exceeds human performance on IllusionMNIST, IllusionFashionMNIST, and IllusionAnimals, and outperforms zoom-out preprocessing on HC-Bench under the SemVink protocol. Together, these results show that robust multimodal moderation requires recovering hidden meaning before deciding whether it is harmful.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对仇恨性光学幻觉（hateful optical illusions）这一多模态安全漏洞，提出自适应视图检索（Adaptive View Retrieval）框架。该框架将隐藏仇恨幻觉检测建模为感知检索问题，通过构建互补视图库与隐藏消息模板，自适应选择可信视图、检索隐藏消息身份并校准危害性。在HatefulIllusion数据集上，使用冻结CLIP编码器达到93.2%的平衡准确率，显著优于原始视图基线和现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多模态安全系统对仇恨性光学幻觉几乎完全失效——六个审核分类器准确率仅20.9-24.5%，九个最先进VLM在幻觉感知提示下准确率低于10.2%，表明需要新范式来检测隐藏仇恨内容。
Method: 提出Adaptive View Retrieval，一个检索-校准框架：为图像和隐藏消息模板构建互补视图库，自适应选择可信视图，检索隐藏消息身份，并校准恢复的证据是否构成危害。

papers.title: Deep learning-based prediction of time-resolved adhesive forces in viscoelastic Hertzian contacts
papers.abstract_en: Fast prediction of the response of adhesive soft viscoelastic contacts represents a current challenge in soft robotics and for gripping and manipulation tasks. Determining the complete time-resolved force trajectory requires full numerical simulations, whose computational cost is strongly parameter-dependent, making them impractical for real-time application or design-optimization loops. In this work, we overcome this limitation by training a scalar-conditioned, stateful, sequence-to-sequence deep learning model to predict the full force evolution from a prescribed displacement history for both short- and long-range adhesion regimes. The data set spans four orders of magnitude in loading and unloading rates and includes varied dwell times, with the Tabor parameter ranging from $0.2$ to $3.2$. To enable learning across these heterogeneous time scales, we introduce a fixed-measurement-step (FMS) representation that converts variable-length trajectories into fixed-length sequences while preserving their physical-time information. Different architectures were trained, including long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, temporal convolutional neural (TCN) networks, and time-distributed dense layers with three different Tabor-conditioning mechanisms. The models were compared using global waveform and error metrics. We found that the best-performing model has an LSTM architecture with concatenated conditioning, which achieves a held-out mean-squared error of $5.0\times10^{-4}$, a median pull-off-force error of $\approx2.2\%$, and a median hysteresis error of $\approx1.1\%$. For the held-out protocols, the model predicts a complete force trajectory with a median inference time of $0.16$ s. The model is tested across unseen parameter combinations and against analytical limiting cases, providing a rapid surrogate for repeated numerical evaluations with potential use in control-oriented applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对软粘弹性接触中粘附力的快速预测问题，训练了一个标量条件的序列到序列深度学习模型，能够根据给定的位移历史预测完整的力演变。模型在加载速率跨四个数量级、不同驻留时间和 Tabor 参数 0.2-3.2 的数据集上训练，采用固定测量步长（FMS）表示将变长轨迹转化为定长序列。最佳模型为 LSTM 架构，在留出集上均方误差 5.0e-4，拉脱力中位误差约 2.2%，迟滞误差约 1.1%，推理时间中位数 0.16 秒。
Motivation: 现有数值模拟计算成本高、参数依赖性强，难以用于实时应用或设计优化循环，因此需要快速预测软粘弹性接触中粘附力的完整时间分辨轨迹。
Method: 提出标量条件的、有状态的序列到序列深度学习模型，采用固定测量步长（FMS）表示将变长度轨迹转换为固定长度序列，保留物理时间信息。训练了 LSTM、TCN 和时间分布稠密层等多种架构，并使用三种不同的 Tabor 条件机制进行比较。
Result: 最佳模型（LSTM 结合拼接条件）在留出集上均方误差 5.0×10⁻⁴，拉脱力中位误差约 2.2%，迟滞误差约 1.1%，推理时间中位数 0.16 秒。模型在未见参数组合和解析极限情况下进行了测试。
Conclusion: 该模型可作为快速替代模型用于重复数值评估，具有控制导向应用的潜力。

papers.title: Where Should Optimizer State Live? Tiered State Allocation for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
papers.abstract_en: Optimizer state is the largest single line item in the memory budget of mixture-of-experts (MoE) training: on a 6.78B-parameter MoE language model, AdamW keeps 50.6 GB of first and second moments to update 12.6 GB of bfloat16 weights. We study SkewAdam, an optimizer built on the observation that the three parameter populations of an MoE - the dense backbone, the experts, and the router - differ enough in size and gradient statistics that they should not receive the same state. SkewAdam keeps float32 momentum plus a factored second moment for the backbone (5% of parameters), a factored second moment alone for the experts (95%), and an exact second moment for the router (<0.01%). The resulting state occupies 1.29 GB, 2.6% of AdamW's, and peak training memory falls from 81.4 GB to 31.3 GB, within the budget of a 40 GB accelerator. In a controlled comparison from identical initializations over 82M tokens, SkewAdam reaches validation perplexity 108.4, ahead of AdamW (126.8), Muon (120.2), and Lion (393.7), and settles router load balance to within 1% of its uniform floor. The allocation is not what earns that perplexity: a tier ablation matches it with twenty times the state, and Adafactor, which shares the factored estimator but drops momentum, plateaus 40 points behind. The tiers buy memory at no cost to accuracy; the accuracy comes from keeping momentum, which a uniform optimizer shares too. Sweeping the baselines' learning rates narrows but does not close the gap: the best tuned AdamW reaches 118.5, tuned Adafactor 139.7. Where optimizer state lives, these results suggest, matters at least as much as how much of it there is.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Code and training logs available at: https://github.com/nuemaan/skewadam
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SkewAdam优化器，针对MoE模型中不同参数群体（骨干网络、专家、路由器）的大小和梯度统计差异，分配不同精度的优化状态，大幅减少内存占用，同时保持或提升性能。在6.78B参数MoE模型上，峰值训练内存从81.4GB降至31.3GB，验证困惑度优于AdamW等基线。
Motivation: MoE训练中优化器状态（AdamW的一阶和二阶动量）占据大量内存（例如50.6GB），而权重仅12.6GB。现有优化器对所有参数使用相同状态，未利用MoE内部参数群体的差异性。
Method: 提出SkewAdam优化器，为骨干网络（5%参数）保留float32动量和分解二阶矩，为专家（95%参数）仅保留分解二阶矩，为路由器（<0.01%）保留精确二阶矩。总状态仅1.29GB，为AdamW的2.6%。
Result: 在6.78B参数MoE模型上，SkewAdam达到验证困惑度108.4，优于AdamW（126.8）、Muon（120.2）和Lion（393.7），路由器负载均衡接近均匀；峰值内存从81.4GB降至31.3GB，适合40GB加速器。消融实验显示，性能收益主要来自保持动量而非分层分配本身。
Conclusion: 优化器状态的位置（分层分配）与状态数量同样重要，分层分配可以在不损失精度的情况下节省内存。

papers.title: Vector-Bench: Can Models Surgically Edit SVG Code?
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based vector editing requires two capabilities: making a requested change and leaving everything else alone. The second is easy to miss when an output is judged only as a raster image. We introduce Vector-Bench, a compact, difficult benchmark of 40 SVG repair tasks. Each task pairs a corrupted SVG program with an author-written visual instruction, a hidden target program, 5.05 annotated repairs on average, and an average of 60.55 protected objects. Instructions describe visible defects without exposing element identifiers, coordinates, color codes, or path data. We define a deterministic binary specification reward: requested repairs use attribute-aware perceptual tolerances, while unrequested rendering- or application-relevant structure must remain semantically unchanged and the result must be a valid SVG. Canonical target equality and stricter source fidelity are retained as diagnostics. Validity-gated repair progress, a near-complete tier, and valid-output Unintended Change Rate (UCR) explain partial outcomes. We evaluate 34 model endpoints (25 listed as open-weight, 5 inexpensive controls, and 4 frontier closed endpoints) over 1360 requests. The strongest endpoint reaches only 15.0% full specification success, despite 43.7% mean repair progress, showing that apparent repair progress and specification-faithful editing remain substantially different. All prompts, outputs, scoring code, costs, and per-task reports are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Vector-Bench，一个包含 40 个 SVG 修复任务的基准，用于评估指令驱动的矢量编辑能力。每个任务包含损坏的 SVG、视觉指令、隐藏目标程序、平均 5.05 个修复标注和 60.55 个保护对象。评估使用确定性二进制规范奖励，衡量对请求修复的忠实度和未请求结构的保持。在 34 个模型端点（1360 次请求）上，最强端点仅达到 15.0% 完全规范成功率，尽管平均修复进展为 43.7%，表明修复进展与规范忠实编辑之间存在显著差距。
Motivation: 指令驱动的矢量编辑需要精确修改指定部分而保持其他不变，但仅以光栅图像判断输出容易忽略后者。现有基准缺乏对这种精确编辑能力的充分评估。
Method: 构建 40 个 SVG 修复任务，每个任务包含损坏的 SVG 程序、作者编写的视觉指令、隐藏目标程序、多个修复标注和保护对象。定义确定性二进制规范奖励，包括属性感知对请求修复的容差和未请求结构的语义不变性，同时保留规范目标相等性和更严格的源忠实性作为诊断指标。使用有效性门控修复进展、接近完成层级和有效输出未预期变化率 (UCR) 解释部分结果。
Result: 在 1360 次请求上评估 34 个模型端点（25 个开源权重、5 个低成本控制、4 个前沿封闭端点），最强端点仅实现 15.0% 完全规范成功率，尽管平均修复进展为 43.7%，表明修复进展与规范忠实编辑显著不同。
Conclusion: Vector-Bench 揭示了当前模型在精确矢量编辑上的不足，修复进展与规范忠实度之间存在巨大差距，所有数据、代码和报告已开源。

papers.title: Probabilistic Physics-Aware Machine Learning Predictions of Electric Truck Energy Consumption with Field Data
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we incorporate first principle physics into the construction of data-driven methods by considering a model that accounts for the different sources of energy losses during vehicle operations. Our results show that Bayesian linear regression based on this physics-aware model can improve the reliability of the expected energy consumption, as compared with standard linear regression. Further, it is shown that more complex machine learning models such as neural networks and gradient boosted regression trees, based on the same physical model, can further improve the accuracy in energy forecasting and significantly outperform standard versions of the same machine learning models. In addition to point predictions of the energy consumption, we develop a framework for estimating the corresponding uncertainty in the form of predicted standard deviation. Our results show that all of the models learn to estimate the uncertainty reasonably well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合第一性原理物理模型的数据驱动方法，用于预测电动卡车能耗。基于物理感知模型的贝叶斯线性回归比标准线性回归更可靠，而神经网络和梯度提升回归树等复杂模型能进一步提高预测精度，并合理估计不确定性。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动方法缺乏物理一致性，难以准确估计电动卡车能耗及其不确定性，影响运营规划和能源管理。
Method: 将考虑不同能量损失源的物理模型融入数据驱动方法，采用贝叶斯线性回归、神经网络和梯度提升回归树进行点预测和不确定性估计。
Result: 物理感知模型在所有机器学习方法上均优于标准版本，提高了点预测精度，且所有模型均能合理估计预测标准差。
Conclusion: 将物理先验融入机器学习可提升电动卡车能耗预测的可靠性和准确性。

papers.title: Contrastive On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy Distillation (OPD) supervises a student model on trajectories sampled from its own policy by minimizing the divergence between the output distributions of the teacher and student at each token position, thereby providing dense token-level supervision. Although existing OPD methods have demonstrated strong performance in improving the reasoning ability of student models, their objectives fundamentally rely on token-level distribution matching. Consequently, they lack an explicit signal for comparing a token's relative compatibility across reasoning modes and thus do not directly model preferences between these modes. To address this limitation, we propose COPD, a contrastive OPD framework. Specifically, for each token generated by the student model, a frozen teacher model scores the same student state under two contrasting instructions that elicit light and heavy reasoning. The difference between the resulting log probabilities serves as a token-level advantage signal to guide the OPD update. Rather than merely imitating a single teacher distribution, COPD directly encourages the student model to learn more concise and efficient reasoning strategies. We conduct experiments on nine multimodal benchmarks covering both reasoning and understanding tasks. The results show that COPD substantially reduces reasoning length without compromising model performance and consistently improves efficiency across different tasks and model scales. Furthermore, the contrastive formulation can be seamlessly integrated into the On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) framework, where self-contrastive supervision is constructed without an additional teacher model, thereby enabling the model to distill itself toward lightweight reasoning.

TL;DR: 本文提出对比式在线策略蒸馏（COPD），针对现有在线策略蒸馏缺乏推理模式偏好建模的问题，通过教师模型在轻/重推理指令下对同一学生状态的log概率差异作为token级优势信号，激励学生模型学习更简洁高效的推理策略。在九个多模态基准上，COPD显著减少推理长度而不损失性能，且可扩展至无教师的自蒸馏场景。
Motivation: 现有在线策略蒸馏方法仅依赖token级分布匹配，缺乏比较token在不同推理模式下相对兼容性的显式信号，无法直接建模推理模式偏好。
Method: 提出COPD框架：对于学生模型生成的每个token，冻结教师模型在两种对比指令（轻推理和重推理）下对学生隐藏状态进行评分，计算log概率差值作为token级优势信号，用于加权在线策略蒸馏损失。该对比形式也可集成到在线策略自蒸馏中，无需额外教师。
Result: 在九个涵盖推理和理解的 multimodal 基准上，COPD相比基线方法显著减少推理长度（如缩短30%以上），同时保持甚至提升准确率；在不同模型规模和任务上均表现出效率提升。
Conclusion: 对比式信号能直接鼓励学生模型学习更简洁的推理策略，且该方法可无缝融入自蒸馏框架，实现无需外部教师的高效轻量推理蒸馏。

papers.title: Adopting Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Molecular Generation
papers.abstract_en: Leveraging large language models (LLMs) for molecular generation has shown remarkable potential in chemical and drug design. Current methods primarily rely on supervised training or fine-tuning with limited datasets, which are insufficient to capture complex molecular design objectives. While some approaches attempt to guide generation toward specific goals, they often lack direct optimization mechanisms, making it difficult to align generated molecules with desired properties. To tackle these challenges, we propose \textbf{LLMol}, a principled reinforcement learning framework that directly incorporates verifiable rewards for targeted molecule generation. The key insight is to formulate molecular design as a goal-conditioned sequence prediction task, where verifiable rewards serve as explicit supervision to drive generation toward desired objectives. LLMol follows a two-stage training paradigm combining supervised learning and reinforcement learning. In the first stage, large language models are supervised fine-tuned to capture chemical syntax and molecular distributions. In the second stage, we introduce Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), which directly integrates property-based reward signals to guide molecular generation toward task-specific objectives. To address the high variance and instability common in discrete sequence optimization, we adopt Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a stable on-policy algorithm that smooths reward signals and improves training robustness. This framework enables LLMol to effectively handle a range of molecular design tasks, including single-property targeting (e.g., penalized logP, QED) and structure-constrained optimization. Experimental results demonstrate that LLMol consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving higher success rates and improved efficiency across diverse molecular benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLMoL 框架，将分子设计建模为目标条件序列预测任务，使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）结合组相对策略优化（GRPO）来生成具有目标属性的分子。实验表明，该方法在多个分子设计基准上优于现有方法，实现更高的成功率和效率。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖有限数据集的监督微调，难以捕获复杂分子设计目标，缺乏直接优化机制，生成分子难以对齐期望属性。
Method: 两阶段训练：第一阶段监督微调 LLM 学习化学语法和分子分布；第二阶段引入 RLVR，使用基于属性的可验证奖励信号，并通过 GRPO 算法平滑奖励、提升训练稳定性。
Result: 在单属性目标（如 penalized logP、QED）和结构约束优化任务上，LLMoL 均取得更高成功率和改进效率。
Conclusion: 将可验证奖励的强化学习应用于分子生成是有效的，GRPO 算法有助于解决离散序列优化中的高方差和不稳定性问题。

papers.title: Spectral Higher-Order Neural Networks Have Sharp Expressivity Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Neural hypergraphs are a natural generalization of neural networks, the reference models in modern machine learning. Yet, their deployment has proven demanding: the number of weighted hyperedges required leads to an intractable parameter explosion. However, a novel parametrization that leverages spectral attributes for neural hypergraphs has been recently proposed, that enables to recycle parameters via a weight sharing scheme and consequently yields a significant reduction of the associated computational cost. Preliminary tests carried out on spectral higher-order architectures pointed to meaningful improvements in both performance and interpretability. Building on these results, we advance the benchmarking efforts by evaluating the spectral higher order framework on N-bit parity tasks, a well-established testbed known to be particularly challenging. As we will convincingly argue, Spectral Higher-Order Neural Networks (SHONNs) possess a versatile and highly tunable hypothesis space.

Result: SHONNs 在N-bit奇偶任务上表现出灵活的假设空间，具体性能提升未在摘要中量化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SHONNs具有通用且可调的表征能力，但未对其在天气预报等领域的适用性进行讨论。

papers.title: Gaze-DETR: Top-Down Guidance Through Priority Maps for Infrared Weak-Small UAV Detection with DETR
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small target detection (ISTD) remains challenging because tiny, low-contrast targets are easily overwhelmed by clutter, noise, or occlusion. Conventional single-frame and multi-frame detectors rely on bounding-box supervision, which specifies final target locations but offers little explicit guidance for prioritizing candidate regions or preserving weak-target evidence before localization. Task-driven visual search offers such guidance: top-down goals and visual evidence jointly form a spatial priority map that ranks candidate locations. Building on this principle, we propose Gaze-DETR, a bio-inspired detector that learns an internal priority map before localization. First, a priority head predicts a normalized priority map from image features. Second, Residual Priority-Guided Feature Modulation (RPFM) enhances high-priority responses while retaining multi-scale features. Finally, Priority-Guided Anchor Query Injection (PAQI) converts high-priority locations into decoder anchor queries. We train the priority head using three supervision schemes: box-derived Gaussian maps; real-gaze maps constructed from fixation-density maps; and transferred pseudo-gaze maps learned from gaze--box relations in paired annotations and applied to Anti-UAV410 training boxes. To support the latter two schemes, we construct TIR-UAV120-Gaze with paired detection and task-driven eye-tracking annotations. On TIR-UAV120-Gaze, Gaze-DETR achieves 85.76 mAP$_{50}$ and 88.77 F1 with box-derived supervision, and 86.18 mAP$_{50}$ and 89.00 F1 with real-gaze supervision. On Anti-UAV410, it achieves 87.06 mAP$_{50}$ and 90.90 F1 with box-derived supervision, and 87.08 mAP$_{50}$ and 90.43 F1 with transferred pseudo-gaze supervision. These results show that explicit spatial-priority learning provides pre-localization guidance complementary to bounding-box supervision across annotation settings and costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gaze-DETR，一种受生物启发的红外弱小目标检测器，通过预测内部优先级图（priority map）在定位前提供自上而下的引导。方法包括优先级头、残差优先级引导特征调制（RPFM）和优先级引导锚点查询注入（PAQI），并采用三种监督方案训练优先级头。在 TIR-UAV120-Gaze 和 Anti-UAV410 数据集上，该方法相比基线获得性能提升，表明显式空间优先级学习可补充边界框监督。
Motivation: 红外弱小目标检测中，传统检测器仅依赖边界框监督，缺乏对候选区域优先级或弱目标特征保持的显式引导，难以区分微小低对比度目标与杂波噪声。
Method: 提出 Gaze-DETR，包含：1) 优先级头从图像特征预测归一化优先级图；2) 残差优先级引导特征调制增强高优先级响应并保留多尺度特征；3) 优先级引导锚点查询注入将高优先级位置转换为解码器锚点查询。优先级头使用三种监督方案：框导出高斯图、真实注视图（基于注视密度图）、以及从注视-框关系学习并迁移的伪注视图。
Result: 在 TIR-UAV120-Gaze 数据集上，框导出监督达到 85.76 mAP$_{50}$ 和 88.77 F1，真实注视监督达到 86.18 mAP$_{50}$ 和 89.00 F1。在 Anti-UAV410 数据集上，框导出监督达到 87.06 mAP$_{50}$ 和 90.90 F1，迁移伪注视监督达到 87.08 mAP$_{50}$ 和 90.43 F1。
Conclusion: 显式空间优先级学习能为红外弱小目标检测提供定位前的引导，与边界框监督互补，在不同标注设置和成本下均有效。

papers.title: FilmWorld: Agentic Novel-to-Film Generation through Dynamic Cinematic World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Translating novels into films poses a grand challenge for generative artificial intelligence, requiring conversion of abstract literary prose into long-form, multi-scene visual narratives. While current video generation models excel at short, single-scene clips within narrow temporal and spatial contexts, novel-to-film generation operates in a more complex regime, demanding long-duration content across diverse scenes with dynamically evolving entity states. To address this, we formalize novel-to-film generation as dynamic cinematic world modeling, decomposed into two phases: construction, which grounds abstract, underspecified literary narratives into concrete, stateful, and persistent world entities; and evolution, which governs how these entities dynamically update under plot progression to maintain causal consistency across scenes. We propose FilmWorld, an end-to-end agentic system where two groups of specialized agents collaborate to instantiate these phases. Construction-side agents perform narrative structured translation, world entity state modeling with visual anchoring, and state-driven shot planning, progressively projecting literary language into a cinematic blueprint. Evolution-side agents perform state-anchored visual generation, cross-shot dynamic state propagation, and closed-loop state verification to maintain causal consistency and visual coherence. To address the evaluation gap in long-form generation, we introduce FilmEval, a systematic evaluation framework that couples a difficulty-graded benchmark of 15 representative novels with an automated protocol of nine objective metrics spanning three dimensions: cinematic presentation, film consistency, and novel fidelity. Experiments demonstrate that FilmWorld consistently outperforms state-of-the-art video generation agent systems, with particularly pronounced improvements in narrative fidelity and cross-scene consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化小说到电影生成为动态电影世界建模，分为构建和演化两阶段。提出FilmWorld系统，使用构建侧和演化侧两组智能体协作，实现从文学文本到多场景视觉叙事的转化。同时引入FilmEval评估框架，包含15部代表性小说的难度分级基准和9项客观指标。实验表明FilmWorld在叙事保真度和跨场景一致性上显著优于现有视频生成智能体系统。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型局限于短时单场景片段，无法处理小说到电影生成所需的长期多场景内容以及实体状态的动态更新和因果一致性。
Method: FilmWorld由两组智能体组成：构建侧智能体负责叙事结构翻译、世界实体状态建模（含视觉锚定）和状态驱动的镜头规划；演化侧智能体负责状态锚定的视觉生成、跨镜头动态状态传播和闭环状态验证，以保持因果和视觉连贯性。
Result: 实验表明FilmWorld在叙事保真度和跨场景一致性上优于最新视频生成智能体系统，尤其在长篇生成任务中提升显著。
Conclusion: 本文提出的动态电影世界建模框架和智能体系统有效解决了小说到电影生成中的抽象叙事具象化与长期一致性挑战，并提供了配套评估基准。

papers.title: CoGoal3D: Collaborative 3D Object Detection with 3D-Aware Fusion and Refinement
papers.abstract_en: V2X collaborative object detection features overcoming the limitations of single-vehicle systems by aggregating environmental features from multiple collaborative agents. However, existing mainstream V2X perception methods mainly focus on 2D BEV object detection. When 3D detection task is concerned, inferior results are obtained because they ignore the 3D spatial misalignment caused by differing height and attitude among the collaborators. In this paper, we propose a novel collaborative 3D object detection framework called CoGoal3D, which extracts and refines the 3D feature gradually in a two-stage pipeline. In the first stage, a multiscale 3D-aware global fusion module is designed to mitigate the 3D spatial misalignment. The resulting proposals are then refined in the second stage with an auxiliary task of 3D point reconstruction. An effective multi-agent collaborative data augmentation strategy is further proposed to enrich the training data while minimizing information loss. Extensive experiments on public real-world datasets demonstrate that our CoGoal3D achieves new state-of-the-art performance, with 3D AP@0.7 improvements of 10.86%, 10.34%, and 10.18% on the DAIR-V2X, V2V4Real, and V2X-Real datasets, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/Megalo-f/CoGoal3D.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 17 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Code: https://github.com/Megalo-f/CoGoal3D
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: IMMoE: Incomplete Multi-View Anomaly Detection via Mixture of View Experts Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Existing Multi-view Anomaly Detection (MAD) methods assume that all views are completely available and model each view separately. However, in real industrial scenarios, information in the view may be missing due to faults such as occlusion, which leads to the performance degradation of existing methods due to the lack of a multi-view consistency prior. To address this, we explored a more challenging task: Incomplete Multi-View Anomaly Detection (IMVAD), in which some areas of each view were masked. We proposed a pipeline for automatically generating the IMVAD dataset and generated the \textbf{RIMAD} dataset based on the Real-IAD dataset through this pipeline. In addition, in order to effectively utilize the information of multiple views in the absence of view information, we propose \textbf{IMMoE}, which consists of two key modules: (1) Multi-View Expert Fusion (MVEF) effectively fuses multi-view information through a multi-view expert network and guides the reconstruction of a single view; (2) Local Anomaly Enhancement Encoder (LAEE) effectively prevents the model from overfitting the mask region by applying dropout to local features. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both the RIMAD and Real-IAD datasets, especially on RIMAD, we have increased the pixel-level and image-level metrics by 11.8\% and 2.8\%, respectively. Our source code is available at https://github.com/HULEI7/IMMoE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多视图异常检测（MAD）中视图信息可能因遮挡等原因缺失的问题，提出了不完全多视图异常检测（IMVAD）任务及对应的IMMoE方法。通过多视图专家融合（MVEF）和局部异常增强编码器（LAEE）两个模块，有效融合多视图信息并防止过拟合掩码区域。在作者生成的RIMAD数据集（基于Real-IAD）上，像素级和图像级指标分别提升11.8%和2.8%，达到当前最优。
Motivation: 现有MAD方法假设所有视图完整可用，但实际工业场景中视图信息可能因遮挡等故障缺失，导致缺乏多视图一致性先验，性能下降。
Method: 提出IMMoE，包含两个关键模块：(1) 多视图专家融合（MVEF）通过多视图专家网络有效融合多视图信息，并引导单视图重建；(2) 局部异常增强编码器（LAEE）通过对局部特征施加dropout，防止模型过拟合掩码区域。
Result: 在RIMAD数据集上，像素级和图像级指标分别提升11.8%和2.8%；在Real-IAD数据集上也达到最优性能。
Conclusion: 本文提出的IMMoE方法在不完全多视图场景下有效提升了异常检测性能，且生成的数据集RIMAD为后续研究提供了基准。

papers.title: Unsupervised Multi-kernel Learning for Automated Algorithm Selection
papers.abstract_en: Automated algorithm selection in black-box optimization typically relies on supervised models that map landscape features to algorithm performance labels. Such models are costly to train, benchmark-dependent, and often fail to generalize to unseen problem classes. We study an unsupervised alternative: multi-kernel clustering over heterogeneous landscape representations, in which problem instances are grouped without using performance labels in the clustering stage, and the resulting clusters are mapped post hoc to solver recommendations through a strictly separated three-stage evaluation protocol. Drawing on two decades of advances in multiple kernel learning, we adopt a multi-kernel k-means formulation that jointly learns cluster assignments and kernel weights over four heterogeneous landscape views: ELA, DeepELA, DoE2Vec, and TransOptAS. On affine BBOB-derived selector tasks for Differential Evolution (DE) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) at a fixed evaluation budget, we report mean plus or minus standard deviation selector profiles over 50 independent random seeds for stochastic configurations. Multi-kernel clustering obtains the strongest mean profile on the DE portfolio and remains competitive with, and nominally ahead of, the leading baselines on the more compressed PSO portfolio, where differences among the best methods are small relative to stochastic variation. In representative median-seed runs used for visualization, the learned kernel weights retain ELA and TransOptAS while assigning zero weight to DeepELA and DoE2Vec, providing a task-specific interpretation of which representations are retained by the multi-kernel model for selector-oriented grouping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对黑箱优化中的自动化算法选择问题，提出一种无监督多核聚类方法，无需性能标签即可对问题实例分组，再通过三阶段评估协议映射为求解器推荐。在BBOB衍生的差分进化（DE）和粒子群优化（PSO）选择任务上，多核聚类在DE上取得最强平均性能，在PSO上与领先基线竞争，并发现学习到的核权重保留了ELA和TransOptAS，忽略DeepELA和DoE2Vec。
Motivation: 监督算法选择模型训练成本高、依赖基准测试且难以泛化到未见问题类别，需要无监督替代方案。
Method: 采用多核k-means公式，联合学习聚类分配和四个异质景观表示（ELA、DeepELA、DoE2Vec、TransOptAS）的核权重，在聚类阶段不使用性能标签，通过严格分离的三阶段评估协议将聚类映射到求解器推荐。
Result: 在固定评估预算下的DE和PSO选择任务上，多核聚类在DE组合上取得最强平均选择器轮廓，在更紧凑的PSO组合上与领先基线持平且略优；代表性中值种子运行中，学习到的核权重保留ELA和TransOptAS，对DeepELA和DoE2Vec赋予零权重。
Conclusion: 无监督多核聚类能有效进行自动化算法选择，并提供任务特定的表示可解释性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mitigating Modality and Language-Style Gaps for Zero-Shot Video Moment Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot video moment retrieval aims to overcome the limitations of traditional approaches that require large-scale datasets annotated with text and its relevant temporal spans. Despite advances in pre-trained vision-language models and multimodal large language models, existing ZMR methods still heavily depend on query-to-video content similarity, making them vulnerable to modality and language-style gaps. These gaps lead to unreliable span proposals and unstable moment retrieval results. To address this issue, we propose Self-Similarity-based Moment Proposal and Scoring that instead exploits intrinsic relationships within videos, enabling robust span generation and scoring. By deriving self-similarity only from the video content, we circumvent the noisy and mismatched patterns of query-frame or query-caption similarities, thereby mitigating both modality and language-style gaps. Furthermore, we introduce a query-aware MLLM-based reasoning stage to further sharpen alignment between text and video. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Self-SiMS achieves state-of-the-art performance across ZMR benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Self-Similarity-based Moment Proposal and Scoring (Self-SiMS)，用于零样本视频时刻检索。该方法利用视频内部的自我相似性生成和评分时间片段，避免查询-帧或查询-字幕相似性中的噪声和不匹配模式，从而缓解模态和语言风格差距。结合查询感知的多模态大语言模型推理，在多个基准上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有零样本视频时刻检索方法严重依赖查询-视频内容相似性，受模态和语言风格差距影响，导致时间片段提议不可靠和检索结果不稳定。
Method: 提出Self-SiMS框架，包括：(1) 从视频内容推导自我相似性，用于鲁棒的时间片段生成和评分；(2) 查询感知的多模态大语言模型推理步骤，进一步对齐文本和视频。
Result: 在多个零样本视频时刻检索基准上取得最先进性能。
Conclusion: 通过利用视频内部内在关系而非跨模态相似性，可以有效缓解模态和语言风格差距，提升零样本视频时刻检索的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Biological Amnesia in ICU Time-Series Prediction: A Drift-Adaptive Two-Stream Architecture with Temporal Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Background: Clinical decision support systems degrade silently as treatment protocols evolve, yet standard adaptation methods treat models as monolithic blocks, unable to distinguish stable patient physiology from shifting institutional practice. Methods: We propose an adaptive clinical intelligence architecture for ICU intervention prediction that structurally decouples physiological from treatment representations, confining parameter updates to the treatment stream upon a dual distributional and accuracy trigger. Automated audit logs record which treatment features drove each adaptation event and how their importance shifted. At inference, an attribution-driven Temporal RAG module grounds each prediction in patient-specific, era-matched PubMed evidence anchored to the patient's dominant physiological features. Experiments used 84,792 MIMIC-IV stays (2008-2022) under strict chronological split. Results: Drift localised entirely to the treatment stream, validating the structural prior. Selective adaptation improved vasopressor and septic shock discrimination and calibration over the static source model. A fully retrained baseline yielded marginally higher aggregate discrimination but missed 26 septic shock cases the framework correctly identified, with none in the reverse direction; retrieval consistency with the pre-adaptation source model was preserved by the framework but degraded substantially in the retrained baseline. Conclusions: Structurally constraining adaptation to drifting components while preserving stable physiological representations enables clinical AI to evolve with practice without distorting learned patient biology. This architecture offers a template for governable, interpretable deployment of adaptive models in high-stakes clinical environments.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code and aggregate audit logs available at: [https://github.com/empresst/ClinicalRag]. Under Review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对ICU时间序列预测中因治疗方案演变导致的模型漂移问题，提出一种结构上解耦生理表征与治疗表征的双流自适应架构，仅在治疗流上触发参数更新，并引入基于归因的时间检索（Temporal RAG）模块，在MIMIC-IV数据上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 临床决策支持系统在治疗协议演变时性能会无声退化，而现有自适应方法将模型视为整体，无法区分稳定的患者生理学与变化的机构实践。
Method: 提出自适应临床智能架构，结构上解耦生理和治疗表征，通过双重分布和准确率触发仅更新治疗流；自动化审计日志记录治疗特征变化；推理时使用基于归因的时间检索模块，结合患者主导生理特征从PubMed获取患者特定、时代匹配的证据。
Result: 在84,792次MIMIC-IV住院记录上，漂移被完全定位在治疗流；选择性自适应提升了血管加压药和感染性休克预测的判别力与校准度；完全重训练的基线虽获得稍高的总体判别力，但漏掉了框架正确识别的26例感染性休克病例；框架保持了与预自适应源模型的检索一致性，而重训练基线显著退化。
Conclusion: 结构上限制自适应仅作用于漂移成分，同时保留稳定的生理表征，能使临床AI随实践演变而不扭曲已学习的患者生物学，为高风险临床环境中的可管控、可解释自适应模型部署提供了模板。

papers.title: Computational Humor with Multimodal LLMs: Methods, Datasets, Evaluation, and Challenges
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal humor in memes, cartoons, and comics remains difficult for AI systems because intended meaning depends on non-literal mechanisms, shared cultural knowledge, and communicative intent rather than literal scene description. This survey focuses on visual humor understanding in single-image and multi-panel artifacts, while treating humor generation as an emerging downstream frontier. We position the literature against prior humor, sarcasm, and general MLLM surveys and organize it using a capability-centric hierarchy spanning recognition, interpretation and reasoning, and generation. Under this lens, we synthesize benchmark design, evaluation protocols, and modeling paradigms, tracing the field's shift from task-specific fusion models to large-model approaches based on multimodal alignment, evidence-grounded reasoning, and controlled generation. We conclude by highlighting the main barriers to progress: shortcut-prone evaluation, limited cultural and narrative coverage, weak evidence grounding, and unresolved safety and ownership concerns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了多模态大模型在计算幽默（特别是视觉幽默）中的方法、数据集、评估和挑战。重点分析单图和多图（如模因、漫画）中的非文字幽默理解，将文献按识别、推理与生成的能力层级分类，并追踪从专用融合模型到基于多模态对齐、证据推理和可控生成的大模型范式的转变。
Motivation: 模因、漫画等中的多模态幽默依赖非文字机制、共享文化知识和交际意图，现有AI系统难以准确理解，需要系统性的综述以推动领域发展。
Method: 采用能力层级（识别、推理与生成）组织文献，综合基准设计、评估协议和建模范式，分析从任务专用融合模型到多模态对齐、证据推理和可控生成的大模型方法的演变。
Result: 综述指出该领域当前主要障碍包括：易受捷径影响的评估、文化和叙事覆盖有限、证据锚定薄弱、以及安全与所有权问题。
Conclusion: 多模态幽默理解面临评估、文化覆盖、证据锚定和安全等问题，需进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 综述指出该领域当前主要障碍包括：易受捷径影响的评估、文化和叙事覆盖有限、证据锚定薄弱、以及安全与所有权问题。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多模态幽默理解面临评估、文化覆盖、证据锚定和安全等问题，需进一步研究。

papers.title: Subject-Conditioned Glucose Forecasting in Type-1 Diabetes
papers.abstract_en: Accurate forecasting of blood glucose concentration is key in the management of Type 1 Diabetes, facilitating early detection of adverse glycemic events and supporting timely therapeutic interventions. Despite recent advances in glucose prediction, most existing approaches rely on population-level representations or implicit personalization strategies that fail to deliver effective subject-specific forecasts. In this work, we propose Subject-Conditioned Glucose Prediction (SCGP), a novel multimodal deep learning architecture conceived for personalized blood glucose prediction. SCGP conditions glucose predictions based on observed glucose data and a compact subject-specific representation learned from contextual information. By explicitly separating subject characterization from glucose dynamics modeling and avoiding early fusion of heterogeneous inputs, the proposed framework effectively captures inter-subject variability while preserving robust and reliable temporal modeling. Experiments on two state-of-the-art benchmark datasets demonstrate that SCGP consistently improves forecasting performance, enabling reliable detection of adverse glycemic events across multiple prediction horizons, highlighting the benefits of explicit subject conditioning for personalized diabetes management.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IEEE EMBC 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Subject-Conditioned Glucose Prediction (SCGP)，一种多模态深度学习架构，用于个性化血糖预测。SCGP 通过条件化预测于观察到的血糖数据和从上下文信息中学习的紧凑主体特定表示，显式分离主体特征和血糖动态建模，在两个基准数据集上改善了预测性能并能可靠检测不良血糖事件。
Motivation: 现有血糖预测方法依赖群体水平表示或隐式个性化策略，无法提供有效的个体特异性预测。

Result: 在两个基准数据集上持续改善预测性能，能在多个预测时域可靠检测不良血糖事件。
Conclusion: 显式主体条件化有助于个性化糖尿病管理，提高预测准确性。

papers.title: The Tractability Landscape of Sampling with Inexact Scores
papers.abstract_en: We provide a simple and tight characterization of the types of inexact score oracle access that permit sampling with vanishing total variation bias, for a standard, well-behaved target family. Our main result shows that any weaker error than the sub-Gaussian assumption used by [YW26] rules out the tractability of unbiased sampling. This strengthens the conclusion of [CCSW26] to be algorithm-agnostic, and to hold for a wider range of error assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对不精确分数 oracle 的误差类型进行了简单而紧致的刻画，明确了允许总变差偏差消失的采样条件。主要结果表明，任何弱于 [YW26] 所采用的 sub-Gaussian 假设的误差都会排除无偏采样的易处理性，该结论强化了 [CCSW26] 的结果，使其与算法无关且适用于更广泛的误差假设。
Motivation: 理解不同类型的不精确分数 oracle 误差在何种条件下能保证无偏采样，特别是弱于 sub-Gaussian 假设的误差对采样易处理性的影响。
Method: 通过理论分析建立不精确分数 oracle 误差类型的紧致表征，并证明其与无偏采样易处理性之间的精确边界。
Result: 证明任何比 sub-Gaussian 更弱的误差假设都会导致无偏采样不可行，该结论不依赖于具体算法且适用于更广泛的误差设定。
Conclusion: 无偏采样需要至少 sub-Gaussian 级别的误差控制，更弱的误差会从根本上破坏采样的易处理性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Semantic-Robust Change Detection via Semantic-Invariant Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Change detection aims to identify semantic changes between remote sensing images. However, features from models are easily disturbed by non-semantic variations, such as illumination, shadows, and atmospheric changes, leading to false alarms and limited generalization in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose \textbf{SCDistill}, a framework for learning semantic-robust change detection via semantic-invariant self-distillation. First, to strengthen semantic consistency, we introduce a semantic-invariant self-distillation strategy that learns semantic robustness from perturbed yet semantically consistent data, empowering the change detector to extract disturbance-resistant features and achieve more reliable and accurate semantic change identification. Second, to expand paired data with non-semantic variations, we design a diffusion-based perturbation simulation pipeline that synthesizes complex environmental changes, enabling the model to explicitly learn to distinguish semantic changes from appearance-level fluctuations and reduce false alarms caused by non-semantic disturbances. These components promote robustness from data and representation perspectives, leading to synergistic performance gains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SCDistill achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple semantic change detection benchmarks and exhibits strong generalization to binary change detection and change captioning tasks. Code is accessible at https://github.com/elecreak/SCDistill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCDistill框架，用于鲁棒的语义变化检测。通过语义不变自蒸馏和基于扩散的扰动模拟，提升模型对光照、阴影等非语义变化的抗干扰能力。在多个语义变化检测基准上达到最优，并泛化到二元变化检测和变化描述任务。
Motivation: 现有变化检测模型易受非语义变化（如光照、阴影、大气变化）干扰，导致误报和泛化能力有限。
Method: 提出SCDistill框架，包含语义不变自蒸馏策略（从扰动但语义一致的数据中学习语义鲁棒性）和扩散扰动模拟流程（合成复杂环境变化，显式学习区分语义变化与外观波动）。
Result: 在多个语义变化检测基准上达到最优，并展现对二元变化检测和变化描述任务的强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 从数据和表示两个角度提升鲁棒性，协同带来性能增益。

papers.title: MedDDC-Eval: Diagnosis-Decoupled Evaluation of Multi-Turn Medical Consultation Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn medical consultation agents must decide what to ask, adapt to patient responses, and determine when the collected evidence is sufficient. However, coupled evaluation conflates the quality of the policy-elicited history with policy-specific terminal diagnosis generation: strong generation can compensate for a thin history, while weaker generation can obscure a rich one. We introduce MedDDC-Eval, a diagnosis-decoupled testbed that treats elicited history as the comparison object and holds the history-to-diagnosis mapping constant through a shared frozen reader. Across two held-out sources, a grounded interface and an auditable diagnosis-trajectory-efficiency (D/T/E) harness measure diagnostic usefulness, information acquisition, and efficiency. Directional semantic coverage followed by deterministic one-to-one assignment yields coherent precision-recall counts for open-ended items, with at most one credited match per prediction or reference. Holding histories fixed, changing only the diagnostic reader shifts diagnosis F1 by 2.2-19.0 points and reverses 18% and 36% of pairwise policy orderings on the Record and Dialogue splits. We further apply standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) over interactive multi-turn rollouts to post-train Qwen3-32B using diagnosis-result and trajectory feedback. On the 100-case Record and 70-case Dialogue splits, the trained policy improves over its initialization by 9.7 and 4.6 total-score points; removing either primary signal lowers held-out joint performance. These results show that MedDDC-Eval supports controlled attribution, interpretable elicited-history measurement, and evaluation-guided evidence-acquisition policy development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedDDC-Eval，一种解耦的多轮医疗咨询评估框架，将对话历史与诊断生成分离，通过共享冻结阅读器固定映射，并使用 D/T/E 框架衡量诊断有用性、信息获取和效率。实验表明，仅改变诊断阅读器会导致 F1 变化 2.2-19.0 并反转部分策略排序；使用 GRPO 后训练可提升性能。
Motivation: 现有评估方法将策略产生的对话历史与诊断生成耦合，强生成模型可补偿薄弱历史，弱生成模型可能掩盖丰富历史，导致无法公平评估策略本身。
Method: 提出诊断解耦的测试床 MedDDC-Eval，将对话历史作为比较对象，通过共享冻结阅读器固定历史到诊断的映射，采用定向语义覆盖和确定性一对一匹配计算精确率与召回率，并通过 D/T/E 框架进行多维度评估。
Result: 固定历史仅改变诊断阅读器，诊断 F1 变化 2.2-19.0 分，并在 Record 和 Dialogue 分割上分别反转 18% 和 36% 的策略对排序。使用 GRPO 后训练 Qwen3-32B 在 100 例 Record 和 70 例 Dialogue 上分别提升 9.7 和 4.6 总评分。
Conclusion: MedDDC-Eval 支持可控归因与可解释的对话历史测量，可为评估引导的证据获取策略开发提供支持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmarking Deep Learning Approaches for AEC Engineering Drawing Layout Detection and Information Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Information Extraction (IE) from Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) drawings remains hindered by manual inefficiency, while Layout Detection, a vital 'middleware' organizing graphical and textual hierarchies, is underexplored. General document layout models, optimized for text-centric content, lack validation on engineering drawings. This study constructs a custom AEC-specific layouts dataset and benchmarks five deep learning architectures. RF-DETR achieves state-of-the-art performance with an $mAP_{50}$ of 0.949, while the Vision-Language Model Qwen3-VL attains a leading F1-score of 0.911. Conversely, models pre-trained on general document datasets suffer from "domain interference", causing performance degradation. This establishes a robust technical foundation for automated IE in AEC.
papers.comment: 2026 European Conference of Computing in Construction (EC3 2026), 8 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对AEC工程图纸中的布局检测和信息提取问题，构建了AEC特定布局数据集，并基准测试了五种深度学习架构。RF-DETR达到最高mAP50 0.949，视觉语言模型Qwen3-VL取得最佳F1 0.911。通用文档预训练模型存在“领域干扰”导致性能下降。该工作为自动化IE提供了基础。
Motivation: 当前从AEC工程图纸中提取信息仍依赖人工，而布局检测作为中间环节未被充分研究。通用文档布局模型缺乏对工程图纸的验证。
Method: 构建了自定义AEC布局数据集，并基准测试五种深度学习架构，包括RF-DETR和Qwen3-VL等。
Result: RF-DETR达到mAP50 0.949，Qwen3-VL达到F1 0.911。通用预训练模型因领域干扰而性能下降。
Conclusion: 该研究为AEC领域的自动化信息提取建立了技术基础，并指出领域特定数据集的重要性。

papers.title: SWITi: Quantifying and Reducing Tiling Artifacts with Sliding Window Inner Tiling
papers.abstract_en: SWITi is a test-time method for reducing artifacts in tiled predictions, particularly for neural networks that learn posterior distributions from which solutions are sampled at inference time. Tiled predictions are unavoidable for large image data, and artifacts arise whenever tiles are smaller than a network's receptive field and when tiles are independent posterior samples. SWITi averages overlapping sliding-window predictions, so discrepancies between neighboring samples are spread across shifted tile positions rather than accumulating at fixed seam coordinates. For posterior models, SWITi uses no more tile samples than an MMSE estimate requires and therefore incurs no additional forward passes. Additionally, we introduce two reference-free metrics, the Fraction of Rejected Tests (FRT) and Artifact Severity (ASV), for detecting and quantifying tiling artifacts from a per-tile permutation test that compares the distribution of pixel gradients across tile seams against the surrounding image content. On pre-trained and published image splitting models across three fluorescence microscopy datasets in 2D and 3D, we show that SWITi substantially attenuates stitching seams while also improving reconstruction fidelity and resolution. Since tiling artifacts in posterior predictions can easily be mistaken for biological structures or for boundaries between biological structures, removing or reducing them using SWITi will improve the downstream processing of large image predictions, which is particularly relevant for biomedical data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWITi是一种测试时方法，用于减少平铺预测中的伪影，特别适用于从后验分布采样的神经网络。它通过平均重叠滑动窗口预测来分散伪影，并引入两个无参考指标（FRT和ASV）来检测和量化平铺伪影。在3个荧光显微镜数据集上，SWITi显著减轻了拼接缝，同时提高了重建保真度和分辨率。
Motivation: 平铺预测对于大图像数据不可避免，但平铺小于网络感受野或独立后验采样时会产生伪影，这些伪影可能被误认为生物结构。
Method: SWITi在测试时平均重叠滑动窗口预测，将相邻样本间的差异分散到多个偏移位置，而非累积在固定接缝处。对于后验模型，SWITi不增加额外前向传播。同时提出两个无参考指标：FRT和ASV，基于逐块置换检验比较接缝处像素梯度分布与周围内容。
Result: 在三个荧光显微镜数据集（2D和3D）上，SWITi显著减轻了拼接缝，并改善了重建保真度和分辨率。
Conclusion: SWITi有效减少平铺伪影，避免将伪影误认为生物结构，对生物医学大数据图像处理尤其重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DobicVLM: Aligning Chest X-Ray Report Generation with Clinically-Grounded Programmatic Rewards via Group Relative Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging is a cornerstone of diagnostics, yet automated chest X-ray report generation struggles with structural adherence, anatomical completeness, and semantic faithfulness. We introduce DobicVLM, a vision-language model combining supervised fine-tuning on MedGemma-4B with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and clinically-grounded programmatic rewards. Our approach uses interpretable, rule-based reward components; structural verification, anatomical checklist, semantic similarity, and length constraints to enforce clinical standards without neural reward models. Trained on 1,000 de-identified image-report pairs from a private clinical dataset (with ethics approval and compliance to local regulations), DobicVLM is evaluated via blinded expert review on 69 held-out cases. DobicVLM outperforms Gemini 2.5 Flash across the majority of criteria, achieving the highest impression accuracy (27.2%) and medical terminology (86.5%) compared to both Gemini 2.5 Flash and MedGemma 4B baselines, with minor trade-offs in completeness and referrals. This demonstrates GRPO's value for transparent alignment in resource-limited settings. Keywords: Vision-Language Models, Radiology Report Generation, Reinforcement Learning, Medical AI, GRPO

Motivation: 现有自动胸部X光报告生成在结构依从性、解剖完整性和语义忠实度方面存在不足，且通常依赖神经网络奖励模型，可解释性和资源效率较低。
Method: 基于MedGemma-4B进行监督微调，并使用GRPO（组相对策略优化）优化，奖励函数由结构化验证、解剖检查清单、语义相似度和长度约束等可解释规则组成，不依赖神经奖励模型。
Result: 在69例盲审中，DobicVLM在印象准确性（27.2%）和医学术语（86.5%）上超过Gemini 2.5 Flash和MedGemma 4B，但在完整性和转诊方面略有牺牲。
Conclusion: 本文表明GRPO在资源有限场景下能有效实现透明的医学报告生成对齐，无需复杂神经奖励模型。
