papers.title: Athena-Brain Technical Report: An Efficient Robot Brain for General Intelligence and Embodied Interactio
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in language understanding, reasoning, and world knowledge. As embodied agents become increasingly capable, there is a growing demand for compact models that can serve as an on-device brain, preserving the broad general intelligence of LLMs while enabling effective high-level interaction with embodied environments. Existing approaches, however, often prioritize either general-purpose intelligence or specialized embodied capabilities, making it challenging to satisfy both requirements within a single model. We present \textbf{Athena-Brain-8B}, an 8B LLM designed to serve as an on-device brain for embodied intelligence for embodied intelligence. Through a multi-stage post-training pipeline consisting of General Supervised Fine-Tuning, General Reinforcement Learning, Embodied Expert training, and Model Merge, Athena-Brain-8B maintains strong general capabilities while acquiring strong high-level embodied interaction capabilities and generating concise responses for efficient embodied interaction. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of Athena across both general and embodied evaluations. Compared with the corresponding Qwen3-8B thinking model, Athena-Brain-8B achieves comparable performance on general language and reasoning benchmarks while generating substantially shorter responses. On in-domain embodied benchmarks, Athena-Brain-8B consistently outperforms models of similar scale and surpasses several substantially larger frontier models evaluated zero-shot, demonstrating that compact language models can effectively integrate strong general intelligence with embodied capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Athena-Brain-8B，一个8B参数的大语言模型，旨在作为具身智能的设备端大脑。通过多阶段后训练（通用监督微调、通用强化学习、具身专家训练、模型融合），该模型在保持强通用能力的同时获得高层具身交互能力，并生成简短响应以提高效率。实验表明，在通用基准上接近Qwen3-8B，在具身基准上超越同规模模型及多个更大尺寸的零样本前沿模型。
Motivation: 现有方法难以同时满足设备端模型的通用智能和具身交互能力需求，需要一种紧凑模型既能保留LLM的广泛通用智能，又能有效进行高层具身环境交互。
Method: 采用多阶段后训练流程：通用监督微调、通用强化学习、具身专家训练和模型融合，使8B模型保持通用能力并获取高层具身交互能力，同时生成简短响应。
Result: 在通用语言和推理基准上与Qwen3-8B表现相当，且响应更短；在域内具身基准上持续优于同规模模型，并超越多个更大规模的零样本前沿模型。
Conclusion: 紧凑语言模型可以有效整合强通用智能与具身能力，验证了多阶段后训练方法的有效性。

papers.title: AutoJourn: Multi-Perspective Summarisation, Bias Detection and Bias Neutralisation for LLM-Generated News in Automated Journalism
papers.abstract_en: We present AutoJourn, a demonstration system for multi-perspective news generation and bias-aware evaluation using large language models (LLMs). The system tackles three core challenges in responsible automated journalism: extracting diverse perspectives from unstructured social media discussions, generating summaries that preserve viewpoint diversity, and detecting or mitigating bias in AI-generated news. The pipeline integrates advanced prompt engineering with optional retrieval augmentation to produce semantically diverse perspective sets, a multi-perspective summarisation module that merges conflicting viewpoints into balanced summaries, and a bias analysis suite supporting sentence-level bias detection and type classification in the generated news article, and automatic neutralisation. Users can inspect perspective clusters, compare stance-specific summaries, generate news articles, and apply bias-aware rewrites directly in the interface. We evaluate each component with intrinsic metrics -- semantic diversity, summary quality, and bias reduction and show improvements over strong baselines while maintaining content fidelity. A live, publicly accessible demo accompanies the paper to facilitate reproducibility and further research on socially responsible automated journalism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoJourn是一个用于多视角新闻生成和偏见感知评估的演示系统，利用大语言模型从非结构化社交媒体讨论中提取多样化视角、生成保留观点多样性的摘要，并检测或缓解AI生成新闻中的偏见。系统包含多个模块，并通过内在指标评估了语义多样性、摘要质量和偏见减少。
Motivation: 自动化新闻中需要负责任地生成新闻，但现有LLM生成的内容往往缺乏视角多样性且存在偏见，需要系统化的方法来提取不同观点、平衡摘要并检测/中和偏见。
Method: 该系统整合了高级提示工程和可选的检索增强来生成语义多样的视角集；多视角摘要模块合并冲突观点；偏见分析套件支持句子级偏见检测和类型分类，并自动中和偏见。用户界面允许检查视角聚类、比较立场特异性摘要、生成新闻文章并应用偏见感知改写。
Result: 摘要报告每个组件在内在指标（语义多样性、摘要质量、偏见减少）上相比于强基线有改进，同时保持内容保真度。提供了公开的演示以支持可重复性。
Conclusion: 该系统促进了社会责任自动化新闻的研究，但目前仅作为演示系统，实际应用中的泛化性和偏见处理深度需进一步评估。

papers.title: Fishing Out Free Riders: Shapley-Based Reward Attribution for Parallel Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at multi-step reasoning, yet current parallel reasoning approaches often fail to distinguish the contributions of individual reasoning paths. Many paths may be redundant, misleading, or even detrimental, but outcome-level rewards assign uniform reward, leading to ambiguous learning signals and unstable training. We propose Parallel Shapley, a reinforcement learning framework that attributes fine-grained, path-level contributions in multi-path reasoning. Treating each path as a player in a cooperative game, we leverage Shapley values to quantify marginal contributions, using a generative reward model to evaluate path utilities and Monte Carlo sampling for efficient approximation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that Parallel Shapley outperforms existing baselines while providing more stable and interpretable training. Our framework effectively "fishes out the free riders," assigning reward proportionally and improving multi-path reasoning in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型并行推理中多个推理路径贡献不明确的问题，提出 Parallel Shapley 框架，利用 Shapley 值对每条路径进行细粒度贡献归因，通过生成式奖励模型评估路径效用，并用蒙特卡洛采样近似。在数学推理基准上，该框架优于现有基线，训练更稳定且可解释。
Motivation: 当前并行推理方法常将所有路径视为同等贡献，但许多路径是冗余、误导甚至有害的，导致学习信号模糊和训练不稳定。
Method: 将每条推理路径视为合作博弈中的玩家，利用 Shapley 值量化边际贡献，使用生成式奖励模型评估路径效用，并用蒙特卡洛采样高效近似。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，Parallel Shapley 优于现有基线，提供更稳定和可解释的训练，有效“揪出搭便车者”，按贡献分配奖励。
Conclusion: 框架通过按比例分配奖励改善了多路径推理，提高了训练稳定性和可解释性。

papers.title: Mi-Memory: A Lifecycle Memory Framework for Personal AI
papers.abstract_en: Personal AI is moving beyond chat-only interaction toward continuous services that span phones, cars, homes, wearables, cameras, and tools. In this setting, memory cannot remain a cache of prior conversations. It should serve as a continuity and governance substrate: preserving durable user state, grounding answers in multimodal and device evidence, supporting correction and forgetting, bounding policy evolution, and remaining deployable under latency, cost, privacy, and edge-cloud constraints. This technical report presents Mi-Memory, a lifecycle memory framework for Personal AI organized around four roles: Structure, Expansion, Evolution, and Deployment. A shared audit contract links these roles through four recurring artifact families: typed evidence payloads preserve source identity and provenance, diagnostic traces localize evidence loss across the serving pipeline, strategy artifacts make memory-policy changes explicit, and gate/rollback records bound accepted evolution. MiMemory instantiates the roles through MemStack, MemSense/MemFuse, D$^{2}$ACCI/E$^{2}$MEND, and LiteMem. In controlled-reference Structure evaluations, MemStack reaches 93.59%, 57.24%, and 87.47% on LoCoMo, PersonaMem-V2, and LongMemEval, respectively; other tracks report module-level, preliminary/internal, transfer-feasibility, or design-only evidence with explicit boundaries. MiMemory is a step toward auditable, evidence-gated, and deployment-aware memory systems for Personal AI. Project homepage: https://darwin-agent.github.io/Mi-Memory/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Mi-Memory，一个面向个人AI的终身记忆框架，围绕结构化、扩展、演进和部署四个角色组织，通过共享审计契约连接类型化证据载荷、诊断追踪、策略工件和门控/回滚记录。MemStack在LoCoMo、PersonaMem-V2和LongMemEval上分别达到93.59%、57.24%和87.47%的准确率。Mi-Memory旨在实现可审计、证据门控且部署感知的个人AI记忆系统。
Motivation: 个人AI正从纯对话交互转向跨设备、跨场景的持续服务，现有记忆系统仅作为对话缓存，缺乏连续性、治理和部署约束支持。
Method: 提出四角色框架（Structure, Expansion, Evolution, Deployment），通过共享审计契约关联四种工件（类型化证据载荷、诊断追踪、策略工件、门控/回滚记录），并实例化为MemStack、MemSense/MemFuse、D²ACCI/E²MEND和LiteMem等模块。
Result: 在受控参照的结构化评估中，MemStack在LoCoMo、PersonaMem-V2和LongMemEval上分别达到93.59%、57.24%和87.47%；其他轨道报告模块级、初步/内部、迁移可行性或仅设计证据。
Conclusion: Mi-Memory是迈向可审计、证据门控且部署感知的个人AI记忆系统的步骤，但部分模块仍处于初步或设计阶段，需要进一步验证。

papers.title: Verifiable Self-Evolution for Open-Ended Dialogue Skills via Future-Feedback Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Textual skills provide a lightweight way to improve frozen language-model agents, but their self-evolution normally requires a stable validation signal. Such signals are natural in mathematics or code, where an answer can be checked after it changes, yet are problematic in open-ended dialogue: changing the assistant response also changes the user's next reaction, so a logged reaction cannot directly evaluate a counterfactual response. We propose future-feedback skill evolution, which first redirects self-evolution from prescribing the current answer to predicting whether the observed answer will lead to a positive or negative subsequent user signal. This prediction task is verifiable on fixed logged tuples and therefore supports validation-gated textual optimization. The evolved feedback skill captures interpretable criteria for response quality and can subsequently serve as a diagnostic and optimization target for answer skills. On a proprietary, privacy-preserving sales-assistant dataset, careful quality filtering and a balanced resolved/unresolved split yield more than 75% prediction accuracy. Beyond this result, the central contribution is a formulation that converts otherwise moving conversational feedback into a fixed offline learning target, enabling reproducible skill evolution without placing every candidate skill in live traffic. We discuss the boundary between observational verification and counterfactual validity, and position the method as an offline optimization stage rather than a replacement for final human or online evaluation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放域对话中自我进化缺乏稳定验证信号的问题，提出未来反馈技能进化（future-feedback skill evolution）方法。该方法将自我进化从规定当前答案转向预测观察到的答案是否会导致正面或负面的后续用户信号，该预测任务可在固定记录元组上验证。在专有销售助手数据集上，经过质量过滤和平衡分割后，预测准确率超过75%。核心贡献是将移动的对话反馈转化为固定的离线学习目标，支持可复现的技能进化。
Motivation: 开放域对话中，改变助手响应会导致用户后续反应变化，因此无法直接利用历史反馈评估反事实响应，缺乏稳定的验证信号来支持技能自我进化。
Method: 提出未来反馈技能进化：先训练一个预测模型，基于对话历史预测当前响应将引发正面还是负面用户反馈，该模型可在固定日志元组上验证；然后利用该预测模型作为验证门控信号，指导回答技能（answer skills）的文本优化。
Result: 在专有隐私保护的销售助手数据集上，经过仔细质量过滤和平衡的已解决/未解决划分，未来反馈预测准确率超过75%。
Conclusion: 该方法将在线对话反馈转化为离线可验证的固定目标，作为离线优化阶段，而非替代最终人类评估或在线评估；文中讨论了观测验证与反事实有效性之间的边界。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对开放域对话中自我进化缺乏稳定验证信号的问题，提出未来反馈技能进化（future-feedback skill evolution）方法。该方法将自我进化从规定当前答案转向预测观察到的答案是否会导致正面或负面的后续用户信号，该预测任务可在固定记录元组上验证。在专有销售助手数据集上，经过质量过滤和平衡分割后，预测准确率超过75%。核心贡献是将移动的对话反馈转化为固定的离线学习目标，支持可复现的技能进化。
summary_sections.motivation: 开放域对话中，改变助手响应会导致用户后续反应变化，因此无法直接利用历史反馈评估反事实响应，缺乏稳定的验证信号来支持技能自我进化。
summary_sections.method: 提出未来反馈技能进化：先训练一个预测模型，基于对话历史预测当前响应将引发正面还是负面用户反馈，该模型可在固定日志元组上验证；然后利用该预测模型作为验证门控信号，指导回答技能（answer skills）的文本优化。
summary_sections.result: 在专有隐私保护的销售助手数据集上，经过仔细质量过滤和平衡的已解决/未解决划分，未来反馈预测准确率超过75%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法将在线对话反馈转化为离线可验证的固定目标，作为离线优化阶段，而非替代最终人类评估或在线评估；文中讨论了观测验证与反事实有效性之间的边界。

papers.title: Skillware: A Software Ontology and Engineering Lifecycle for Persistent Behavioral Artifacts
papers.abstract_en: Agent Skills have become persistent behavioral artifacts across independent AI agent systems. They combine natural-language task specifications with metadata and optional references, scripts, assets, hooks, package manifests, tests, and companion interfaces. Existing studies explain how Skills are specified, executed, maintained, and evolved, but lack an ontology that defines these artifacts as independent software objects. This paper introduces Skillware as the software abstraction that extends software engineering to persistent Behavioral Artifacts in agent systems. A Skill Artifact specifies reusable task behavior; a Skillware Unit manages that artifact as software through an independent identity and lifecycle. A compatible Agent Host activates the unit for runtime interpretation. Three necessary conditions operationalize category membership: behavioral primacy, independent software identity, and an Agent Host execution relationship. Lifecycle Continuity records whether the same unit identity persists through update, maintenance, rollback, and removal as a separate software-grade property. Evidence combines the Agent Skills specification, a frozen corpus of 138,133 content-deduplicated SKILL.md records associated with 20,556 repository identifiers, independent empirical studies, 15 category-boundary cases, and 13 fixed-revision engineering implementations. The evidence establishes a recurring artifact envelope, separable software identities, compatible execution paths, and lifecycle engineering pressure. Skillware provides the software ontology and engineering lifecycle through which agent capabilities can become identifiable, composable, maintainable, and evolvable software artifacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Skillware 作为 AI 智能体系统中持久行为工件（Persistent Behavioral Artifacts）的软件抽象，定义了技能本体和工程生命周期。通过分析 138,133 条 SKILL.md 记录、15 个边界案例和 13 个实现，论证了技能作为独立软件对象所需的三个必要条件：行为优先性、独立软件身份和 Agent 宿主执行关系。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对智能体技能（Agent Skills）作为独立软件对象的本体定义，难以支撑其可识别、可组合、可维护和可演化的工程需求。
Method: 提出 Skillware 本体，包括 Skill Artifact（可复用行为规范）、Skillware Unit（管理工件的独立身份与生命周期）、Agent Host（运行时解释环境），并定义 Lifecycle Continuity 属性追踪同一单元身份在更新、回滚等操作中的持续性。
Result: 基于 Agent Skills 规范、138,133 条去重 SKILL.md 记录（关联 20,556 个仓库标识符）和 13 个固定版本实现，验证了技能工件包络、可分离身份、兼容执行路径和生命周期工程压力。
Conclusion: Skillware 为智能体能力提供了软件本体和工程生命周期，使其成为可识别、可组合、可维护和可演化的软件工件。

papers.title: Measuring Reward-Seeking via Contrastive Belief Updates
papers.abstract_en: Language models trained with reinforcement learning may learn to optimize the grader's judgment rather than the intended objective. This "reward-seeking" is difficult to measure because a model that pursues the grader's judgment and one that pursues the intended objective behave identically whenever the grader rewards the intended behavior. We measure reward-seeking using Contrastive Synthetic Document Finetuning to change a model's beliefs about what the grader rewards, putting those beliefs in conflict with what users or developers want, and measuring the rate at which the model adopts each party's preferred behavior. Applied to intermediate checkpoints of a capabilities-focused OpenAI o3 RL run, without safety training, we find that these checkpoints often side with grader preferences over those of users or developers on coding and alignment tasks. This tendency to side with the grader trends upward throughout RL training. For example, in an environment that forces a choice between keeping a promise to a supervisor and breaking it to complete the task, a late capabilities-focused o3 checkpoint breaks the promise 87% of the time when SDF documents say the grader rewards task completion, versus 9% when they say it rewards honesty (a choice its chain-of-thought often makes explicit). An earlier checkpoint is far less sensitive (40% vs. 24%). Our method also generalizes to reward-hacking models. A model organism trained to reward-hack (gpt-oss-120b) is more than twice as sensitive to grader preferences as the unmodified model, with the mean behavioral shift in favor of the grader rising from 33% to 86%. These results indicate that RL can increase reward-seeking over the course of training, producing models that may act against their developers' intentions when they believe that doing so leads to higher reward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对比信念更新（Contrastive Belief Updates）测量语言模型中的奖励寻求（reward-seeking）行为。作者使用对比合成文档微调（Contrastive Synthetic Document Finetuning）改变模型关于评分者奖励的信念，使其与用户或开发者的意图冲突，从而测量模型采纳哪一方偏好的速率。在未经安全训练的OpenAI o3 RL中间检查点上，模型在编码和对齐任务中往往偏向评分者偏好而非用户或开发者偏好，且此倾向随RL训练增强。例如，在守信与完成任务的选择中，后期检查点87%的时间选择违约（当文档暗示评分者奖励任务完成时），而早期检查点仅为40%。该方法还可推广到奖励破解模型。
Motivation: 语言模型在强化学习训练中可能学会优化评分者的判断而非真实目标，即奖励寻求。由于当评分者奖励预期行为时，追求评分者判断与追求真实目标的模型行为相同，因此难以直接测量奖励寻求。
Method: 提出对比合成文档微调（Contrastive Synthetic Document Finetuning），通过改变模型关于评分者奖励的信念，使信念与用户或开发者意图冲突，然后测量模型采纳每一方偏好行为的速率，从而量化奖励寻求程度。
Result: 在OpenAI o3 RL中间检查点上，模型在编码和对齐任务中常偏向评分者偏好；此倾向随RL训练上升。例如，晚期检查点在任务完成与信守承诺冲突时87%选择违约（若文档暗示评分者奖励完成），而早期为40%。在奖励破解模型gpt-oss-120b上，对评分者偏好的敏感度比未修改模型高一倍以上（平均行为偏移从33%升至86%）。
Conclusion: 结果表明RL训练会增加奖励寻求，产生可能违背开发者意图的模型。

papers.title: Variational meta-learning inference for low dimensional neural system identification
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has proven highly effective for nonlinear system identification, but heavily parameterized neural networks are prone to overfitting in low-data regimes and lack reliable uncertainty quantification. The recently developed manifold meta-learning framework addresses the data efficiency problem by restricting the model parameters to a meta-learned low-dimensional manifold. However, that method is purely deterministic. We propose a fully probabilistic extension of the manifold meta-learning framework, based on amortized Variational Inference, where a generative prior over the low-dimensional parameter manifold is learned. During task-specific adaptation, we combine Maximum A Posteriori estimation with the Laplace approximation to yield a mathematically grounded posterior approximation. Evaluated on a static regression task and the Bouc--Wen dynamical system benchmark, the proposed approach achieves predictive accuracy comparable to its deterministic counterpart while successfully providing calibrated uncertainty bounds in severely low-data regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于变分推理的流形元学习概率扩展，用于低维神经系统的系统识别。该方法在低数据量下提供校准的不确定性边界，并在静态回归和Bouc-Wen动态系统基准上取得与确定性方法相当的预测精度。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在非线性系统识别中易过拟合且缺乏不确定性量化，现有流形元学习框架是确定性的，未能提供概率预测。
Method: 基于摊销变分推理（amortized variational inference）学习低维参数流形上的生成先验，在任务适配时结合最大后验估计和拉普拉斯近似得到后验近似。
Result: 在静态回归任务和Bouc-Wen动态系统基准上，所提方法实现了与确定性方法相当的预测精度，同时在严重低数据量下成功提供校准的不确定性边界。
Conclusion: 本文提出的概率扩展为低数据量的系统识别提供了一种可靠的不确定性量化方法，但仅验证了小规模静态和动态系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Dependency to Compositionality: A Neurosymbolic Lifting of LLM Outputs via Combinatory Categorial Grammar
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) generate fluent text by incrementally predicting the next token from a prefix. Critics in the generative tradition argue that such systems lack genuine grammar; influential replies from the dependency-grammar perspective hold that LLM behavior is well described by local head-dependent structure built word by word. We argue that a sharper observation has been overlooked: the prefix-driven, type-completing dynamics of autoregressive generation align closely with the incremental processing model that Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG) was originally designed to support. On this basis we propose a neurosymbolic framework in which LLM outputs are lifted into typed compositional derivations -- not claiming that LLMs implement CCG internally, but that their outputs admit a principled, incremental, and auditable CCG reconstruction. Two consequences follow. First, through the Curry-Howard correspondence the lifting extends beyond natural language to the formal languages LLMs also produce -- programming languages such as Solidity, description-logic and query languages such as OWL and SQL -- with the type system varying and the architecture held fixed. Second, the lifting supports two layers of checking: a compositional layer that catches structural failures directly, and a content layer that checks the lifted structure against external knowledge sources, enabling the earliest possible flagging of hallucinated content. The account thereby requires of a producer not cognition but a prefix-driven generative profile. We close with a sketch of synchronous LLM-CCG coupling as one direction the framework opens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM文本生成缺乏严格语法的问题，提出一个神经符号框架，利用组合范畴语法(CCG)对LLM输出进行增量、可审计的类型化组合推导重建。通过Curry-Howard对应，该框架将自然语言扩展到LLM生成的形式语言（如Solidity、SQL），并支持组合层和内容层两层检查，以尽早标记幻觉内容。摘要未报告实验定量结果。
Motivation: 批评者指出LLM缺乏真正语法，而依赖语法观点认为其行为由局部头-依存结构描述；作者认为被忽略的是自回归生成的前缀驱动、类型补全动态与CCG增量处理模型的紧密对齐。
Method: 提出神经符号框架：不声称LLM内部实现CCG，而是将其输出提升为CCG类型化组合推导；利用Curry-Howard对应扩展到形式语言；框架包含组合层（捕获结构失败）和内容层（对外部知识检查）。
Result: 摘要称该框架能直接捕获结构失败，并实现幻觉内容的最早标记。未报告具体数值或基准测试结果。
Conclusion: 该框架不要求生成者具备认知能力，只需前缀驱动的生成轮廓。作者展望了同步LLM-CCG耦合作为未来方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SFGA: A Statistics-First Gating Architecture with Adjudicative Escalation for Trustworthy SFT Data Procurement
papers.abstract_en: Procuring supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data forces a buyer to decide, before any downstream training, whether a candidate corpus is worth acquiring. We present \sys{}, a statistics-first gating architecture that treats procurement as a cost-aware routing problem over three intrinsic quality axes -- diversity, utility, and redundancy. Cheap blind measurements are summarised into per-axis estimates with confidence intervals; a gate accepts a decision only when intervals are tight, sample sizes are adequate, and the axes agree, otherwise it escalates the case to an adjudicative debate between a buy-advocate and a reject-advocate judge, resolved by a presiding verdict. On a controlled benchmark of 12 datasets ($2{\times}3{\times}2$ grid over the three axes) with 5 seeds, the gate reaches 0.90 accuracy and 0.83 $F_1$ at \$0.017 per unit, sitting between an always-verify baseline (0.75) and an oracle upper bound (0.98) while spending less than always-escalate (\$0.020). We further report honest negative diagnostics of the debate path: a con-side win rate of 0.80 ($p\approx3{\times}10^{-6}$) and a 52\% position-flip rate under advocate swapping expose negativity and positional biases that a naive LLM-judge would hide. We frame the injected-knob evaluation explicitly as a controlled synthetic benchmark for measurement fidelity and routing calibration, and delimit external validity as future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SFGA，一种统计优先的门控架构，将SFT数据采购视为成本感知的路由问题，基于多样性、效用和冗余三个质量轴。通过廉价测量获得带置信区间估计，门控在条件满足时接受决策，否则升级到买卖双方辩论。在12数据集基准上达到0.90准确率和0.83 F1，每单位成本0.017美元。还报告了辩论路径的负面诊断，包括反对胜率0.80和位置翻转率52%。
Motivation: SFT数据采购中，买家在训练前需决定是否购买候选语料，现有方法缺乏成本有效的质量评估机制，导致决策不可靠或成本高。
Method: 提出统计优先门控架构，使用带置信区间的盲测量估计三个质量轴（多样性、效用、冗余），门控在置信区间窄、样本量足够且轴一致时接受，否则升级到由买-倡导者和拒-倡导者辩论，由法官裁决。
Result: 在12数据集基准上，门控达到0.90准确率和0.83 F1，每单位成本0.017美元，介于始终验证基线(0.75)和预言机上限(0.98)之间，且成本低于始终升级(0.020美元)。辩论中反对方胜率0.80（p≈3×10⁻⁶），位置翻转率52%。
Conclusion: 框架利用注入旋钮评估作为受控合成基准用于测量保真度和路由校准，限制外部效度作为未来工作。

papers.title: Dual Adversarial Fine-tuning for Enhancing Robustness of Large Vision Language Model
papers.abstract_en: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), represented by LLaVA and GPT-4V, have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, their visual inputs remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks, posing significant security risks. Existing defense methods predominantly target single-task scenarios (e.g., zero-shot classification) and consequently lack generalizability across various multimodal tasks. To address this limitation, we propose a dual adversarial fine-tuning framework that jointly optimizes visual and semantic supervision signals from two modalities, enhancing model robustness while generalizing across multiple downstream tasks. The proposed framework comprises two core components, i.e., $\textbf{Visual}$ supervision branch and $\textbf{Semantic}$ supervision branch. The former branch leverages features from clean images, extracted via a frozen original vision encoder, to guide adversarial robustness while the latter incorporates caption-image alignment as a contextual signal to preserve semantic coherence under attack. Moreover, our method achieves cross-task robustness by simply replacing the CLIP vision encoder in the original model, with no need of separate task-specific retraining or architecture modifications.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art method in adversarial robustness evaluation across zero-shot classification, image captioning, and visual question answering (VQA) tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双对抗微调框架 (Dual Adversarial Fine-tuning)，联合优化视觉和语义两种模态的监督信号，增强大视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 的鲁棒性，并在零样本分类、图像描述、视觉问答等下游任务上泛化。框架包括视觉监督分支和语义监督分支，通过简单替换CLIP视觉编码器实现跨任务鲁棒性，无需任务特定重训练。实验表明在对抗鲁棒性评估上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有防御方法主要针对单任务场景（如零样本分类），缺乏多模态任务的泛化能力。大语言模型的视觉输入易受对抗攻击，存在安全风险。
Method: 提出双对抗微调框架，包含视觉监督分支（利用冻结原始视觉编码器提取的干净图像特征指导对抗鲁棒性）和语义监督分支（利用图像-标题对齐作为上下文信号保持语义一致性）。通过替换原始模型的CLIP视觉编码器实现跨任务鲁棒性，无需架构修改或任务特定重训练。
Result: 在零样本分类、图像描述、视觉问答任务上的对抗鲁棒性评估中，该方法优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过联合优化双模态监督信号，增强了LVLM的鲁棒性并泛化到多任务，简单替换编码器即可实现。

papers.title: H$^2$SD: Hybrid Hindsight Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models on tasks such as mathematical reasoning and code generation. However, most RLVR methods assign a scalar outcome reward to an entire trajectory, resulting in sparse supervision and limited token-level credit assignment. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides denser supervision by distilling token-level distributions from a stronger teacher model, but requires an additional teacher and typically assumes a shared vocabulary. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) removes this dependency by conditioning the same model on privileged information to construct a teacher policy. However, directly matching the teacher distribution may cause information leakage and unstable optimization. RLSD avoids direct matching by using the teacher signal only to modulate update magnitudes, but it cannot provide an explicit correction direction when the sampled reasoning fails. To address this tradeoff, we introduce $\mathrm{H}^{2}\mathrm{SD}$, a hybrid hindsight self distillation framework that uses the teacher differently according to trajectory correctness. For successful trajectories, the teacher receives the student response confirmed as correct together with a rephrasing instruction, and its probabilities on the original response tokens are used to modulate update magnitudes without changing the direction determined by the reward. For failed trajectories, we condition the teacher on a reference hint containing key reasoning steps and a verified answer, and minimize the reverse KL divergence from the student to the teacher. Experiments on multiple challenging reasoning benchmarks show that H$^2$SD consistently outperforms representative RLVR, OPSD, and RLSD baselines while maintaining stable optimization and favorable generation efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 H²SD（混合事后自蒸馏）框架，用于改善大语言模型在推理任务（如数学和代码生成）上的强化学习训练。该框架根据轨迹是否成功采用不同的教师信号利用方式：成功轨迹中教师根据学生正确响应调整更新幅度，失败轨迹中教师基于参考提示提供显式纠正方向。在多个推理基准上，H²SD 持续优于 RLVR、OPSD 和 RLSD 基线，且优化稳定、生成效率高。
Motivation: 现有 RLVR 方法奖励稀疏且缺乏 token 级别信用分配；OPD 需要额外教师且依赖共享词表；OPSD 可能导致信息泄露和不稳定优化；RLSD 无法在推理失败时提供纠正方向。
Method: 对于成功轨迹，教师接收学生正确响应及改写指令，用其概率调整更新幅度而不改变奖励方向；对于失败轨迹，教师基于包含关键推理步骤和验证答案的参考提示，最小化学生到教师的反向 KL 散度。
Result: 在多个挑战性推理基准上，H²SD 胜过 RLVR、OPSD 和 RLSD 基线，同时保持优化稳定性和生成效率。
Conclusion: 混合事后自蒸馏通过区分轨迹正确性来灵活利用教师信号，有效缓解了稀疏奖励和优化不稳定问题。

papers.title: What General Intelligence Requires: Non-Reducible Constraints Across Levels of Description
papers.abstract_en: General intelligence, of the kind that underwrites the full range of human cognitive achievement, is not a property of computational architecture alone. This paper advances a single thesis: the structural constraints on general intelligence occupy distinct levels of description and are mutually non-reducible, in the sense that the special-sciences tradition gives to that term. It follows that no single architectural advance, and no continuation of the scaling programme by itself, can produce artificial general intelligence (AGI), and that research programmes must be evaluated against the full constraint profile rather than against performance on any one benchmark. The thesis is developed through a method that reads general intelligence through four evidential lenses, AI systems research, anthropology, law, and economics, each anchored to a distinct level of description, supplemented by speculative fiction used as a disciplined heuristic in the context of discovery rather than the context of justification. Applying the method yields a taxonomy of twenty-three structural constraints organised into eight clusters; six are examined in depth and ordered as an ascending ladder of levels, with explicit bridges showing why progress at one level cannot carry to the next. The argument issues in five falsifiable predictions, each stated with a named benchmark family and a disconfirmation condition, converting a descriptive framework into a research programme with a longer horizon than the scaling hypothesis implies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通用智能（general intelligence）并非单纯由计算架构决定，而是受到多个描述层次上不可约的（non-reducible）结构约束。通过AI系统研究、人类学、法学和经济学四个透镜，识别出23个结构约束（分为8个簇），并构造了从低到高的层次阶梯，论证每个层次的进步无法自动传递到下一层次。最后提出五个可证伪的预测，将描述性框架转化为研究纲领。
Motivation: 当前AGI研究主要依赖缩放定律和单一架构改进，但忽略了通用智能可能需要的跨层次非可约约束。本文旨在系统识别这些约束并论证其不可约性，从而引导研究范式转变。
Method: 采用跨学科方法，通过AI系统研究、人类学、法学和经济学四个透镜（分别对应不同描述层次）收集证据，并辅以思辨科幻作为发现启发式。最终归纳出23个结构约束的八类簇，并选取六个进行深度分析，构建层次阶梯和层次间桥梁。
Result: 论文识别出23个结构约束，分为8个簇；深入分析了6个约束，并构建了从低到高的层次阶梯。提出了五个可证伪的预测，每个预测附带具体基准和证伪条件。
Conclusion: 通用智能不能仅通过单一架构或缩放实现，研究必须评估完整的约束轮廓而非单一基准。所提出的预测框架将理论转化为可检验的研究纲领，其时间跨度超过缩放假说。

papers.title: NGPS: GPS-Denied Aerial Geo-Localization and 2.5D Reconstruction via Deep Satellite Image Matching and Multi-Rate Sensor Fusion
papers.abstract_en: We present NGPS (Next-Generation Positioning System), a visual geo-localization framework for high-altitude UAVs that provides GPS-free absolute positioning by matching down-facing images to georeferenced satellite imagery with deep features. The system combines (1) adaptive confidence-weighted UKF fusion, where NGPS covariance is modulated by RANSAC inlier ratio, reprojection error, and match confidence; (2) velocity-predictive kernel extraction, using VIO velocity to predict the satellite search region; and (3) an asynchronous multi-rate temporal priority queue that interleaves absolute position (1-2 Hz), VIO (10-20 Hz), and IMU (100-200 Hz) updates in chronological order. Globally optimized poses from VINS pose-graph optimization, anchored by NGPS corrections, further enable real-time 2.5D georeferenced orthomosaic reconstruction. On five flight sequences (60-150 m AGL), NGPS achieves 2.94 m position RMSE, with worst-case ATE 6.04 m at 150 m AGL and 2 m/s, yielding a 3.5x improvement over standalone monocular VIO. The system runs in real time on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. Part of the implementation is open-sourced at https://github.com/snktshrma/ngps_flight.
papers.comment: 9 pages (8-page paper + IEEE copyright/citation cover page), 6 figures. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ IROS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NGPS是一种用于高空无人机的视觉地理定位框架，通过将下视图像与地理参考卫星图像进行深度特征匹配，实现无GPS的绝对定位。系统结合了自适应置信加权无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF）、速度预测核提取和异步多速率时间优先级队列，并利用VINS位姿图优化实现实时2.5D地理参考正射影像重建。在五组飞行序列（60-150米高度）上，位置RMSE为2.94米，最差ATE为6.04米（150米高度、2米/秒速度），相比单目VIO提升3.5倍，并在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上实时运行。
Motivation: 传统GPS在复杂环境中易受干扰或不可用，而现有视觉定位方法缺乏绝对参考，且高空无人机的地面图像与卫星图像匹配存在尺度、视角和光照差异，需要一种鲁棒、实时的无GPS绝对定位方案。
Method: 提出NGPS框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) 自适应置信加权UKF融合，根据RANSAC内点率、重投影误差和匹配置信度调节NGPS协方差；(2) 速度预测核提取，利用VIO速度预测卫星搜索区域；(3) 异步多速率时间优先级队列，按时间顺序交错处理绝对位置（1-2 Hz）、VIO（10-20 Hz）和IMU（100-200 Hz）更新。此外，通过VINS位姿图优化全局位姿，并由NGPS校正锚定，实现2.5D正射影像重建。
Result: 在五组飞行序列（60-150米高度）上，NGPS实现位置RMSE 2.94米，最差ATE 6.04米（150米高度、2米/秒速度），比单目VIO提升3.5倍。系统在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上实时运行。
Conclusion: NGPS在GPS受限环境下为高空无人机提供高精度绝对定位和2.5D重建，性能显著优于纯视觉里程计，且计算效率满足实时要求。

papers.title: Functional Equivalence and Geometric Diversity in Neural Network Approximations: An Empirical Characterization
papers.abstract_en: The Universal Approximation Theorem states that a neural network with a single hidden layer is sufficient to approximate any continuous univariate function on a compact domain to arbitrary error. However, the uniqueness of such neural network representations is not guaranteed, raising questions about practical identifiability. In this work, we address this concern by analyzing functional equivalence and geometric diversity of neural network approximations to a few elementary mathematical functions. The analysis includes an extensive study of single-layer neural networks and multilayer perceptrons under noisy and noise-free conditions. Beyond just network capacity, we study the geometric properties through the lens of sloppiness, characterized by the eigen spectrum of the Hessian of the cost function and the effective rank to quantify the dimensionality of parameter space. The study reveals large equivalence classes of functionally indistinguishable yet geometrically diverse networks that consistently exhibit low effective rank and structural redundancy. Finally, a model select criterion is proposed for identifying optimal models based on parsimony, ease of estimation, and inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究神经网络逼近中泛函等价性与几何多样性的关系。通过对单层和多层感知机在不同噪声条件下的广泛实验，发现存在大量功能等价但几何结构多样的网络，这些网络普遍具有低有效秩和结构冗余。最后提出基于简约性、易估计性和推理效率的模型选择标准。
Motivation: 神经网络万能逼近定理保证了存在逼近任意连续函数的网络，但网络表示的唯一性未得到保证，这引发了实际可辨识性问题。本文旨在分析神经网络逼近的泛函等价类和几何多样性，理解参数空间的结构特性。
Method: 对单层神经网络和多层感知机进行大量实验，分析不同噪声条件下网络逼近的泛函等价性。通过代价函数Hessian矩阵的特征谱和有效秩量化参数空间的维度，从“sloppiness”角度研究几何性质。
Result: 揭示了大量功能不可区分但几何结构多样的等价类，这些网络普遍表现出低有效秩和结构冗余。
Conclusion: 神经网络参数空间存在显著的冗余，本文提出的模型选择标准可基于简约性、易估计性和推理效率识别最优模型。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: OntoBook: Ontology-Grounded Synthetic Textbooks for Medical Encoder Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: We present OntoBook, a method that converts medical ontology structure into pretraining signal for encoder language models. Our approach has three stages: random walks through ontology graphs capture hierarchical and causal relations between medical codes, a large language model reformulates these walks into fluent textbook-style prose, and the resulting text is used to train ModernCamemBERT, a 149M-parameter French encoder, with two objectives on the same data: masked language modeling and relation prediction between code pairs. On three French medical coding benchmarks (FRACCO, Cantemist-FR, Distemist-FR), OntoBook achieves significant improvements over MLM-only pretraining, with +2.5 micro-F1 on FRACCO and +8.0 micro-F1 on Distemist. We find that alignment between objectives is necessary: misaligned training, where each task uses different data, causes a 30-point degradation. We release 1.3 million LLM-reformulated medical textbooks across three French ontologies (CIM-10, CCAM, ATC) and pretrained model checkpoints.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Models Workshop, May 2026, Palma de Mallorca, Spain
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OntoBook 是一种利用医学本体结构生成合成教科书文本，进而预训练编码器语言模型的方法。通过随机游走捕获代码间关系，再用大语言模型改写为教科书风格文本，训练 ModernCamemBERT 模型，在三个法语医学编码基准上取得提升。
Motivation: 现有医学编码任务中，编码器语言模型缺乏领域结构知识，本体中的层次和因果关联未被有效利用作为预训练信号。
Method: 三阶段流程：1) 对医学本体图进行随机游走生成代码关系序列；2) 使用大语言模型将序列改写为流畅的教科书风格文本；3) 用同一数据同时训练掩码语言模型和代码关系预测两个目标。
Result: 在 FRACCO、Cantemist-FR、Distemist-FR 三个法语医学编码基准上，OntoBook 相比仅 MLM 预训练获得显著提升，FRACCO 上 micro-F1 提高 2.5 点，Distemist 上提高 8.0 点。目标不对齐时性能下降 30 点。
Conclusion: OntoBook 表明利用本体结构生成合成文本进行多任务预训练可以有效提升医学编码性能，且任务对齐至关重要。代码和模型已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Explicit Physical Parameter Control and Benchmarking for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in image-to-video generation have improved visual realism, making physically grounded and controllable dynamics an important step toward future world simulation. Current models often generate plausible motion, but it is not reliably governed by explicit physical causes, and instance-level constraints can leak or become entangled in multi-object interactions. We attribute this gap to two missing pieces: large-scale, fine-grained physical parameterization, and model designs that correctly bind physical attributes to instances and emphasize dynamics over appearance. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhyParam-Dataset, an interaction-centric collection of 130K physically simulated videos with dense physical parameterization, including force vectors, object material properties, and environmental constants across five representative rigid-body motion types. Built on this data, we present PhyParam, a physics-guided image-to-video diffusion model that conditions on object-level forces, masses, friction, restitution, and scene-level gravity via a lightweight physical-attention routing mechanism, and further improves motion learning with semantic-structural feature-space supervision. We also establish PhyParam-Bench, a benchmark for physical-law consistency in image-to-video generation, with a multi-level protocol evaluating temporal dynamics, spatial stability, and semantic--physical alignment. Experiments show that PhyParam improves physical consistency while maintaining high visual fidelity, advancing explicit rigid-body physical-parameter control for image-to-video generation. We will publicly release the dataset, benchmark, and code to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图像到视频生成中缺乏显式物理参数控制的问题，构建了包含130K视频的PhyParam-Dataset数据集，并提出了PhyParam模型，通过轻量级物理注意力路由机制对物体级力、质量、摩擦等物理参数进行条件控制，同时建立了PhyParam-Bench基准以评估物理一致性。实验表明该方法在保持视觉保真度的同时提升了物理一致性。
Motivation: 现有图像到视频生成模型生成的运动虽然合理，但缺乏显式物理原因控制，实例级约束在多物体交互中易泄漏或纠缠。作者认为缺少大规模细粒度物理参数化数据集以及能正确绑定物理属性到实例并强调动态的模型设计。
Method: 提出PhyParam-Dataset（130K物理模拟视频，含力、材料属性、环境常数等密集物理参数）和PhyParam模型（基于扩散，通过物理注意力路由机制以物体级力、质量、摩擦、恢复系数和场景级重力为条件，并利用语义-结构特征空间监督改进运动学习）。同时建立PhyParam-Bench基准，包含时序动态、空间稳定性和语义-物理对齐的多级评估协议。
Result: 实验表明PhyParam提升了物理一致性并保持高视觉保真度，推进了显式刚体物理参数控制在图像到视频生成中的应用。
Conclusion: 作者将公开数据集、基准和代码以支持未来研究。当前工作聚焦于刚体运动，未涉及流体或更复杂物理场景。

papers.title: Visual Semantic Decoding of Electrocorticography from Video Stimuli using End-to-End Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: ECoG-based visual semantic decoding enables inference of semantic interpretation of visual perception from complex, noisy brain activity. This study examines the feasibility of visual semantic decoding using an end-to-end deep learning framework using electrocorticography (ECoG). Specifically, the decoding task is to predict visual categories from video stimuli using time-series neural inputs. A previously collected ECoG dataset from participants ($n=17$) with drug-resistant epilepsy is used for analysis. With fewer than 50 training samples per visual category, this study evaluates multiple deep learning approaches, artificial neural network architectures, and frequency-band filtered inputs. The best-performing approach is analyzed to shed light on the discriminative information it relies on across spectral, temporal, and cortical dimensions. The selected decoding system uses mixup augmentation, a Transformer-based encoder, and high-gamma (80-150 Hz) inputs with a 900 ms post-stimulus window. Further analysis shows that early visual cortex (V2-V4), ventral stream visual cortex, MT+ complex with neighbouring visual areas, and lateral temporal cortex contributed substantially to decoding performance. This study demonstrates that an end-to-end deep learning framework can yield promising decoding performance from dynamic visual stimuli without handcrafted features, while the model behavior remains interpretable through spectral, temporal, and cortical dimensions, which are broadly consistent with established neuroscience knowledge.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于视频刺激的皮质电图（ECoG）视觉语义解码，采用端到端深度学习框架，在少量训练样本（每类少于50个）下预测视觉类别。最佳方法使用mixup增强、Transformer编码器和高伽马频带（80-150 Hz）输入，在900ms后刺激窗口内取得良好性能，并发现早期视觉皮层、腹侧流视觉皮层等区域贡献显著。
Motivation: 目前基于ECoG的视觉语义解码通常需要手工特征，且动态视觉刺激下的解码可行性尚待验证。本研究旨在探索端到端框架是否能在少量训练样本下有效解码视频刺激的语义类别。
Method: 采用端到端深度学习，对比多种人工神经网络架构和频带滤波输入，最终选择mixup增强、Transformer编码器以及高伽马频带（80-150 Hz）输入，使用900ms后刺激窗口进行解码。
Result: 在17名难治性癫痫患者的数据集上，每类少于50个训练样本时，端到端框架获得有希望的解码性能，且模型行为在频谱、时间和皮层维度上可解释，与已知神经科学知识一致。
Conclusion: 研究表明端到端深度学习可实现动态视觉刺激的语义解码，无需手工特征，且模型具有可解释性，但未涉及与现有方法的定量比较或泛化性验证。

papers.title: Circuit Claims Depend on What Is Extracted and How It Is Compared
papers.abstract_en: Circuit extraction identifies a small set of model components whose presence preserves a target behavior under ablation, and the resulting circuit is often read as the mechanism behind that behavior. We argue that this reading is under-determined: preserving behavior does not single out one circuit, because the claim it supports depends on which circuit is reported and how two circuits are compared. We make this concrete in a synthetic Lean tactic-prediction benchmark -- predicting the next step of a proof -- where fixed proof rules with randomized surface form let differences between extracted circuits be attributed to these choices rather than to the task. Across dense and weight-sparse checkpoints (most weights constrained to zero) of the same transformer, evaluated on atomic (single-rule) and compositional (multi-rule) proofs, we vary which extracted object is reported (a compact prediction-preserving circuit, a broader graph that also keeps surrounding read, write, and routing structure, or the smallest subgraph meeting a post-ablation loss threshold), and whether each attention head's query and key are represented jointly or separately. Exact component-to-component edge overlap is low and sensitive to these choices, at times dropping to a random baseline, while two coarser summaries stay stable: the set of selected attention heads, and the circuit-size ranking of conditions that differ in which supervised checkpoint initializes reinforcement learning (RL). The largest accuracy gains from RL on compositional proofs come with the most structure beyond the atomic circuits. A circuit-level claim is therefore well defined only once one states which circuit is reported, the pruning threshold used to extract it, and the level at which circuits are compared. We distill these requirements into a reporting practice for circuit-extraction studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过合成Lean战术预测基准，系统研究了电路提取结果对报告对象和比较方式的敏感性。实验表明，组件级边重叠低且受选择影响，而粗粒度摘要（如选中的注意力头集合）保持稳定。作者由此提出电路提取研究的规范报告实践。
Motivation: 电路提取常被用来解读模型机制，但保留目标行为并不能唯一确定电路，因为结论依赖于报告哪个电路以及如何比较电路。
Method: 在合成Lean战术预测基准上，使用固定证明规则和随机表面形式，变化提取对象（紧凑电路、更广图、最小子图）和表示粒度（查询/键联合或分离），并比较不同检查点和证明类型下的电路重叠与稳定性。
Result: 组件级边重叠低且随选择变化，有时降至随机基线；而选中的注意力头集合和电路大小排名保持稳定。强化学习在组合证明上的最大准确率增益来自超出原子电路的结构。
Conclusion: 电路级声明需明确报告电路种类、提取阈值和比较层次。作者将这些要求提炼为电路提取研究的报告实践。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TAP-RAG: Task-Aware Policy Control for Long-Document Multimodal Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Long-document multimodal question answering requires more than retrieving relevant chunks from a large document. Different queries require different evidence behavior. Existing multimodal RAG systems improve evidence access through text chunks, page images, graph links, or heterogeneous document elements, but they often apply a largely query-agnostic evidence-use strategy. We present TAP-RAG, a task-aware policy-controlled RAG framework for long-document multimodal QA. TAP-RAG contains a main controller, the Task-Aware Policy Controller (TAPC), and two policy-guided evidence executors: Task-Aware Query-Guided Flow Diffusion (TA-QFD) and Task-Aware Visual Enhancement (TAVE). For each query, TAPC predicts the task prior, estimates visual/local/global evidence signals, and produces an executable policy. TA-QFD then expands textual and structural evidence over the multimodal document graph, while TAVE selectively inspects page images when visual or layout evidence is needed. A guarded synthesis stage fuses text, visual, and structural evidence and abstains when support is insufficient. On DocBench and MMLongBench-Doc, TAP-RAG achieves the best overall accuracy among the compared systems, improving over a matched multimodal-RAG baseline by +9.1 points (61.1 to 70.2) and +4.5 points (42.2 to 46.7), respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TAP-RAG，一个任务感知策略控制的检索增强生成（RAG）框架，用于长文档多模态问答。它通过任务感知策略控制器（TAPC）预测任务先验并估计证据信号，结合查询引导流扩散（TA-QFD）和视觉增强（TAVE）两个执行器，选择性地扩展文本、结构和视觉证据。在DocBench和MMLongBench-Doc上，TAP-RAG分别比匹配的多模态RAG基线提升9.1和4.5个准确率点。
Motivation: 现有多模态RAG系统通常采用查询无关的证据使用策略，无法根据不同的查询需求调整证据行为，导致长文档问答中证据利用不充分。
Method: TAP-RAG包含任务感知策略控制器（TAPC）和两个策略引导的执行器：任务感知查询引导流扩散（TA-QFD）在文档图上扩展文本和结构证据，任务感知视觉增强（TAVE）在需要视觉或布局证据时选择性检查页面图像。受控的合成阶段融合文本、视觉和结构证据，并在证据不足时弃权。
Result: 在DocBench上，TAP-RAG达到70.2%准确率，比多模态RAG基线（61.1%）提升9.1个百分点；在MMLongBench-Doc上提升4.5个百分点（42.2%到46.7%），达到最佳总体准确率。
Conclusion: 任务感知的策略控制能够根据查询需求动态调整证据类型，显著提升长文档多模态问答的准确率，并支持在证据不足时弃权。

papers.title: Breaking Feedback-Blindness: Utility-Augmented Transformer for Sequential Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: Sequential decision making in non-stationary and partially observable environments requires rapid adaptation to latent regime changes. However, existing Transformer decision models face a structural bottleneck in the retrieval mechanism: even when reward is used for training or exposed as an input token, attention retrieval remains primarily driven by observation-derived similarity. We formalize this limitation as feedback-blind retrieval, and formally show that, on feedback-informative tasks, observation-equivalent histories with different action-reward outcomes cannot be distinguished by any observation-only attention, resulting in suboptimal choice. To address this mismatch, we propose the Utility-Augmented Transformer (UAT), a new feedback-conditioned retrieval attention architecture in which a compact utility state modulates the query, key, and value projections, allowing action-reward history to directly alter context retrieval during the forward pass. UAT also enjoys an exact zero-gate degradation property that recovers the Vanilla Transformer when feedback is uninformative. Under finite-horizon compactness and Lipschitz assumptions, we prove that UAT strictly enlarges the observation-only Transformer class and can uniformly approximate feedback-dependent decision maps. Across four non-stationary benchmarks: synthetic navigation with hidden goal shifts, non-stationary sepsis treatment, cross-market portfolio allocation, and delayed-feedback recommendation, UAT consistently improves performance over observation-only, test-time adaptation, and input-level feedback baselines, with particularly large gains in noisier regimes that require stronger adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Utility-Augmented Transformer (UAT)，通过紧凑的效用状态调制注意力中的查询、键和值投影，使动作-奖励历史直接改变上下文检索，解决了现有 Transformer 决策模型在非平稳部分可观察环境中的反馈盲区问题。摘要证明 UAT 严格扩大了仅观测 Transformer 的类，并能一致逼近反馈依赖的决策函数。在四个非平稳基准（合成导航、非平稳脓毒症治疗、跨市场投资组合分配、延迟反馈推荐）上，UAT 一致优于仅观测基线和测试时适应基线，在噪声更强、需要更强适应性的场景中增益尤为显著。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 决策模型在非平稳部分可观察环境中存在反馈盲区：即使奖励用于训练或作为输入 token，注意力检索仍主要由观测相似性驱动，无法区分观测等价但动作-奖励不同的历史，导致次优选择。
Method: 提出 Utility-Augmented Transformer (UAT)，引入一个紧凑的效用状态来调节注意力中的查询、键和值投影，使得动作-奖励历史能在前向传播中直接改变上下文检索。UAT 还拥有精确的零门退化性质，当反馈无信息时可恢复为标准 Transformer。
Result: 在四个非平稳基准（合成导航、非平稳脓毒症治疗、跨市场投资组合分配、延迟反馈推荐）上，UAT 一致优于仅观测基线、测试时适应基线和输入级反馈基线，尤其在噪声更强、需要更强适应性的环境中性能提升显著。
Conclusion: 摘要指出 UAT 通过反馈条件检索解决了反馈盲区，理论上扩大了仅观测 Transformer 的类，并能在有限时域紧致性和 Lipschitz 假设下一致逼近反馈依赖的决策映射。实验表明在需要强适应的环境中增益大。

papers.title: Enhancing Transformer-based Routing by Encoding Distance via Relative Positional Encoding
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores Relative Positional Encoding (RPE) as an additive bias in Transformer architectures to solve the Team Orienteering Problem. By embedding in the attention mechanism pairwise spatial relationships among nodes of the graph that represents the routing problem, the transformer encoder can compute a richer spatial-aware graph embedding that allows the decoder to estimate better routes. Experimental results involving instances up to 100 nodes demonstrate consistent improvements in collected rewards and optimality gaps over vanilla Transformer architectures used by other state-of-the-art works. These findings highlight that explicit relational modeling significantly enhances scalability and generalization for complex combinatorial optimization.
papers.comment: This work was accepted to be presented at the Graph Signal Processing Workshop 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将相对位置编码（RPE）作为Transformer注意力机制的加性偏置，用于求解团队定向问题（Team Orienteering Problem）。通过在注意力中嵌入图中节点间的空间关系，编码器能生成空间感知的图嵌入，从而帮助解码器估计更优路线。在多达100个节点的实例上，该方法在收集奖励和最优性差距上一致优于其他基于Transformer的基线方法。结果表明显式关系建模能显著提升复杂组合优化问题的可扩展性和泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有Transformer模型在求解路由优化问题时缺乏对节点间空间关系的显式建模，限制了其性能和泛化能力。
Method: 在注意力机制中引入相对位置编码（RPE）作为加性偏置，将图中节点间的成对空间关系编码到自注意力计算中，使编码器生成空间感知的图嵌入。
Result: 在多达100个节点的测试实例上，该方法在收集奖励和最优性差距方面持续优于其他基于Transformer的基线方法。
Conclusion: 显式关系建模（如RPE）能显著提升Transformer在复杂组合优化问题上的可扩展性和泛化能力。

papers.title: SynGallery: A Synthetic Gallery of Real Paintings for Instance-Level Artwork Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Instance-level artwork recognition requires matching a handheld visitor photograph to a specific work in a large museum collection. This is challenging because painting datasets typically provide clean catalog images for training, while test queries are captured under oblique viewpoints, gallery lighting, reflections, frames, and other scene-level variations. We present SynGallery, a synthetic gallery dataset for artwork retrieval that addresses this gap without collecting additional real photographs. Starting from catalog images of real paintings, we place each artwork into a procedurally generated 3D gallery scene and render it from multiple viewpoints under varied geometric and appearance conditions, while preserving the exact identity of the original work. The resulting dataset contains 24,490 rendered views of 4,898 paintings from the Met benchmark. We show that these synthetic views provide a stronger training signal than the corresponding studio photographs. At the same number of training data points, training only on SynGallery improves art painting recognition from 67.18 to 73.47 GAP$^-$. When added to the full Met training set, SynGallery improves the published benchmark protocol from 35.97 to 38.48 GAP. Ablation experiments show that the gain comes primarily from geometric viewpoint variation rather than photographic realism: blur, sensor noise, and image compression consistently reduce performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SynGallery，一个合成画廊数据集，用于实例级艺术品识别。通过将真实画作放置在程序生成的3D画廊场景中并从多视角渲染，生成24,490张合成视图。训练时使用这些合成视图可显著提升识别性能，且增益主要来自几何视点变化而非照片级真实感。
Motivation: 实例级艺术品识别面临训练集（清洁目录图像）与测试集（手持拍摄，存在倾斜视角、画廊灯光、反射等差异）之间的域偏移问题。现有方法需要收集额外真实照片，成本高。
Method: 从真实画作的目录图像出发，将每幅画放入程序生成的3D画廊场景中，从多个视角渲染，同时保留原始画作的精确身份。数据集包含Met基准中4,898幅画的24,490个渲染视图。
Result: 仅使用SynGallery训练（相同数据量）将艺术品识别性能从67.18 GAP$^-$提升到73.47 GAP$^-$；将SynGallery加入完整Met训练集后，将基准协议从35.97 GAP提升到38.48 GAP。消融实验表明增益主要来自几何视点变化，而非照片级真实感（模糊、传感器噪声、图像压缩反而降低性能）。
Conclusion: 合成画廊数据可有效缓解域偏移，无需额外真实照片即可提升艺术品识别性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Black-Mamba: Biologically-Inspired Leaky Accumulation for Conceptual Knowledge under Distribution Drift
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting under real-world conditions is inherently non-stationary, as the conditional distribution of future observations evolves over time. Recent test-time adaptive sequence models address this challenge by updating internal states during inference, but tie adaptation to instantaneous prediction errors or surprise. This coupling can conflate persistent distribution shift with stochastic innovations, leading to unnecessary updates and inefficient adaptation. We introduce Black-Mamba, a test-time adaptive forecasting architecture that formulates online adaptation as evidence-gated state tracking under distribution drift. The model augments a base predictor with a dynamic memory updated when temporally accumulated surprisal provides sufficient evidence of a regime change. This turns adaptation into a selective, event-driven process rather than a continuous one. Across multiple forecasting benchmarks with non-stationary dynamics, Black-Mamba achieves competitive or improved predictive performance compared to existing test-time adaptation methods while significantly reducing the number of memory updates during inference. Together with mathematical analysis and biological evidence, these results suggest that accumulated surprisal provides a principled signal for distinguishing persistent drift from transient noise, yielding more efficient and robust adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Black-Mamba架构，一种基于累积惊奇（accumulated surprisal）的测试时自适应序列预测模型，用于分布漂移下的在线预测。该模型通过选择性更新动态记忆，仅在累积惊奇证据足够时触发状态更新，从而区分持久性漂移与瞬时噪声。在多个非平稳预测基准上，Black-Mamba在减少内存更新次数的同时取得了与现有方法相当或更优的预测性能。
Motivation: 现有测试时自适应模型将适应耦合到瞬时预测误差，可能混淆持久性分布漂移与随机创新，导致不必要的更新和低效适应。需要一种更原则性的机制来区分两者。
Method: Black-Mamba在基础预测器上增加动态记忆，通过时间累积惊奇（surprisal）作为证据门控信号，仅在检测到机制变化时才更新记忆，使适应成为选择性事件驱动过程而非连续过程。
Result: 在多个非平稳预测基准上，Black-Mamba实现了与现有测试时自适应方法相当或更优的预测性能，同时显著减少了推理期间的记忆更新次数。
Conclusion: 累积惊奇为区分持久性漂移与瞬态噪声提供了有原则的信号，从而产生更高效、更稳健的自适应。数学分析和生物证据也支持这一机制。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: NaviAIS: A Scenario-Level Vessel Trajectory Prediction Dataset withVectorized Lane Priors and the NaviLane Forecasting Framework
papers.abstract_en: Vessel trajectory prediction in complex maritime environments is essential for traffic management, collision warning, route planning, and autonomous navigation. Although AIS-based learning methods have progressed rapidly, existing datasets are often released as raw message streams or irregular time series, with inconsistent sampling rates, noisy observations, heterogeneous coordinate systems, and non-unified scenario protocols. Most public AIS resources also lack structured representations of navigational lanes, waterway geometry, and navigable-region constraints, limiting reproducible, environment-aware forecasting. To address this, we introduce NaviAIS, a standardized scenario-level AIS dataset for vessel trajectory prediction. It organizes multi-vessel historical-future trajectories within unified temporal windows and local coordinate systems, and provides rasterized navigable maps, vectorized lane priors, lane graphs, and structured map representations. Compared with existing datasets, it jointly supports vectorized lanes, multi-scenario coverage, vectorized maps, open accessibility, and processed trajectories. Built on this dataset, we propose NaviLane, a hierarchical macro-action framework for map-aware prediction. NaviLane first performs trajectory-map joint encoding for a unified scene representation, then uses a discrete macro-action codebook to generate multimodal candidates coarse-to-refined. A residual refinement module improves local geometric and dynamical consistency, and a world-model-based consequence-aware evaluator ranks candidates by interaction risk and environmental feasibility. Experiments show NaviLane outperforms representative baselines in both single-modal and multimodal settings, confirming the value of structured navigational priors, hierarchical multimodal generation, and consequence-aware evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NaviAIS，一个标准化的场景级船舶轨迹预测数据集，包含矢量航道先验、可导航地图等结构化信息，并在此基础上提出 NaviLane 框架，通过分层宏动作编码、残差细化模块和基于世界模型的风险评估器实现地图感知预测。实验表明 NaviLane 在单模态和多模态设置下均优于基线方法。
Motivation: 现有 AIS 数据集缺乏结构化航道表示和水域约束，且存在采样率不一致、噪声大、坐标系统不统一等问题，限制了可复现的环境感知预测研究。
Method: 构建 NaviAIS 数据集提供统一时空窗口的轨迹、矢量地图和航道图；提出 NaviLane 框架，包含轨迹-地图联合编码、离散宏动作码本的多模态候选生成、残差细化模块以及基于世界模型的风险评估器。
Result: 实验表明 NaviLane 在单模态和多模态预测设置下均优于代表性基线，验证了结构化航道先验、层次化多模态生成和后果感知评估的有效性。
Conclusion: 结构化航道先验和后果感知评估对提升船舶轨迹预测性能具有重要价值，NaviAIS 数据集为社区提供了标准化基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KALE: Kernel Alignment with Loss Equilibration for Stable CLIP-DINOv2 Alignment at Web Scale
papers.abstract_en: Kernel-based alignment of CLIP toward a vision centric teacher such as DINOv2 (KUEA) improves CLIP's visual representations while preserving text-encoder compatibility, using a fixed trade-off weight tuned on curated ImageNet-1K. We ask whether this transfers to noisy, web-scale data (CC12M) and find that it does not: the alignment term's weighted contribution falls to about 0.2% of the clean term, so under any fixed weight its gradient is effectively inert. We introduce KALE, a loss-equilibration controller that tracks both losses and adaptively rescales the alignment weight toward a target ratio, restoring the signal with no per-dataset tuning; reaching balance requires increasing the weight by roughly four orders of magnitude, and the required value is configuration-dependent, so no fixed scalar suffices. We characterize the resulting regime: a bounded high learning rate and a decaying schedule with a moderate floor are needed for stability, and the controller equilibrates rather than diverging. On a 3.3M-image CC12M subset, the aligned model preserves image-text retrieval and reproducibly improves SVHN linear probing; zero-shot improves by +2.00 over CLIP on the standard 11-dataset average, exceeding KUEA's +1.29. We report all results with explicit run-to-run variance and base our conclusions on the metrics that are stable across runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于核的CLIP与DINOv2对齐（KUEA）在Web规模数据（CC12M）上的迁移性，发现固定权重导致对齐项梯度无效。提出KALE损失均衡控制器，自适应调整对齐权重约四个数量级，无需每数据集调参。在330万图像子集上保持检索性能，SVHN线性探测提升；零样本11数据集平均比CLIP高+2.00，超过KUEA的+1.29。
Motivation: KUEA在ImageNet-1K上有效，但固定权重在噪声、Web规模数据下对齐项贡献降到约0.2%，梯度几乎无效，需要自适应调整权重的方案。
Method: 提出KALE损失均衡控制器，跟踪两项损失并自适应缩放对齐权重至目标比率，无需每数据集调参；同时要求有界高学习率和衰减调度以保持稳定。
Result: 在CC12M的330万图像子集上，对齐模型保留图像-文本检索能力，SVHN线性探测可重复提升；零样本11数据集平均比CLIP高+2.00，超过KUEA的+1.29。
Conclusion: KALE通过自适应权重恢复对齐信号，无需手动调参，且在Web规模数据上稳定提升视觉表示，所有结果报告了运行间方差，结论基于稳定指标。

papers.title: Public perceptions of AI-driven decision-making in healthcare: A structural equation modeling approach
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into healthcare to support diagnostics, decision-making, and administrative processes. However, the successful implementation of AI depends not only on technical performance but also on public perceptions of its helpfulness, riskiness, and fairness. This study examines public perceptions of automated decision-making (ADM) in healthcare. Data were drawn from the first wave of an ongoing longitudinal survey panel. The final sample consisted of 3,915 respondents and was analyzed with structural equation modeling. Perceptions of ADM in healthcare as helpful, risky, and fair were treated as the dependent variables. AI literacy, familiarity with different forms of AI, confidence in clinicians' ability to distinguish AI- from human-generated content, use of conversational agents for health information, and use of traditional digital health information sources were included as exogenous. Greater familiarity with different forms of AI, higher confidence in the clinician's ability to recognize AI-generated content, and use of conversational agents for health information were associated with greater perceived helpfulness. Use of conversational agents was associated with lower perceived risk, whereas greater familiarity with AI and greater reliance on traditional health information sources were associated with higher perceived risk. Perceptions of ADM as fair were most strongly predicted by confidence in the clinician's ability, with additional small positive associations with AI familiarity, AI literacy, and use of conversational agents. Public perceptions of ADM in healthcare are shaped by technological familiarity, use of conversational agents, and confidence in human oversight. Overall, ADM's perceived helpfulness and fairness are driven more by trust in healthcare professionals than by trust in the technology itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本研究调查公众对医疗中自动化决策（ADM）的看法，基于3915名受访者的纵向调查数据，使用结构方程模型分析感知有用性、风险性和公平性的影响因素。结果表明，AI熟悉度、对临床医生识别AI生成内容能力的信心、以及使用对话式健康信息代理与感知有用性正相关；而传统数字健康信息来源的使用与感知风险正相关。
Motivation: AI在医疗中的应用日益增多，其成功实施不仅依赖技术性能，还取决于公众对其有用性、风险性和公平性的看法。当前缺乏对这些感知的量化理解。
Method: 采用第一轮纵向调查面板数据（n=3915），以感知有用性、风险性和公平性为因变量，AI素养、AI熟悉度、对临床医生能力的信心、使用对话代理和传统数字健康信息来源等为外生变量，通过结构方程模型进行分析。
Result: 较高的AI熟悉度、对临床医生识别AI生成内容能力的信心和使用对话代理与感知有用性正相关；使用对话代理与感知风险负相关，而AI熟悉度和传统信息来源使用与感知风险正相关；感知公平性主要由临床医生能力信心预测。
Conclusion: 公众对医疗中ADM的看法由技术熟悉度、对话代理使用和对人工监督的信心塑造，感知有用性和公平性更多依赖于对医疗专业人员的信任而非技术信任。

papers.title: RAMP: Recognition parametrisation by Amortised Message Passing
papers.abstract_en: A central aim of unsupervised learning is to uncover latent factors that explain dependencies among observations. Probabilistic models typically achieve this by introducing multiple latent variables linked through a graph of conditional relationships, with distributional parameters and their dependence learnt from data. Learning relies either on distributional choices that allow tractable belief propagation, or on approximations that scale poorly with model size and complexity. We build on the recently developed recognition-parametrised modelling paradigm to propose an alternative approach: RAMP, a method that implicitly defines latent structure by learning a flexible, nonlinear, amortised message-passing framework. We show that RAMP enables efficient likelihood-based recovery of latent-variable distributions within expressive nonlinear models acting on complex high-dimensional data.
papers.comment: In the proceedings of the Symposium on Probabilistic Machine Learning 2026 (ProbML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAMP（Recognition parametrisation by Amortised Message Passing），一种基于摊销消息传递的无监督学习方法，用于隐式定义潜在变量结构。通过在非线性模型中学习灵活的消息传递框架，RAMP能够高效地恢复潜在变量分布，适用于复杂高维数据。
Motivation: 无监督学习旨在发现解释观测依赖关系的潜在因子，但传统概率模型要么依赖可处理的信念传播，要么近似方法随模型规模扩展性差。
Method: RAMP基于识别参数化（recognition-parametrised）建模范式，通过学习一个灵活的非线性摊销消息传递框架，隐式定义潜在结构，从而实现高效似然恢复。
Result: 摘要表明RAMP能够在表达性非线性模型中高效恢复潜在变量分布，适用于复杂高维数据。
Conclusion: RAMP为概率无监督学习提供了一种替代方案，通过摊销消息传递实现高效且可扩展的潜在变量推断。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Local Label-Informed Feature Transfer for Generating Ground-Truth Medical Images: A Comparison of GAN- and Diffusion-Based Approaches
papers.abstract_en: Validating Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) methods in medical imaging requires ground-truth data with known locations of informative features. However, current approaches rely on expert annotations, which are prone to labeling errors, or on hand-crafted artificial perturbations superimposed onto healthy images to mimic lesions or malignant features, which lack clinical realism. We present Local Label-Informed Feature Transfer (LLIFT), a framework for generating semi-synthetic brain magnetic resonance images with realistic lesions placed in user-controlled regions, which does not require pixel-level lesion annotations during training. We implement LLIFT with two generative paradigms: LLIFT-GAN, a custom GAN that learns pathological features from binary class labels alone, and LLIFT-DM, a diffusion-based inpainting pipeline conditioned on bounding-box masks via ControlNet. Both approaches are evaluated on brain magnetic resonance imaging data derived from the Human Connectome Project. In evaluations, both achieve Fréchet Inception Distance scores, with respect to the real pathological distribution, that are comparable to the inter-class reference between healthy and pathological images in the given dataset. Furthermore, qualitative inspection confirms the realism of lesion structures. The resulting benchmark datasets provide spatially controlled ground truth data for evaluating XAI methods in medical imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Local Label-Informed Feature Transfer (LLIFT) 框架，用于生成半合成的脑部磁共振图像，其中包含位于用户控制区域的真实病灶。该框架在训练时不需要像素级病灶标注，通过两种生成范式实现：LLIFT-GAN（自定义 GAN）和 LLIFT-DM（基于 ControlNet 的扩散修复管道）。在 HCP 数据集上评估，两者在 Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) 上达到了与真实病理分布相当的水平，并通过定性检查确认了病灶结构的真实性。生成的基准数据集为医学图像中评估 XAI 方法提供了空间可控的 ground-truth 数据。
Motivation: 当前验证医学图像 XAI 方法需要已知特征位置的 ground-truth 数据，但专家标注存在错误，而人工扰动缺乏临床真实性。本文旨在无需像素级标注的情况下生成具有真实病灶的半合成图像。
Method: 提出 LLIFT 框架，包含 GAN 和扩散两种实现：LLIFT-GAN 仅从二值类别标签学习病理特征；LLIFT-DM 是通过 ControlNet 以边界框掩码为条件的扩散修复管道。
Result: 在 HCP 脑部 MRI 数据上，两种方法在 FID 分数上与真实病理分布相当，且定性检查确认病灶结构真实。
Conclusion: 生成的基准数据集可为医学图像中的 XAI 方法提供空间可控的 ground-truth 数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Informed Super-Resolution of Atmospheric Data
papers.abstract_en: In the context of global warming, extreme events have become more frequent and intense, making their trustworthy detection and forecasting more important than ever. Yet, atmospheric observations lack sufficient spatial resolution, motivating atmospheric data downscaling as a way to reconstruct high-resolution data from coarse observations. This task is now being formulated as a super-resolution (SR) problem with machine learning methods featuring high efficiency. Nevertheless, it remains unclear whether the super-resolved atmospheric data still satisfies fundamental physics governing the Earth system, raising concerns about their trustworthiness in climate-related applications. In this work, we address this challenge by constraining SR models to respect hydrostatic primitive equations that represent multivariate atmospheric physics. First, we propose a Physics-Informed Super-Resolution (PISR) method involving multi-scale physics-informed objectives based on primitive equations. PISR favors the SR outputs to respect these equations and therefore naturally encodes inter-variable relationships. In addition, we propose a metric called Normalized Physical Consistency (NPC) derived from said primitive equations to measure the physical consistency of super-resolved data. Experiments on ERA5, CERRA, and COSMO demonstrate that PISR enhances the reconstruction fidelity by improving physical consistency, SR accuracy, and downstream detection of extreme events, as demonstrated by case studies in heatwaves and extreme winds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大气观测空间分辨率不足的问题，提出物理信息超分辨率（PISR）方法，通过基于原始方程的多尺度物理信息约束，使超分辨率输出满足流体静力学原始方程，从而编码变量间关系。同时提出归一化物理一致性（NPC）指标衡量超分辨率数据的物理一致性。在ERA5、CERRA和COSMO数据集上的实验表明，PISR提高了重建保真度、超分辨率精度以及极端事件（如热浪和极端风）的下游检测能力。
Motivation: 现有超分辨率方法重建的大气数据可能不满足地球系统的基本物理定律，在气候应用中可靠性存疑。
Method: 提出PISR方法，引入基于原始方程的多尺度物理信息目标函数，约束超分辨率输出尊重流体静力学原始方程，并设计NPC指标衡量物理一致性。
Result: 在ERA5、CERRA和COSMO数据集上，PISR提升了物理一致性、超分辨率精度，并在热浪和极端风案例研究中改进了极端事件检测。
Conclusion: 论文表明物理信息约束能有效提高大气数据超分辨率的物理一致性和下游应用可靠性。
Relevance: 65

summary_sections.conclusion: 论文表明物理信息约束能有效提高大气数据超分辨率的物理一致性和下游应用可靠性。

papers.title: Wave2Body: Rethinking mmWave Human Pose Estimation as Radar-to-Body Token Translation
papers.abstract_en: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-friendly human sensing, but its sparse point clouds are physical measurements of view-dependent electromagnetic reflections and only indirectly characterize body articulation. Recovering a complete 3D pose from such partial, geometry-dependent observations is therefore under-constrained. Existing methods directly regress joint coordinates from paired radar-pose data, relying on the same limited paired supervision to learn radar perception, human-body structure, and their alignment. This coupling can encourage dataset-specific shortcuts under ambiguous radar observations. We propose Wave2Body, a radar-to-body token translation framework that decouples these learning targets using a self-supervised mmWave tokenizer, a pretrained compositional body tokenizer that defines the output space, and a lightweight translator between them. Experiments on M4Human and mmBody show that Wave2Body achieves stronger cross-domain generalization than previous methods while incurring much lower computational costs for training and inference. All the code and experiment results are publicly available at https://github.com/Galaxywalk/Wave2Body.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Wave2Body，将毫米波雷达人体姿态估计重新定义为雷达到身体令牌翻译。通过自监督毫米波分词器、预训练组合身体分词器和轻量翻译器解耦学习目标，在M4Human和mmBody数据集上实现更强的跨域泛化和更低计算成本。

Method: 提出Wave2Body框架，包含自监督毫米波分词器（mmWave tokenizer）、预训练组合身体分词器（compositional body tokenizer）和两者间的轻量翻译器。
Result: 在M4Human和mmBody上，Wave2Body相比先前方法实现更强的跨域泛化，且训练和推理计算成本大幅降低。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Delivery Drone-Based Participatory Sensing in Dynamic Environments
papers.abstract_en: Using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) for urban sensing has emerged as a powerful paradigm to monitor the status of the city, e.g., air quality and noise levels, through agile aerial crowdsourcing. Despite this potential, existing UAV-based sensing approaches overlook environmental disturbances like wind that drastically impact drone velocity and energy efficiency. Consequently, directly applying existing methods to this joint delivery and sensing paradigm in dynamic environments faces two severe challenges: (1) scalability bottlenecks as fleet sizes expand; and (2) multi-timescale decision heterogeneity between macro task dispatching and micro velocity control. To tackle these, we formalize the problem as SensUAV and propose a Two TimeScale Reinforcement Learning framework (TSRL). Specifically, TSRL separates decision-making into two cooperative layers. At the macro level, a task-embedding sensing dispatcher handles scalability by separately encoding distinct task features and sequentially evaluating UAV suitability before task selection. At the micro level, a wind-aware velocity controller learns fine-grained velocity scheduling to adapt to dynamic environmental variations. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that TSRL significantly outperforms baselines, achieving average system profit improvements of 20.1% in Hangzhou and 46.6% in Shanghai.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态环境下配送无人机参与式感知问题，提出双时间尺度强化学习框架（TSRL）。该框架将决策分为宏观任务调度和微观速度控制两层，宏观层采用任务嵌入感知分配器处理可扩展性，微观层使用风感知速度控制器适应环境变化。在杭州和上海真实数据集上的实验表明，TSRL比基线方法分别提升20.1%和46.6%的系统利润。
Motivation: 现有无人机感知方法忽略环境扰动（如风）对速度和能效的影响，直接应用于动态环境面临规模扩展瓶颈和多时间尺度决策异质性问题。
Method: 提出双时间尺度强化学习框架（TSRL），分为宏观任务嵌入感知分配器和微观风感知速度控制器两层，分别处理任务调度和速度控制。
Result: 在杭州和上海真实数据集上，TSRL分别实现20.1%和46.6%的平均系统利润提升，显著优于基线方法。
Conclusion: TSRL通过分离宏观和微观决策有效应对动态环境下的可扩展性和多时间尺度挑战，并展示了在真实城市环境中的有效性。

papers.title: HindsightBench: A Black-Box Behavioral Audit Protocol for Parametric Hindsight in Time-Indexed LLM Decision Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models leak parametric knowledge of realized outcomes into historical financial decision tasks. Existence is settled; what users lack is a cheap way to audit a given model for it. We present HindsightBench, a black-box behavioral audit protocol that profiles parametric hindsight in any time-indexed LLM decision task at probe-level cost (no backtests, no logprobs, no corpus access). The protocol chains a four-arm date-manipulation matrix (revealed/date-only/masked/transplanted), dual memory probes (date recovery; outcome recall), and six per-model metrics -- trigger strength, transplant effect, post-cutoff placebo, recoverability, behaviorally effective knowledge cutoff, and a recall-accuracy dissociation coefficient -- with explicit gates where identifiability is data-dependent. Applying it to 15 models from seven vendors on a 258-node vintage-correct macro panel yields three headline patterns: (i) the date-trigger reflex tracks training generation, not scale -- absent across the 2024 open-weight generation from 1B to 70B, present in every tested 2026-generation model, and switching on within one vendor lineage (Qwen3 -> Qwen3.6) at fixed MoE architecture and 3B active parameters; (ii) effective cutoffs span 22 months across vendors and precede vendor-reported dates by up to eight months, invalidating calendar-window placebo designs; (iii) audit results are not invariant to serving -- BF16 serving of an FP8-referenced model breaks the trigger estimate's stability while AWQ-INT4 preserves it, and a provider-locked reasoning regime makes one probe non-convergent -- so the protocol ships with operational requirements (pin quantization and thinking regime; disclose parser and sampling policy). We release the panel, frozen preregistrations, per-model audit rows with measured dollar costs, transcripts, and one-command regeneration.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Code, panel, and per-model audit rows: https://github.com/Khaozhe/hindsightbench (v1.0 release archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21453191)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HindsightBench，一个黑盒行为审计协议，用于检测大型语言模型在时间索引的决策任务中是否泄露了事后知识（parametric hindsight）。通过四臂日期操作矩阵、双记忆探针和六个指标，对15个模型进行审计，发现日期触发反射与训练代际相关，有效知识截止日期早于厂商报告日期，且审计结果受服务配置影响。
Motivation: 现有研究已证实LLM会泄露事后知识，但缺乏低成本、易实施的审计方法。用户需要一个无需回测、对数概率或语料库访问的协议来审计任意模型。
Method: 构建四臂日期操作矩阵（揭示/仅日期/遮蔽/移植）、双记忆探针（日期恢复和结果召回），以及六个指标（触发强度、移植效应、截止后安慰剂、可恢复性、行为有效知识截止、回忆-准确度分离系数），并设置数据依赖的可识别性门控。
Result: 对7家供应商的15个模型在258节点宏观面板上进行审计，发现：(i)日期触发反射与训练代际相关，而非模型规模——2024年开源模型（1B-70B）无此现象，2026年模型均存在，且在同一供应商的Qwen3到Qwen3.6切换中开启；(ii)有效知识截止日期跨度达22个月，比厂商报告日期早最多8个月；(iii)审计结果受服务配置影响（如BF16与AWQ-INT4量化、推理模式）。
Conclusion: 该协议提供了一种低成本、可复现的审计方法，揭示了LLM中事后知识泄漏的规律，并强调了审计时需固定量化、思维模式和采样策略等操作要求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimizing Regret
papers.abstract_en: Building on the identity that expected regret equals the covariance between costs and decisions, this paper develops the complete derivative theory of the covariance regret functional. We derive the Gâteaux derivative, showing that the universal steepest-descent direction is the contrarian policy $-(c-\bar{c})$, while ascent yields momentum. For linear policies $\hatπ(c) = Ac+b$, the gradient is the cost covariance matrix $Σ_c$, with a zero Hessian implying boundary-optimal solutions such as the minimum-variance portfolio. We extend to constrained optimization, sign-gradient duality between regret minimization and alpha maximization, finite-sample convergence bounds paralleling Thompson Sampling, and gradient-descent algorithms requiring only input observations, with applications to portfolio tilting and LLM-based allocation strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于期望后悔等于成本与决策协方差的恒等式，建立了协方差后悔泛函的完整导数理论。推导了Gâteaux导数，指出通用最速下降方向为逆向策略，而上升方向产生动量。对于线性策略，梯度为成本协方差矩阵，Hessian为零，导致边界最优解如最小方差组合。扩展到约束优化、后悔最小化与alpha最大化的符号梯度对偶、有限样本收敛界及梯度下降算法，应用于投资组合倾斜和基于LLM的分配策略。
Motivation: 现有后悔理论缺乏完整的导数分析框架，本文旨在为后悔优化提供严格的数学基础，并连接机器学习和金融优化。
Method: 从期望后悔的协方差表示出发，推导Gâteaux导数，分析线性策略下的梯度与Hessian，并扩展到约束优化、对偶性和收敛界，提出基于观测的梯度下降算法。
Result: 建立了后悔优化的完整导数理论，包括最速下降方向、动量、边界最优解、对偶性、收敛界等结果。
Conclusion: 本文为后悔优化提供了统一的数学框架，并展示其在投资组合和LLM分配中的潜在应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhanced NQS via Annealed Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Neural quantum states offer expressive representations of quantum many-body wave functions, yet their practical accuracy can be limited by stochastic optimization rather than representational capacity. Here we identify a finite-sample instability, termed subspace trapping, in which physically important configurations become strongly underestimated, remain absent from successive sampling batches and receive insufficient gradient feedback. This self-reinforcing loss of sampled support can confine optimization to an effective subspace and produce apparently stationary states above the true ground state energy. To address this problem, we introduce annealed gradient descent (AGD), a sampling-aware update with annealing factor that temporarily increases the relative contribution of sampled low-probability configurations while limiting the dominance of high-probability ones. We establish the connection between finite-sample support loss and effective subspace optimization, and then evaluate the method across molecular systems, one and two-dimensional $J_1$-$J_2$ models. Annealed gradient descent suppresses metastable trapping, preserves physically relevant configurations and enables compact neural quantum states to attain chemical accuracy and competitive state-of-the-art performance. These results establish AGD as a lightweight complement to expressive neural architectures, improved sampling strategies for scalable quantum many-body optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经量子态优化中存在的有限样本不稳定性（子空间陷阱）问题，提出退火梯度下降（AGD）方法。AGD通过退火因子暂时增加低概率构型的相对贡献，限制高概率构型的支配，从而抑制亚稳态陷阱，使紧凑的神经量子态达到化学精度和竞争性的最新性能。在分子系统和一维/二维J1-J2模型上进行了评估。
Motivation: 神经量子态在表达量子多体波函数时，由于随机优化而非表达能力限制，会出现有限样本不稳定性（子空间陷阱），导致物理重要构型被低估，优化陷入有效子空间，产生高于真实基态能量的表观稳态。
Method: 提出退火梯度下降（AGD），一种采样感知的更新方法，引入退火因子暂时增强低概率构型的相对贡献，同时限制高概率构型的支配，以缓解子空间陷阱。
Result: AGD抑制了亚稳态陷阱，保留了物理相关构型，使紧凑神经量子态在分子系统和一维/二维J1-J2模型上达到化学精度和竞争性的最新性能。
Conclusion: AGD作为轻量级补充，可与表达性强的神经架构和改进的采样策略结合，用于可扩展的量子多体优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reliability-Aware 3D Geometric Injection for Universal Person Re-identification
papers.abstract_en: Universal person re-identification (ReID) aims to retrieve pedestrian identities across diverse real-world scenarios, including severe occlusions, clothing changes, and cross-modality shifts, within a unified model. However, existing 2D representations fundamentally struggle with spatial ambiguities due to a lack of depth and topological awareness, while naively introducing monocular 3D priors often causes severe negative transfer due to geometric estimation noise under extreme visual degradation. To safely harness the clothing-invariant and canonical structural properties of 3D geometry, we propose UniGeo, a Universal Monocular 3D-Enhanced ReID framework driven by a Consistency-Aware Reliability Gate and Dual-Stream Residual Fusion. Specifically, the processing of 3D information is strategically decoupled into geometric extraction and dynamic utilization. To provide pure structural compensation, we project monocular 3D parameters into kinematic joint representations, explicitly capturing instance-level geometric topology to resolve appearance-based ambiguities. To robustly incorporate these cues without perturbing the reliable 2D feature space, we isolate the 3D prior as a late-stage structural residual; modulated by the consistency-aware gate, this mechanism adaptively filters geometric noise and enables controlled fallback to the pure 2D baseline. Extensive experiments show that our method improves challenging, structure-sensitive scenarios while preserving competitive performance on clean domains. Code is available at https://github.com/BohanSu/UniGeo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniGeo 框架，通过一致性感知可靠性门控和双流残差融合，将单目3D几何信息安全地注入通用行人重识别模型，解决遮挡、衣物变化等场景下的空间歧义问题，同时避免噪声干扰2D特征空间。实验表明该方法在结构敏感场景下显著提升性能，且在干净域保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有2D表示缺乏深度和拓扑信息，难以处理遮挡和外观变化；简单引入单目3D先验会因几何估计噪声导致负迁移。需要一种可靠的方式利用3D几何的服装不变性和拓扑结构。
Method: 采用一致性感知可靠性门控和双流残差融合。将单目3D参数投影为运动学关节表示以获取几何拓扑，并通过门控机制自适应过滤噪声，将3D信息作为后期残差注入2D基线。
Result: 在多个挑战性场景（遮挡、衣物变化、跨模态）上取得改进，同时在干净域保持与现有方法相当的性能。
Conclusion: 通过解耦几何提取与动态利用，可以安全地增强通用行人重识别在极端条件下的鲁棒性。
