papers.title: Temporal-Causal Unity as an Operational Framework for Collective Dynamics: Causal-Progress Clocks, Synchronization, and Polarization
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops temporal-causal unity (TCU), a framework connecting a process-philosophical thesis -- time is the ordered unfolding of causal change -- to an operational model of cognitive and social dynamics. The framework deliberately separates three claims: an interpretive thesis about becoming, a measurable causal-progress coordinate, and a stochastic network model. Causal progress is defined by $τ(t)=\int_0^tλ(s\mid\mathcal H_s)\,{\rm d}s$, where the nonnegative event intensity $λ$ must be specified independently of the outcome. Agents carry an orientation phase and an activation amplitude; weighted interaction, heterogeneous drift, external input, anchoring, and diffusion govern their evolution in $τ$. First- and second-harmonic order parameters separate consensus from bipolar polarization. For the all-to-all noisy Kuramoto special case with Lorentzian drift width $Δ$, synchronization begins at the conditional threshold $K_c = 2(Δ+ D)$, not at a universal constant. Reproducible numerical illustrations illustrate (not empirically demonstrate) this threshold, causal-clock curve collapse, and the consensus-polarization distinction. Six historical episodes are treated as scope probes rather than validation data. The paper derives falsifiable hypotheses and an out-of-sample protocol for comparing causal-progress and chronological-time models. TCU is therefore offered as a disciplined bridge between process ontology and complex-systems modeling, not as a replacement for spacetime physics or as an empirically established identity between time and causation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了时间-因果统一性（TCU）框架，将过程哲学论题（时间是因果变化的有序展开）与认知和社会动力学的操作模型联系起来。该框架区分了三个层面：关于生成的解释性论题、可测量的因果进展坐标以及随机网络模型。因果进展定义为τ(t)=∫₀ᵗλ(s|Hₛ)ds，其中非负事件强度λ需独立于结果指定。代理具有定向相位和激活幅度；加权交互、异质漂移、外部输入、锚定和扩散在τ中支配其演化。一阶和二阶序参量区分共识与双极极化。对于全连接噪声Kuramoto特例（洛伦兹漂移宽度Δ），同步始于条件阈值K_c=2(Δ+D)，而非普遍常数。可复现的数值示例说明了该阈值、因果钟曲线坍缩以及共识-极化区分。六个历史片段作为范围探针而非验证数据。论文推导了可证伪的假设和一个用于比较因果进展与时间时间模型的留出协议。TCU被视为过程本体论与复杂系统建模之间的纪律性桥梁，而非时空物理的替代或时间与因果之间经验上确立的同一性。
Motivation: 现有模型难以在因果、时间和集体动力学之间建立统一的操作框架，尤其是缺少一个独立于结果的可测量因果进展坐标。
Method: 提出TCU框架，定义因果进展τ(t)，并构建包含定向相位、激活幅度、加权交互、异质漂移、外部输入、锚定和扩散的随机网络模型。使用一阶和二阶序参量区分共识与极化，并分析全连接Kuramoto模型的特例阈值。
Result: 数值示例展示了同步阈值K_c=2(Δ+D)、因果钟曲线坍缩以及共识与极化的区分，但摘要明确表示这些是数值插图而非经验证明。
Conclusion: TCU提供了一个有纪律的桥梁，将过程哲学与复杂系统建模连接起来，但并非取代时空物理或主张时间与因果的等同；论文推导了可证伪假设和用于比较因果进展与时间时间模型的协议。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LatentMT: Machine Translation with Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Latent-reasoning looped language models (LoopLMs) offer a different scaling path for machine translation (MT): instead of increasing parameter count or emitting explicit chain-of-thought tokens, they spend additional recurrent computation inside hidden states. We introduce LatentMT, the first systematic study of latent-reasoning LoopLMs for machine translation. LatentMT adapts a small 2.6B-parameter backbone model with lightweight training. Across 32 translation directions spanning high-, mid-, and low-resource languages, LatentMT achieves performance comparable to models three to five times larger. It is competitive in a high-resource language and achieves state-of-the-art performance on both mid-resource and low-resource languages. Studying the behavior of scaling the number of recurrent reasoning steps, we find that recurrent computation consistently improves translation quality in early steps, then saturates quickly afterwards. Our mechanistic analysis shows that hidden-representation differences shrink along the recurrent reasoning-step axis, supporting the observed saturation in performance. Finally, our efficiency analysis shows that LatentMT requires lower training and inference compute than much larger non-latent-reasoning models with similar performance, making latent recurrent computation a promising path toward compact, efficient, and strong machine translation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究潜在推理循环语言模型（LoopLM）在机器翻译中的应用。LatentMT 使用 26 亿参数的轻量骨干模型，在 32 个翻译方向上（涵盖高、中、低资源语言）取得与三到五倍更大模型相当的性能，在中等和低资源语言上达到最优。增加循环步数能持续提升翻译质量但很快饱和，计算效率优于同等性能的非潜在推理大模型。
Motivation: 现有机器翻译模型主要靠扩大参数量或显式思维链来提升性能，而潜在推理提供了一种不同的缩放路径，即在隐藏状态中增加循环计算而不发射显式 token。但此前缺乏对此类模型在翻译任务上的系统研究。
Method: 提出 LatentMT，将潜在推理循环语言模型（LoopLM）适配到机器翻译任务，使用 2.6B 参数的轻量骨干，通过轻量训练并支持可调节的循环推理步数。
Result: 在 32 个翻译方向上，LatentMT 性能与 3~5 倍大的模型相当，在中低资源语言上达到最优；循环步数增加早期明显提升质量，随后饱和；训练和推理计算量显著低于同等性能的非潜在推理大模型。
Conclusion: 潜在循环推理是走向紧凑、高效且强大的机器翻译模型的有前景路径，但循环步数的收益存在饱和现象。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stochastic Meta-Unlearning: Bridging Language Backbone and Multimodal Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning for vision-language models (VLMs) remains underexplored. Unlike language models, VLMs combine a language backbone with visual components, which makes unlearning more complex. There is a surprising phenomenon when moving from single-modality unlearning to VLM unlearning: a target forgotten by the standalone language backbone can still be recovered when image information is given to the full VLM. This shows that text-only feedback is not enough for reliable VLM unlearning. Motivated by this observation, we propose Stochastic Meta-Unlearning (SMU), a bilevel framework that uses VLM-level feedback to learn an unlearning-ready initialization. In the inner loop, SMU applies a few unlearning steps to the language backbone using text data. In the outer loop, SMU recomposes the updated backbone with the frozen VLM and evaluates forgetting and utility at the VLM level. This design makes the unlearning update aware of the final multimodal behavior, while still keeping the update local to the language backbone. Experiments on two VLMs, two multimodal meme datasets, and three baselines show that SMU achieves the best overall forget-retain trade-off. Compared with the strongest baseline for each metric, SMU reduces average Forget accuracy by 10.52 points and improves average Retain and Test accuracy by 20.10 and 17.01 points, respectively. More importantly, SMU also transfers to new forgetting targets and to different meta-test unlearning methods. These results suggest that VLM-level feedback can make language-backbone unlearning more reliable and more transferable for VLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）中的机器遗忘问题，发现单独语言骨干的遗忘在VLM中可能被恢复，提出随机元遗忘（SMU）框架，利用VLM级反馈学习遗忘就绪的初始化。实验表明SMU在遗忘-保留权衡上优于基线，并具有可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有语言模型遗忘方法在迁移到VLM时，目标被语言骨干遗忘后仍可从图像信息中恢复，说明文本反馈不足以实现可靠的VLM遗忘。
Method: 提出双层次框架SMU，内环对语言骨干进行少量遗忘步骤（文本数据），外环将更新后的骨干与冻结VLM重组，在VLM级评估遗忘和效用，使遗忘更新感知最终多模态行为，同时保持更新局部于语言骨干。
Result: 在两个VLM、两个多模态模因数据集、三个基线上，SMU实现最佳遗忘-保留权衡；与最强基线相比，平均遗忘准确率降低10.52点，保留和测试准确率分别提高20.10和17.01点；并能迁移到新遗忘目标和不同元测试遗忘方法。
Conclusion: VLM级反馈可使语言骨干遗忘更可靠且更具可迁移性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mitigating Matthew Effect: Multi-Hypergraph Boosted Multi-Interest Self-Supervised Learning for Conversational Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: The Matthew effect is a big challenge in Recommender Systems (RSs), where popular items tend to receive increasing attention, while less popular ones are often overlooked, perpetuating existing disparities. Although many existing methods attempt to mitigate Matthew effect in the static or quasi-static recommendation scenarios, such issue will be more pronounced as users engage with the system over time. To this end, we propose a novel framework, Multi-Hypergraph Boosted Multi-Interest Self-Supervised Learning for Conversational Recommendation (HiCore), aiming to address Matthew effect in the Conversational Recommender System (CRS) involving the dynamic user-system feedback loop. It devotes to learn multi-level user interests by building a set of hypergraphs (i.e., item-, entity-, word-oriented multiple-channel hypergraphs) to alleviate the Matthew effec. Extensive experiments on four CRS-based datasets showcase that HiCore attains a new state-of-the-art performance, underscoring its superiority in mitigating the Matthew effect effectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/zysensmile/HiCore.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiCore 框架，通过构建多通道超图（物品、实体、单词）和多兴趣自监督学习，缓解对话推荐系统（CRS）中因用户-系统动态反馈循环加剧的马太效应。在四个 CRS 数据集上的实验表明，HiCore 达到新的最先进性能，有效减轻了流行物品偏见。
Motivation: 现有推荐系统在静态或准静态场景下尝试缓解马太效应，但在对话推荐系统（CRS）中，用户与系统的动态交互会进一步加剧流行物品被过度关注、非流行物品被忽视的问题。
Method: 提出多超图增强的多兴趣自监督学习框架（HiCore），构建物品、实体、单词三个视角的超图以学习多级用户兴趣，并通过自监督任务增强表示。
Result: 在四个 CRS 基准数据集上，HiCore 取得了新的最先进性能，有效减轻了马太效应。
Conclusion: HiCore 通过多通道超图和多兴趣自监督学习有效缓解了对话推荐中的马太效应，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Intelligent Multi-UAV Navigation in ITNTNs: A Hierarchical LLM Approach
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of high-speed Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in 3D aerial highways necessitates robust coordination of physical flight kinematics and multi-tier network handovers. While Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers rapid tactical control, it lacks the zero-shot strategic reasoning required to quickly adapt to dynamic Integrated Terrestrial and Non-Terrestrial Networks (ITNTNs). Conversely, Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at semantic reasoning but suffer from high inference latency, rendering them unsuitable for real-time aerodynamic control. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel Hierarchical LLM-driven control framework. A massive cloud-based LLM deployed on a High-Altitude Platform Station (HAPS) manages slow-timescale global load balancing, while lightweight edge-LLMs on individual UAVs translate local observations into tactical sub-goals. These sub-goals guide a fast-timescale physical DRL controller to execute collision-free, handover-aware trajectories. Simulation results demonstrate that our agentic architecture significantly reduces collision rates and improves aggregate system throughput compared to existing baselines.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE GLOBECOM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高速无人机在3D空中高速公路中的导航与网络切换问题，提出分层大语言模型（LLM）控制框架。云端LLM部署于高空平台站（HAPS）负责慢时间尺度全局负载均衡，轻量级边缘LLM在无人机上生成战术子目标，指导快速时间尺度的物理深度强化学习（DRL）控制器执行避碰与切换感知轨迹。仿真表明该架构相比基线显著降低碰撞率并提升系统吞吐量。
Motivation: 深度强化学习（DRL）缺乏零样本战略推理以适应动态综合天地网络（ITNTN），而大语言模型（LLM）推理延迟高，不适用于实时气动控制。现有方法难以兼顾全局负载均衡与实时轨迹规划。
Method: 提出分层LLM驱动控制框架：云端LLM（部署于HAPS）管理慢时间尺度全局负载均衡；边缘LLM（部署于无人机）将局部观测转化为战术子目标；快速时间尺度DRL控制器执行避碰、切换感知的轨迹规划。
Result: 仿真结果表明，所提架构相比现有基线显著降低碰撞率并提升系统总吞吐量。
Conclusion: 该分层LLM框架可有效融合LLM的战略推理与DRL的实时控制能力，适用于动态ITNTN中的多无人机导航。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoIndex: Learning Representation Programs for Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: We present AutoIndex, a framework for learning representation programs: executable transformations that map raw documents into the representations exposed to a retrieval system. Rather than tuning retrievers, rerankers, or a small set of preprocessing hyperparameters, AutoIndex searches over programs that slice, enrich, normalize, reweight, or reorganize documents before indexing. At each iteration, AutoIndex performs validation-guided program search, in which agents diagnose failures of the current program and synthesize candidate updates, retaining only updates that improve retrieval quality under the resulting index. We evaluate AutoIndex on CRUMB, a benchmark of heterogeneous retrieval tasks, with BM25 held fixed across all experiments. The learned programs improve recall over a static full-document BM25 baseline on all 8 tasks, with average gains of +8.4% in Recall@100 and +8.3% in nDCG@10, and largest gains of +30.5% in Recall@100 and +43.6% in nDCG@10. These results suggest that document representation should not be treated as a fixed preprocessing choice made before retrieval begins, but as an explicit optimization target. Code to reproduce our results is available at https://github.com/auto-index/autoindex.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoIndex 是一个用于学习检索表示程序的框架，它通过搜索可执行的程序对文档进行切片、增强、归一化、重加权或重组，以优化索引后的检索质量。在 CRUMB 基准上，使用固定 BM25 检索器时，学习到的程序在所有 8 个任务上都优于静态全文 BM25 基线，平均 Recall@100 提升 8.4%，nDCG@10 提升 8.3%，最大提升分别达 30.5% 和 43.6%。
Motivation: 现有的检索系统通常将文档表示视为固定的预处理步骤，而作者认为文档表示应作为显式优化目标，以提高检索质量。
Method: 提出 AutoIndex 框架，通过验证引导的程序搜索，由代理诊断当前程序的失败并合成候选更新，仅保留能提升检索质量的更新。
Result: 在 CRUMB 基准上，对 8 个异构检索任务，AutoIndex 学习到的程序相比静态全文 BM25 基线，平均 Recall@100 提升 8.4%，nDCG@10 提升 8.3%，最大提升分别为 30.5% 和 43.6%。
Conclusion: 文档表示不应是检索前的固定预处理选择，而应作为显式优化目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BRIDGE: Bottleneck-Aware Regulator-Set Inference and Diagnosis for Cooperative Gene Regulatory Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative gene regulation often depends on groups of regulators acting jointly, but most gene regulatory network (GRN) inference methods output pairwise regulator-target rankings. We introduce Bottleneck-Aware Regulator-Set Inference and Diagnosis (BRIDGE), a framework for complete regulator-set recovery, and Targeted Recovery Attribution for Cooperative Evaluation (TRACE), a diagnostic suite that attributes failures to retrieval, set-level scoring, decoding, and evaluation bottlenecks. TRACE includes a leak-free mechanism-mismatch cooperativity stress test in which cooperative targets are generated by random nonlinear mechanisms rather than product interactions. This design avoids feature-mechanism circularity: Residual higher-order set scoring (Residual HOS2) operates on raw expression vectors without handcrafted product-correlation features. Across 30 matched seed-cooperativity settings, Residual HOS2 improves Jaccard similarity from 0.382 to 0.460, recall from 0.522 to 0.597, and exact recovery from 0.053 to 0.113 over a decomposable pairwise set scorer (PairS2), although exact recovery remains low. On SERGIO DS3, oracle retrieval and TRACE show that candidate coverage is necessary but insufficient because set-level misranking remains the dominant source of exact-recovery failure. PairS2 proposal followed by Residual HOS2 reranking reduces HOS2-scored candidate sets by 94-97% while largely preserving exact-recovery behavior. These results distinguish edge ranking, candidate retrieval, set-level scoring, and exact cooperative regulator-set recovery as separate objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BRIDGE框架用于合作基因调控网络（GRN）中完整调控因子集合的恢复，并引入TRACE诊断套件，通过分解失败原因（检索、集合评分、解码、评估瓶颈）来提升性能。方法包括无泄漏机制失配的协同压力测试和残差高阶集合评分（Residual HOS2），在30种种子-协同性设置下，Jaccard相似度从0.382提升至0.460，召回率从0.522提升至0.597，精确恢复率从0.053提升至0.113。结果还显示候选覆盖是必要但不充分条件，集合级误排仍是精确恢复失败的主要原因。
Motivation: 现有基因调控网络推断方法主要输出成对调控因子-靶标排名，忽略了多调控因子协同作用的情形，缺乏完整的调控因子集合恢复能力。
Method: 提出Bottleneck-Aware Regulator-Set Inference and Diagnosis (BRIDGE)框架和Targeted Recovery Attribution for Cooperative Evaluation (TRACE)诊断套件，包含无泄漏机制失配协同压力测试和残差高阶集合评分（Residual HOS2），后者直接在原始表达向量上操作，避免手工制作的特征。
Result: 在30种匹配的种子-协同性设置下，Residual HOS2相比可分解的成对集合评分器（PairS2）将Jaccard相似度从0.382提升至0.460，召回率从0.522提升至0.597，精确恢复率从0.053提升至0.113。在SERGIO DS3上，TRACE诊断显示集合级误排是精确恢复失败的主要瓶颈。PairS2提案后接Residual HOS2重排序可减少94-97%的HOS2评分候选集，同时基本保留精确恢复表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调应将边排名、候选检索、集合级评分和精确合作调控因子集合恢复视为独立的目标，并指出候选覆盖是必要但不充分条件，集合级误排是主要失败瓶颈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Self-Evolving Default Action for Cooperative Tasks with Continuous Action Space
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual credit assignment has proven effective in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for discrete action spaces, yet its extension to continuous-action cooperative tasks remains challenging. Existing methods that approximate the counterfactual baseline via Monte Carlo sampling often introduce bias into policy gradients and fail to guarantee convergence to local optima, as the sampled actions may not have been sufficiently trained. To address these limitations, we propose SAFE, a novel MARL framework that employs a counterfactual baseline conditioned on a self-evolving default action sampled from each agent's experience buffer. This design naturally extends to continuous action spaces without relying on additional simulations, reward models, or environment-specific prior knowledge. The baseline accurately quantifies each agent's contribution, and introduces no bias into the deterministic policy gradient, ensuring convergence to local optima. Extensive experiments on cooperative vehicular tasks demonstrate that SAFE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续动作空间中的多智能体合作任务，提出一种名为SAFE的框架，使用自演进的默认动作（self-evolving default action）构造反事实基线，避免了蒙特卡洛采样带来的偏差，并保证了策略梯度无偏收敛到局部最优。实验在合作性车辆任务上优于现有模型。
Motivation: 现有反事实信用分配方法在连续动作空间中通过蒙特卡洛采样近似基线，引入偏差且无法保证收敛到局部最优。
Method: 提出SAFE框架，利用每个智能体经验缓冲区中采样的自演进默认动作构造反事实基线，无需额外仿真、奖励模型或环境先验知识。
Result: 在合作性车辆任务上的实验表明，SAFE一致优于当前最优模型。
Conclusion: 该设计使得反事实基线自然扩展到连续动作空间，且保证确定性策略梯度的无偏性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Frontier AI performance across the business disciplines: a case-grounded benchmark of knowledge work and analytical reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are improving rapidly as reflected in benchmark scores, yet these AI benchmarks largely test capabilities such as factual recall, narrow question answering, mathematical problem-solving, and coding and agentic tool-use. What remains poorly measured is AI progress on the analytical knowledge work white-collar professionals perform daily, including synthesizing complex information, exercising judgment under uncertainty and incomplete information, applying strategic and adversarial thinking in multi-stakeholder settings, weighing trade-offs, and producing defensible, structured analyses. This gap is even more pronounced for subjective components of such work, where success can be challenging to define. The "case method" form of education practiced by top business schools provides a natural foundation for addressing this measurement gap, and we construct BusinessCaseBench, a benchmark spanning hundreds of questions drawn from business cases across eighteen disciplines, each paired with a grading rubric derived from the expert-written instructor case solution. On BusinessCaseBench, frontier AI models already score highly against instructor rubrics, and capability within one model family improves substantially over two years. These results provide strong evidence that AI performance on this class of work is already high and rapidly improving, with implications for business schools, where case pedagogy trains undergraduates and MBAs in this kind of analytical reasoning, and for entry-level professional roles, where such skills have historically anchored early-career work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 当前AI基准测试主要评估事实回忆、窄问答、数学和编程能力，但缺乏对白领分析性知识工作的衡量。本文基于商学院案例教学法，构建了BusinessCaseBench基准，涵盖18个学科的数百个问题，每个问题配有专家评分标准。前沿AI模型在该基准上已取得高分，且同一模型系列的能力在两年内显著提升，表明AI在分析性推理方面的表现已很高且快速进步。
Motivation: 现有AI基准测试未能测量白领专业人员日常进行的分析性知识工作，如综合信息、在不确定条件下判断、战略性思考和多利益相关者权衡等，尤其缺乏对主观成分的评估。
Method: 基于商学院案例教学法，构建BusinessCaseBench基准，包含来自18个学科的数百个问题，每个问题均配有专家编写的详细评分标准（instructor case solution）。
Result: 前沿AI模型在BusinessCaseBench上已取得高分，且同一模型系列的能力在两年内显著提升，提供了AI在该类工作上表现优异且快速进步的强有力证据。
Conclusion: AI在分析性知识工作上的表现已很高且快速进步，对商学院案例教学法和依赖此类技能的入门级专业角色具有重要影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MeanFlowNFT: Bringing Forward-Process RL to Average-Velocity Generators
papers.abstract_en: MeanFlow generators achieve fast few-step sampling by predicting average velocities over time intervals, making them attractive for efficient generation. Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful way to align diffusion and flow models with human preferences and task-specific objectives. In particular, DiffusionNFT offers an efficient forward-process RL framework that does not require reverse-process trajectories or likelihood estimation. However, applying such RL methods to MeanFlow remains underexplored. DiffusionNFT optimizes instantaneous velocities, whereas MeanFlow samples with average velocities. To bridge this gap, we introduce MeanFlowNFT. Inspired by the MeanFlow identity, which bridges average and instantaneous velocities, we construct an induced instantaneous-velocity predictor. We apply the DiffusionNFT objective to this predictor, making reward optimization well-defined for MeanFlow. Sampling remains based on the average velocity, preserving MeanFlow's fast few-step generation. We further prove that MeanFlowNFT inherits DiffusionNFT's strict policy-improvement guarantee. Experiments on image and video generation show that MeanFlowNFT consistently improves baselines. Moreover, it outperforms prior state-of-the-art RL-tuned few-step generators on most metrics ($6$ of $8$ on SD3.5-M), and can even surpass multi-step RL-tuned diffusion while using only a few sampling steps. For instance, on Wan 2.1, $4$-step MeanFlowNFT reaches a VBench score of $84.33$, surpassing $50$-step LongCat-Video RL ($82.57$).
papers.comment: Project Page: https://harahan.github.io/meanflownft-project-page/, GitHub: https://github.com/Harahan/MeanFlowNFT, Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/Harahan/MeanFlowNFT, Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Harahan/meanflownft-fewstep-generation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MeanFlowNFT，将前向过程强化学习（DiffusionNFT）扩展到平均速度生成器（MeanFlow）上。通过 MeanFlow 恒等式构造瞬时速度预测器，将 DiffusionNFT 的奖励优化目标应用于该预测器，同时采样仍使用平均速度，保留快速少步生成能力。实验表明，MeanFlowNFT 在图像和视频生成上一致提升基线，在 SD3.5-M 上 8 个指标中 6 个超越先前 SOTA 少步生成器，且 4 步 MeanFlowNFT 在 Wan 2.1 上 VBench 达到 84.33，超过 50 步 LongCat-Video RL 的 82.57。
Motivation: DiffusionNFT 等前向过程 RL 方法优化瞬时速度，但 MeanFlow 生成器使用平均速度采样，直接应用 RL 存在 gap。需要桥接两者以利用 RL 对齐优势而不损失 MeanFlow 的少步采样效率。
Method: 利用 MeanFlow 恒等式连接平均速度与瞬时速度，构建诱导的瞬时速度预测器。将 DiffusionNFT 的优化目标应用于该预测器，同时采样阶段仍使用原始平均速度，并证明该框架继承 DiffusionNFT 的严格策略改进保证。
Result: 在图像和视频生成任务上，MeanFlowNFT 一致优于未经 RL 微调的基线。在 SD3.5-M 上，8 个指标中 6 个超过先前最先进的 RL 微调少步生成器。在 Wan 2.1 上，4 步 MeanFlowNFT 获得 VBench 84.33，超越 50 步 LongCat-Video RL 的 82.57。
Conclusion: MeanFlowNFT 成功将前向过程 RL 应用于平均速度生成器，实现了策略改进保证并保持了少步生成优势。

papers.title: Team RAS in 11th ABAW Competition: Multimodal Ambivalence Recognition Approach
papers.abstract_en: Automatic recognition of ambivalence and hesitancy is challenging because these states may be expressed through inconsistent linguistic, acoustic, facial, and contextual patterns, while top-performing systems often rely on computationally expensive ensembles. We present a single text-centered multimodal approach for video-level ambivalence and hesitancy recognition for the 11th Affective & Behavior Analysis in-the-Wild (ABAW) Challenge. The proposed approach combines linguistic, acoustic, facial, and scene features using text-centered multimodal fusion model. Text Residual Fusion treats text as the anchor modality and applies gated residual adjustments based on the other modalities. Experiments on the Behavioural Ambivalence/Hesitancy (BAH) corpus confirm that text is the strongest unimodal modality. The Text Residual Fusion model achieves an average Macro F1-score (MF1) of 75.14% across the Development and Public Test subsets. On the Private Test subset, it reaches an MF1 of 78.24%, outperforming the text model by 4.03%. These results demonstrate that complementary multimodal information can improve recognition performance without requiring a large model ensemble.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对ABAW挑战中的矛盾与犹豫情绪识别任务，提出以文本为中心的多模态融合方法。该方法将文本作为锚定模态，通过门控残差调整融合语言、声学、面部和场景特征。在BAH语料库上，文本残差融合模型在开发集和公共测试集上平均Macro F1为75.14%，在私有测试集上达到78.24%，比纯文本模型提升4.03%。
Motivation: 矛盾与犹豫状态的自动识别具有挑战性，因为其表达可能涉及不一致的语言、声学、面部和上下文模式，而现有高性能系统常依赖计算昂贵的集成方法。
Method: 提出以文本为中心的文本残差融合（Text Residual Fusion）模型，将文本作为锚定模态，基于其他模态信息对文本特征进行门控残差调整。
Result: 在BAH语料库上，开发集和公共测试集平均Macro F1为75.14%；私有测试集Macro F1为78.24%，比纯文本模型提升4.03%。
Conclusion: 互补的多模态信息可以在不需要大型模型集成的情况下提升识别性能。

papers.title: RetroAgent: Harnessing LLMs to Search Over Structured Memory for Agentic Retrosynthesis Planning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step retrosynthesis planning seeks to decompose a target molecule into commercially available building blocks through a sequence of feasible reactions. The vast combinatorial search space makes this task challenging even for expert chemists. Traditional methods combine tree search with offline-trained value networks that score candidates in isolation, without reasoning about complete multi-step routes. Recent work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) for this task, but relies on simple interfaces that limit exploration of the full search space. We introduce RetroAgent, an LLM agent that bridges symbolic search and neural reasoning through a harness with structured memory. Through memory and chemistry tools, the agent observes the full search state, including explored routes, available alternatives, and properties of intermediates, enabling informed decisions grounded in both global progress and domain knowledge. Experiments on in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks demonstrate that RetroAgent delivers strong performance and generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RetroAgent，一种利用大语言模型（LLM）作为智能体，结合结构化记忆进行多步逆合成路径规划的方法。通过内存和化学工具，智能体能够观察完整搜索状态，包括探索过的路径、可用替代方案和中间体性质，从而做出基于全局进展和领域知识的决策。在分布内和分布外基准测试中表现出强性能和泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有逆合成规划方法要么依赖离线训练的价值网络独立评分候选分子，无法推理多步路线；要么使用简单接口的LLM，限制了对完整搜索空间的探索。需要一种更智能的搜索策略。
Method: 引入RetroAgent，一个LLM智能体，通过结构化记忆将符号搜索与神经推理桥接。智能体利用记忆和化学工具观察完整搜索状态，包括已探索路径、可用替代方案和中间体性质，以支持基于全局进度和领域知识的决策。
Result: 在分布内和分布外基准测试上，RetroAgent表现出强性能和泛化能力。
Conclusion: RetroAgent通过结合结构化记忆和LLM推理，有效提升了逆合成规划的搜索效率和泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NexForge: Scaling Agent Capabilities through Requirement-Driven Task Synthesis for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Scaling executable agent training data for LLM post-training is bottlenecked by substrate-bound methods that tie task generation to predefined tools, repositories, or skill graphs: expanding coverage requires manual substrate engineering, each new domain demands a bespoke pipeline, and the resulting task distributions often reflect substrate biases rather than real-world demand. We introduce NexForge, a requirement-driven framework that takes high-level capability requirements as input and synthesizes diverse, executable agent tasks and expert trajectories for SFT. NexForge first investigates real-world demand to construct representative scenarios and task profiles, then performs distribution-aware compilation to generate task directives. For each directive, NexForge automatically retrieves or constructs the required files, dependencies, and runtime configurations, and finally synthesizes expert rollouts and produces training trajectories. Without domain-specific infrastructure, NexForge produces 3.6K terminal and 2K office tasks, improving Qwen3.5-35B-A3B Base from 22.5\% to 52.0\% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 and from 813 to 1338 Elo on GDPval; scaling further to 43.2K terminal tasks yields 58.4\%, on par with Claude Opus 4.6 equipped with Claude Code. Scaled further, NexForge-synthesized data contributes to the training of Nex-N2, a family of publicly available agent models that lift Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to 75.3\% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and to 1585 Elo on GDPval -- achieving state-of-the-art open-source performance and surpassing several frontier proprietary systems. Nex-N2 models are available at https://nex.sii.edu.cn/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NexForge是一个需求驱动的任务合成框架，用于为LLM后训练生成可执行的智能体任务和专家轨迹。它从真实世界需求出发，自动构建场景、任务配置、文件依赖和运行时环境，并生成训练数据。在终端和办公任务上，NexForge合成数据显著提升了模型性能，并训练了开源智能体模型Nex-N2，在Terminal-Bench和GDPval上达到开源最优。
Motivation: 现有智能体训练数据生成方法受限于预定义工具、仓库或技能图，扩展新领域需要大量人工工程，且任务分布存在偏见。
Method: 提出需求驱动框架NexForge：先调研真实需求构建场景和任务画像，进行分布感知编译生成任务指令，自动检索或构建文件及运行时配置，最后合成专家轨迹。
Result: 生成3.6K终端和2K办公任务，使Qwen3.5-35B-A3B Base在Terminal-Bench 2.0上从22.5%提升至52.0%，在GDPval上从813 Elo提升至1338；扩展到43.2K终端任务后达58.4%，与Claude Opus 4.6+Claude Code持平。Nex-N2模型在Terminal-Bench 2.1上达75.3%，GDPval达1585 Elo，超越多个前沿商业系统。
Conclusion: NexForge通过需求驱动合成可扩展的智能体训练数据，无需领域特定基础设施，可有效提升LLM智能体能力，且合成数据有助于训练开源领先模型。

papers.title: Recursive ArUco Markers: A Scalable Fiducial Marker Design for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Landing Pads
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) increasingly rely on visual fiducial markers for autonomous navigation and precision landing. However, standard markers suffer from limited operational ranges, becoming undetectable when the camera is either too far or too close. While recursive and fractal markers have been proposed to address this issue, existing approaches either require the marker's center to remain visible, making them vulnerable to occlusion, or are limited in their recursion depth and placement. We propose a novel Recursive ArUco marker design. Our method allows any standard fiducial marker to be transformed into a recursive marker with an arbitrary depth. By employing a modified bit-sampling strategy during detection, we embed complete markers within both the black and white bits of the parent marker. This approach guarantees unlimited recursion depth and robust detection even with partial occlusion, as it does not rely on the marker's center being visible. Furthermore, by maintaining a single, unique identifier across all recursive scales, our proposal provides an extensive dictionary of multiple unique landing pads. This capability allows fleets of UAVs to operate simultaneously, with each drone landing at its designated location -- a feature not supported by existing Fractal and Harco markers due to their structural and dictionary constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种递归ArUco标记设计，允许任意标准基准标记转换为具有任意深度的递归标记，通过改进的位采样策略在父标记的黑白位中嵌入完整标记，实现无限递归深度和鲁棒检测，支持部分遮挡，并保持跨递归尺度的唯一标识符，为多无人机同时着陆提供扩展字典。
Motivation: 现有标准基准标记在无人机着陆任务中工作范围有限，远距离或近距离时难以检测；现有递归或分形标记要么依赖中心可见，易受遮挡，要么递归深度和放置受限。
Method: 提出一种递归ArUco标记方法，通过改进的位采样策略，在父标记的每个黑白位中嵌入完整子标记，无需中心可见，支持任意深度递归，且所有尺度共享单一唯一标识符。
Result: 摘要声称该方法实现无限递归深度，在部分遮挡下仍能鲁棒检测，并提供大量唯一着陆标记，支持多无人机同时着陆。
Conclusion: 本文提出的递归ArUco标记解决了现有标记的局限，为无人机自主着陆提供了可扩展、鲁棒的视觉基准方案。

papers.title: The Café in Amsterdam: When the Incumbent Becomes the Oracle
papers.abstract_en: A field can reformulate its computations freely exactly where its demand is stated independently of any incumbent implementation, and finds itself unable to when the incumbent's own output has quietly become the specification. This note offers that observation as a lens on computational reformulation for modern accelerators, where posing a problem in a hardware-friendly form can yield large speed and energy gains, but only if a replacement can be judged at all. Building on the test-oracle problem (Weyuker; Barr et al.), on requirements engineering's notion of implementation bias (Zave and Jackson), and on the case for judging approximate designs by acceptability rather than numerical proximity (Felzmann et al.), it names the pathology "baseline capture": the moment an incumbent stops being evidence that a demand can be met and becomes the definition of meeting it. It then separates two questions that are easily confused: whether a reformulation can be judged at all, which turns on the existence of an incumbent-independent demand, and whether its discovery can be automated, which turns additionally on the cost of evaluating that demand. Short cases -- shortest-path routing, learnable audio frontends, ZIP-215 for Ed25519 signature validation, CESM-ECT for climate models, and a single-GEMM audio frontend measured at 1.64x-3.29x speedup and up to 3.03x less energy -- illustrate the pattern and the move of "buying a verifier": making a demand explicit, operational, and independent of the incumbent. No component is claimed novel in isolation; the contribution is the synthesis and the single question it makes easy to ask of any reformulation result -- does its acceptance test mention the incumbent's output?
papers.comment: 4 pages, two-column. v2: corrected the definition of representation (existential, not universal); demand now stated as a criterion rather than a set of outputs; minor notation fixes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别并命名了计算重构中的一种病理现象——"基线捕获"（baseline capture）：当现有实现（incumbent）的输出悄然成为规范定义时，领域无法自由地以无关实现的方式重构计算。基于测试预言问题、需求工程中的实现偏差以及近似设计可接受性判据，作者区分了两个易混淆的问题：重构是否可以被评判（取决于是否存在独立于基线的需求），以及其发现能否自动化（还取决于评判需求的开销）。通过最短路径路由、可学习音频前端、ZIP-215签名验证、气候模型ECT以及一个单GEMM音频前端的案例（实测获得1.64倍至3.29倍加速、节能最高3.03倍）来说明该模式以及"购买验证器"（buying a verifier）的做法——使需求显式化、可操作化且独立于基线。
Motivation: 现代加速器上的计算重构常因基线实现被默认为规范而受阻，领域难以判断替代方案是否有效。作者旨在揭示并命名这一系统性障碍，以便在研究社区中明确讨论。
Method: 通过整合软件测试中的测试预言问题、需求工程中的实现偏差概念以及近似设计可接受性判据，提出"基线捕获"这一术语，并区分评判可行性（依赖于独立需求的存在）与自动化发现（附加需求评估成本）两个层面。
Result: 摘要描述了多个案例以说明该模式，并报告了一个单GEMM音频前端实现获得1.64倍至3.29倍加速、节能最高3.03倍的实证结果。

papers.title: Deep-learning Causal Retrieval Optimization for Efficient e-commerce Distribution in Pinterest
papers.abstract_en: Pinterest is where people turn inspiration into action as users browse ideas, then take steps toward realization, often by discovering shoppable content. To support this journey, we must distribute commerce content when it helps, not when it distracts. We frame this as a causal decision of triggering shopping candidate generators in early retrieval and deploy a production system at Pinterest that learns personalized and contextualized triggering policies. A deep multi-task model jointly predicts outcomes and uplift of multiple events, trained with a doubly-robust pseudo-outcome alongside calibrated outcome losses for stable, single-robust uplift learning. A randomized data logging supplies counterfactual coverage, and the model is evaluated by both regular and reverse metrics for full assessment. A linear-time offline replay is designed to select thresholds and forecast policy impact with extremely high consistency with online results. For productionization, the model runs in parallel with remote retrieval calls without end-to-end latency regression. At web scale, we cut shopping triggers by up to 85% while holding key shopping sessions neutral, improving important total sessions (+0.26%) and Pin saves (+1.10%), with significant infrastructure savings. By unifying deep causal learning with reliable offline replay and demonstrating production-grade deployment, this work provides a generally practical recipe for early-retrieval optimizations in modern cascading recommenders beyond shopping, aligning exploration and cost with user intent at scale.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于深度学习的因果检索优化系统，用于Pinterest电商场景中控制购物候选生成器的触发时机。通过多任务模型联合预测多个事件的结果和提升度，结合双重稳健伪结果训练，并设计线性时间离线回放来选取阈值。系统在保持关键购物会话不变的情况下，减少了高达85%的购物触发，同时提升了总会话数（+0.26%）和Pin保存（+1.10%），并节省了基础设施成本。
Motivation: 在Pinterest购物旅程中，过早或过多地触发电商内容会干扰用户体验，因此需要因果决策框架来决定何时触发购物候选生成器，平衡用户意图与系统成本。
Method: 采用深度多任务模型联合预测多个事件的结果和提升度（uplift），使用双重稳健（doubly-robust）伪结果与校准结果损失进行稳定学习；通过随机数据日志提供反事实覆盖；设计线性时间离线回放选择阈值并预测策略效果。
Result: 在Web规模上，购物触发减少85%，同时关键购物会话保持中性，总会话数提升0.26%，Pin保存提升1.10%，并带来显著的基础设施节省。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个通用的早期检索优化方案，可应用于现代级联推荐系统中，将深度因果学习与可靠离线回放相结合，并在生产环境中得到验证。

papers.title: Resist and Update: Counterfactual Report Coordinates for Incentive-Compatible LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Aligned language models routinely misreport under non-evidential pressure: they cave to a confident user, yet fail to revise when genuine evidence arrives. We cast this as a failure of internal incentive-compatibility and study the two demands, resist (ignore forbidden pressure) and update (follow licensed evidence), on a Bayesian-witness benchmark with known posteriors, where the same user disagreement is evidence or pressure purely by stated source reliability, removing the evidence/pressure confound by construction. Using interchange interventions rather than probes, we causally localize low-rank report coordinates for answer, confidence, and caveat, establishing causal sufficiency at a late intervention site rather than uniqueness or necessity, with a causal cross-talk matrix showing strong own-coordinate control and only small cross-effects (partial functional disentanglement). We then introduce a training-free counterfactual report-coordinate (CRC) clamp that references the model's own report under an incentive-neutralized counterfactual of the prompt. The two-pass full-window clamp attains resist and update of $1.00$ jointly (Wilson 95% CI $[0.99,1.00]$; the rank-16 projection alone reaches $0.88/0.90$), which we read as a causal certificate and upper bound under a constructible reference, not a claim of a deployed solution. Tested global decoding and fixed-direction steering trade one objective against the other, and resist-only training collapses updating to $0.01$. The deployable single-pass compilation is lossy ($0.73/0.97$). The mechanism and the clamp reproduce across three model families and transfer to a natural sycophancy benchmark with significant paired improvements. Our contribution is the interface and certification method: activation-level counterfactual incentive-invariance as a structural primitive for internal incentive-compatibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在非证据压力下误报的问题，将其归因于内部激励兼容性失败。作者提出反事实报告坐标（CRC）夹子方法，通过干预激活层实现模型对禁止压力的抵抗和对证据的更新，在贝叶斯见证基准上达到联合完美性能。该机制跨模型家族复现并迁移至自然谄媚基准。
Motivation: 对齐的语言模型在面对自信用户时会妥协，但在出现真正证据时却不能更新，这种不对称性破坏了激励兼容性。
Method: 采用交换干预（interchange interventions）定位低秩报告坐标，并提出无需训练的反事实报告坐标夹子，通过模型在激励中性反事实提示下的自身报告进行校准。
Result: 两遍全窗口夹子使resist和update均达到1.00（95% CI [0.99,1.00]），秩-16投影达到0.88/0.90。抵抗训练会导致更新降至0.01。单遍编译有损（0.73/0.97）。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种接口和认证方法：激活层面的反事实激励不变性作为内部激励兼容性的结构基元。方法在多个模型家族上复现并迁移至自然谄媚基准，实现了显著的配对改进。

papers.title: FormalAnalyticGeo: A Neural-Symbolic Based Framework for Multimodal Analytic Geometry Problem Generation
papers.abstract_en: Math reasoning has achieved significant progress with the rapid advancement of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), however analytic geometry remains largely underexplored, primarily due to the scarcity of annotated samples. Existing diagram generation approaches struggle with analytic geometry: template methods cannot handle constraint-driven layouts, and generative models lack the geometric precision to render annotated conic curves correctly. We present FormalAnalyticGeo, a scalable framework for fully automatic generation of multimodal analytic geometry problems. Leveraging the rigor of formal languages, we design the framework around CDL (Condition Description Language), a formal intermediate representation that bridges free-form problem text with precise diagram rendering via a Signed Distance Field (SDF) engine. The framework employs four specialized LLM components in sequence: a Generator that produces diverse analytic geometry problems, a Formalizer that converts each problem into CDL for SDF-based rendering, a Measurer that extracts ground-truth answers through vision-based measurement on the rendered diagrams, and a Quality Verifier that checks outputs at three stages. Structured feedback from the Quality Verifier drives automatic retry, forming a closed loop that eliminates any need for human annotation. Applying FormalAnalyticGeo at scale yields AnalyticGeo7K, a dataset of over 7K verified multimodal problems, each with aligned text, diagram, formal annotation, and ground truth.Experiments show that the generated problems achieve a median ground-truth relative error of 0.70\%, with 82.3\% of answers falling within 5\% of the exact symbolic solution. Our framework and dataset will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FormalAnalyticGeo，一个基于神经-符号的多模态解析几何问题自动生成框架。利用形式语言 CDL（条件描述语言）作为中间表示，结合符号距离场渲染引擎，通过四个专用 LLM 组件（生成器、形式化器、测量器、质量验证器）实现从文本到带注解图的全自动生成，无需人工标注。框架生成 AnalyticGeo7K 数据集，包含 7000+ 个经过验证的多模态问题，其中答案中位数相对误差 0.70%，82.3% 的答案在精确符号解的 5% 以内。
Motivation: 解析几何领域因标注样本稀缺而未被充分探索，现有模板方法无法处理约束驱动的布局，生成模型缺乏渲染带注释圆锥曲线的几何精度。
Method: 设计 CDL 形式语言作为中间表示，连接自由文本与基于 SDF 的精确绘图引擎；采用四个专用 LLM 组件（生成器、形式化器、测量器、质量验证器）顺序工作，质量验证器的结构化反馈驱动自动重试，形成无需人工标注的闭环。
Result: 生成问题答案的中位数相对误差为 0.70%，82.3% 的答案在精确符号解的 5% 以内；构建的 AnalyticGeo7K 数据集包含 7000+ 个已验证的多模态问题。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了利用形式语言和神经符号方法实现几何问题自动生成的可行性，数据集和框架将公开释放，有望推动解析几何推理研究。

papers.title: Evidence-Grounded AI for Musculoskeletal Care
papers.abstract_en: Musculoskeletal diseases are among the leading causes of disability and drive the greatest global need for rehabilitation. Because recovery, remodelling and degeneration of bones, joints and related tissues unfold over months to years, care requires longitudinal management rather than isolated decisions. Clinicians must repeatedly integrate evolving patient evidence, medical knowledge and stage-specific functional goals, yet evidence is often fragmented across visits, departments and hospital systems, disrupting continuous, individualised management. Here we report OrthoPilot, a clinical artificial intelligence (AI) system powered by a large language model (LLM) that integrates hospital data streams with authoritative external knowledge for continuous musculoskeletal care. It autonomously retrieves real-time imaging, laboratory, pathology and order data and translates evolving patient states into evidence-based decisions from admission diagnosis through rehabilitation planning. We established a specialist-validated benchmark from real-world electronic health records (EHRs) spanning 1,000 disease codes. In a full-pathway reader study against 81 orthopaedic physicians, OrthoPilot outperformed experts with 25 years of experience in diagnostic reasoning, clinical decision-making and management planning. This advantage generalised across 60 external clinical centres, where OrthoPilot surpassed all evaluated intelligent systems. In a prospective physician decision-making study of 1,870 complex cases, OrthoPilot improved full-chain management success by 10.6%. In a randomised deployment involving 8,240 inpatients, integration into routine care increased cumulative cases per bed by 9.7% and improved patient-reported access to health information. These results move clinical AI from predicting isolated events toward executing longitudinal management across complete musculoskeletal care pathways.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报道了 OrthoPilot，一个基于大语言模型的临床 AI 系统，用于肌肉骨骼疾病的纵向管理。该系统自动整合医院数据流与外部知识，从入院诊断到康复计划提供基于证据的决策。在多项研究中，OrthoPilot 在诊断推理、临床决策和管理计划上超越了有 25 年经验的专家，并在前瞻性研究和随机部署中分别将全链管理成功率提升 10.6% 和每床累计病例增加 9.7%。
Motivation: 肌肉骨骼疾病需要长期纵向管理，但临床证据分散于不同就诊、科室和医院系统，导致管理不连续且个性化不足。
Method: 提出 OrthoPilot，一个由大语言模型驱动的临床 AI 系统，能够自主检索实时影像、实验室、病理和医嘱数据，并结合外部权威知识进行基于证据的决策。
Result: 在 81 位骨科医生的全路径读片研究中，OrthoPilot 在诊断推理、临床决策和管理计划上优于 25 年经验的专家；在 60 个外部临床中心中超越所有评估的智能系统；在前瞻性研究中将 1870 例复杂病例的全链管理成功率提高 10.6%；在 8240 名住院患者的随机部署中使每床累计病例增加 9.7%。
Conclusion: 结果表明，临床 AI 可以从预测孤立事件转向执行完整的纵向管理路径，提升肌肉骨骼护理的连续性和效率。

papers.title: LakeQuest: A Three-Domain Benchmark for Grounded Question Answering across Data Lakes
papers.abstract_en: While modern question answering (QA) systems excel on clean, schema-aligned corpora, real-world knowledge is rarely so neatly packaged. Answering questions over enterprise and scientific data lakes requires systems to navigate heterogeneous, weakly structured collections of tables, passages, and linked metadata. Current benchmarks abstract away this noisy discovery process, failing to evaluate end-to-end performance. To bridge this gap, we introduce LakeQuest, a human-validated benchmark of 9,846 QA pairs designed to evaluate the end-to-end retrieve-and-synthesize pipeline over realistic data lakes. LakeQuest spans three diverse domains (AI/ML metadata, retail banking, and multimodal biomedical drug information) and pairs every question with exact, modality-aware evidence pointers. By isolating source discovery from cross-modal synthesis, LakeQuest exposes critical failure modes in modern QA systems. Our baseline evaluations, including standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic tool-use methods, reveal that high-quality retrieval does not guarantee correct reasoning. Systems consistently struggle with relation chaining in metadata graphs, policy grounding in bank ledgers, and joint tabular QA in biomedical contexts, highlighting the need for robust discovery and faithful cross-file composition mechanisms in future agentic QA systems.

papers.title: Training-Free Semantic-Edge Response Decoding of SAM3 for Cross-Domain Infrastructure Crack Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-project crack segmentation is hindered by variations in materials, imaging conditions, crack morphology, and background interference. Text-promptable foundation models reduce task-specific training, but SAM3's final region proposals may suppress, truncate, or distort weak and fragmented cracks. We propose \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{E}dge \textbf{R}esponse \textbf{D}ecoding (\textbf{SERD}), a training-free method that replaces the proposal interface with the internal language-conditioned response. SERD normalizes this dense response, calibrates it using a fixed Sobel structural prior, and applies a single threshold to generate the crack mask. SAM3 remains frozen, with no target-domain annotation, auxiliary prompting network, or test-time optimization. When CamCrack789 is used only for threshold selection, SERD achieves 58.00\% average Crack IoU on five unseen datasets, compared with 54.33\% for native SAM3. Across six rotated source-domain settings, SERD obtains 60.23\% mean target-domain IoU and 67.18\% Boundary F1, exceeding SAM3 by 3.27 and 2.70 percentage points. Regional, structural, foreground-area, robustness, and latency analyses show that direct response decoding recovers substantial crack evidence lost during proposal formation, while structural calibration improves precision and boundary localization. The results demonstrate that internal-response decoding provides a simple and transferable interface for cross-domain infrastructure crack segmentation. \textit{Code is available at: \href{https://github.com/xauat-liushipeng/SERD}{GitHub}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SERD (Semantic-Edge Response Decoding)，一种无需训练的方法，通过解码 SAM3 内部的语言条件响应并利用 Sobel 结构先验进行校准，实现跨领域基础设施裂缝分割。在五个未见数据集上，SERD 的平均裂缝 IoU 达到 58.00%，优于原生 SAM3 的 54.33%。
Motivation: 跨项目裂缝分割受材料、成像条件、裂缝形态和背景干扰的影响，现有文本提示基础模型（如 SAM3）的区域提议可能会抑制、截断或扭曲弱裂缝和碎片化裂缝。
Method: SERD 替换 SAM3 的提议接口，直接使用内部语言条件响应，通过归一化、Sobel 结构先验校准和单阈值处理生成裂缝掩码，无需训练、目标域标注或辅助网络。
Result: 在五个未见数据集上，SERD 的平均裂缝 IoU 为 58.00%，比原生 SAM3 高 3.67 个百分点；在六个旋转源域设置下，目标域平均 IoU 为 60.23%，边界 F1 为 67.18%，分别超过 SAM3 3.27 和 2.70 个百分点。
Conclusion: 内部响应解码为跨领域基础设施裂缝分割提供了一种简单且可迁移的接口，SERD 恢复了大量在提议形成过程中丢失的裂缝证据，结构校准提高了精度和边界定位。

papers.title: AdvNav: Behavior-Guided Black-Box Adversarial Attacks on Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Despite progress in Embodied AI, Vision-and-Language Navigation systems remain vulnerable to adversarial visual disturbances. Most existing methods rely on white-box access to target model gradients, which is often unrealistic for real-world deployed systems and computationally exhaustive due to recursive backpropagation for optimization, limiting their applicability. While previous black-box methods predominantly target single-step, instantaneous decision tasks, they struggle to handle the task complexities and temporal dependencies. This highlights the need for a gradient-free attack method that can effectively disrupt the multistep sequential perception-action loop using only observable inputs and outputs. Therefore, we propose AdvNav, a behavior-guided black-box adversarial attack framework that disturbs an agent's first-person views during navigation. To construct an informative surrogate objective for effective optimization guidance in gradient-free search under the black-box setting, we design a dual-granularity behavior-based feedback, aggregating a trajectory-level performance score representing overall navigation degradation, an action-level reward score considering the potential decision risk, and a deviation indicator, all of which are extracted from the agent's self-output behaviors. This feedback guides a hybrid optimization strategy that heuristically tunes perturbation strength via adaptive updates and evolves noise spatial structure genetically, to iteratively discover the most disruptive noise configuration. Evaluated against Transformer-based HAMT and LLM-based MapGPT with two types of backbones on R2R dataset, AdvNav achieves 49.70/65.96/87.30% Attack Success Rate. The result demonstrates the effectiveness and generality of AdvNav, reveals critical perception vulnerabilities and offers insights for the design of future resilient VLN models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdvNav，一种行为引导的黑盒对抗攻击框架，针对视觉-语言导航（VLN）系统的多步感知-行动循环。通过设计双粒度行为反馈（轨迹级性能、动作级奖励和偏离指标）指导混合优化策略（启发式自适应扰动强度与遗传噪声结构进化），在无需梯度的情况下迭代寻找破坏性噪声。在 R2R 数据集上对 HAMT 和 MapGPT 进行攻击，成功率达到 49.70%/65.96%/87.30%，揭示了 VLN 模型的感知脆弱性。
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击多依赖白盒梯度访问，不适用于现实部署系统，且黑盒方法难以处理 VLN 的多步时序依赖和任务复杂性。
Method: AdvNav 框架：从 agent 自身输出行为提取双粒度反馈（轨迹级性能得分、动作级奖励得分和偏离指示器），指导基于自适应更新和遗传进化的混合优化策略，在无梯度条件下搜索最优扰动。
Result: 在 R2R 数据集上，针对 Transformer 基 HAMT 和 LLM 基 MapGPT，AdvNav 的攻击成功率分别为 49.70%、65.96% 和 87.30%。
Conclusion: 结果表明 AdvNav 有效且具有泛化性，暴露了关键感知漏洞，为设计鲁棒 VLN 模型提供了见解。

papers.title: Falsifiable Release Gates for Self-Improving Systems: Standing Invariants at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Safety claims for self-improving agent runtimes are almost always self-graded: a policy file, a guardrail, a promise in a README. We describe falsifiable release gates, a methodology in which every new capability must pass a pre-declared, machine-checkable acceptance suite before it ships, while a fixed set of standing invariants is preserved across every gate. We instantiate it in Antahkarana, an open runtime, then do what a method paper is only vindicated by: we follow the same runtime as it grows and ask whether the guarantees survive. The safety-critical property, that no action reaches an effector without a capability token minted by a control ring, is machine-checked exhaustively over the reachable states of a bounded model; a deliberately broken model yields the shortest counterexample, so the checker demonstrably has teeth. We then carry the runtime through six further releases. Across every one, the action-safety invariants INV-1 through INV-6 held without a single change, and one release added three capabilities while introducing no new invariant. Under the same teeth discipline, six more machine-checked families were added: memory with provable unlearning, a governed agent, calibrated abstention over a post-quantum record, a harness of many sub-agents, the self-improvement loop itself, and the residency of what it produces. The acceptance suite grew from 122 tests to 563. The load-bearing result sits in the negative space: across more than a doubling of capability, the safety core was neither weakened nor redesigned. The last families are the first on real hardware: gated self-improvement compounds a small model from 20% to 70% accuracy while auto-rejecting a candidate that only inflates confidence, and the whole governed path costs 0.021 ms per request, 0.008% of model inference. We release the runtime, tools, and gate suite; every number reproduces with a single command.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 14 figures. Major revision merging the follow-up "Standing Invariants at Scale" into this paper per arXiv moderation: the machine-checked action-safety core preserved across six further releases, six new invariant families with teeth, and real-hardware self-improvement; suite grown from 122 to 563 tests. Software, gate suite, run artifacts, and TLA+ spec are open source
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可证伪的发布门控（falsifiable release gates）方法，要求每个新能力在发布前必须通过预先声明的、机器可检查的验收套件，同时保持一组固定不变的不变量。作者在Antahkarana开源运行时中实例化该方法，并通过六个连续版本验证了动作安全不变量的持久性。从122个测试增长到563个，安全核心在能力翻倍后既未削弱也未重新设计。真实硬件上的自我改进将小模型准确率从20%提升至70%，同时每条请求的管控开销仅为0.021毫秒。
Motivation: 自我改进系统的安全性声明通常是自我评级的（如策略文件、护栏或README中的承诺），缺乏可验证的保证。本文旨在提供一种方法论，确保每次发布新能力时，预定义的、机器可检查的不变量得到保持。
Method: 描述可证伪的发布门控方法：每个新能力必须通过预先声明的验收套件，且一组固定的站立不变量（standing invariants）在每次门控中保持不变。在Antahkarana运行时中实例化，并使用有界模型检查对所有可达状态进行穷举验证。故意破坏模型可产生最短反例以展示检验的有效性。
Result: 经过六个版本，动作安全不变量INV-1至INV-6无需任何更改；增加了三个能力但未引入新不变量。新增六个机器检查族（可证明遗忘的记忆、受控智能体、后量子记录上的校准弃权、多子智能体、自我改进循环及其产物驻留）。测试套件从122个增至563个。在真实硬件上，门控自我改进将小模型准确率从20%提升至70%，同时自动拒绝仅提高置信度的候选；每条请求的管控路径耗时0.021毫秒，仅为模型推理时间的0.008%。
Conclusion: 本文通过实证表明，在能力翻倍的情况下，安全核心既未削弱也未重新设计，验证了所提方法在规模上的有效性。所有结果均可通过单条命令复现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ARMOR: Stabilizing On-Policy LLM RL with Off-Policy Anchor Samples
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has significantly enhanced the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet the training process remains notoriously fragile. In this work, we investigate a critical source of this instability: over-optimization, where models exploit training heuristics at the expense of generalizable reasoning. While reverse KL regularization is the standard defense against such degradation, our analysis reveals that it is often insufficient in this regime, as it fails to ensure comprehensive coverage of the reference distribution. To address this, we propose ARMOR (Anchor Rollout and Mixed Optimization for RL), a framework that shifts the paradigm from passive penalty to active sample stabilization. ARMOR comprises two key components: (1) Anchor Rollout, which leverages off-policy data from the reference policy to preserve established solution patterns; and (2) Mixed Optimization, which reformulates the policy objective to enable controlled exploration without relying on auxiliary losses. Extensive experiments on reasoning benchmarks validate that ARMOR effectively mitigates validation collapse, enabling sustained performance improvements over extended training horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线策略强化学习（on-policy RL）训练大语言模型（LLM）时的不稳定性问题，发现过度优化（over-optimization）是重要原因，且反向KL正则化不足以覆盖参考分布。提出ARMOR框架，通过锚点 rollout（Anchor Rollout）利用离线策略数据保存已有解模式，并结合混合优化（Mixed Optimization）控制探索，无需辅助损失。实验证明该方法能有效缓解验证坍塌（validation collapse），在推理基准上实现持续性能提升。
Motivation: 大语言模型强化学习训练过程脆弱，容易因过度优化导致泛化能力下降。现有反向KL正则化虽为标准防御手段，但在该场景下无法确保对参考分布的充分覆盖，亟需更稳定的训练方法。
Method: 提出ARMOR框架，包含两个关键组件：1) Anchor Rollout，从参考策略采样离线数据以维持已有解模式；2) Mixed Optimization，重新定义策略目标函数，在不依赖辅助损失的情况下实现受控探索。
Result: 在推理基准上的大量实验表明，ARMOR能有效缓解验证坍塌，并在更长训练周期中持续提升性能。
Conclusion: ARMOR通过主动稳定样本而非被动惩罚，为在线策略RL训练LLM提供了更稳定的方法，但摘要未提及其他任务或理论局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One mechanism for many mental spaces: a shared router over a value slot in language models
papers.abstract_en: Language builds discourse contexts other than the actual: a painting, a belief, a memory, a hypothetical. Each is a mental space in which the same entity can take a different value, as when a flower is red in reality but purple in a portrait. Formal semantics keeps these contexts apart because their logics differ (modal, temporal, doxastic, depictive). Fauconnier's mental-space theory, by contrast, treats them as one space-building operation. We ask which of these a transformer language model implements, and find a mechanistic version of Fauconnier's unification. The model uses one router/slot format across the inventory: a reusable value slot stores attributed content, and a causally manipulable router (the space index) selects which space is read. A subspace trained with Distributed Alignment Search to control one space type, counterfactual, belief, fictional, or temporal, also controls the others, well above a random floor, on three model families. Belief, which formal semantics marks as a distinct case, is not specially separated. The router is low-rank, composes additively with entity identity, and acts through a few late-layer heads. Two further results show the mechanism drives inference and composes: a subspace trained on a rule-derived conclusion flips what the model infers while dissociating from what it reports, and composing space-builders mints a fresh router over the shared slot. This paper establishes the cross-type generality. A companion paper develops belief in depth, because of its special status in philosophy, psychology, and linguistics (epistemology, theory of mind, and propositional attitude reports).

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究Transformer语言模型是否实现Fauconnier的心理空间理论中的统一空间构建操作。通过机制分析，发现模型在所有心理空间类型（反事实、信念、虚构、时间等）上使用共享的路由器/值槽机制：一个可复用的值槽存储属性内容，一个可因果操作的路由器（空间索引）选择读取哪个空间。使用分布式对齐搜索训练的子空间控制一个空间类型后，也能控制其他类型，且信念空间并未被特殊区分。路由器是低秩的，与实体身份加性组合，通过少数后期层注意力头起作用。
Motivation: 形式语义学认为不同心理空间（模态、时间、信念、描绘等）逻辑不同，应分开处理；而Fauconnier的心理空间理论将其视为统一的构建操作。本文想确定Transformer语言模型到底采用哪种观点，即是否存在一个统一的跨类型机制。
Method: 使用分布式对齐搜索（Distributed Alignment Search）训练子空间来控制特定空间类型（反事实、信念、虚构、时间），然后测试该子空间对其他空间类型的控制能力。在三个模型家族上进行实验，并通过低秩分析、因果干预和组合实验揭示机制。
Result: 一个空间类型的子空间能显著控制其他空间类型，远高于随机基线；信念空间并未被特殊分离。路由器是低秩的，与实体身份加性组合，通过少数后期层注意力头实现。此外，子空间能翻转模型推理结论，且组合不同空间构建者能生成新的路由器。
Conclusion: 本文建立了心理空间跨类型通用性的机制证据，支持Fauconnier的统一观点。信念空间的特殊性将在后续论文中深入探讨。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An LLM-powered Agentic Recommendation System for Connected TV Content Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Recommendation systems, from traditional multi-stage to recent unified generative architectures, face challenges in incorporating diverse contextual signals, such as trending topics, breaking news, cultural events, and cross-surface user activities, into their ranking pipelines. These systems are designed to consume structured behavioral signals with consistent schemas, and lack the reasoning capability to naturally process unstructured or heterogeneously formatted contextual information. Incorporating such signals typically requires feature engineering, bespoke data pipelines, and carefully tuned heuristics. In this paper, we present an LLM-powered agentic recommendation system designed for Connected TV (CTV) content discovery that addresses these limitations. Our system leverages the reasoning capabilities of large language models to naturally process and synthesize diverse signals across varying schemas and structures, eliminating much of the manual integration inherent in traditional ranking and retrieval systems. Recognizing that current LLM-based solutions still fall short of traditional machine learning models in several recommendation tasks, including retrieval efficiency, personalization precision, and scalability, we adopt an agentic architecture that orchestrates specialized components, allowing each sub-task to be handled by the most suitable method, whether LLM-based or traditional ML. The main contribution of this work is our engineering approach to successfully overcoming the practical limitations of enabling LLM for recommendation, particularly inference latency. We share insights from our work and discuss the trade-offs and lessons learned in building a hybrid system that combines the flexibility of LLMs with the performance of established recommendation techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的代理推荐系统，用于联网电视（CTV）内容发现。系统利用LLM的推理能力处理非结构化上下文信号（如趋势话题、突发新闻、文化活动），并通过代理架构协调专用组件（包括LLM和传统ML）以克服LLM在检索效率、个性化精度和可扩展性方面的不足。主要贡献在于工程方法上成功解决了LLM用于推荐的推理延迟问题。
Motivation: 传统推荐系统难以自然融入非结构化或异构格式的上下文信号（如趋势话题、跨平台用户活动），通常需要手动特征工程和定制数据流水线。
Method: 采用代理架构，将推荐任务分解为多个子任务，每个子任务由最合适的方法（LLM或传统机器学习）处理，并通过LLM的推理能力综合多种信号。重点优化推理延迟。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称成功克服了LLM用于推荐时的推理延迟问题，分享了构建混合系统的经验教训和权衡。
Conclusion: 本文的工程方法展示了结合LLM灵活性与传统推荐技术性能的可行性，但仍需进一步优化LLM在推荐任务中的效率和精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RUBRIC: Realism--Utility Balanced Ranking for Imbalanced Classification
papers.abstract_en: Class imbalance poses a fundamental challenge in risk-sensitive applications such as fraud detection and medical diagnosis, where minority-class samples are scarce yet critical for accurate classification. Existing oversampling methods generate synthetic samples to rebalance class distributions; however, they often produce large numbers of low-quality candidates that distort decision boundaries or introduce artifacts, leading to overfitting and degraded generalization. In this work, we introduce RUBRIC, a generator-agnostic filtering framework that formulates synthetic sample selection as a quality-over-quantity optimization problem. RUBRIC ranks candidates using a realism-utility trade-off: realism is quantified by a learned discriminator that distinguishes real samples from synthetic samples, while utility captures proximity to the decision boundary through a concave margin-based scoring function. We show that, under mild regularity conditions, the proposed filtering strategy monotonically tightens the generalization bound for margin-based classifiers by jointly reducing distribution shift and suppressing near-negative tail contributions. Through extensive experiments on credit-card fraud detection and other imbalanced benchmarks, we demonstrate that RUBRIC improves F1-macro and recall while maintaining comparable ROC-AUC across several generators. We also provide explicit lambda-sensitivity analysis to show how users can recover AUPRC when ranking quality is prioritized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RUBRIC 框架，通过真实性-效用平衡筛选合成样本以改进不平衡分类。该方法利用判别器评估真实性，并基于边际的凸函数衡量效用，理论证明其能收紧泛化界，实验在信用卡欺诈检测等任务上提升 F1-macro 和召回率。
Motivation: 现有过采样方法生成大量低质量合成样本，导致决策边界扭曲和过拟合，尤其在高风险应用中影响严重。
Method: 提出生成器无关的过滤框架 RUBRIC，将合成样本选择建模为质量优先的优化问题，通过真实性（判别器区分真假）和效用（接近决策边界的边际得分）的权衡进行排序。
Result: 在信用卡欺诈检测等多个不平衡基准上，RUBRIC 提升 F1-macro 和召回率，同时保持 ROC-AUC 相当，并提供了 λ 灵敏度分析。
Conclusion: 实验表明基于真实性-效用平衡的样本筛选能有效改善过采样质量，且理论分析支持其泛化优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Applying JEPA-Style Predictive Learning to JA4-Derived Network Fingerprints
papers.abstract_en: I-JEPA and V-JEPA learn by matching latent predictions to target encoder outputs rather than regenerating the original input, and this has worked well for images and video. We explore whether the same objective works for compact network fingerprints. We built JA4-JEPA, a Transformer-based model trained on JA4, JA4H, JA4S, and JA4X subfields drawn from JA4DB and CIC-IDS- 2017. The training data combines roughly 397K samples from both sources, though no single sample contains all four view families. We evaluated the learned representations with a frozen kNN probe on protocol-family classification across TLS, DNS, and SSH. On 39,416 heldout samples the model achieved a cosine similarity of 0.9899 and a kNN accuracy of 0.9220. These results indicate that JEPA-style predictive learning can produce useful embeddings from JA4-derived fingerprints, even with incomplete view overlap across sources. Keywords: JA4, network fingerprinting, JEPA, predictive representation learning, self-supervised learning
papers.comment: the manuscript requires substantial revision following further validation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索将JEPA风格的预测学习（I-JEPA/V-JEPA）应用于JA4系列网络指纹表征学习。作者构建了JA4-JEPA模型，在JA4DB和CIC-IDS-2017的约39.7万样本上训练，使用冻结kNN探针在协议族分类任务上评估，达到0.9899余弦相似度和0.9220准确率，表明即便视角不完整也能学到有用嵌入。
Motivation: 验证JEPA预测学习目标（匹配潜在预测与目标编码器输出）能否从紧凑的网络指纹中学习有效表征，填补该领域在自监督表示学习方面的空白。
Method: 基于Transformer构建JA4-JEPA模型，输入JA4、JA4H、JA4S、JA4X子字段，训练数据来自两个来源（约39.7万样本），无需所有样本包含全部四个视图。
Result: 在39,416个保留样本上，余弦相似度达0.9899，kNN准确率达0.9220（协议族分类：TLS、DNS、SSH）。
Conclusion: JEPA式预测学习可从JA4网络指纹生成有用嵌入，即使不同来源的视图覆盖不完全。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Transdiagnostic Space of Disorder Like Phenotypes in Reinforcement Learning Agents
papers.abstract_en: Modelling psychological disorders in artificial agents offers a testbed for computational psychiatry and a lens on affective-control failure modes. Prior work induces one or two disorders by hand-tuned reward shaping, labels the behaviour post hoc, and reports single runs. We recast disorder modelling as dose-controllable manipulation of cognitive appraisal signals in an appraisal-guided PPO agent, expressing seven disorders (anxiety, mania, obsessive-compulsive checking, depression, impulsivity, addiction, and post-traumatic stress) each as a single knob grounded in a computational psychiatry account, with each symptom measured by a preregistered assay. Across more than a thousand runs (10 seeds, four controls, 95% confidence intervals) every disorder shows a graded, monotone dose-response that no control reproduces. Beyond these induced effects, three findings emerge that were not written into the reward: disorders self-organise into a two-dimensional affective space in which mania mirrors anxiety; removing a knob remits reward-distortion disorders (mania, checking, addiction) but not avoidance disorders (anxiety, PTSD), which recover under a graded exposure curriculum; and two simultaneous knobs interact nonadditively, yielding testable comorbidity predictions. The depression and addiction knobs further reproduce their double dissociation in a 3D pixel environment (MiniWorld) with a standard convolutional agent and no appraisal critic, showing the framework generalises beyond grid worlds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出在强化学习智能体中将心理障碍建模为认知评价信号的剂量可控操纵，在评价引导的PPO智能体中用单个旋钮表达七种障碍（焦虑、躁狂、强迫检查、抑郁、冲动、成瘾、创伤后应激），并通过预注册测试测量症状。超过1000次运行（10个种子，四个对照组，95%置信区间）表明每种障碍均表现出分级单调剂量反应，且对照组无法复现。进一步发现障碍自组织成二维情感空间，躁狂与焦虑镜像；移除旋钮可恢复奖励扭曲障碍但非回避障碍；两个旋钮同时作用产生非加性交互，提供可测试的共病预测。框架在MiniWorld像素环境中泛化。
Motivation: 先前心理障碍建模工作通常手工调整奖励诱导一两种障碍，后验标记行为，且仅报告单次运行，缺乏系统性和可重复性。
Method: 将障碍建模为认知评价信号的剂量可控操纵，在评价引导的PPO智能体中用单个旋钮表达七种障碍，每种症状由预注册测试测量，并在超过1000次运行中系统评估。
Result: 每种障碍均显示分级单调剂量反应；障碍自组织成二维情感空间；移除旋钮可恢复奖励扭曲障碍但非回避障碍；两个旋钮非加性交互产生共病预测。
Conclusion: 该框架在更复杂的像素环境（MiniWorld）中泛化，抑郁和成瘾旋钮在标准卷积智能体中复现双分离，表明方法超越简单网格环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Feature Learning for the High Dimensional Stationary Schödinger Equation with Deep Ritz Method
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates feature learning within the framework of the deep Ritz method for solving the stationary Schrödinger equation with Neumann boundary conditions. We first analyze the convergence of Riemannian gradient descent in an agnostic setting, where the hypothesis function is restricted to a single-index model while the PDE solution is arbitrary. We prove that gradient descent reaches an approximate global minimum: after T = O(log(1/ε)) iterations, the loss is within εof a constant multiple of the optimal loss. We then examine the loss landscape when the source term of the PDE itself follows a single-index model, considering hypothesis functions given by either a single-index model or a two-neuron multi-index model. In the single-index case, we show that the minimum Ritz energy is attained at the feature vector aligned with that of the source term. In the two-neuron case, we study the landscape of regularized Ritz losses and characterize how a second feature emerges, given that the first feature is aligned with the source, as the regularization parameter varies. Finally, numerical experiments are presented to validate the feature emergence theory in the two-neuron setting.

TL;DR: 本文研究使用深度Ritz方法求解高维平稳薛定谔方程时的特征学习问题。理论分析了单指标模型下的梯度下降收敛性，以及源项为单指标/双神经元多指标模型时的损失景观，并用数值实验验证了特征涌现理论。
Motivation: 高维偏微分方程的数值求解中，深度神经网络的特征学习机制尚不明确，尤其对于静止薛定谔方程这类问题。
Method: 在深度Ritz框架下，考虑假设函数为单指标模型（与任意PDE解）的agnostic设置，以及源项服从单指标或双神经元多指标模型时，分析梯度下降收敛性和损失景观。
Result: 单指标agnostic设置下，梯度下降经过 O(log(1/ε)) 次迭代达到近似全局最小；单指标源项下，最优Ritz能量由与源特征对齐的特征向量实现；双神经元情况中，正则化参数变化导致第二个特征涌现。
Conclusion: 论文为高维薛定谔方程中深度Ritz方法的特征学习提供了理论保证，但arxiv评论指出当前版本有待完善，尚未公开发表。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prompt Robustness Is Task-Dependent: Comparing Objective and Belief-Style Questions in LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Survey-style evaluations of large language models often treat a prompted response as a measure of a model's values or beliefs. This assumption is particularly fragile when responses are read as evidence of political values, social attitudes, or beliefs. We ask whether prompt robustness differs between objective questions with fixed answers and subjective questions that ask for opinions or values. We evaluate four instruction-tuned model families on three objective datasets (MMLU, ARC, and CulturalBench) and three subjective datasets (Political Compass Test, ValueBench, and World Values Survey). For each question/statement, we apply multiple types of prompt changes, such as variations in wording, framing, and format, and measure whether the model gives the same answer across variants. Using a binomial generalized estimating equation, we find significant effects of model, dataset, prompt category, and their interactions. The dataset type effect is also significant, and the interaction between dataset type and prompt category is large. These results show that prompt robustness depends on the question type, the prompt change, and the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在客观问题和主观问题上的提示鲁棒性差异。通过对四种指令微调模型在三个客观数据集（MMLU、ARC、CulturalBench）和三个主观数据集（政治光谱测试、ValueBench、世界价值观调查）上应用多种提示变体，使用二项式广义估计方程分析，发现提示鲁棒性取决于问题类型、提示变化和模型本身。
Motivation: 现有LLM评估常将提示响应视为模型价值观或信念的度量，但这一假设对不同类型问题（客观与主观）的鲁棒性可能不同，需系统研究其差异。
Method: 对四种指令微调模型家族，在三个客观和三个主观数据集上，应用措辞、框架和格式等多种提示变体，通过二项式广义估计方程（GEE）检验模型、数据集、提示类别及其交互效应的显著性。
Result: 模型、数据集、提示类别及其交互效应显著；数据集类型效应显著，且数据集类型与提示类别的交互效应较大。提示鲁棒性因问题类型、提示变化和模型而异。
Conclusion: 摘要强调提示鲁棒性具有任务依赖性，评估LLM时需考虑问题类型对结果的影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BioSecBench-Refusal: A paired metric for performance and alignment in agentic biosecurity risk assessment
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents are incorporated into life science workflows, the capabilities that speed discovery might also enable misuse. We present BioSecBench-Refusal, a benchmark for risk identification and refusal behavior for biological research tasks. The benchmark pairs 61 Routine tasks, legitimate analyses adapted from the published literature, with 46 Red-Team tasks, fictional scenarios that resemble real research but conceal a biosecurity hazard. Across 16 model-harness configurations, refusal rates ranged from 7 percent to 74 percent on Routine tasks and 1 percent to 62 percent on Red-Team tasks, with many configurations refusing legitimate Routine work at comparable or higher rates than concealed hazards. Refusals were most often triggered by provider API filters applied prior to agentic reasoning. However, models given room to reason showed the potential to identify more real threats. We release BioSecBench-Refusal as a tool for model developers to calibrate capability and caution for agentic biotech research and development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BioSecBench-Refusal是一个用于评估AI agent在生物研究任务中风险识别与拒绝行为的基准。它包含61个常规任务（来自已发表文献的合法分析）和46个红队任务（虚构但含有生物安全风险的场景）。在16个模型-工具链配置上，常规任务的拒绝率为7%-74%，红队任务为1%-62%，且许多配置对常规任务的拒绝率高于或等于对隐藏风险的拒绝率。拒绝主要由提供商的API过滤器在agent推理前触发，但允许推理的模型更有潜力识别真实威胁。该基准旨在帮助模型开发者校准agent在生物技术研发中的能力与谨慎度。
Motivation: AI agent在生命科学工作流中可能加速发现的同时也带来被滥用的风险，现有基准缺乏针对agent在生物安全风险识别和拒绝行为方面的评估工具。
Method: 构建成对的任务集合：61个常规任务（改编自发表文献的合法分析）和46个红队任务（虚构但模拟真实研究并隐藏生物安全危害的场景）。在不同模型和工具链配置上测量拒绝率。
Result: 在16个配置上，常规任务拒绝率7%-74%，红队任务拒绝率1%-62%；许多配置对常规任务的拒绝率与红队任务相当或更高；拒绝主要由API预过滤器引起；但给模型推理空间后能识别更多真实威胁。
Conclusion: BioSecBench-Refusal可作为工具，帮助模型开发者在agent生物技术研发中平衡能力与安全性。

papers.title: LP-SFT: Local-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning via Multimodal Entropy Structure
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the standard approach for adapting pretrained language models to downstream domains, yet it often improves target-domain behavior at the cost of degrading pre-existing capabilities. Standard cross-entropy fine-tuning promotes only the observed label token and leaves unconstrained how probability mass is redistributed over other plausible alternatives, potentially distorting the rich local preference structure learned during pretraining. We first analyze next-token predictions using Shannon and Renyi entropies, revealing that pretrained models exhibit a regular multimodal entropy structure. These entropy peaks correspond to varying numbers of plausible alternatives, indicating that the base model intrinsically encodes rich distributional knowledge beyond the single supervised token. Motivated by this observation, we propose LP-SFT, a Local-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning objective designed to explicitly protect this inherent entropy structure. At each step, LP-SFT constructs a local top-K support of alternative tokens from the frozen base distribution. Crucially, it removes the supervised target token from this set to avoid conflicting with the cross-entropy objective, and applies a locally normalized KL divergence to maintain the base model's relative preference structure among the remaining non-label alternatives. Across mixed-domain and single-domain fine-tuning experiments, LP-SFT improves overall performance over vanilla SFT and recent SFT-enhancement baselines, achieving the best balance between pass@1 accuracy and pass@k performance. These results suggest that local preservation helps mitigate capability degradation without collapsing sampling-accessible diversity.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/Wakaka161/LP-SFT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对监督微调（SFT）中目标域性能提升但预训练能力退化的问题，提出局部保持的监督微调方法 LP-SFT。该方法基于对预训练模型香农熵和瑞利熵的分析，发现模型具有规则的多模态熵结构，因此通过冻结基模型的 top-K 候选集并施加局部归一化 KL 散度，保持非标签候选的相对偏好。实验表明 LP-SFT 在 pass@1 和 pass@k 上均优于标准 SFT 及近期基线。
Motivation: 标准交叉熵微调仅优化目标标签概率，未约束其他备选词的分布重分配，容易破坏预训练中学习到的局部偏好结构，导致已有能力下降。
Method: LP-SFT 在每一步从冻结基模型分布中构建局部 top-K 支持集，移除监督目标标签以避免与交叉熵冲突，然后对该集合应用局部归一化 KL 散度，保留基模型对非标签候选项的相对偏好结构。
Result: 在混合域和单域微调实验中，LP-SFT 在整体性能上超越标准 SFT 和近期 SFT 增强基线，在 pass@1 准确率和 pass@k 多样性之间取得最佳平衡。
Conclusion: 局部保持机制有助于缓解微调导致的能力退化，同时不降低可采样多样性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Context-Masked Truncated Reasoning Audits for Answer-Key Dependence in LLM Tutors
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) tutors may have access to teacher notes, answer keys, rubrics, or retrieved solutions while producing student-facing explanations. We study whether truncated reasoning probes can distinguish direct access to such private context from answer information carried by the written explanation. Using Truncated Reasoning AUC Evaluation (TRACE), we evaluate 1000 GSM8K problems under question-only, correct answer-key, and wrong answer-key contexts. When forced-answer probes retain the private key, answer-key TRACE AUC rises from 0.375 to 0.900, and the gold answer is recoverable with no explanation at all in 998 of 1000 cases. We then introduce a context-masked replay: answer-key-generated prefixes are probed under the corresponding question-only prompt. Masking reduces 10\% prefix accuracy from 0.997 to 0.126 and median AUC from 0.900 to 0.375, nearly matching question-only values of 0.113 and 0.375. On 746 pairs where both explanations end correctly, the masked mean AUC difference is $-0.0086$ with a 95\% bootstrap interval spanning zero. Wrong keys still account for 272 of 387 incorrect final responses, showing that private artifacts can influence outputs even when early-prefix evidence disappears after masking. These results establish context masking as necessary for attributing early answer availability to an explanation rather than its hidden input.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM辅导系统在生成学生面向前解释时，是否能够通过截断推理探针区分对私有上下文（如答案键）的直接访问与解释本身携带的答案信息。使用TRACE评估1000个GSM8K问题，发现强制答案探针在保留私有键时AUC从0.375升至0.900，且998例中无需解释即可恢复正确答案。引入上下文掩盖回放后，10%前缀准确率从0.997降至0.126，中位AUC从0.900降至0.375，与纯问题条件接近。在746对正确解释中，掩盖后平均AUC差异为-0.0086，95%自助区间包含零。错误键仍导致387个错误最终响应中的272个。
Motivation: LLM辅导系统可能接触到教师笔记、答案键等私有上下文，而学生面向前解释可能无意中泄露这些信息。现有方法难以区分解释中答案信息是来自私有上下文还是解释本身。
Method: 提出截断推理AUC评估（TRACE）和上下文掩盖回放方法。在GSM8K问题中比较纯问题、正确答案键、错误答案键三种上下文下的截断推理探针性能，然后对答案键生成的前缀在纯问题提示下进行掩盖回放探测。
Result: 强制答案探针保留私有键时AUC从0.375升至0.900；掩盖后10%前缀准确率从0.997降至0.126，中位AUC从0.900降至0.375，与纯问题条件（0.113和0.375）几乎一致。在746对正确解释中，掩盖后平均AUC差异为-0.0086，95%置信区间包含零。错误键导致272/387错误响应。
Conclusion: 上下文掩盖是归因早期答案可用性于解释而非其隐藏输入的必要条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Auto-AEG: Scalable Data Construction for Open-Vocabulary Audio Event Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) reason fluently about sound yet struggle to localize precisely when events occur, while classical Sound Event Detection attains frame-level precision only over a closed label set. At the intersection of these paradigms lies the task of Open-Vocabulary Audio Event Grounding: predicting all time intervals of a target sound event described by an arbitrary natural language query. While this task is crucial for real-world audio understanding and LALM adaptation, it is bottlenecked by data scarcity. Few large-scale resources provide open-vocabulary onset/offset supervision, and manual temporal annotation is prohibitively expensive. To address this, we introduce Auto-AEG, a scalable pipeline that constructs such supervision by automatic data construction and model fine-tuning. It pairs programmatically synthesized clips, which carry exact ground-truth intervals for supervised cold-start, with multi-model pseudo-labels on real-world audio that supply the reward signal for reinforcement learning. Training with this pipeline yields promising performance gains on both the DESED SED benchmark and AEGBench, an independent difficulty-stratified benchmark we release. Our results show that automatically constructed data, coupled with interval-aware reward function design, is an effective data-side route to expanding the temporal localization capability of LALMs. AEGBench: https://huggingface.co/datasets/zihan-audio/AEGBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Auto-AEG，一种用于开放词汇音频事件定位的数据自动构建与模型微调流水线。通过程序合成片段提供精确区间监督，结合多模型伪标签强化学习，提升大音频语言模型的时间定位能力。在DESED SED和自建难度分层基准AEGBench上取得性能提升。
Motivation: 开放词汇音频事件定位任务受限于数据稀缺，手动时间标注成本极高，缺乏大规模开放词汇的起止监督资源。
Method: 提出自动数据构建流水线Auto-AEG，包含程序化合成片段（提供精确真值区间）和基于多模型伪标签的真实音频（为强化学习提供奖励信号），并结合区间感知奖励函数。
Result: 在DESED SED基准和自建难度分层基准AEGBench上取得性能增益。
Conclusion: 自动构建的数据与区间感知奖励函数设计是扩展大音频语言模型时间定位能力的有效数据端途径。

papers.title: Beyond Post-Quantization: Native Hash Learning with a Dedicated HASH Token
papers.abstract_en: Efficient large-scale image retrieval requires compact representations that preserve semantic similarity under fast Hamming-space search. Deep hashing is appealing, but most existing CNN- and ViT-based methods still follow a post-quantization paradigm, where continuous visual features are first learned and binary codes are then produced by a terminal hash projection or binarization operation. This late code generation creates a feature-to-code discrepancy between the continuously optimized representation space and the discrete Hamming space used for retrieval. To address this limitation, we propose HashViT, a Vision Transformer framework for native hash token learning. Instead of treating hashing as a terminal readout, HashViT introduces a dedicated HASH token that serves as a persistent, hash-oriented retrieval state inside the transformer. The HASH token is structurally decomposed into a Hash Register for direct binary code generation and a Semantic Workspace for preserving auxiliary continuous semantics. To enable effective workspace-to-register interaction, we further design a lightweight Hash Refinement Adapter that progressively refines the Hash Register across transformer layers. As a result, binary-oriented representations are formed through token evolution within the backbone, rather than being abruptly induced by an output-level projection. HashViT is optimized with a unified objective that combines learnable semantic center supervision, class-token similarity distillation, and quantization regularization, encouraging the HASH token to encode semantically structured and compact binary representations. Extensive experiments on three widely used benchmarks demonstrate that HashViT achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive retrieval performance while preserving the efficiency of compact Hamming codes. Code is available at https://github.com/Xinze919/HashViT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HashViT，一种用于原生哈希学习的Vision Transformer框架，通过引入专门的HASH token在transformer内部学习二进制表示，避免了后量化范式中的特征编码不一致问题。方法在三个图像检索基准上达到SOTA或竞争性性能。
Motivation: 现有的深度哈希方法大多采用后量化范式，即先学习连续视觉特征再通过哈希投影生成二进制码，导致连续优化空间与离散汉明空间之间的不一致。
Method: HashViT在transformer中引入HASH token，分解为Hash Register直接生成二进制码和Semantic Workspace保留连续语义，并通过Hash Refinement Adapter跨层逐步精炼Hash Register，统一优化语义中心监督、类token相似度蒸馏和量化正则化。
Result: 在三个广泛使用的图像检索基准上取得SOTA或高度竞争性的检索性能，同时保持紧凑汉明码的效率。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过token演化而非输出级投影来形成二进制表征，可有效解决特征编码不一致问题。
