papers.title: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Vidu S1, a real-time interactive video generation model supporting voice control of digital characters. Users can control video generation content at any moment through voice instructions. Vidu S1 supports infinite-length real-time video generation without blurring, drift, or visual distortion. Built with TurboDiffusion and TurboServe, Vidu S1 outputs 540p real-time videos at up to 42 FPS on regular consumer GPUs. Users can upload custom images of real people, anime, and pets, and choose different voice tones for personalized experiences. Experiments show that Vidu S1 achieves the best performance across all test metrics while fully meeting real-time inference requirements. A playable online demo is available at https://vidu.com/vidu-stream.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Vidu S1，一个支持语音控制的实时交互式视频生成模型，可生成无限长度、无模糊漂移的 540p 视频，在普通消费级 GPU 上达到 42 FPS。用户可通过语音指令控制视频内容，并上传自定义图像和选择语音音调。实验表明该模型在所有测试指标上达到最优，同时满足实时推理需求。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型难以实现实时交互和用户控制，尤其缺乏基于语音的即时反馈能力，且长视频生成常出现模糊和视觉失真。
Method: 提出 Vidu S1 模型，结合 TurboDiffusion 和 TurboServe 架构，实现实时推理；支持语音指令解析和用户自定义图像输入，实现无限长度视频生成。
Result: 在普通消费级 GPU 上输出 540p 视频，帧率高达 42 FPS；实验显示在所有测试指标上最佳性能，满足实时要求。
Conclusion: Vidu S1 实现了实时、交互且无限长度的视频生成，通过语音控制提升了用户体验，适用于数字角色互动等场景。

papers.title: Forensic Trajectory Signatures for Agent Memory Poisoning Detection
papers.abstract_en: We discover a behavioral invariant in LLM agents under persistent memory poisoning and characterize its deployment boundary. In architectures where retrieval is routed through observable memory-tool invocations, successful attacks require calling memory_recall_fact before email_send_email, a transition mechanistically forced by the attack's information-retrieval dependency. A simple rule exploiting this invariant achieves AUC = 0.9563; a Random Forest over 19 trajectory features refines it to AUC = 0.9904 (BCa 95% CI [0.987, 0.993]). The signature is overdetermined within the poisoned-but-defended evaluation set: removing all recall-related features leaves AUC unchanged. Cross-model hold-out on 9 models (7B-120B) confirms AUC = 1.000 on 6/9 splits, and the invariant transfers to frontier models (GPT-4.1, GPT-4o) without retraining. [v2] A preregistered follow-up (N=4,360, 13 models) reveals a critical deployment boundary: benign memory-grounded sends produce the same recall_before_send signature, yielding 100% false positives conditional on recall_before_send=1 (unconditional benign FPR: 24.7-52.6% depending on recall protocol). The signature is a valid attack precondition, not a maliciousness predicate; standalone blocking is not viable, but gating with recipient metadata restores separation. A prefix-only variant achieves AUC = 0.934, enabling real-time triage.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. v2: adds preregistered deployment boundary study (N=4,360, 13 models). Companion to arXiv:2605.08442
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现LLM代理在持续内存中毒攻击下存在行为不变性，并刻画了其部署边界。通过利用攻击中强制出现的工具调用顺序（先调用memory_recall_fact再调用email_send_email），一个简单规则即可达到AUC=0.9563，随机森林进一步将AUC提升至0.9904。跨模型保持测试显示该签名在9个模型中的6个上AUC=1.000，并可零样本迁移到前沿模型。但预注册大规模实验发现，良性内存驱动的发送也会产生相同签名，导致100%假阳性，因此签名仅作为攻击前提而非恶意性谓词，需结合接收者元数据才能实现有效检测。
Motivation: 现有针对LLM代理内存中毒的检测方法缺乏对攻击行为不变性的理解，且未考虑实际部署中的误报问题。
Method: 通过分析攻击者必须执行的信息检索依赖性，发现攻击中强制出现的工具调用顺序（先读内存再发送），基于此设计简单规则和随机森林分类器。在预注册部署边界研究中进一步验证了签名的普适性与假阳性问题。
Result: 简单规则AUC=0.9563，随机森林AUC=0.9904；跨模型保持测试中6/9模型AUC=1.000；但良性场景下基于签名会导致100%假阳性，无条件假阳性率24.7-52.6%。
Conclusion: 该签名是有效的攻击前提检测信号，但不能单独作为恶意性判定，需结合接收者元数据等额外信息才能实现可靠检测。

papers.title: EvalSafetyGap: A Hybrid Survey and Conceptual Framework for LLM Evaluation-Safety Failures
papers.abstract_en: LLM evaluation and AI safety face a shared measurement problem: benchmark scores, reward-model signals, and reported safety metrics can improve while the latent properties they are meant to represent remain difficult to verify. This paper combines a hybrid survey - a systematic search paired with narrative synthesis and separately tracked grey evidence - with a conceptual framework and a structured ten-model audit. The synthesis spans eight evidence streams: benchmark validity, dynamic evaluation, LLM-as-judge reliability, safety evaluation, jailbreak/refusal robustness, reward hacking, mechanistic interpretability, and governance/auditability, covering 2018-2026 evaluation-safety measurement work. We introduce EvalSafetyGap as an organizing hypothesis for comparing evaluation-side and alignment-side proxy failures under optimization pressure, using Goodhart's Law together with two constructs we develop here - an Instability Decomposition and an Alignment Trilemma - as tools for generating testable comparisons. The audit shows how conclusions shift when capability, behavioral safety, and governance are measured separately. In this sample ($n = 10$), the association between capability and sustained adversarial robustness is statistically indeterminate using the displayed Table 3 inputs (Pearson $r = +0.232$, $p = 0.520$), and the apparent open-closed safety gap is modest, driven mainly by governance and disclosure rather than behavioral robustness, and sensitive to how a single borderline model is classified; attempt-budget results are protocol dependent. Because the public evidence uses heterogeneous protocols, the audit is diagnostic rather than rank-generating. The contribution is a shared vocabulary and evidence map to support dynamic evaluation, transparent source reporting, multi-attempt safety measurement, and auditable alignment practice.
papers.comment: This manuscript is a 80-page hybrid survey and conceptual framework on LLM evaluation and AI-safety failures. It includes 8 figures and multiple evidence-synthesis tables, covering literature from 2018 to 2026. The paper introduces the EvalSafetyGap framework and reports a structured audit of 10 LLMs. It is submitted as a review/survey article and is not currently under consideration elsewhere
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是80页的混合综述与概念框架，系统梳理了2018-2026年LLM评估与安全测量中的代理失效问题。提出了EvalSafetyGap框架，并基于10个模型的结构化审计显示，能力与对抗鲁棒性之间无显著相关（r=0.232, p=0.520），开放-封闭安全差距主要由治理和披露驱动而非行为鲁棒性。
Motivation: 基准分数、奖励模型信号和安全指标可以提升，但它们所代表的潜在属性（如真实安全性）仍难以验证，评估与安全面临共同的测量问题。
Method: 采用混合综述方法（系统搜索+叙述综合+灰色证据追踪），提出EvalSafetyGap框架，并发展了不稳定性分解和对齐三难困境两个概念，最后对10个LLM进行了结构化审计。
Result: 审计发现能力与持续对抗鲁棒性之间的关联统计不确定（Pearson r=+0.232, p=0.520），表面上的开放-封闭安全差距较小且主要受治理和披露影响，结果依赖于协议和边界模型分类。
Conclusion: 贡献在于提供共享词汇和证据地图，以支持动态评估、透明来源报告、多尝试安全测量和可审计的对齐实践。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAGA: Scene-Aware, Goal-Evolving Agents for Long-Horizon Strategy Game Planning
papers.abstract_en: Grand-strategy games such as Civilization pose a distinctive long-horizon planning problem: an agent must divide one shared resource pool among six competing domains -- technology, government, diplomacy, city development, expansion, and military -- under partial observability, with no feedback except a delayed final score. Current LLM agents fall short in three ways: 1) they cannot infer spatial relations from raw coordinates; 2) they allocate resources poorly, because feeding the entire growing state into one prompt and planning all domains in a single output diffuses attention and biases decisions toward urgent events; and 3) they cannot improve, as the delayed score gives no signal within or across games. We present SAGA, an LLM multi-agent framework pairing one mechanism with each weakness: (i) a Map-Semantic Scene Graph turning coordinates into per-entity statements of distance, direction, and threat; (ii) a Tool-Augmented Planner that retrieves only the state a decision needs, cutting the order of magnitude of its input, and issues a separate plan per domain to six specialist controllers, so urgent events do not derail long-term plans; and (iii) a Dual-Horizon Feedback Loop setting short-term goals during play and distilling each game into lessons for the next. On CivRealm, a Civilization-style benchmark, SAGA leads five LLM baselines on mean final score and is the only method significantly ahead of all of them on city development, the first investment baselines sacrifice, with 27% fewer output tokens; with cross-game learning it scores highest after five games, and its fifth game consistently surpasses its first across four maps. Our code is available at https://github.com/Kazecloudk/SAGA-Scene-Aware-Goal-Evolving-Agents-for-Long-Horizon-Strategy-Game-Planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGA 框架，针对文明类策略游戏的长时域规划问题，通过地图语义场景图、工具增强规划器和双视界反馈循环分别解决空间关系推理、资源分配和跨游戏学习难题。在 CivRealm 基准上，SAGA 在平均最终得分上领先五个 LLM 基线，且是唯一在城市发展方面显著优于所有基线的方法，同时减少 27% 输出 token；通过跨游戏学习，五局后得分最高，且第五局一致优于第一局。
Motivation: 当前 LLM 智能体在长时域策略游戏中存在三个不足：无法从原始坐标推断空间关系、资源分配不佳（因将整个状态输入单一提示并一次性规划所有领域导致注意力分散和偏向紧急事件）、以及无法改进（因延迟得分无法在局内或跨局提供信号）。
Method: 提出 SAGA 多智能体框架，包含三个组件：地图语义场景图（Map-Semantic Scene Graph）将坐标转换为每个实体的距离、方向和威胁陈述；工具增强规划器（Tool-Augmented Planner）仅检索决策所需状态，并将输入规模降低一个数量级，为每个领域向六个专家控制器发出独立计划；双视界反馈循环（Dual-Horizon Feedback Loop）在游戏过程中设定短期目标，并将每局经验提炼为下一局的教训。
Result: 在 CivRealm 基准上，SAGA 在平均最终得分上领先五个 LLM 基线，是唯一在城市发展方面显著优于所有基线的方法，同时减少 27% 输出 token；跨游戏学习后五局得分最高，且第五局一致优于第一局（四张地图）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过三个机制弥补现有 LLM 智能体在长时域策略游戏中的三个不足，实验证明 SAGA 在 CivRealm 上表现领先。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 SAGA 框架，针对文明类策略游戏的长时域规划问题，通过地图语义场景图、工具增强规划器和双视界反馈循环分别解决空间关系推理、资源分配和跨游戏学习难题。在 CivRealm 基准上，SAGA 在平均最终得分上领先五个 LLM 基线，且是唯一在城市发展方面显著优于所有基线的方法，同时减少 27% 输出 token；通过跨游戏学习，五局后得分最高，且第五局一致优于第一局。
summary_sections.motivation: 当前 LLM 智能体在长时域策略游戏中存在三个不足：无法从原始坐标推断空间关系、资源分配不佳（因将整个状态输入单一提示并一次性规划所有领域导致注意力分散和偏向紧急事件）、以及无法改进（因延迟得分无法在局内或跨局提供信号）。
summary_sections.method: 提出 SAGA 多智能体框架，包含三个组件：地图语义场景图（Map-Semantic Scene Graph）将坐标转换为每个实体的距离、方向和威胁陈述；工具增强规划器（Tool-Augmented Planner）仅检索决策所需状态，并将输入规模降低一个数量级，为每个领域向六个专家控制器发出独立计划；双视界反馈循环（Dual-Horizon Feedback Loop）在游戏过程中设定短期目标，并将每局经验提炼为下一局的教训。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调通过三个机制弥补现有 LLM 智能体在长时域策略游戏中的三个不足，实验证明 SAGA 在 CivRealm 上表现领先。

papers.title: TaskTok: Delving into Task Tokens for Task-driven Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: While traditional image restoration focuses on perceptual quality, Task-Driven Image Restoration (TDIR) aims to maximize the performance of downstream high-level vision tasks. Recent approaches leveraging generative priors have shown promise for TDIR; however, they typically suffer from computational inefficiency and potential semantic alteration by indiscriminately updating all latent tokens. In this paper, we posit that not all visual information is equally important for machine perception. Through an analysis of the latent token space, we observe that task-relevant cues are unevenly distributed across the token sequence, exhibiting index-wise specialization. This suggests that selectively refining a subset of tokens can be sufficient for task-driven objectives. Leveraging this insight, we propose TaskTok, a novel framework that selectively restores only task-relevant tokens via a learnable token switch and a lightweight token refinement module. Extensive experiments across image classification, semantic segmentation, and object detection demonstrate that TaskTok significantly enhances task performance with high computational efficiency. The source code is available at https://github.com/jimmy9704/TaskTok
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对任务驱动图像恢复（TDIR）中现有方法计算开销大、可能改变语义的问题，提出TaskTok框架。通过分析发现任务相关线索在token序列中分布不均，因此选择性恢复任务相关token。该方法引入可学习的token开关和轻量级细化模块，在分类、分割、检测任务上提升性能并保持高效。
Motivation: 现有TDIR方法使用生成先验但存在计算效率低和潜在语义改变的问题，且未考虑任务相关token的不均匀分布。
Method: 提出TaskTok，包含可学习的token开关和轻量级token细化模块，仅恢复任务相关token。
Result: 在图像分类、语义分割、目标检测任务上显著提升任务性能，同时保持高计算效率。
Conclusion: 本文提出的选择性恢复策略有效平衡了TDIR中的性能与效率。

papers.title: Is Variational Monte Carlo Robust? Sharp Moment Thresholds and Heavy-tailed Stochastic Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) is a central algorithm in electronic structure theory and has gained renewed importance through modern neural-network ansätze such as FermiNet. At its core, VMC seeks ground states by minimizing the Rayleigh quotient by stochastic optimization. In this work, we show that the resulting stochastic optimization problem is intrinsically governed by the nodal geometry of the underlying wave function. More precisely, we establish that properties of the nodal set determine the integrability of the local energy and gradient estimators that drive VMC. For broad and practically relevant ansatz classes, including Slater-Jastrow wave functions with variable-exponent Slater-type orbitals, we prove that these estimators are generically heavy-tailed and fail to admit higher moments. At the same time, for general analytic ansätze, we prove weak moment bounds for the relevant estimators and identify precise low-moment regimes, showing how generic and degenerate nodal structures lead to different integrability thresholds. Building on this analysis, we introduce a new robust variant of VMC $\unicode{x2013}$ coined PS-Clip-VMC $\unicode{x2013}$ which is based on clipping both the local energies and the per-sample gradients. We prove that PS-Clip-VMC converges both in expectation and with high probability in the weak moment regime of VMC. The robustness of our method is confirmed experimentally by training FermiNet on atoms with up to 18 electrons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究变分蒙特卡洛 (VMC) 中随机优化的稳定性，证明估计量因波函数节点几何而呈重尾分布，并提出基于裁剪的鲁棒算法 PS-Clip-VMC。理论证明其在弱矩条件下收敛，实验在多达 18 电子的 FermiNet 上验证。
Motivation: VMC 的核心随机优化问题中，局部能量和梯度估计量的矩性质未知，实际中可能出现重尾导致训练不稳定，现有理论缺乏对节点几何影响的精确刻画。
Method: 通过分析波函数节点集的可积性，证明 Slater-Jastrow 类 ansatz 的估计量重尾且无更高阶矩；对解析 ansatz 给出弱矩界。据此提出 PS-Clip-VMC，对局部能量和每个样本梯度进行裁剪，并证明其在弱矩条件下依期望和高概率收敛。
Result: 理论确定不同节点结构下估计量的矩阈值；PS-Clip-VMC 在弱矩区域收敛，实验在 FermiNet 上对 18 电子原子验证了鲁棒性。
Conclusion: VMC 的随机优化本质上受波函数节点几何控制，需要针对重尾估计量的鲁棒算法。

papers.title: A Red Teaming Framework for Large Language Models: A Case Study on Faithfulness Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across natural language processing tasks, yet their deployment in high-stakes applications raises critical concerns regarding reliability, safety, and trustworthiness. In this paper, we present a red teaming framework that systematically uncovers vulnerabilities in LLM outputs. Our approach employs a novel multi-role architecture comprising target, attacker, and jury models. The attackers generate increasingly effective adversarial prompts while the jury rigorously evaluates response accuracy and consistency across tasks. In a case study, our strategy proved particularly effective at exposing unfaithfulness in LLM responses. Exploitative adversarial prompts increased the attack success rate by up to 7.9% in question-answering tasks, revealing weaknesses in reliability. The approach identifies how structural constraints in summarization can shape vulnerability patterns, with format limitations yielding measurable gains in faithfulness, and shows that architectural design choices typically outweigh parameter scaling in determining model safety. The framework's key strength is its adaptability across evaluation tasks, from English question-answering to Arabic summarization, enabling comprehensive comparison of model vulnerabilities. While it excels at comparing cross-model and cross-linguistic vulnerabilities, it faces challenges in fully automating adversarial prompt generation across languages. Our experiments also reveal limitations in detecting subtle forms of unfaithfulness that do not manifest as explicit factual contradictions, particularly across linguistic contexts. Overall, this architecture provides both actionable insights into current LLM vulnerabilities and a scalable methodology for ongoing safety evaluation as models evolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个红队测试框架，通过多角色架构（目标、攻击者、评审模型）系统性地揭示大语言模型输出的脆弱性。案例研究聚焦于忠诚度评估，发现对抗性提示在问答任务中将攻击成功率提升高达7.9%，并揭示了摘要任务中结构约束对脆弱性模式的影响。框架支持跨任务和跨语言（英语问答和阿拉伯语摘要）的漏洞比较。
Motivation: 大语言模型在高风险场景中的部署存在可靠性、安全性和可信度问题，现有评估方法对忠诚度等细粒度漏洞的检测不足。
Method: 提出一个包含目标模型、攻击者模型和评审模型的多角色红队测试架构。攻击者生成逐步增强的对抗性提示，评审模型严格评估响应准确性和一致性。
Result: 攻击成功率在问答任务中提升7.9%；格式限制在摘要任务中可衡量地提升忠诚度；架构设计选择对模型安全性的影响通常超过参数规模。
Conclusion: 该框架能有效比较跨模型和跨语言的漏洞，但在完全自动化生成跨语言对抗性提示以及检测不表现为显式事实矛盾的细微不忠诚方面存在挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling for Non-Stationary Contextual Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study non-stationary linear contextual bandits where the reward model drifts over time, rendering classical contextual bandit algorithms brittle because historical data becomes systematically biased. We propose Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling (fcTS), a Bayesian method that reuses experience by transporting past rewards to the present using an explicit drift model and incorporating each transported observation with a confidence weight that reflects transport reliability. This yields a unified template that specializes in (i) linear parameter drift via online slope estimation and reward correction, (ii) periodic variation via phase-aware reuse across cycles, and (iii) recurring regime switches via changepoint detection and regime-specific posterior memory. The resulting posterior updates remain closed-form under a linear Gaussian model and can be implemented efficiently with truncated, incrementally updated sufficient statistics. Across five controlled case studies and a semi-synthetic portfolio-selection benchmark with multiple overlapping non-stationarities, fcTS outperforms standard forgetting-based baselines (discounting, sliding windows, and periodic restarts), with the largest gains in settings exhibiting recurring temporal structure. These results demonstrate that when non-stationarity is structured, correcting and reweighting historical observations can be substantially more sample-efficient than uniformly discarding them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非平稳线性上下文赌博机（non-stationary linear contextual bandits）中奖励模型随时间漂移的问题，提出 Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling (fcTS)。该方法通过显式漂移模型将历史奖励“运输”到当前时刻，并为每次运输的观测赋予反映运输可靠性的置信权重，从而复用经验。fcTS 可处理线性参数漂移、周期性变化和重复制度切换，后验更新在线性高斯模型下保持闭式，可利用截断的递增更新充分统计量高效实现。在多个控制案例和半合成投资组合选择基准上，fcTS 优于折扣、滑动窗口和周期性重启等标准遗忘基线，尤其在具有重复时间结构的设置中增益最大。
Motivation: 标准上下文赌博机算法在非平稳环境下因历史数据系统性偏差而表现脆弱，需要更有效的经验复用方法。
Method: 提出 Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling (fcTS)，一种贝叶斯方法，通过显式漂移模型将过去奖励运输到当前，并用置信权重衡量运输可靠性；具体包括线性漂移的在线斜率估计与奖励修正、周期波动的相位感知跨周期复用，以及重复制度切换的变点检测与制度特定后验记忆。后验更新保持闭式。
Result: 在五个控制案例研究和半合成投资组合选择基准上，fcTS 显著优于折扣、滑动窗口和周期性重启等基线，在具有重复时间结构的环境中提升最明显。
Conclusion: 当非平稳性具有结构时，纠正和重新加权历史观测比统一丢弃它们更节省样本。

papers.title: Signed Evidence Flow: Conflict-Aware and Stability-Calibrated Data Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Modern data analysis usually gives a prediction without showing whether the evidence behind it is clear, conflicting, or stable. Two cases can have the same fitted confidence even when one has mostly agreeing evidence and the other has strong support and strong opposition. We propose Signed Evidence Flow (SEF), which combines a fitted prediction rule with signed feature attributions to measure support, opposition, conflict, and perturbation stability. We prove that confidence determines conflict exactly when it also determines total evidence mass, derive the remaining conditional variance, and state when conflict can improve loss prediction beyond confidence and other audit variables. We also connect conflict to geometric decision fragility. Across healthcare, Covertype, black-box, finance, and ten external data sets, conflict sometimes separates risk among predictions that already appear confident. Cross-fitted tests show added error-ranking information beyond confidence and attribution entropy on several data sets, including two large finance tasks. The direction is not universal: in some tasks, lowconflict cases are riskier. We therefore introduce ScopeGate, a held-out permutation diagnostic that checks the direction before SEF is used for review triage. SEF is consequently an audit tool rather than a universal risk score: it describes evidence structure, while an independent calibration sample determines whether that structure is useful in the target population.
papers.comment: 44 pages, including figures and tables. Reproducibility code and supplementary materials are available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Signed Evidence Flow (SEF)，一种结合拟合预测规则与符号特征归因的方法，用于测量证据的支持、反对、冲突和扰动稳定性。证明置信度与总证据质量决定冲突，并推导剩余条件方差，指出冲突有时能提升损失预测。跨多个数据集（包括医疗、Covertype、金融等）验证了冲突在置信度之外提供错误排序信息，但方向非通用，因此引入 ScopeGate 诊断。SEF 是审计工具而非通用风险评分。
Motivation: 现代数据分析通常给出预测，但不显示背后的证据是否清晰、冲突或稳定。两个案例可能有相同的拟合置信度，但一个证据基本一致，另一个既有强烈支持又有强烈反对。需要一种方法来量化证据的冲突和稳定性。
Method: 提出 Signed Evidence Flow (SEF)，结合拟合预测规则与符号特征归因，度量支持、反对、冲突和扰动稳定性。引入 ScopeGate 作为保留置换诊断，在使用 SEF 审查分流前检查方向。
Result: 在多个数据集上，冲突在置信度之外提供了额外的错误排序信息，包括两个大规模金融任务。但在某些任务中低冲突案例风险更高，因此方向非通用。
Conclusion: SEF 是描述证据结构的审计工具，而非通用风险评分；独立校准样本决定该结构在目标群体中是否有用。

summary_sections.result: 在多个数据集上，冲突在置信度之外提供了额外的错误排序信息，包括两个大规模金融任务。但在某些任务中低冲突案例风险更高，因此方向非通用。
summary_sections.conclusion: SEF 是描述证据结构的审计工具，而非通用风险评分；独立校准样本决定该结构在目标群体中是否有用。

papers.title: The Correctness Illusion in LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for LLM-generated GPU kernels (KernelBench, TritonBench, GEAK) score correctness through fixed-shape, small-sample allclose-style checks. The number of inputs varies between benchmarks. The shape, dtype, and tolerance are fixed for each kernel. We test that oracle empirically. We construct a controlled corpus of 24 Triton and CPU stand-in kernels (15 correct controls and 9 LLM-style buggy variants seeded with documented transcription errors) and re-evaluate it under op-schema-aware seeded fuzzing with a high-precision (fp64) CPU reference and per-(op, dtype) absolute tolerances. The seeded oracle flags 9 of 9 buggy kernels and passes 15 of 15 correct controls, at zero precision cost on controls. We extend the corpus to 26 ops (adding a flash-attention pair) and re-run the same protocol on five GPU classes (RTX 3060, A10, L40S, A100 SXM4, H100 NVL). The verdicts are identical across all five GPUs: 10 of 10 illusions caught and 16 of 16 controls clean. The corpus result is about LLM-style transcription bugs that the allclose-on-one-shape oracle certifies as correct, not about the bug rate of any specific deployed LLM. Every flagged failure replays byte-for-byte from a stored seed.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, LNCS format. Companion papers to follow on arXiv next week; IDs will be added in a v2 replace
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM生成的GPU内核正确性测试基准（如KernelBench、TritonBench、GEAK）中存在的“正确性幻觉”——即通过固定形状、小样本的allclose检查而误认为正确。作者构建了24个Triton和CPU替代内核的受控语料库（15个正确控制、9个LLM风格的错误变体），并采用基于操作模式感知的种子模糊测试（高精度fp64 CPU参考和逐操作绝对容差）重新评估。该种子测试正确识别了所有9个错误内核并通过了所有15个正确控制。随后扩展到26个操作并在五类GPU上复现，结果一致。
Motivation: 现有LLM生成的GPU内核基准测试仅通过固定形状、小样本的allclose检查来评估正确性，可能导致LLM生成的错误内核被误判为正确，产生“正确性幻觉”。
Method: 构建受控语料库（24个内核，15正确9错误），采用基于操作模式感知的种子模糊测试，使用高精度fp64 CPU参考和逐操作绝对容差进行测试，并在五类GPU上验证。
Result: 种子测试在24个内核中准确识别所有9个错误和15个正确内核；扩展到26个操作后，在RTX 3060、A10、L40S、A100 SXM4、H100 NVL五类GPU上结果一致：10个幻觉被捕获，16个控制通过。
Conclusion: 作者强调该结果针对的是LLM风格的转录错误，而非任何特定部署LLM的bug率；所有失败均可从存储种子逐字节复现。

papers.title: Externalizing Research Synthesis and Validation in AI Scientists through a Research Harness
papers.abstract_en: AI systems can increasingly automate scientific workflows, but the reasoning that links prior evidence, generated ideas, experiments and final claims often remains implicit inside model inference. Here we introduce Xcientist, a research harness that externalizes research synthesis and experimental validation into inspectable, contract-governed processes. Xcientist organizes literature evidence, idea states, implementation plans, ablation records and repair traces as persistent research artifacts, so that generated mechanisms can be grounded, executed, tested and revised without losing their evidential basis. We identify claim drift as a failure mode of automated research, where runnable artifacts no longer support the mechanism originally claimed. Across training-free memory systems, graph-structured traffic forecasting and multi-scale physics-informed neural networks, Xcientist preserves traceable trajectories from problem formulation to mechanism design, validation and bounded revision. These results suggest that AI scientists should be evaluated not only by their final artifacts, but by whether their synthesis and validation processes remain attributable, inspectable and scientifically accountable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Xcientist，一个将研究综合与实验验证外部化的研究框架，通过可检查的合同驱动流程组织文献证据、想法状态、实施计划等研究工件，防止自动研究中出现“声明漂移”问题。在无训练记忆系统、图结构交通预测和多尺度物理知识神经网络等任务上验证了可追溯、可归属的研究流程。
Motivation: 现有AI科研系统在自动生成研究时，连接先验证据、产生想法、实验和最终声明的推理过程常隐式存在于模型内部，缺乏可检查性和科学可问责性。
Method: Xcientist框架将研究综合与验证外部化为可检查、合同驱动的流程，持久化文献证据、想法状态、实施计划、消融记录和修复轨迹等工件，确保生成机制可执行、可测试且不丢失证据基础。
Result: 在无训练记忆系统、图结构交通预测和多尺度物理知识神经网络上，Xcientist保留了从问题定义到机制设计、验证和有限修正的可追溯轨迹。
Conclusion: AI科学家不仅应通过最终工件评估，还应通过其综合与验证过程是否可归属、可检查且科学可问责来评估。

papers.title: Sign-Rank, Index, and List Replicability: Connections and Separations
papers.abstract_en: In learning theory, the sign-rank of a binary concept class captures the smallest dimension in which it can be represented by points and halfspaces. Despite tremendous interest, lower bounds on sign-rank are notoriously difficult to come by. Two recent approaches to the problem establish lower bounds on sign-rank by measures that are easier to analyze: the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-index and the list replicability number. We order these measures, showing that the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-index is upper-bounded by a linear function of the list replicability number. As a main consequence, we obtain a strong separation between sign-rank and $\mathbb{Z}_2$-index, thereby resolving a question of Frick, Hosseini, and Vasileuski. This motivates a thorough study of list replicability, the stronger of the two lower-bounding measures. We establish upper bounds on the list replicability number by two combinatorial measures: height and minimum star number. We also prove a fundamental composition result, showing that the product of two concept classes has list replicability number bounded by the sum of the list replicability numbers of the two classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究学习理论中概念类的 sign-rank、Z₂-index 和 list replicability number 三种度量之间的关系。证明 Z₂-index 被 list replicability number 的线性函数上界控制，从而得到 sign-rank 与 Z₂-index 的强分离，解决 Frick, Hosseini 和 Vasileuski 的开放问题。进一步给出 list replicability number 的上界（基于 height 和 minimum star number）以及乘积概念类的组合结果。
Motivation: sign-rank 的下界难以获得，而 Z₂-index 和 list replicability 是两种较易分析的下界度量。本文旨在理清这些度量之间的关系，特别是分离 sign-rank 和 Z₂-index。
Method: 通过数学证明建立度量之间的序关系，并利用组合度量（height 和 minimum star number）给出 list replicability number 的上界，同时证明两个概念类乘积的 list replicability number 有界于两者之和。
Result: 主要结果：Z₂-index ≤ c·list replicability number（c为常数），从而 sign-rank 与 Z₂-index 存在强分离；list replicability number 被 height 和 minimum star number 限定；两个概念类的乘积的 list replicability number 不超过各自 list replicability number 之和。
Conclusion: 本文解决了 Frick 等人的开放问题，并推动了对 list replicability 的进一步研究，但未提供实验验证或具体应用场景。

papers.title: ReRAM-aware Model Finetuning addressing I-V Non-linearity and Retention Errors
papers.abstract_en: Traditional CPU, GPU, and NPU architectures are increasingly limited by the von Neumann bottleneck. While In-Memory Computing (IMC) using ReRAM crossbar arrays offers a high-density, energy-efficient alternative, its practical deployment is constrained through their non-idealities. Existing hardware-aware training frameworks often require training from scratch, which is computationally prohibitive for modern large-scale models. In this work, we propose a finetuning-based hardware-aware training algorithm that enables robust DNN deployment on ReRAM with minimal training overhead. Our approach mitigates I-V non-linearity by applying a range-shrunk sinh transformation and incorporates retention errors directly into a regularization loss during the finetuning process. We evaluate our framework across models and tasks such as image classification and question-answering (QA). Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves similar accuracy on large-scale models like ResNet18 and DeiT-Tiny as the base model. In-case of ImageNet for MobileNetV3 families the technique has only less than 2% accuracy degradation. Further, applying the technique on the SQuAD v2 dataset results in only 1 point degradation of F-1 score.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables, with appendix (5 pages, 9 figures)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对ReRAM非理想特性（I-V非线性和保持错误）导致传统硬件感知训练需要从头开始训练计算成本过高的问题，本文提出一种基于微调的硬件感知训练算法。方法通过范围收缩的sinh变换缓解I-V非线性，并将保持错误作为正则化损失纳入微调过程。在图像分类和问答任务上评估，ResNet18和DeiT-Tiny精度与基模型相当，MobileNetV3在ImageNet上精度下降不到2%，SQuAD v2上F1分数仅下降1点。
Motivation: 现有硬件感知训练通常需要从头训练，对于现代大模型计算开销过大；ReRAM的非理想特性（I-V非线性、保持错误）在实际部署中造成性能损失。
Method: 提出基于微调的硬件感知训练算法：通过范围收缩的sinh变换（range-shrunk sinh transformation）缓解I-V非线性；将保持错误建模为正则化损失项，在微调过程中优化。
Result: 在大规模模型（ResNet18、DeiT-Tiny）上精度与基模型相当；MobileNetV3在ImageNet上精度下降小于2%；SQuAD v2上F1分数仅下降1点。
Conclusion: 所提微调方法能在极小训练开销下使DNN在ReRAM上稳健部署，有效缓解非理想特性影响。

papers.title: LieBN: Batch Normalization over Lie Groups
papers.abstract_en: Manifold-valued measurements are prevalent in various machine learning tasks. Recent advances have extended Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) to operate on manifolds. These extensions have been accompanied by normalization techniques tailored to different geometries, collectively referred to as Riemannian normalization. However, most existing Riemannian normalization methods are either designed for specific manifolds or fail to effectively normalize manifold-valued sample distributions. To address these limitations, we propose LieBN, a framework for Riemannian Batch Normalization (RBN) over Lie groups. Our approach leverages the theoretically convenient left- and right-invariant metrics, which naturally exist in every Lie group, and provides theoretical guarantees for controlling the Riemannian mean and variance. We instantiate LieBN across nine distinct geometries: four on the Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) manifold, one on the group of rotation matrices, and four on the manifold of full-rank correlation matrices. Notably, among the SPD metrics, we introduce a novel right-invariant metric and extend three existing Lie group structures via matrix power deformation. Experiments on different manifolds validate the effectiveness of our framework. The code is available at https://github.com/GitZH-Chen/LieBN.git.
papers.comment: Extended version of the ICLR 2024 paper: A Lie Group Approach to Riemannian Batch Normalization. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2403.11261
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LieBN，一个基于李群的 Riemannian 批量归一化框架，利用左右不变度量对流形值样本进行归一化，并提供了控制 Riemannian 均值和方差的理论保证。作者在对称正定流形、旋转矩阵群和满秩相关矩阵流形上实例化了九种几何，实验验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有的 Riemannian 归一化方法要么针对特定流形设计，要么无法有效归一化流形值样本分布，限制了深度神经网络在流形上的应用。
Method: 提出 LieBN 框架，利用李群上自然存在的左/右不变度量，通过控制 Riemannian 均值和方差实现批量归一化，并实例化了九种几何（包括对称正定流形上的四种度量、旋转矩阵群上的一种、满秩相关矩阵流形上的四种，其中一种为新提出的右不变度量）。
Result: 实验在不同流形上验证了 LieBN 框架的有效性。
Conclusion: LieBN 为 Riemannian 批量归一化提供了统一的理论框架，并在多种李群几何上取得有效结果。

papers.title: Trusted Multi-View Deep Learning Classification of Fetal Congenital Heart Disease with Feature-level and Decision-level Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Congenital heart disease (CHD) refers to the abnormal anatomical structure caused by the abnormal development of the heart and great vessels during embryonic development. Traditional diagnostics often fail to achieve high accuracy and efficiency, especially given the complexity of cardiac anatomy. This study presents a specialized multi-view deep learning framework for CHD binary classification using echocardiographic images. A large-scale CHD dataset, including five views, was used to train the model, enabling it to integrate multi-angle image data. The framework utilizes advanced feature extraction and attention mechanisms to improve diagnostic precision and reliability. An uncertainty-based decision-making component is also integrated to handle low-quality images, enhancing diagnostic outcomes. Experimental results show that this method achieves top-tier performance on our dataset and provides a robust tool for early CHD detection, underscoring its potential for clinical use. The dataset and source code will be released upon paper acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多视图深度学习框架的胎儿先天性心脏病（CHD）二分类方法，使用超声心动图五个视图的图像，通过特征提取、注意力机制和不确定性决策融合实现高精度诊断。
Motivation: 传统诊断方法在处理复杂心脏解剖结构时准确率和效率不足，亟需更可靠的自动化工具。
Method: 提出多视图深度学习框架，包含特征提取、注意力机制以及基于不确定性的决策融合（feature-level 和 decision-level 融合），并针对低质量图像引入不确定性处理组件。
Result: 在自建大规模CHD数据集（五个视图）上达到顶级性能，为早期检测提供鲁棒工具。

papers.title: The Theory of Mind Utility: Formal Specification of a Mentalizing Mechanism
papers.abstract_en: Inferring others' beliefs requires more than reading surface signals; it requires tracking who told them what, in what order, and how credibly. The Theory of Mind Utility (ToM-U) formalizes this epistemic state inference problem at the computational level of analysis, specifying what mentalizing computes and why without commitment to algorithmic or neural implementation. ToM-U achieves this by constructing Local Epistemic World Models (LEWMs) -- directed typed graphs that represent agents, state nodes, and the epistemic relationships among them -- and evaluating discrete candidate LEWMs against observed behavior until one achieves sufficient confidence. Five formal definitions specify the LEWM structure, agent node properties including ordered information access history, a bounded proliferation mechanism for recursive mentalizing, three inference procedures, and a residue function that captures the structured trace left by failed mentalizing attempts. ToM-U differs from Bayesian Theory of Mind and adjacent formal accounts, which presuppose rather than derive belief states, and from simulation theory and theory-theory, which lack a formal apparatus for epistemic state inference. The architecture generates directional, falsifiable predictions about mentalizing failure that follow from structural properties of the model rather than auxiliary assumptions, and positions ToM-U as a domain-agnostic mechanism upstream of goal inference and other downstream social cognitive processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了心理理论效用（ToM-U）的计算框架，用于形式化描述心智化（mentalizing）机制——即推断他人信念的过程。ToM-U 通过构建局部认知世界模型（LEWM）并评估离散候选模型，实现了对信念状态的计算级规范，无需承诺具体算法或神经实现。该框架区别于贝叶斯心智理论和模拟理论等方法，并生成关于心智化失败的可证伪预测。
Motivation: 现有心理理论模型要么预设信念状态（如贝叶斯方法），要么缺乏形式化工具，因此需要一种在计算层面明确规范心智化计算内容与原因的形式机制。
Method: 提出了五条形式定义，包括 LEWM 结构、代理节点属性（包含有序信息访问历史）、递归心智化的有界增殖机制、三种推理过程以及一个残差函数（刻画失败心智化尝试的结构性痕迹）。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验数值，但声称该架构能够从结构属性而非辅助假设出发，生成关于心智化失败的方向性、可证伪预测。
Conclusion: ToM-U 被定位为领域无关的心智化机制，处于目标推断等下游社会认知过程的上游。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for Mathematical Reasoning: An Integrated Survey of Language Models, Neuro-symbolic Systems, and Verified Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical reasoning has long served as a stringent test of machine intelligence; over the past decade, it has moved from a niche problem within NLP to one of the most consequential AI frontiers. This survey provides a unified account of the field's evolution, from early rule-based math word problem (MWP) solvers and template-driven geometry systems, through neural expression generation and LLM prompting, to contemporary reasoning models, multi-agent systems, neuro-symbolic theorem provers, and verified discovery workflows. We organize the landscape along four axes: (i) informal reasoning over text and diagrams, spanning MWP solving, multimodal geometry, and VLMs; (ii) formal reasoning in proof assistants, including autoformalization, tactic prediction, compiler-guided repair, and proof search; (iii) mathematical discovery, where systems propose constructions, improve bounds, or assist attacks on open problems; and (iv) the inference and training-time techniques, including CoT prompting, tool use, process reward models, and RLVR, that increasingly connect generation with verification. We catalog major benchmarks across grade-school arithmetic, competition mathematics, geometry, formal proving, multimodal and multilingual reasoning, and expert evaluation, and we examine benchmark saturation, contamination, reporting mismatches, and the distinction between pass@1, majority voting, and verifier-assisted pass@$k$. We critically assess failure modes: brittleness under perturbation, reward hacking, multimodal grounding failures, fragile formalization, and the energy cost of reasoning-scale inference. Drawing on recent perspectives from working mathematicians, we identify future directions centered on verified-discovery workflows, reasoning efficiency, and infrastructure to make AI-assisted formalization broadly usable. Companion materials: https://github.com/Starscream-11813/awesome-AI4Math.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是关于人工智能数学推理的综述，系统梳理了从早期规则系统到当代大语言模型、神经符号系统和验证发现工作流的演进。作者从非正式推理、形式推理、数学发现、推理与训练技巧四个维度组织文献，并讨论了基准饱和、污染、报告失配以及失败模式等问题。
Motivation: 数学推理是机器智能的严格测试，近年来从NLP小众问题变为AI前沿，但缺乏统一视角的综述。本文旨在整合该领域的发展脉络与关键挑战。
Method: 沿四个轴线组织：非正式推理（文本/图解的MWP、多模态几何等）、形式推理（证明助手、自动形式化等）、数学发现（构造、改进界、协助开放问题）、推理与训练技术（CoT、工具使用、过程奖励模型、RLVR）。
Result: 目录化主要基准（从小学算术到竞赛数学、几何、形式证明等），分析基准饱和、污染、报告失配，以及pass@1、多数投票、验证辅助pass@k的区别。批判性评估失效模式（扰动脆弱性、奖励黑客、多模态接地失败等）。
Conclusion: 未来方向聚焦于验证发现工作流、推理效率、以及基础设施以使AI辅助形式化广泛可用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AgentJet: A Distributed Swarm Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Training reinforcement learning (RL) policies for large language model (LLM) agents requires optimizing multi-turn trajectories that interact with external environments. Existing training frameworks struggle with runtime failures, single-model constraints, incompatible task environments, and redundant context. We present AgentJet, a distributed swarm training framework based on a decoupled multi-node architecture. AgentJet treats the server--client topology as configurable: swarm servers host trainable models and perform optimization on GPU clusters, while detachable swarm clients execute arbitrary agents and communicate through OpenAI-compatible APIs. Reconfiguring this topology supports heterogeneous multi-model RL, mixed-task training with isolated runtimes, fault-tolerant execution, and live code iteration through hot-swappable clients. AgentJet also introduces context tracking with timeline merging, reducing actor-update time by 6.25x on AppWorld. The same detachable-client design supports an automated research system that conducts long-horizon, multi-day RL studies on large-scale clusters with limited human intervention. AgentJet is open-source and compatible with agent systems that issue standard LLM inference requests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentJet，一个基于解耦多节点架构的分布式 swarm 训练框架，用于大语言模型智能体的强化学习。该框架通过可配置的服务器-客户端拓扑支持异构多模型 RL、混合任务训练、容错执行和热插拔客户端，并引入时间线合并的上下文跟踪，将 AppWorld 上的 actor 更新时间减少 6.25 倍。
Motivation: 现有的 LLM 智能体 RL 训练框架在运行时容易遇到失败、单模型约束、任务环境不兼容和上下文冗余等问题，亟需一种灵活、高效的分布式训练方案。
Method: AgentJet 采用解耦的多节点架构：swarm 服务器在 GPU 集群上托管可训练模型并执行优化，可分离的 swarm 客户端通过 OpenAI 兼容 API 执行任意智能体并通信。通过重新配置拓扑支持异构多模型 RL、混合任务训练、容错执行和热插拔客户端，并利用时间线合并的上下文跟踪加速训练。
Result: 摘要报告在 AppWorld 上 actor 更新时间减少 6.25 倍，并支持长周期、多天的大规模集群 RL 研究，人工干预有限。
Conclusion: AgentJet 是一个开源、兼容标准 LLM 推理请求的通用训练框架，通过可分离客户端设计实现了灵活性和可扩展性。

papers.title: ViMax: Agentic Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Long-form video generation requires systematic narrative planning and visual consistency that current short-clip methods cannot provide. Existing methods generate isolated sequences without narrative structure and lack mechanisms for maintaining character and environmental consistency across scenes. We present ViMax, an agentic video generation framework that addresses video creation through coordinated multi-agent collaboration where specialized components negotiate narrative decisions, visual continuity, and production quality. Our framework employs a hierarchical narrative engine with retrieval-augmented generation for global story coherence and a dependency-aware visual consistency mechanism that tracks character and environmental states across temporal boundaries, while VLM-guided agents continuously monitor and refine both narrative coherence and visual fidelity. The framework enables coordinated agent collaboration to generate extended narrative content. This maintains both storytelling integrity and visual coherence across multi-scene timelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ViMax是一个基于多智能体协作的视频生成框架，通过分级叙事引擎和依赖感知的视觉一致性机制，实现长视频的叙事规划与视觉连贯性。
Motivation: 现有方法只能生成孤立短片段，缺乏叙事结构和跨场景的角色、环境一致性保持机制。
Method: 提出多智能体协作框架，包括分级叙事引擎（结合检索增强生成）和依赖感知的视觉一致性机制，由VLM引导的智能体持续监控并优化叙事连贯性和视觉保真度。
Result: 能够生成具有叙事完整性和视觉一致性的多场景长视频内容。
Conclusion: 该框架通过智能体协作解决了长视频生成中的叙事与视觉一致性问题，但摘要未提供定量评估或局限性说明。

papers.title: Multi$^2$: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Decision-Making with LLM-Based Agents in Interactive Environments
papers.abstract_en: A central goal of large language model (LLM) research is to build agentic systems that can plan, act, and adapt through sustained interaction with dynamic environments. While recent LLM-based agents exhibit impressive contextual reasoning, their long-horizon decision-making remains fragile, often suffering from objective drift, where goals and plans drift over extended interactions. We introduce Multi$^2$, a hierarchical multi-agent decision-making framework that explicitly decomposes agent behavior into complementary roles. A high-level agent (System 1) focuses on context-aware sub-goal generation using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while a low-level agent (System 2) executes atomic actions through offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) in interactive environments. This separation enables stable long-horizon control, mitigates objective drift, and allows efficient adaptation. Across diverse interactive environments, Multi$^2$ consistently outperforms strong agentic baselines, demonstrating improved robustness and coordination in multi-turn interaction. Beyond performance, we introduce and release three hierarchical benchmark datasets, filling a long-standing gap in training and evaluating hierarchical decision-making for LLM-based agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi²，一种层次化多智能体决策框架，用于 LLM 在交互环境中的长期决策。高层智能体（System 1）通过监督微调生成上下文感知的子目标，低层智能体（System 2）通过离线到在线强化学习执行原子动作，以缓解目标漂移。在多种交互环境中，Multi² 优于强基线，并发布三个层次化基准数据集。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在长期交互中容易发生目标漂移，即目标与计划随交互延长而偏离，导致决策不稳定。
Method: 采用层次化架构：高层智能体使用 SFT 生成子目标，低层智能体使用离线到在线 RL 执行动作，两者协同实现稳定长程控制。
Result: 在多种交互环境中，Multi² 持续优于强基线，表现出更好的鲁棒性和协调性。
Conclusion: 层次化角色分解能有效缓解目标漂移，并提升 LLM 智能体在长期交互中的决策稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OF$^3$GS: On-the-Fly Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unposed Images
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient and high-fidelity novel view synthesis (NVS) from offline image sequences. However, achieving on-the-fly NVS from unposed images remains challenging: the system must reconstruct renderable 3D Gaussians as images arrive, without access to future observations. Although online feed-forward geometry methods have been developed for causal depth and point-cloud recovery, directly adapting them to NVS often leads to severe rendering artifacts because Gaussian-based rendering demands stricter multi-view consistency in primitive scale and pose-geometry alignment. Even minor deviations can accumulate under causal inference and visibly degrade rendering quality. To this end, we propose OF$^3$GS, a feed-forward framework for efficient and high-quality on-the-fly NVS from sparse-view unposed images under causal constraints. We introduce two mechanisms for causal geometric stability: a Decoupled Intrinsic Recovery Head that mitigates cumulative camera-intrinsic bias and scene-scale jitter, and Dynamic Point Refinement Offsets that relax rigid unprojection to compensate for coupled pose-depth drift. Extensive experiments show that OF$^3$GS outperforms online baselines and approaches offline feed-forward 3DGS methods under comparable sparse-input settings. It also remains memory-feasible with denser inputs. Homepage: https://richardchen225.github.io/of3gs/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OF$^3$GS，一种前馈框架，用于从无位姿的稀疏视图图像在因果约束下进行高效、高质量的即时新颖视图合成。通过解耦内在恢复头和动态点细化偏移来稳定几何，优于在线基线方法。
Motivation: 现有前馈3DGS方法依赖离线图像序列，无法在图像到达时即时重建可渲染的3D高斯；直接改造在线几何方法会导致渲染伪影。
Method: 提出解耦内在恢复头（Decoupled Intrinsic Recovery Head）缓解相机内在偏差和场景尺度抖动，以及动态点细化偏移（Dynamic Point Refinement Offsets）补偿耦合的位姿-深度漂移。
Result: 在稀疏输入设置下，OF$^3$GS优于在线基线方法，接近离线前馈3DGS方法，且对密集输入内存可行。
Conclusion: 该系统实现了从无位姿图像的即时新颖视图合成，保证了因果几何稳定性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出解耦内在恢复头（Decoupled Intrinsic Recovery Head）缓解相机内在偏差和场景尺度抖动，以及动态点细化偏移（Dynamic Point Refinement Offsets）补偿耦合的位姿-深度漂移。
summary_sections.result: 在稀疏输入设置下，OF$^3$GS优于在线基线方法，接近离线前馈3DGS方法，且对密集输入内存可行。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该系统实现了从无位姿图像的即时新颖视图合成，保证了因果几何稳定性。

papers.title: CWind: A Cross-site Router for Large Language Model Inference Serving at Renewable Energy Farms
papers.abstract_en: AI power demand is growing at an unprecedented rate while power grids are often ailing and struggle to keep up. Grid expansion comes with high capital expenditure and long-distance transmission losses, yet there is abundant renewable energy at the source, just not matched to demand. This paper proposes a complementary AI infrastructure deployment model, AI Greeninferencing, that brings modular AI compute to renewable energy sources, focusing on wind, allowing AI footprint expansion, generating local behind-the-meter demand for renewable sites, and helping ease the growing strain on power utilities. Our feasibility analysis shows that 890+ GW of wind capacity lies within 50 ms network round trip time of Azure data centers, and that site-wise right-sizing combined with spatial complementarity of wind energy keeps aggregate fleet utilization on par with traditional deployments. To serve inference requests under variable wind power, we build CWind, a lightweight, reactive, and workload-agnostic AI inference router that uses only real-time signals: inference latency, KV-cache utilization, and queue depth, to dynamically configure sites and distribute requests. Evaluated on a real 64-GPU A100 testbed emulating three wind-powered sites with Azure production traces, CWind reduces P99 end-to-end latency by up to 52% over the strongest contender (also our idea) and by up to 98% over baselines such as power-capping and GPU idling, with consistent gains across workload types, load levels, and GPU generations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为了解决AI能源需求激增与电网压力之间的矛盾，本文提出AI Greeninferencing模型，将模块化AI计算部署到风能产地，并开发了CWind路由器。CWind利用推理延迟、KV-cache利用率和队列深度等实时信号动态配置站点和分发请求。在64-GPU A100测试台上模拟三个风能站点的实验表明，与最强竞争者相比，P99端到端延迟降低最多52%，与功率限制等基线相比降低最多98%。
Motivation: AI能源需求快速增长，而电网扩展成本高昂且存在传输损耗，同时可再生能源（如风能）产地有富余电力但未与需求匹配。本文旨在通过将AI计算引入可再生能源农场来缓解电网压力并支持AI扩展。
Method: 提出AI Greeninferencing部署模型，并通过可行性分析展示890+ GW风能容量在Azure数据中心50 ms网络往返时间内。构建CWind，一个轻量级、反应式、与工作负载无关的AI推理路由器，仅使用推理延迟、KV-cache利用率和队列深度等实时信号来动态配置站点和分发请求。
Result: 在64-GPU A100测试台上模拟三个风能站点并使用Azure生产轨迹，CWind将P99端到端延迟降低最多52%（对比最强竞争者）和最多98%（对比功率限制和GPU空闲等基线），且在不同工作负载、负载水平和GPU代际上表现一致。
Conclusion: 论文验证了将AI推理服务部署到可再生能源农场的可行性，并证明CWind路由器能有效利用风能变化下的计算资源，显著降低延迟。

papers.title: Partial Fusion of Neural Networks: Efficient Tradeoffs Between Ensembles and Weight Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Ensembles of neural networks typically outperform individual networks but incur large computational costs, whereas weight aggregation produces less costly, yet also less accurate, aggregate models. We introduce partial fusion of networks, which interpolates between ensembles and weight aggregation and thus allows for a flexible tradeoff between computational cost and performance. A direct way to achieve this is to extend existing weight aggregation methods based on neuron-level similarity between different networks, where partial fusion then only aggregates weights of neurons which are most similar. We showcase one particular method to jointly identify which neurons are most similar and match them via partial optimal transport. Further, we consider the more general perspective of weight aggregation and partial fusion as generalized pruning of ensemble models, where neurons cannot just be deleted, but also linearly combined. Finally, we show that generalized pruning applied to a single network yields similar benefits as partial fusion by allowing for a tradeoff between isolating, deleting, and linearly combining neurons based on similarity. Our code is available at https://github.com/Fabian-Mor/partial_fusion_nn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经网络的部分融合方法，介于完全集成与权重聚合之间，通过基于神经元相似性的部分最优传输匹配最相似的神经元并仅聚合其权重，从而在计算成本与性能之间灵活权衡。该方法被视为对集成模型的广义剪枝，允许神经元被删除或线性组合。
Motivation: 集成模型性能好但计算成本高，权重聚合成本低但精度损失大，缺乏介于两者之间的灵活权衡方案。
Method: 扩展基于神经元级相似性的权重聚合方法，通过部分最优传输匹配最相似的神经元，仅聚合这些神经元的权重，实现部分融合。同时将其视为广义剪枝，允许神经元删除或线性组合。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称部分融合在计算成本与性能之间提供了有效的权衡。
Conclusion: 部分融合和广义剪枝为神经网络融合提供了更灵活的范式，可应用于单个网络以在隔离、删除和线性组合神经元之间进行权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tunable MAGMAX: Preference-Aware Model Merging for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning (CL) aims to train models sequentially on multiple tasks while mitigating catastrophic forgetting of previously learned knowledge. Recent advances in large pre-trained models (LPMs) and model merging techniques, such as MAGMAX, have demonstrated effective CL performance by combining task-specific parameters. However, existing methods primarily focus on average performance across all tasks and do not adequately address how to construct models accommodating different deployment environments or varying user preferences. This paper proposes a model merging framework, termed Tunable MAGMAX, which enables preference-aware control of task-specific performance in CL. Our method introduces a preference vector that controls the number of elements selected from each task vector during model merging, allowing us to adjust the merged model performance according to their deployment needs. We further propose a method for automatically constructing appropriate preference vectors by leveraging small amounts of target environment data and datasets from model training tasks, thereby eliminating the need for manual specification. The experimental result on CL benchmark tasks demonstrates that Tunable MAGMAX effectively controls task-wise performance and successfully adapts merged models to various target environments. The proposed Tunable MAGMAX achieves superior or comparable performance to baseline methods, making it a practical solution for deploying CL models to various environments where the preferences of each task performance differ.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at ICPR 2026 (v2: fixed typos)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Tunable MAGMAX框架，通过引入偏好向量控制模型合并时从每个任务向量中选择的元素数量，实现持续学习中任务性能的可调控制。该方法利用少量目标环境数据和训练任务数据自动构建偏好向量，无需手动指定。实验表明，该方法能有效控制任务级性能，适应不同部署环境，性能优于或持平基线方法。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法主要关注所有任务的平均性能，无法针对不同部署环境或用户偏好调整模型在特定任务上的表现。
Method: 提出Tunable MAGMAX，引入偏好向量控制模型合并时从各任务向量中选择的元素数量，并利用少量目标环境数据和训练任务数据自动构建偏好向量。
Result: 在持续学习基准任务上，Tunable MAGMAX能有效控制任务级性能，适应多种目标环境，性能优于或持平基线方法。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种实用的解决方案，可将持续学习模型部署到任务偏好各异的多种环境中。

papers.title: Reframing AI Loss of Control: What Control Is, How to Have It, How to Lose It
papers.abstract_en: At present, loss of control risks have gained much prominence in public discussion, particularly in relation to AI, with extensive discourse present among academics, frontier labs, and even governments. However, in the existing literature, the concept seems to rest on surprisingly weak foundations, where even those that discuss loss of control extensively do not first establish what control is and what exactly is being lost. Our paper aims to address these gaps. We establish a working definition of control by anchoring it to the "setting and getting of goals". Then, we discuss various aspects of control, built on foundational concepts from related fields like cybernetics, management control, and control theory. This includes who (or what) can be in control, and the things they require to be in control, such as the ability to set goals, having a functional control loop, having requisite variety, and having sufficient goal alignment. Once a framework for control is established, we then discuss how control can be lost, how AIs can contribute to such loss of control, and offer relevant recommendations for how one can maintain control. One interesting consequence of our work is that humanity, as individuals and as groups, can lose varying degrees of control as a result of AI behaviour that is far below the level of superintelligence; the potential for loss of control scenarios (as we define them) already exist, and have existed for a long time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文旨在建立AI损失控制风险的严格定义和框架。通过将控制锚定于“目标的设定与获取”，借鉴控制论、管理控制和控制理论等基础概念，明确了谁（或什么）可以处于控制中、需要哪些条件（如目标设定能力、功能控制回路、必要多样性、目标对齐）。然后讨论控制如何丧失、AI如何促成这种丧失，并提出维持控制的建议。一个关键结论是：人类个体或群体可能因远低于超级智能水平的AI行为而丧失不同程度控制，这类风险早已存在。
Motivation: 当前关于AI损失控制风险的讨论广泛，但概念基础薄弱，缺乏对“控制是什么”以及“丧失了什么”的明确定义。
Method: 从控制论、管理控制和控制理论中提取基础概念，定义控制为“目标的设定与获取”，并阐述控制所需组件（目标设定、控制回路、必要多样性、目标对齐），进而分析控制丧失机制及AI的贡献。
Result: 提出一个系统的控制框架，并指出损失控制风险可在AI远未达到超级智能时出现，且这种风险早已存在。
Conclusion: 需要更严谨地定义控制，并关注低水平AI行为可能导致的控制丧失，而不仅限于超级智能风险。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Global Automation Atlas
papers.abstract_en: Automation can displace or complement labour, but this need not be constant across economies. Existing exposure measures typically assign fixed scores to tasks or occupations and capture cross-country variation through employment structure. Here we show that feasible automation depends jointly on task content and country-level conditions. We use a large language model to classify 18,797 work tasks in 124 economies by exposure, labour margin, technology channel and artificial-intelligence materiality. Construct-matched components of the measure correlate strongly with established exposure indices, observed work-related ChatGPT use, AI preparedness and firm-reported adoption. The exposed share of tasks ranges from 3.3% to 61.6%, rises with income yet remains heterogeneous within income groups. Lower-income economies are more concentrated in rule-based and labour-substituting forms of automation, whereas physical execution, planning and inference channels, together with labour-augmenting uses of artificial intelligence, become more prominent with development. Country conditioning changes occupation exposure rankings, especially in lower-income economies. Combined with employment data, we find that women are disproportionately employed in occupations with substitution-facing exposure. Machine-learning hypothesis generation identifies digital records, capital equipment, local judgement, trust-based markets and data integration as conditions associated with exposure differences.
papers.comment: 78 pages, 6 figures, 5 Extended Data figures. Substantially revised and expanded. Data and code: https://automationatlas.org/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用大语言模型对124个经济体的18,797项工作任务进行分类，评估自动化暴露程度、劳动边际、技术渠道和人工智能重要性。研究发现可行的自动化取决于任务内容和国家层面条件，暴露比例从3.3%到61.6%不等，且随收入上升但组内异质性显著。低收入经济体更集中于基于规则和劳动替代型自动化，而高收入经济体更多涉及物理执行、规划和推理渠道以及劳动增强型AI。国家条件改变职业暴露排名，女性在替代性暴露职业中比例过高。
Motivation: 现有自动化暴露指标通常为任务或职业分配固定分数，仅通过就业结构捕捉跨国差异，忽视了国家层面条件的影响。本文旨在证明可行的自动化取决于任务内容和国家条件共同作用，并提供更全面的跨国分析。
Method: 使用大语言模型对124个经济体的18,797项工作任务进行分类，涉及暴露程度、劳动边际、技术渠道和人工智能重要性四个维度。通过构建匹配指标与现有暴露指数、ChatGPT使用、AI准备度和企业采用数据验证相关性。
Result: 暴露任务比例范围为3.3%至61.6%，随收入上升但组内异质性显著。低收入经济体更集中于基于规则和劳动替代型自动化，高收入经济体更突出物理执行、规划和推理渠道及劳动增强型AI。国家条件改变职业暴露排名，女性在替代性暴露职业中比例过高。机器学习假设生成识别出数字记录、资本设备、本地判断、基于信任的市场和数据整合是影响暴露差异的条件。
Conclusion: 自动化暴露并非恒定不变，而是依赖于国家具体条件。国家条件改变职业暴露排名，尤其对低收入经济体影响显著。研究结果对理解自动化对不同经济体和人群的影响具有政策意义。

summary_sections.conclusion: 自动化暴露并非恒定不变，而是依赖于国家具体条件。国家条件改变职业暴露排名，尤其对低收入经济体影响显著。研究结果对理解自动化对不同经济体和人群的影响具有政策意义。

papers.title: GQLA: Group-Query Latent Attention for Hardware-Adaptive Large Language Model Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), the attention used in DeepSeek-V2/V3, jointly compresses keys and values into a low-rank latent and matches the H100 roofline almost perfectly. Its trained weights, however, expose only one decoding path - an absorbed MQA form - which ties efficient inference to H100-class compute-bandwidth ratios, forfeits tensor parallelism along the head axis, and yields no Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) gain on commodity inference GPUs such as the export-restricted H20. We propose Group-Query Latent Attention (GQLA), a minimal modification of MLA whose trained weights expose two algebraically equivalent decoding paths over the same parameters: an MQA-absorb path identical to MLA's, and a GQA path with a per-group expanded cache. The runtime picks the path that matches the target hardware - no retraining, no custom kernels - so a single set of GQLA weights pins the rooflines of both H100 (MQA-absorb, s_q=1) and H20 (GQA + MTP, s_q=2), while supporting up to 8-way zero-redundancy tensor parallelism on the GQA path. To avoid pretraining from scratch we extend TransMLA into TransGQLA, which converts a pretrained GQA checkpoint into a GQLA model; on LLaMA-3-8B it compresses the per-token KV cache to 28.125% of the GQA baseline on the MQA-absorb path while structurally preserving GQA-level traffic on the per-group path.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Group-Query Latent Attention (GQLA)，是对DeepSeek-V2/V3使用的Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA)的最小修改，通过训练后暴露两条代数等价的解码路径（MQA-absorb路径和GQA路径），使得单一GQLA权重能够在H100（MQA路径）和H20（GQA+多token预测）上达到最佳性能，无需重训或定制内核。此外，TransGQLA方法可将预训练GQA检查点转换为GQLA模型，在LLaMA-3-8B上MQA路径将KV缓存压缩至GQA基线的28.125%。
Motivation: MLA在H100上接近roofline，但其暴露的唯一解码路径（MQA-absorb形式）限制了在H20等受出口限制的GPU上的推理效率，且无法利用张量并行和多token预测。需要一种硬件自适应的注意力机制。
Method: 在MLA基础上引入Group-Query Latent Attention (GQLA)，训练权重同时保持MQA-absorb和GQA两条代数等价路径；运行时根据目标硬件选择路径。同时提出TransGQLA将GQA检查点转换成GQLA。
Result: 在H20上GQA路径支持最多8路零冗余张量并行并实现多token预测；在LLaMA-3-8B上MQA路径将KV缓存压缩至GQA基线的28.125%。
Conclusion: GQLA提供了一种无需重训的硬件自适应解码方案，适用于不同算力带宽比的GPU，特别是受出口限制的型号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Guide, Think, Act: Interactive Embodied Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose GTA-VLA(Guide, Think, Act), an interactive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework that enables spatially steerable embodied reasoning by allowing users to guide robot policies with explicit visual cues. Existing VLA models learn a direct "Sense-to-Act" mapping from multimodal observations to robot actions. While effective within the training distribution, such tightly coupled policies are brittle under out-of-domain (OOD) shifts and difficult to correct when failures occur. Although recent embodied Chain-of-Thought (CoT) approaches expose intermediate reasoning, they still lack a mechanism for incorporating human spatial guidance, limiting their ability to resolve visual ambiguities or recover from mistakes. To address this gap, our framework allows users to optionally guide the policy with spatial priors, such as affordance points, boxes, and traces, which the subsequent reasoning process can directly condition on. Based on these inputs, the model generates a unified spatial-visual Chain-of-Thought that integrates external guidance with internal task planning, aligning human visual intent with autonomous decision-making. For practical deployment, we further couple the reasoning module with a lightweight reactive action head for efficient action execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. On the in-domain SimplerEnv WidowX benchmark, our framework achieves a state-of-the-art 81.2% success rate. Under OOD visual shifts and spatial ambiguities, a single visual interaction substantially improves task success over existing methods, highlighting the value of interactive reasoning for failure recovery in embodied control. More details of the project can be found here: https://github.com/FutianLabs/GTA-VLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GTA-VLA框架，允许用户通过视觉线索（如可交互点、框、轨迹）引导机器人策略，并生成空间-视觉思维链（spatial-visual Chain-of-Thought）以整合人类意图与自主决策。在SimplerEnv WidowX基准上达到81.2%成功率，在域外场景下单次视觉交互显著提升任务成功率。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型直接学习从观察到动作的映射，在域外偏移下脆弱且难以纠正；虽然已有CoT方法暴露中间推理，但缺乏融入人类空间指导的机制，无法消除视觉歧义或从错误中恢复。
Method: 提出交互式VLA框架，用户可提供空间先验（如可交互点、框、轨迹），模型据此生成统一的空间-视觉思维链，将外部指导与内部任务规划对齐，并耦合轻量级反应式动作头进行高效执行。
Result: 在SimplerEnv WidowX基准上达到81.2%成功率（SOTA）；在域外视觉偏移和空间歧义下，单次视觉交互显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 交互式空间推理对于故障恢复和提升VLA模型鲁棒性具有重要价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: More Edits, More Stable: Understanding the Lifelong Normalization in Sequential Model Editing
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong Model Editing aims to continuously update evolving facts in Large Language Models while preserving unrelated knowledge and general capabilities, yet it remains plagued by catastrophic forgetting and model collapse. Empirically, we find that recent editors resilient over long horizons share the same core strategy: Lifelong Normalization (LN), which normalizes value gradients using running statistics. Removing LN causes immediate performance collapse, and we observe a counter-intuitive positive cumulative effect where early edits can promote the success of future edits. Yet the mechanism of LN remains a "black box", leaving its precise role in lifelong stability poorly understood. In this work, we provide the first theoretical account of LN in the lifelong regime. Our analysis reveals a self-reinforcing stability loop and proves that, when combined with ridge-regularized regression, LN yields parameter updates with asymptotic orthogonality and bounded norms, directly mitigating forgetting and systemic collapse. Based on these insights, we derive StableEdit, which strengthens this stability loop via an explicit warm-up stage and full whitening, improving long-horizon stability at minimal overhead. Extensive experiments validate our theory and demonstrate competitive performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/MINE-USTC/StableEdit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对终身模型编辑中的灾难性遗忘和模型崩溃问题，首次从理论上解释了终身归一化（Lifelong Normalization, LN）的机制，证明其与岭正则化结合能产生渐近正交且有界范数的参数更新，直接缓解遗忘和系统崩溃。基于理论洞察提出StableEdit方法，通过显式预热阶段和完全白化加强稳定性循环，实验验证了理论有效性并在长期编辑任务上取得竞争性能。
Motivation: 终身模型编辑面临灾难性遗忘和模型崩溃，而近期成功方法中的核心策略LN机制不明，成为“黑盒”，缺乏理论理解限制了方法改进。
Method: 提供LN在终身机制下的首个理论分析，揭示自强化稳定性循环，并证明LN与岭正则化回归结合可实现参数更新的渐近正交性和有界范数。由此导出StableEdit，增加显式预热阶段和完全白化操作以强化稳定性循环。
Result: 理论证明LN+岭正则化可缓解遗忘和崩溃；实验表明StableEdit在长期编辑任务上性能与现有方法相当或更优，且理论分析与实验结果一致。
Conclusion: 该工作弥合了终身模型编辑中LN的经验成功与理论理解之间的差距，所提StableEdit方法以低开销提升长期稳定性，为后续编辑算法设计提供了理论指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ScaleMoGen: Autoregressive Next-Scale Prediction for Human Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present ScaleMoGen, a scale-wise autoregressive framework for text-driven human motion generation. Unlike conventional autoregressive approaches that rely on standard next-token prediction, ScaleMoGen frames motion generation as a coarse-to-fine process. We quantize 3D motions into compositional discrete tokens across multiple skeletal-emporal scales of increasing granularity, learning to generate motion by autoregressively predicting next-scale token maps. To maintain structural integrity, our motion tokenizers and quantizers are explicitly designed so that discrete tokens at every scale strictly preserve the skeletal hierarchy. Additionally, we employ bitwise quantization and prediction, which efficiently scale up the tokenizer vocabulary to preserve motion details and stabilize optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScaleMoGen achieves state-of-the-art performance, establishing an FID of 0.030 (vs. 0.045 for MoMask) on HumanML3D and a CLIP Score of 0.693 (vs. 0.685 for MoMask++) on the SnapMoGen dataset. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our skeletal-temporal multi-scale representation naturally facilitates training-free, text-guided motion editing.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://inwoohwang.me/ScaleMoGen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ScaleMoGen，一种基于尺度级自回归的文本驱动人体运动生成框架。与传统逐token预测不同，它将运动生成建模为从粗到细的过程，通过量化多尺度骨骼-时间离散token并自回归预测下一尺度token图，同时采用位量化扩展词汇量并保持骨骼层次结构。在HumanML3D和SnapMoGen数据集上达到最先进性能，FID为0.030，CLIP Score为0.693，并支持无需训练的文本引导运动编辑。
Motivation: 现有自回归运动生成方法通常采用标准逐token预测，缺乏对运动结构的层次化建模，难以同时保持全局一致性和局部细节。
Method: 提出尺度级自回归框架，将3D运动量化为多个骨骼-时间尺度的离散token，通过预测下一尺度token图实现粗到细生成；使用位量化和预测扩展词汇表，并设计严格保持骨骼层次结构的tokenizer。
Result: 在HumanML3D上FID达到0.030（vs MoMask 0.045），在SnapMoGen数据集上CLIP Score达到0.693（vs MoMask++ 0.685）。
Conclusion: 多尺度骨骼-时间表示有效提升运动生成质量，并自然支持无需训练的文本引导运动编辑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Cognitive Kardashev Scale: Quantifying the Material Envelope of Civilisational Computation
papers.abstract_en: How much thinking can a civilisation do? Kardashev ranked civilisations by the energy they command. This paper borrows his ladder and asks how much machine cognition each rung could support. The arithmetic is deliberately simple. A civilisation has some total power. Only a fraction of that can be spared for computing, and each joule spent buys computation at whatever efficiency the hardware of the day has reached. The product of the three sets a ceiling on machine thought. To keep the resulting quantities intelligible, I express them in units of the human brain's own processing rate, as a rough yardstick rather than a claim about minds. Calibrating the ceiling against present-day supercomputers and AI accelerators led me to two conclusions I did not expect at the outset. Even today's energy supply could support far more machine cognition than humanity actually uses, so physical capacity is not what binds. And whether energy or hardware efficiency becomes the constraint over the coming decade turns on engineering choices that have not yet been made. On the question that may matter most, who gets access to the cognition it describes, the scale is silent. That is a matter of political economy, and the calibration is offered as an input to that debate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文借用卡尔达舍夫等级的思想，通过简单算术模型估算不同能量等级文明可支持的计算量上限，并以人脑处理速率作为单位。校准当前超算和AI加速器后，作者发现两个意外结论：现有能源供应已能支持远超实际使用的机器认知，因此物理容量并非限制因素；未来十年能量效率或硬件效率哪个成为瓶颈取决于尚未做出的工程选择。该尺度对谁有权使用认知能力保持沉默，这属于政治经济学问题。
Motivation: 探讨文明能量等级与机器认知能力上限的关系，量化物质条件对计算能力的约束，并揭示当前实际使用与理论容量的差距。
Method: 采用简单的乘法模型：文明总能量 × 可用于计算的比例 × 硬件每焦耳的计算效率，以人脑处理速率作为单位进行标度，并利用当前超算和AI加速器进行校准。
Result: 即使当前能量供应也能支持远多于人类实际使用的机器认知；未来十年能量效率与硬件效率哪个成为瓶颈取决于未定的工程选择。
Conclusion: 物理容量并非当前限制机器认知的因素；关于谁有权使用这些认知能力的问题超出该尺度范围，属于政治经济学讨论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bridging the Last Mile of Circuit Design: PostEDA-Bench, a Hierarchical Benchmark for PPA Convergence and DRC Fixing
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are increasingly applied to the "last mile" of Electronic Design Automation (EDA): repairing residual sign-off Design Rule Check (DRC) violations and converging Power-Performance-Area (PPA) targets after tool runs. Existing EDA-LLM benchmarks, however, omit DRC fixing entirely and rely on flat hierarchies tied to a single toolchain. We introduce PostEDA-Bench, a hierarchical benchmark with 145 tasks across DRC-Essential, DRC-Reasoning, PPA-Mono, and PPA-Multi, supported by EDA toolchains with machine-checkable evaluation. Across eight commercial and open-source LLMs under multiple agent scaffolds, we find that agents handle synthetic DRC-Essential and single-objective PPA-Mono reasonably well but degrade sharply on the more practical DRC-Reasoning, where the best success rate is 36.66%, and PPA-Multi, where the best success rate is 20.00%; vision augmentation consistently enhances DRC-Bench; and trade-off reasoning, rather than knob knowledge, is the dominant PPA-Multi bottleneck.

papers.title: How Many Iterations to Jailbreak? Dynamic Budget Allocation for Multi-Turn LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating and predicting the performance of large language models (LLMs) in multi-turn conversational settings is critical yet computationally expensive; key events -- e.g., jailbreaks or successful task completion by an agent -- often emerge only after repeated interactions. These events might be rare, and under any feasible computational budget, remain unobserved. Recent conformal survival frameworks construct reliable lower predictive bounds (LPBs) on the number of iterations to trigger the event of interest, but rely on static budget allocation that is inefficient in multi-turn setups. To address this, we introduce \emph{Dynamic Allocation via PRojected Optimization} (DAPRO), the first theoretically valid dynamic budget allocation framework for bounding the time-to-event in multi-turn LLM interactions. We prove that DAPRO satisfies the budget constraint and provides distribution-free, finite-sample coverage guarantees without requiring the conditional independence between censoring and event times assumed by prior conformal survival approaches. A key theoretical contribution is a novel coverage bound that scales with the square root of the mean censoring weight rather than the worst-case weight, yielding provably tighter guarantees than prior work. Furthermore, DAPRO can be employed to obtain unbiased, low-variance estimates of population-level evaluation metrics, such as the jailbreak rate, under limited computing resources. Comprehensive experiments across agentic task success, adversarial jailbreaks, toxic content generation, and RAG hallucinations using LLMs such as Llama 3.1 and Qwen 2.5 demonstrate that DAPRO consistently achieves coverage closer to the nominal level with lower variance than static baselines, while satisfying the budget constraint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAPRO 框架，用于多轮 LLM 交互中事件发生时间（如越狱）的动态预算分配，在满足预算约束的同时提供分布自由、有限样本的覆盖保证。实验表明其在越狱、任务成功等场景中比静态基线更接近名义覆盖率且方差更低。
Motivation: 多轮对话中关键事件（如越狱）出现罕见且计算昂贵，现有静态预算分配方法效率低，且缺乏有效的覆盖保证。
Method: 提出 DAPRO（Dynamic Allocation via PRojected Optimization），通过优化投影实现动态预算分配，并推导出基于平均删失权重的覆盖界，无需条件独立性假设。
Result: 在 Llama 3.1 和 Qwen 2.5 上的实验表明，DAPRO 在任务成功、越狱、有毒内容生成和 RAG 幻觉等场景中均达到更接近名义覆盖率的水平，且方差更低。
Conclusion: DAPRO 是首个理论上有效的多轮 LLM 交互事件时间动态预算分配框架，在满足预算约束下提供更紧的覆盖保证。

papers.title: FinRAG-12B: A Production-Validated Recipe for Grounded Question Answering in Banking
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly being adopted across various domains. However, their adoption in banking industry faces resistance due to demands for high accuracy, regulatory compliance, and the need for verifiable and grounded responses. We present a unified, data-efficient framework for training grounded domain-specific LLMs that optimizes answer quality, citation grounding, and calibrated refusal under real-world deployment constraints. First, we describe a data generation pipeline that combines LLM-as-a-Judge filtering, citation annotation, and curriculum learning with only 143M tokens. The resulting 12B model achieves high answer quality outperforming GPT-4.1 on citation grounding, with a modest citation tradeoff versus the untuned base. Second, we propose a calibrated refusal mechanism: training on 22% unanswerable examples yield a 12% "I don't know" rate, substantially improving over the base model's unsafe 4.3% rate while avoiding GPT-4.1's over-refusal (20.2%). Third, we present an end-to-end methodology spanning from data curation to quantized serving. The system is deployed at 40+ financial institutions, achieving a 7.1 percentage point improvement in query resolution (p < 0.001). Additionally, the model delivers 3-5x faster responses at 20-50x lower cost compared to GPT-4.1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一个面向银行领域的域特定RAG训练框架（FinRAG-12B），通过数据生成管道（含LLM-as-a-Judge过滤、引用标注和课程学习）仅用143M token训练12B模型，在回答质量和引用接地性上超越GPT-4.1，并设计了校准拒答机制（22%不可回答样本训练实现12%拒答率）。系统已在40+家金融机构部署，查询解决率提升7.1个百分点，响应速度比GPT-4.1快3-5倍且成本低20-50倍。
Motivation: 银行领域对LLM的准确性、合规性和可验证接地响应有高要求，但现有通用模型难以满足，且缺乏大规模领域标注数据。
Method: 构建数据生成管道：结合LLM-as-a-Judge过滤、引用标注和课程学习，仅用143M token；提出校准拒答机制，训练集中包含22%不可回答样本；采用量化部署实现高效服务。
Result: 12B模型在回答质量和引用接地性上超越GPT-4.1；校准拒答机制使拒答率从基线的4.3%提升至12%，优于GPT-4.1的20.2%过度拒答；实际部署中查询解决率提升7.1个百分点（p<0.001），响应快3-5倍且成本低20-50倍。
Conclusion: 论文验证了数据高效的域特定LLM训练框架在金融领域的有效性，并强调了校准拒答和量化部署对实际应用的重要性。

papers.title: Understanding Self-Supervised Learning via Latent Distribution Matching
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) excels at finding general-purpose latent representations from complex data, yet lacks a unifying theoretical framework that explains the diverse existing methods and guides the design of new ones. We cast SSL as latent distribution matching (LDM): learning representations that maximize their log-probability under an assumed latent model (alignment), while maximizing latent entropy to prevent collapse (uniformity). This view unifies independent component analysis with contrastive, non-contrastive, and predictive SSL methods, including stop gradient approaches. Leveraging LDM, we derive a nonlinear, sampling-free Bayesian filtering model with a Kalman-based predictor for high-dimensional timeseries. We further prove that predictive LDM yields identifiable latent representations under mild assumptions, even with nonlinear predictors. Overall, LDM clarifies the assumptions behind established SSL methods and provides principled guidance for developing new approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将自监督学习（SSL）统一为潜在分布匹配（LDM）框架：学习最大化潜在模型下对数概率（对齐）同时最大化熵防止坍缩（均匀性）的表示。该框架统一了独立成分分析、对比式、非对比式和预测式SSL方法，并推导出一种无采样的非线性贝叶斯滤波模型。进一步证明在温和假设下预测式LDM可得到可识别的潜在表示。
Motivation: 现有SSL方法多样但缺乏统一理论框架来解释各种方法并指导新方法设计。
Method: 提出潜在分布匹配（LDM）视角，将SSL目标分解为对齐项（最大化潜在表示在假设模型下的对数概率）和均匀性项（最大化熵）。基于此推导出适用于高维时间序列的基于卡尔曼预测器的非线性、无采样贝叶斯滤波模型。
Result: 理论统一了多种SSL方法（ICA、对比、非对比、预测、stop-gradient），并证明预测式LDM在非线性预测器下仍能获得可识别的潜在表示。
Conclusion: LDM框架澄清了现有SSL方法的假设，并为设计新方法提供了原则性指导。

papers.title: Lifting Embodied World Models for Planning and Control
papers.abstract_en: World models of embodied agents predict future observations conditioned on an action taken by the agent. For complex embodiments, action spaces are high-dimensional and difficult to specify: for example, precisely controlling a human agent requires specifying the motion of each joint. This makes the world model hard to control and expensive to plan with as search-based methods like CEM scale poorly with action dimensionality. To address this issue, we train a lightweight policy that maps high-level actions to sequences of low-level joint actions. Composing this policy with the frozen world model produces a lifted world model that predicts a sequence of future observations from a single high-level action. We instantiate this framework for a human-like embodiment, defining the high-level action space as a small set of 2D waypoints annotated on the current observation frame, each specifying a near-term goal position for a leaf joint (pelvis, head, hands). Waypoints are low-dimensional, visually interpretable, and easy to specify manually or to search over. We show that the lifted world model substantially outperforms searching directly in low-level joint space ($3.8\times$ lower mean joint error to the goal pose), while remaining more compute-efficient and generalizing to environments unseen by the policy.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV2026. Edited policy masking
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具身智能体（如人体）中动作空间高维导致规划困难的问题，提出“提升式世界模型”（lifted world model）。通过训练一个轻量级策略，将少数高层动作（2D waypoints）映射为低层关节动作序列，与冻结的世界模型组合后，可从单个高层动作预测未来观测序列。在人体类似具身任务中，该方法比直接搜索低层关节空间的平均关节误差降低3.8倍，且计算更高效，能泛化到未见环境。
Motivation: 具身智能体的世界模型通常基于低层关节动作进行预测，但高维动作空间导致基于搜索的规划方法（如CEM）扩展性差，难以有效控制和规划。
Method: 训练一个轻量级策略，将高层动作（如当前观测帧上的少量2D路点，指定叶关节的近端目标位置）映射为低层关节动作序列，然后与冻结的世界模型组合，形成提升式世界模型，从单个高层动作预测未来观测序列。
Result: 在人体类似具身任务中，提升式世界模型在达到目标姿态的平均关节误差上比直接搜索低层关节空间低3.8倍，同时计算效率更高，并能泛化到策略未见过的环境。
Conclusion: 通过定义语义上可解释、低维的高层动作空间，并结合轻量级策略，可以有效缓解具身世界模型在高维动作空间下的控制与规划难题。

papers.title: Large Language Models Explore by Latent Distilling
papers.abstract_en: Generating diverse responses is crucial for test-time scaling of large language models (LLMs), yet standard stochastic sampling mostly yields surface-level lexical variation, limiting semantic exploration. In this paper, we propose Exploratory Sampling (ESamp), a decoding approach that explicitly encourages semantic diversity during generation. ESamp is motivated by the well-known observation that neural networks tend to make lower-error predictions on inputs similar to those encountered before, and incur higher prediction error on novel ones. Building on this property, we train a lightweight Distiller at test time to predict deep-layer hidden representations of the LLM from its shallow-layer representations to model the LLM's depth-wise representation transitions. During decoding, the Distiller continuously adapts to the mappings induced by the current generation context. ESamp uses the prediction error as a novelty signal to reweight candidate token extensions conditioned on the current prefix, thereby biasing decoding toward less-explored semantic patterns. ESamp is implemented with an asynchronous training--inference pipeline, with less than 5% worst case overhead (1.2% in the optimized release). Empirical results show that ESamp significantly boosts the Pass@k efficiency of reasoning models, showing superior or comparable performance to strong stochastic and heuristic baselines. Notably, ESamp achieves robust generalization across mathematics, science, and code generation benchmarks and breaks the trade-off between diversity and coherence in creative writing. Our code has released at: https://github.com/LinesHogan/tLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出探索性采样（ESamp），一种在解码时通过轻量级蒸馏器（Distiller）预测深度层隐藏表示，利用预测误差作为新颖性信号，鼓励生成语义多样的文本。该方法通过异步训练-推理管道实现，开销低，在推理、数学、科学和代码生成任务上提升了Pass@k，并打破了创意写作中多样性与连贯性的权衡。
Motivation: 标准随机采样主要产生表层词汇变化，限制了语义探索。需要一种解码方法显式鼓励语义多样性，以提升大语言模型的测试时扩展（test-time scaling）能力。
Method: 训练轻量级Distiller，在线预测LLM从浅层到深层表示的变化，将其预测误差作为新颖性信号，在解码时重新加权候选token，偏向尚未探索的语义模式。采用异步训练-推理管道，开销小于5%。
Result: 显著提升推理模型的Pass@k效率，在数学、科学和代码生成基准上表现优于或堪比强基线和随机采样，同时在创意写作中打破多样性与连贯性的权衡。

papers.title: Zero-Shot DINOv3-Based Image Matching via Many-to-Many Association
papers.abstract_en: We explore zero-shot image matching based on DINOv3 features. These general-purpose features are semantically rich yet geometrically ambiguous -- the nearest neighbor in feature space is often a false geometric match -- so the conventional one-to-one association paradigm is prone to discarding true correspondences. We instead retain many-to-many associations and cast the ensuing estimation as maximum-likelihood inference. This formulation reveals the existing robust mechanism for many-to-many association as a zeroth-order approximation to the otherwise intractable likelihood, and yields a novel mechanism with faster evaluation and finer granularity. We condense these theoretical findings into a two-stage LO-RANSAC algorithm which, combined with careful layer selection and positional bias correction for DINOv3 features, forms a zero-shot pipeline that degrades gracefully under background variation and across RGB-thermal pairs, where specialized baselines collapse under domain shift. Code released at https://github.com/LIAS-CUHKSZ/Zero-Shot-DINOv3-Image-Matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于DINOv3特征的零样本图像匹配方法。由于DINOv3特征语义丰富但几何模糊，传统一对一类比容易丢弃正确匹配，因此改用多对多关联，并将估计问题转化为最大似然推理。现有鲁棒机制被证明是似然函数的零阶近似，本文提出一个更快、更细粒度的新机制，并集成到两阶段LO-RANSAC算法中。结合层选择和位置偏差校正，该方法在背景变化和RGB-热成像跨域场景下表现优于专业基线。
Motivation: 现有零样本图像匹配方法依赖一对一类比，但DINOv3等通用特征在几何上存在歧义，导致许多真实对应被丢弃。
Method: 保留多对多关联，将匹配估计构建为最大似然推理问题；推导出新机制替代现有鲁棒机制的零阶近似，并集成到两阶段LO-RANSAC算法中，同时优化了DINOv3的层选择和位置偏差校正。
Result: 在背景变化和RGB-热成像跨域场景下，该方法零样本性能优于专业基线，且降级更平滑。
Conclusion: 本文的理论分析和算法设计证明，基于多对多关联的最大似然框架能有效利用DINOv3特征的语义丰富性，提升零样本图像匹配的鲁棒性和跨域泛化能力。
