papers.title: Agentic AI-assisted coding offers a unique opportunity to instill epistemic grounding during software development
papers.abstract_en: The capabilities of AI-assisted coding are progressing at breakneck speed. Chat-based vibe coding has evolved into fully fledged AI-assisted, agentic software development using agent scaffolds where the human developer creates a plan that agentic AIs implement. One current trend is utilizing documents beyond this plan document, such as project and method-scoped documents. Here we propose GROUNDING.md, a community-governed, field-scoped epistemic grounding document, using mass spectrometry-based proteomics as an example. We have drafted a file specific to proteomics: proteomics_GROUNDING.md (available at https://github.com/OmicsGrounding/proteomics-grounding) to demonstrate what a GROUNDING.md would look like. This explicit field-scoped grounding document encodes Hard Constraints (non-negotiable validity invariants empirically required for scientific correctness) and Convention Parameters (community-agreed defaults) that override all other contexts to enforce validity, regardless of what the user prompts. In practice, this will empower a non-domain expert to generate code, tools, and software that have best practices baked in at the ground level, providing confidence to the software developer but also to those reviewing or using the final product. Undoubtedly it is easier to have agentic AIs adhere to guidelines than humans, and this opportunity allows for organizations to develop epistemic grounding documents in such a way as to keep domain experts in the loop in a future of democratized generation of bespoke software solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为GROUNDING.md的社区治理、领域范围的认知基础文档，用于AI辅助编码中确保科学正确性。以质谱蛋白质组学为例，该文档包含硬约束和惯例参数，覆盖用户提示的其他上下文，以强制执行有效性。作者认为这能使非领域专家生成内嵌最佳实践的代码。
Motivation: 当前AI辅助编码发展迅速，但缺乏系统性的领域知识约束，导致生成的软件可能违反科学正确性。本文旨在通过领域范围的认知基础文档（grounding document）来强制保证科学有效性。
Method: 提出GROUNDING.md，一种社区维护的领域级文档，包含硬约束（不可协商的正确性不变量）和惯例参数（社区同意的默认值），在开发过程中覆盖其他上下文，确保AI生成的代码符合领域最佳实践。
Result: 以质谱蛋白质组学为例，提供了示例文件proteomics_GROUNDING.md，并论证这种方法可以让非领域专家生成可靠的软件。
Conclusion: 本文认为利用agentic AI比人类更容易遵守指南，这种机会使组织能够以让领域专家参与的方式开发认知基础文档，从而在定制软件解决方案的民主化未来中保持领域专家的参与。

papers.title: AnchorRefine: Synergy-Manipulation Based on Trajectory Anchor and Residual Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Precision-critical manipulation requires both global trajectory organization and local execution correction, yet most vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate actions within a single unified space. This monolithic formulation forces macro-level transport and micro-level refinement to be optimized under the same objective, causing large motions to dominate learning while suppressing small but failure-critical corrective signals. In contrast, human manipulation is structured by global movement planning together with continuous local adjustment during execution. Motivated by this principle, we propose AnchorRefine, a hierarchical framework that factorizes VLA action modeling into trajectory anchor and residual refinement. The anchor planner predicts a coarse motion scaffold, while the refinement module corrects execution-level deviations to improve geometric and contact precision. We further introduce a decision-aware gripper refinement mechanism to better capture the discrete and boundary-sensitive nature of gripper control. Experiments on LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-robot tasks demonstrate that AnchorRefine consistently improves both regression-based and diffusion-based VLA backbones, yielding gains of up to 7.8% in simulation success rate and 18% in real-world success rate.
papers.comment: The authors have decided to withdraw this manuscript because the work requires substantial revision and further experimental validation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnchorRefine，一种将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的动作生成分解为轨迹锚点（trajectory anchor）和残差细化（residual refinement）的层次化框架。锚点规划器预测粗略运动骨架，细化模块修正执行级偏差以提升几何与接触精度，并引入决策感知的夹爪细化机制。在 LIBERO、CALVIN 和真实机器人任务上的实验表明，该方法在仿真成功率上提升高达 7.8%，在真实世界成功率上提升 18%。但作者已决定撤稿，称工作需大幅修改和进一步实验验证。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 策略在单一空间中生成动作，迫使宏观传输与微观细化在同一目标下优化，导致大运动主导学习而抑制小但关键的校正信号。人类操作则结合全局运动规划与连续局部调整，受此启发提出层次化分解。
Method: 提出 AnchorRefine 框架，将 VLA 动作建模分解为轨迹锚点规划（预测粗运动骨架）和残差细化（修正执行级偏差），并引入决策感知的夹爪细化机制以处理夹爪控制的离散与边界敏感性。可与基于回归和基于扩散的 VLA 骨干结合。
Result: 在 LIBERO、CALVIN 和真实机器人任务上，AnchorRefine 一致提升基线性能，仿真成功率提升 7.8%，真实世界成功率提升 18%。
Conclusion: 层次化分解动作空间能有效分离宏观规划与微观修正，提升精密操作任务的性能。但论文已撤稿，结论需谨慎对待。

papers.title: Why Do Vision Language Models Struggle To Recognize Human Emotions?
papers.abstract_en: Understanding emotions is a fundamental ability for intelligent systems to be able to interact with humans. Vision-language models (VLMs) have made tremendous progress in the last few years for many visual tasks, potentially offering a promising solution for understanding emotions. However, it is surprising that even the most sophisticated contemporary VLMs struggle to recognize human emotions or to outperform even specialized vision-only classifiers. In this paper we ask the question 'Why do VLMs struggle to recognize human emotions?', and observe that the inherently continuous and dynamic task of facial expression recognition (DFER) exposes two critical VLM vulnerabilities. First, emotion datasets are naturally long-tailed, and the web-scale data used to pre-train VLMs exacerbates this head-class bias, causing them to systematically collapse rare, under-represented emotions into common categories. We propose alternative sampling strategies that prevent favoring common concepts. Second, temporal information is critical for understanding emotions. However, VLMs are unable to represent temporal information over dense frame sequences, as they are limited by context size and the number of tokens that can fit in memory, which poses a clear challenge for emotion recognition. We demonstrate that the sparse temporal sampling strategy used in VLMs is inherently misaligned with the fleeting nature of micro-expressions (0.25-0.5 seconds), which are often the most critical affective signal. As a diagnostic probe, we propose a multi-stage context enrichment strategy that utilizes the information from 'in-between' frames by first converting them into natural language summaries. This enriched textual context is provided as input to the VLM alongside sparse keyframes, preventing attentional dilution from excessive visual data while preserving the emotional trajectory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究视觉语言模型（VLM）为何难以识别人类情感，指出两个关键弱点：情感数据集的长尾分布导致VLM偏向常见类别，以及VLM的稀疏时间采样策略无法捕捉微表情（0.25-0.5秒）的短暂情感信号。作者提出替代采样策略和多阶段上下文丰富策略，通过将中间帧转换为自然语言摘要来增强时间信息。
Motivation: 尽管VLM在众多视觉任务中表现出色，但在人类情感识别上甚至不如专门的纯视觉分类器，这一反直觉现象亟待解释。
Method: 通过分析动态面部表情识别（DFER）任务，诊断VLM的两个缺陷：头类偏差和时域信息不足。提出多阶段上下文丰富策略，将关键帧之间的帧转换为文本摘要作为额外输入，避免注意力稀释。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，但指出所提策略有助于缓解VLM在情感识别中的不足。
Conclusion: VLM在情感识别上的失败源于数据偏差和时域采样的错配，未来的VLM设计需考虑长尾分布和精细时间动态。

papers.title: Geometric Capacity of Transformers: A Tropical Geometry Perspective
papers.abstract_en: To quantify the geometric capacity of transformers, we develop a tropical-geometric framework for analyzing the spatial partitions induced by conditioned self-attention. In the zero-temperature limit, we show that fixed-key top-$1$ routing is exactly represented by a power diagram in query space, while an auxiliary log-lifted value parameterization yields a vector-valued tropical rational representation. For Multi-Head Self-Attention (MHSA) with sequence length $N$ and $H$ attention heads, the joint routing geometry is encoded by Minkowski sums of headwise Newton polytopes, giving an $\mathcal{O}(N^H)$ universal bound that sharpens to $\mathcal{O}((HN)^{d_{\mathrm{model}}-1})$ once the number of heads reaches the intrinsic dimension $d_{\mathrm{model}}$. Extending this analysis across depth $L$, we derive the first tight asymptotic bounds on the number of linear regions in transformers ($Θ\!\left(N^{\min\{H,d_{\mathrm{model}}-1\}L}\right)$). We further show that finite-temperature softmax preserves the top-$1$ routing structure and admits exponentially decaying local approximation and differential bounds away from routing boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从热带几何视角出发，研究Transformer的几何容量，分析了固定键top-1路由在零温极限下由查询空间的幂图表示，并推导了多头自注意力的联合路由几何由牛顿多面体的闵可夫斯基和编码，给出了线性区域数量的渐近界。
Motivation: 现有工作缺乏对Transformer空间划分（即几何容量）的理论刻画，本文旨在利用热带几何工具填补这一空白。
Method: 在零温极限下，将固定键top-1路由表示为查询空间中的幂图；引入辅助对数提升值参数化获得向量值热带有理表示；通过多头注意力中牛顿多面体的闵可夫斯基和推导联合路由几何；并扩展至深度L，得到线性区域数量的渐近界。
Result: 得到序列长度N、注意力头数H、模型维度d_model下的线性区域数量上界：通用界为O(N^H)，当H达到d_model-1时锐化为O((HN)^{d_model-1})；深度L下渐近界为Θ(N^{min{H,d_model-1}L})。
Conclusion: 本文为Transformer的几何容量提供了首个紧渐近界，并证明有限温度softmax保留top-1路由结构，具有指数衰减的局部近似和离开路由边界时的微分界。

summary_sections.method: 在零温极限下，将固定键top-1路由表示为查询空间中的幂图；引入辅助对数提升值参数化获得向量值热带有理表示；通过多头注意力中牛顿多面体的闵可夫斯基和推导联合路由几何；并扩展至深度L，得到线性区域数量的渐近界。
summary_sections.result: 得到序列长度N、注意力头数H、模型维度d_model下的线性区域数量上界：通用界为O(N^H)，当H达到d_model-1时锐化为O((HN)^{d_model-1})；深度L下渐近界为Θ(N^{min{H,d_model-1}L})。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文为Transformer的几何容量提供了首个紧渐近界，并证明有限温度softmax保留top-1路由结构，具有指数衰减的局部近似和离开路由边界时的微分界。

papers.title: CPGRec+: A Balance-oriented Framework for Personalized Video Game Recommendations
papers.abstract_en: The rapid expansion of gaming industry requires advanced recommender systems tailored to its dynamic landscape. Existing Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based methods primarily prioritize accuracy over diversity, overlooking their inherent trade-off. To address this, we previously proposed CPGRec, a balance-oriented gaming recommender system. However, CPGRec fails to account for critical disparities in player-game interactions, which carry varying significance in reflecting players' personal preferences and may exacerbate over-smoothness issues inherent in GNN-based models. Moreover, existing approaches underutilize the reasoning capabilities and extensive knowledge of large language models (LLMs) in addressing these limitations. To bridge this gap, we propose two new modules. First, Preference-informed Edge Reweighting (PER) module assigns signed edge weights to qualitatively distinguish significant player interests and disinterests while then quantitatively measuring preference strength to mitigate over-smoothing in graph convolutions. Second, Preference-informed Representation Generation (PRG) module leverages LLMs to generate contextualized descriptions of games and players by reasoning personal preferences from comparing global and personal interests, thereby refining representations of players and games. Experiments on \textcolor{black}{two Steam datasets} demonstrate CPGRec+'s superior accuracy and diversity over state-of-the-art models. The code is accessible at https://github.com/HsipingLi/CPGRec-Plus.
papers.comment: Published in ACM Transactions on Information Systems (TOIS). 43 pages, 9 figures
papers.journal_ref: ACM Trans. Inf. Syst. 44, 3, Article 66 (March 2026), 44 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CPGRec+，一个面向视频游戏推荐的平衡准确性与多样性的框架。在原有CPGRec基础上，新增偏好感知边重加权（PER）模块，通过符号边权重区分玩家兴趣与不兴趣并量化偏好强度以减少图卷积过平滑；以及偏好感知表示生成（PRG）模块，利用大语言模型推理玩家与游戏的个性化描述。在两个Steam数据集上的实验表明，CPGRec+在准确性和多样性上均优于现有模型。
Motivation: 现有基于GNN的游戏推荐方法主要优化准确性而忽视多样性，且未能处理玩家-游戏交互中不同重要性的差异，导致过平滑问题。同时，大语言模型的推理能力未被充分利用。
Method: 提出两个模块：PER模块为交互边分配符号权重以区分兴趣与不兴趣，并量化偏好强度；PRG模块利用LLM从全局与个人兴趣对比中生成游戏和玩家的上下文描述，从而优化表示。
Result: 在两个Steam数据集上，CPGRec+在准确性和多样性指标上均超过现有最先进模型。
Conclusion: 论文表明结合偏好感知的边重加权和LLM驱动的表示生成可有效平衡游戏推荐的准确性与多样性。

papers.title: JD-BP: A Joint-Decision Generative Framework for Auto-Bidding and Pricing
papers.abstract_en: Auto-bidding services optimize real-time bidding strategies for advertisers under key performance indicator (KPI) constraints such as target return on investment and budget. However, uncertainties such as model prediction errors and feedback latency can cause bidding strategies to deviate from ex-post optimality, leading to inefficient allocation. To address this issue, we propose JD-BP, a Joint generative Decision framework for Bidding and Pricing. Unlike prior methods, JD-BP jointly outputs a bid value and a pricing correction term that acts additively with the payment rule such as GSP. To mitigate adverse effects of historical constraint violations, we design a memory-less Return-to-Go that encourages future value maximizing of bidding actions while the cumulated bias is handled by the pricing correction. Moreover, a trajectory augmentation algorithm is proposed to generate joint bidding-pricing trajectories from a (possibly arbitrary) base bidding policy, enabling efficient plug-and-play deployment of our algorithm from existing RL/generative bidding models. Finally, we employ an Energy-Based Direct Preference Optimization method in conjunction with a cross-attention module to enhance the joint learning performance of bidding and pricing correction. Offline experiments on the AuctionNet dataset demonstrate that JD-BP achieves state-of-the-art performance. Online A/B tests at JD.com confirm its practical effectiveness, showing a 4.70% increase in ad revenue and a 6.48% improvement in target cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JD-BP，一个联合生成式决策框架，同时输出出价（bid）和定价修正项（pricing correction），以应对模型预测误差和反馈延迟导致的实时竞价策略偏离最优问题。框架包含无记忆的 Return-to-Go 机制、轨迹增强算法以及基于能量的直接偏好优化（Energy-Based Direct Preference Optimization）和交叉注意力模块。离线实验在 AuctionNet 数据集上达到最先进性能，京东在线 A/B 测试显示广告收入提升 4.70%，目标成本改善 6.48%。
Motivation: 现有自动出价服务在关键绩效指标约束下优化策略，但预测误差和反馈延迟等不确定性导致出价策略偏离事后最优，造成分配效率低下。
Method: 提出联合决策框架 JD-BP，同时输出出价值与定价修正项（与 GSP 等支付规则相加）；设计无记忆的 Return-to-Go 激励未来价值最大化，并通过定价修正处理累积偏差；提出轨迹增强算法，从任意基础出价策略生成联合出价-定价轨迹，实现即插即用；采用基于能量的直接偏好优化和交叉注意力模块增强联合学习性能。
Result: 离线实验在 AuctionNet 数据集上达到最先进性能；京东在线 A/B 测试显示广告收入提升 4.70%，目标成本改善 6.48%。
Conclusion: JD-BP 通过联合学习和修正机制有效提升自动出价与定价的联合优化效果，并在实际广告平台中验证了其有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semantic Richness or Geometric Reasoning? The Fragility of VLM's Visual Invariance
papers.abstract_en: This work investigates the fundamental fragility of state-of-the-art Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under basic geometric transformations. While modern VLMs excel at semantic tasks such as recognizing objects in canonical orientations and describing complex scenes, they exhibit systematic failures at a more fundamental level: lack of robust spatial invariance and equivariance required to reliably determine object identity under simple rotations, scaling, and identity transformations. We demonstrate this limitation through a systematic evaluation across diverse visual domains, including symbolic sketches, natural photographs, and abstract art. Performance drops sharply as semantic content becomes sparse, and this behavior is observed across architectures, model capacities, and prompting strategies. Overall, our results reveal a systematic gap between semantic understanding and spatial reasoning in current VLMs, highlighting the need for stronger geometric grounding in future multimodal systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了当前最先进的视觉语言模型（VLM）在基本几何变换（旋转、缩放、恒等变换）下的鲁棒性。发现VLMs在语义任务上表现优异，但缺乏可靠的空间不变性和等变性，尤其是在语义内容稀疏时性能急剧下降，这种脆弱性跨架构、模型大小和提示策略普遍存在。
Motivation: 当前VLM在语义理解上表现出色，但在基本的空间推理上存在系统性漏洞，尤其是在对象身份识别时对简单几何变换缺乏鲁棒性，这阻碍了多模态系统的可靠应用。
Method: 作者通过在符号草图、自然照片和抽象艺术等多种视觉域上进行系统评估，测试不同架构、模型容量和提示策略下VLM对旋转、缩放和恒等变换的响应。
Result: 性能随语义内容稀疏度增加而急剧下降，且该现象在所有测试的VLM架构中一致出现。
Conclusion: 揭示了当前VLM在语义理解与空间推理之间的系统性差距，强调未来多模态系统需要更强大的几何基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust Reasoning Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve high performance on standard mathematical benchmarks, their problem-solving abilities depend on the context and textual formatting. We introduce the Robust Reasoning Benchmark (RRB), a pipeline of 13 deterministic textual perturbations applied to AIME 2024 and AIME 2025. Evaluating 8 state-of-the-art models, we find that frontier models are largely resilient, with the notable exception of Claude, which categorically refuses many transformed prompts. Open-weights reasoning models exhibit a range of failure modes under structural noise (cognitive thrashing, tokenization breakdown, and reasoning collapse), with up to 54% average accuracy drops across perturbations and up to 100% on some. We further study one of these failure modes in isolation: attention dilution caused by the model's own chain-of-thought. By tasking models with solving multiple independent mathematical problems sequentially within a single context window, we identify Intra-Query Attention Dilution. Open-weights models ranging from 7B to 120B parameters exhibit accuracy decay on subsequent problems, suggesting that intermediate reasoning steps progressively pollute standard dense attention mechanisms. We argue that in order to achieve reliable reasoning, future architectures need to integrate explicit contextual resets within models' own chain-of-thought, leading to open research questions regarding the optimal granularity of reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出鲁棒推理基准（RRB），通过对AIME 2024/2025数学问题应用13种确定性文本扰动，评估8个前沿LLM的鲁棒性。发现大多数模型表现稳健，但Claude会拒绝许多变体，开源推理模型在结构噪声下出现多种失败模式（认知振荡、分词崩溃、推理崩溃），平均准确率下降高达54%，部分扰动下下降100%。进一步研究模型自身思维链引起的注意力稀释问题，发现多问题顺序推理时，开源自注意力模型（7B-120B参数）在后续问题上准确率下降，表明中间推理步骤污染了注意力机制。
Motivation: 现有LLM在标准数学基准上表现良好，但其问题解决能力依赖于上下文和文本格式，缺乏对输入扰动的鲁棒性评估。
Method: 构建RRB管道：对AIME 2024/2025题目应用13种确定性文本扰动（如换行、同义词替换等），并对多模型进行评估；此外设计实验分离注意力稀释问题——让模型在单上下文窗口内顺序解决多个独立数学问题。
Result: 前沿模型总体稳健，但Claude拒绝许多扰动输入；开源推理模型在结构噪声下平均准确率下降54%，某些扰动下降100%。多问题推理中，后续问题准确率随问题增多而下降，表明注意力机制被中间步骤污染。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，为了实现可靠推理，未来架构需在模型自身思维链中集成显式的上下文重置，并提出了关于推理任务最优粒度的开放性问题。

papers.title: Estimating near-verbatim extraction risk in language models with decoding-constrained beam search
papers.abstract_en: Recent work shows that standard greedy-decoding extraction methods for quantifying memorization in LLMs miss how extraction risk varies across sequences. Probabilistic extraction -- computing the probability of generating a target suffix given a prefix under a decoding scheme -- addresses this, but is tractable only for verbatim memorization, missing near-verbatim instances that pose similar privacy and copyright risks. Quantifying near-verbatim extraction risk is expensive: the set of near-verbatim suffixes is combinatorially large, and reliable Monte Carlo (MC) estimation can require ~100,000 samples per sequence. To mitigate this cost, we introduce decoding-constrained beam search, which yields deterministic lower bounds on near-verbatim extraction risk at a cost comparable to ~20 MC samples per sequence. Across experiments, our approach surfaces information invisible to verbatim methods: many more extractable sequences, substantially larger per-sequence extraction mass, and patterns in how near-verbatim extraction risk manifests across model sizes and types of text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型中近逐字（near-verbatim）提取风险的量化问题，指出标准贪婪解码提取方法无法捕捉序列间提取风险的变化，而概率提取方法虽可做到但仅适用于逐字记忆，且近逐字提取的蒙特卡洛估计成本高昂。作者提出解码约束波束搜索（decoding-constrained beam search），可在与约20个MC样本相当的成本下提供近逐字提取风险的确定性下界。实验表明该方法揭示了逐字方法无法发现的更多可提取序列和更大的提取质量。
Motivation: 现有方法在量化语言模型记忆时，标准贪婪解码提取方法忽略了提取风险在序列间的变化；概率提取方法仅适用于逐字记忆，无法处理近逐字实例，而近逐字提取的可靠估计需要大量样本，成本过高。
Method: 提出解码约束波束搜索（decoding-constrained beam search），以与约20个MC样本相当的计算成本，为近逐字提取风险提供确定性下界。
Result: 该方法能够发现逐字方法无法发现的更多可提取序列、更大的每序列提取质量，以及近逐字提取风险在不同模型规模和文本类型中的变化模式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法以较低成本提供了对近逐字提取风险的更全面量化，揭示了逐字方法遗漏的信息。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该方法以较低成本提供了对近逐字提取风险的更全面量化，揭示了逐字方法遗漏的信息。

papers.title: CLT-Forge: A Scalable Library for Cross-Layer Transcoders and Attribution Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability seeks to understand how Large Language Models (LLMs) represent and process information. Recent approaches based on dictionary learning and transcoders enable representing model computation in terms of sparse, interpretable features and their interactions, giving rise to feature attribution graphs. However, these graphs are often large and redundant, limiting their interpretability in practice. Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) address this issue by sharing features across layers while preserving layer-specific decoding, yielding more compact representations, but remain difficult to train and analyze at scale. We introduce an open-source library for end-to-end training and interpretability of CLTs. Our framework integrates scalable distributed training with model sharding and compressed activation caching, a unified automated interpretability pipeline for feature analysis and explanation, attribution graph computation using Circuit-Tracer, and a flexible visualization interface. This provides a practical and unified solution for scaling CLT-based mechanistic interpretability. Our code is available at: https://github.com/LLM-Interp/CLT-Forge.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Code: https://github.com/LLM-Interp/CLT-Forge. Demonstration video: https://youtu.be/6ptrrLawTl8

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个名为CLT-Forge的开源库，用于跨层转录器（CLT）的端到端训练和机械可解释性分析。该库集成了分布式训练、模型分片、压缩激活缓存、自动化可解释性流水线、基于Circuit-Tracer的归因图计算以及灵活的可视化界面，旨在解决CLT在大规模应用中训练和分析困难的问题。
Motivation: 跨层转录器（CLT）通过跨层共享特征并保留层特定解码，产生更紧凑的表示，但现有方法难以规模化训练和分析。
Method: 提出了一个统一的库，包含分布式训练框架（支持模型分片和压缩激活缓存）、自动化可解释性流水线（用于特征分析和解释）、归因图计算（使用Circuit-Tracer）以及可视化界面。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，但称该库为规模化CLT机械可解释性提供了实用且统一的解决方案。
Conclusion: CLT-Forge简化了CLT的训练和解释过程，有望推动基于CLT的机械可解释性研究。

papers.title: When Agents Disagree: The Selection Bottleneck in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM pipelines produce contradictory evidence on whether team diversity improves output quality: heterogeneous Mixture-of-Agents teams outperform single models, yet homogeneous Self-MoA teams consistently win under synthesis-based aggregation. We propose a resolution by identifying the selection bottleneck -- a crossover threshold in aggregation quality that determines whether diversity helps or hurts. Under this model, we obtain a closed-form crossover threshold $s^*$ (Proposition 1) that separates the regimes where diversity helps and hurts. In a targeted experiment spanning 42 tasks across 7 categories ($N=210$), a diverse team with judge-based selection achieves a win rate of 0.810 against a single-model baseline, while a homogeneous team scores 0.512 -- near chance (Glass's $Δ= 2.07$). Judge-based selection outperforms MoA-style synthesis by $Δ_{\mathrm{WR}} = +0.631$ -- the synthesis approach is preferred over the baseline in zero of 42 tasks by the judge panel. A decoupled evaluation with independent judges confirms all directional findings (Spearman $ρ= 0.90$). Exploratory evidence suggests that including a weaker model improves performance while reducing cost ($p < 10^{-4}$, not pre-registered). Our results suggest that selector quality may be a more impactful design lever than generator diversity in single-round generate-then-select pipelines.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文针对多智能体LLM管线中团队多样性是否提升输出质量的矛盾结论提出选择瓶颈（selection bottleneck）模型，识别出一个交叉阈值。实验表明，基于裁判选择的多样化团队胜率达0.810，而同质团队仅0.512（接近随机），裁判选择显著优于MoA风格合成。研究认为选择器质量比生成器多样性更具设计杠杆作用。
Motivation: 现有研究在团队多样性对输出质量的影响上存在矛盾：异构Mixture-of-Agents团队优于单一模型，但同构Self-MoA团队在合成聚合下持续获胜。论文旨在解释这一矛盾并给出关键因素。
Method: 提出选择瓶颈模型，推导出交叉阈值的封闭形式（命题1）；通过42个任务（7大类，N=210）的对照实验，比较多样化团队与同质团队在裁判选择与MoA合成两种聚合方式下的表现。
Result: 多样化团队（裁判选择）胜率0.810，同质团队0.512（Glass's Δ=2.07）；裁判选择相比MoA合成胜率提升+0.631，且在42个任务中MoA合成无一次优于基准；独立裁判验证确认所有方向性发现（Spearman ρ=0.90）。
Conclusion: 在单轮生成-选择管线中，选择器质量可能是比生成器多样性更关键的设计维度。

papers.title: PlotTwist: A Creative Plot Generation Framework with Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Creative plot generation presents a fundamental challenge for language models: transforming a concise premise into a coherent narrative that sustains global coherence, character development, pacing, tone consistency, and emotional progression. Although recent Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong fluency on general-purpose tasks, they require preference alignment to perform well on domain-specific tasks such as creative plot generation. However, conducting such alignment at the scale of frontier LLMs is computationally prohibitive, significantly limiting accessibility and practical deployment. To address this, we present PlotTwist, a structured framework that enables Small Language Models (SLMs) with $\leq$3B active parameters to generate high-quality, premise-conditioned plots competitive with frontier systems of vastly greater parameter scale. Our approach decomposes generation into three specialized components: (1) an Aspect Rating Reward Model, trained via a novel Positive-Negative prompting strategy; (2) a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) plot generator aligned via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO); and (3) an Agentic Evaluation module using a cross-family jury for unbiased, independent post-hoc assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PlotTwist consistently outperforms all baselines, including frontier models, across multiple Narrative Quality Dimensions (NQDs), achieving higher win rates against every baseline except the strongest, with which it remains competitive. Further validation confirms strong sensitivity to narrative quality, as the framework reliably distinguishes plots derived from critically acclaimed versus widely panned screenplays. Together, these results establish structured, preference-based alignment as a resource-efficient approach to high-quality creative plot generation. Project page: https://abhinavthorat.github.io/plottwist/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PlotTwist 框架，利用 ≤3B 参数的小语言模型进行创意情节生成。框架将生成过程分解为三个专门组件：方面评分奖励模型（通过正负提示策略训练）、混合专家（MoE）情节生成器（通过直接偏好优化对齐）以及跨族陪审团评估模块。实验表明，PlotTwist 在多个叙事质量维度上始终优于包括前沿模型在内的所有基线，与最强基线保持竞争力。该工作表明结构化的偏好对齐是一种资源高效的创意情节生成方法。
Motivation: 大语言模型在创意情节生成等特定任务上需要偏好对齐，但在前沿模型规模下进行对齐计算成本过高，限制了可访问性和实际部署。
Method: 提出三个组件：(1) 通过正负提示策略训练的方面评分奖励模型；(2) 通过直接偏好优化（DPO）对齐的混合专家（MoE）情节生成器；(3) 使用跨族陪审团进行无偏事后评估的智能评估模块。
Result: PlotTwist 在多个 Narrative Quality Dimensions (NQDs) 上始终优于所有基线（包括前沿模型），除最强基线外均取得更高胜率，并可靠区分来自好评与差评剧本的情节。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过结构化、基于偏好对齐的方法，小语言模型能够以资源高效的方式生成高质量创意情节，媲美甚至超越大参数规模的前沿系统。

papers.title: TransDex: Pre-training Visuo-Tactile Policy with Point Cloud Reconstruction for Dexterous Manipulation of Transparent Objects
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous manipulation enables complex tasks but suffers from self-occlusion, severe depth noise, and depth information loss when manipulating transparent objects. To solve this problem, this paper proposes TransDex, a 3D visuo-tactile fusion motor policy based on point cloud reconstruction pre-training. Specifically, we first propose a self-supervised point cloud reconstruction pre-training approach based on Transformer. This method accurately recovers the 3D structure of objects from interactive point clouds of dexterous hands, even when random noise and large-scale masking are added. Building on this, TransDex is constructed in which perceptual encoding adopts a fine-grained hierarchical scheme and multi-round attention mechanisms adaptively fuse features of the robotic arm and dexterous hand to enable differentiated motion prediction. Results from transparent object manipulation experiments conducted on a real robotic system demonstrate that TransDex outperforms existing baseline methods. Further analysis validates the generalization capabilities of TransDex and the effectiveness of its individual components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对灵巧操作中透明物体自遮挡和深度噪声问题，提出 TransDex，一种基于三维视觉-触觉融合的电机策略，采用自监督点云重建预训练。该方法利用 Transformer 从交互点云中恢复物体三维结构，并设计细粒度层级感知编码和多轮注意力机制融合机械臂与灵巧手特征。在真实机器人系统上的透明物体操作实验表明，TransDex 优于现有基线方法。
Motivation: 透明物体的灵巧操作面临自遮挡、深度噪声严重和深度信息丢失等挑战，现有方法难以有效处理。
Method: 提出自监督点云重建预训练方法，基于 Transformer 从带有随机噪声和大规模掩蔽的交互点云中恢复物体三维结构；构建 TransDex 策略，采用细粒度层级感知编码和多轮注意力机制自适应融合机械臂和灵巧手特征，实现差异化运动预测。
Result: 在真实机器人系统上的透明物体操作实验中，TransDex 优于现有基线方法，并验证了其泛化能力和各组件有效性。
Conclusion: 所提出的基于点云重建预训练的视觉-触觉融合策略能有效解决透明物体灵巧操作中的感知困难，具有良好泛化性。

papers.title: SWE-Milestone: Evaluating AI Agents on Continuous Software Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Real-world software must continuously evolve to meet ever-changing and open-ended requirements. AI agents, increasingly deployed as long-running systems, are now entrusted to drive this evolution. Yet, existing benchmarks evaluate agents on isolated, one-off coding tasks, neglecting the temporal dependencies and technical debt inherent in real-world software evolution. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepCommit, an agentic pipeline that reconstructs verifiable Milestone DAGs from noisy commit logs, where milestones are defined as functionally cohesive development goals. These executable sequences enable SWE-Milestone, a benchmark that evaluates agents on streams of milestone-level tasks, requiring them to sustain system integrity and limit error accumulation, dimensions of long-term software evolution largely missing from current benchmarks. Our evaluation of 12 frontier models across 4 agent frameworks reveals a critical vulnerability: overall performance scores drop significantly from >80% on isolated tasks to 38.03% in continuous settings, exposing agents' profound struggle with long-term maintenance and error propagation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SWE-Milestone 基准，通过 DeepCommit 流水线从提交日志重建里程碑 DAG，评估 AI agent 在连续软件演化任务上的表现。实验表明，在孤立任务上性能超过 80% 的模型，在连续设置中仅达 38.03%，揭示 agent 在长期维护和错误传播方面的严重不足。
Motivation: 现有基准仅评估 agent 在孤立的一次性编码任务上的表现，忽略了真实软件演化中的时间依赖和技术债务。
Method: 提出 DeepCommit 流水线，从嘈杂的提交日志中重建可验证的里程碑 DAG，并构建 SWE-Milestone 基准，要求 agent 处理连续的里程碑级任务。
Result: 在 12 个前沿模型和 4 个 agent 框架上的评估显示，连续设置下整体性能从孤立任务的 >80% 骤降至 38.03%。
Conclusion: 当前 AI agent 在长期软件维护和错误传播管理方面存在根本性缺陷，需要新的评估方法和设计改进。

papers.title: Information Theoretic Bayesian Optimization over the Probability Simplex
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization is a data-efficient technique that has been shown to be extremely powerful to optimize expensive, black-box, and possibly noisy objective functions. Many applications involve optimizing probabilities and mixtures which naturally belong to the probability simplex, a constrained non-Euclidean domain defined by non-negative entries summing to one. This paper introduces $α$-GaBO, a novel family of Bayesian optimization algorithms over the probability simplex. Our approach is grounded in information geometry, a branch of Riemannian geometry which endows the simplex with a Riemannian metric and a class of connections. Based on information geometry theory, we construct Matérn kernels that reflect the geometry of the probability simplex, as well as a one-parameter family of geometric optimizers for the acquisition function. We validate our method on benchmark functions and on a variety of real-world applications including mixtures of components, mixtures of classifiers, and a robotic control task, showing its increased performance compared to constrained Euclidean approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出α-GaBO，一种在概率单纯形上进行贝叶斯优化的新方法。该方法基于信息几何构建Matérn核和采集函数的几何优化器，在基准函数和实际应用（混合物、分类器组合、机器人控制）上优于欧几里得约束方法。
Motivation: 许多优化问题涉及属于概率单纯形的变量（如概率和混合），传统欧几里得方法忽略了其非欧几何结构，导致低效。
Method: 利用信息几何理论，在单纯形上定义黎曼度量，构造反映几何的Matérn核，并设计一簇几何优化器用于采集函数优化。
Result: 在基准函数和实际应用（包括混合物、分类器组合及机器人控制任务）中，所提方法相比约束欧几里得方法性能提升。
Conclusion: α-GaBO通过几何感知的贝叶斯优化有效处理概率单纯形上的优化问题。

papers.title: Give Them an Inch and They Will Take a Mile:Understanding and Measuring Caller Identity Confusion in MCP-Based AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open and standardized interface that enables large language models (LLMs) to interact with external tools and services, and is increasingly adopted by AI agents. However, the security of MCP-based systems remains largely unexplored.In this work, we conduct a large-scale security analysis of MCP servers integrated within MCP clients. We show that treating MCP servers as trusted entities without authenticating the caller identity is fundamentally insecure. Since MCP servers often cannot distinguish who is invoking a request, a single authorization decision may implicitly grant access to multiple, potentially untrusted callers.Our empirical study reveals that most MCP servers rely on persistent authorization states, allowing tool invocations after an initial authorization without re-authentication, regardless of the caller. In addition, many MCP servers fail to enforce authentication at the per-tool level, enabling unauthorized access to sensitive operations.These findings demonstrate that one-time authorization and server-level trust significantly expand the attack surface of MCP-based systems, highlighting the need for explicit caller authentication and fine-grained authorization mechanisms.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对模型上下文协议（MCP）系统中的调用者身份混淆问题进行了大规模安全分析，发现大多数MCP服务器依赖持久授权状态，缺乏每次工具调用的重认证，导致攻击面扩大。
Motivation: MCP被AI代理广泛采用，但安全性研究不足。服务器通常将调用者视为可信实体，不进行身份验证，存在安全隐患。
Method: 对集成在MCP客户端中的MCP服务器进行大规模安全分析，研究授权状态和工具级认证的缺失。
Result: 发现大多数MCP服务器依赖持久授权状态，允许初始授权后的任意调用者进行工具调用，且缺乏每工具认证，导致敏感操作可被未授权访问。
Conclusion: 需要显式的调用者认证和细粒度授权机制来增强MCP系统的安全性。

papers.title: Animating Petascale Time-varying Data on Commodity Hardware with LLM-assisted Scripting
papers.abstract_en: Scientists face significant visualization challenges as time-varying datasets grow in speed and volume, often requiring specialized infrastructure and expertise to handle massive datasets. Petascale climate models generated in NASA laboratories require a dedicated group of graphics and media experts and access to high-performance computing resources. Scientists may need to share scientific results with the community iteratively and quickly. However, the time-consuming trial-and-error process incurs significant data transfer overhead and far exceeds the time and resources allocated for typical post-analysis visualization tasks, disrupting the production workflow. Our paper introduces a user-friendly framework for creating 3D animations of petascale, time-varying data on a commodity workstation. Our contributions: (i) Generalized Animation Descriptor (GAD) with a keyframe-based adaptable abstraction for animation, (ii) efficient data access from cloud-hosted repositories to reduce data management overhead, (iii) tailored rendering system, and (iv) an LLM-assisted conversational interface as a scripting module to allow domain scientists with no visualization expertise to create animations of their region of interest. We demonstrate the framework's effectiveness with two case studies: first, by generating animations in which sampling criteria are specified based on prior knowledge, and second, by generating AI-assisted animations in which sampling parameters are derived from natural-language user prompts. In all cases, we use large-scale NASA climate-oceanographic datasets that exceed 1PB in size yet achieve a fast turnaround time of 1 minute to 2 hours. Users can generate a rough draft of the animation within minutes, then seamlessly incorporate as much high-resolution data as needed for the final version.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用户友好的框架，用于在普通工作站上创建petascale时间变化数据的3D动画。框架包括通用动画描述器（GAD）、高效数据访问、定制渲染系统和LLM辅助脚本接口。通过在超过1PB的NASA气候-海洋数据集上进行案例验证，动画生成时间从1分钟到2小时。
Motivation: 科学家在处理超大规模时间变化数据（如petascale气候模型）时面临可视化挑战，传统方法需要专门基础设施和专家，且耗时、资源密集，影响生产工作流。
Method: 提出包含四个组件的框架：基于关键帧的通用动画描述器（GAD）、从云托管仓库高效访问数据、定制渲染系统、以及利用LLM的对话式脚本模块，使无可视化经验的领域科学家也能创建动画。
Result: 在超过1PB的NASA气候-海洋数据集上，动画生成时间从1分钟到2小时，用户可快速生成草稿并逐步加入高分辨率数据。
Conclusion: 框架在普通硬件上实现了petascale时间变化数据的快速动画生成，降低了可视化门槛。

papers.title: LLM-Grounded Explainable AI for Supply Chain Risk Early Warning via Temporal Graph Attention Networks
papers.abstract_en: Disruptions at critical logistics nodes pose severe risks to global supply chains, yet existing risk prediction systems typically prioritize forecasting accuracy without providing operationally interpretable early warnings. This paper proposes an evidence-grounded framework that jointly performs supply chain bottleneck prediction and faithful natural-language risk explanation by coupling a Temporal Graph Attention Network (TGAT) with a structured large language model (LLM) reasoning module. Using maritime hubs as a representative case study for global supply chain nodes, daily spatial graphs are constructed from Automatic Identification System (AIS) broadcasts, where inter-node interactions are modeled through attention-based message passing. The TGAT predictor captures spatiotemporal risk dynamics, while model-internal evidence -- including feature z-scores and attention-derived neighbor influence -- is transformed into structured prompts that constrain LLM reasoning to verifiable model outputs. To evaluate explanatory reliability, we introduce a directional-consistency validation protocol that quantitatively measures agreement between generated risk narratives and underlying statistical evidence. Experiments on six months of real-world logistics data demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms baseline models, achieving a test AUC of 0.761, AP of 0.344, and recall of 0.504 under a strict chronological split while producing early warning explanations with 99.6\% directional consistency. Results show that grounding LLM generation in graph-model evidence enables interpretable and auditable risk reporting without sacrificing predictive performance. The framework provides a practical pathway toward operationally deployable explainable AI for supply chain risk early warning and resilience management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对供应链风险预警中可解释性不足的问题，提出一种将时序图注意力网络（TGAT）与结构化大语言模型（LLM）推理模块结合的框架，在预测瓶颈的同时生成基于证据的自然语言解释。基于全球航运枢纽的AIS数据构建空间图，通过TGAT捕捉时空风险动态，并将模型内部证据转化为结构化提示约束LLM推理。实验表明，该方法在真实物流数据上达到AUC 0.761、AP 0.344、召回率0.504，且解释的方向一致性达99.6%。
Motivation: 现有供应链风险预测系统侧重预测精度，缺乏可操作的可解释早期预警，导致决策者难以信任和运用模型输出。
Method: 提出证据驱动框架，耦合TGAT预测器与结构化LLM推理模块：TGAT通过注意力机制对AIS数据构建的时空图进行消息传递；模型内部证据（如特征z分数、注意力邻居影响）转化为结构化提示，约束LLM生成与统计证据一致的文本解释。
Result: 在六个月真实物流数据上，严格时间划分下测试AUC为0.761，AP为0.344，召回率为0.504；生成的早期预警解释方向一致性达99.6%。
Conclusion: 将LLM生成过程锚定于图模型证据，可在不牺牲预测性能的前提下实现可审计的风险报告，为供应链风险预警的可部署可解释AI提供了可行路径。

papers.title: When Visual Evidence is Ambiguous: Pareidolia as a Diagnostic Probe for Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: When visual evidence is ambiguous, vision models must decide how to interpret face-like patterns. Face pareidolia, the perception of faces in non-face objects, provides a controlled probe of such decisions. We introduce a diagnostic framework that analyzes detection, localization, uncertainty and bias across class, difficulty and emotion. We evaluate six models spanning four representational regimes: vision-language models (VLMs; CLIP-B/32, CLIP-L/14, LLaVA-1.5-7B), pure vision classification (ViT), object detection (YOLOv8), and face detection (RetinaFace). Our results reveal that uncertainty and bias are decoupled: low uncertainty can signal either safe suppression, as in detectors, or extreme over-interpretation, as in VLMs. VLMs exhibit semantic overactivation, systematically interpreting ambiguous non-human regions as Human, with LLaVA over-calling on 73% of non-human pareidolic images, especially for negative emotions. ViT instead follows an uncertainty-as-abstention strategy, remaining diffuse yet largely unbiased. Detection-based models achieve low bias through conservative priors that suppress pareidolia responses even when localization is controlled. Together, these results show that behavior under ambiguity is governed more by representation than thresholds, establishing face pareidolia as a diagnostic of semantic robustness and a source of ambiguity-aware hard negatives for vision models. Code will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用空想性错视（face pareidolia）作为诊断探针，系统评估视觉模型在模糊视觉证据下的行为。研究覆盖视觉语言模型（CLIP、LLaVA）、纯视觉分类（ViT）、目标检测（YOLOv8）和人脸检测（RetinaFace）四种表征范式，分析检测、定位、不确定性和偏差。结果表明不确定性与偏差解耦：低不确定性既可表示安全抑制（检测器），也可表示极端过度解读（VLM）；VLM对非人区域系统性地过度激活人脸，ViT采用不确定性即放弃策略，检测模型通过保守先验保持低偏差。最终建立空想性错视作为语义鲁棒性诊断工具和硬负样本来源。
Motivation: 视觉模型在模糊证据下如何解释类人脸图案？空想性错视提供可控探针，需系统分析模型在检测、定位、不确定性和偏差方面的行为差异。
Method: 引入诊断框架，分析六种模型（CLIP-B/32、CLIP-L/14、LLaVA-1.5-7B、ViT、YOLOv8、RetinaFace）在空想性错视图像上的检测、定位、不确定性和偏差，跨越类别、难度和情绪维度。
Result: VLM（尤其是LLaVA）对73%的非人空想性图像过度调用人脸，尤其负面情绪；ViT保持扩散但低偏差；检测模型通过保守先验实现低偏差。不确定性与偏差解耦。
Conclusion: 模糊下的行为主要由表征而非阈值决定；空想性错视可作为语义鲁棒性诊断和硬负样本来源。

papers.title: Discrete Diffusion with Sample-Efficient Estimators for Conditionals
papers.abstract_en: We study a discrete denoising diffusion framework that integrates a sample-efficient estimator of single-site conditionals with round-robin noising and denoising dynamics for generative modeling over discrete state spaces. Rather than approximating a discrete analog of a score function, our formulation treats single-site conditional probabilities as the fundamental objects that parameterize the reverse diffusion process. We employ a sample-efficient method known as Neural Interaction Screening Estimator (NeurISE) to estimate these conditionals in the diffusion dynamics. Controlled experiments on synthetic Ising models, MNIST, and scientific data sets produced by a D-Wave quantum annealer, synthetic Potts model and one dimensional quantum systems demonstrate the proposed approach. On the binary data sets, these experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms popular existing methods including ratio-based approaches, achieving improved performance in total variation, cross-correlations, and kernel density estimation metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种离散去噪扩散框架，使用样本高效的NeurISE估计器直接建模单站点条件概率，以替代评分函数近似。在合成Ising模型、MNIST、D-Wave量子退火器数据等二元数据集上，该方法在总变差、互相关和核密度估计指标上优于比率法等现有方法。
Motivation: 现有离散扩散方法通常近似离散评分函数，但可能效率低或精度不足。本文直接估计单站点条件概率，利用轮询去噪动态提升生成性能。
Method: 采用NeurISE（神经交互筛选估计器）作为单站点条件概率的样本高效估计器，并在轮询去噪动态中集成，替代传统的评分函数近似。
Result: 在合成Ising模型、MNIST、D-Wave量子退火器数据、Potts模型和一维量子系统上，该方法在二元数据集的总变差、互相关和核密度估计指标上均优于比率法等流行方法。
Conclusion: 所提框架在二元离散数据生成上表现优越，但限于单元条件概率估计框架，未来可扩展到更高阶交互。

papers.title: Brewing Stronger Features: Dual-Teacher Distillation for Multispectral Earth Observation
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are transforming Earth Observation (EO), yet the diversity of EO sensors and modalities makes a single universal model unrealistic. Multiple specialized EO foundation models (EOFMs) will likely coexist, making efficient knowledge transfer across modalities essential. Most existing EO pretraining relies on masked image modeling, which emphasizes local reconstruction but provides limited control over global semantic structure. To address this, we propose a dual-teacher contrastive distillation framework for multispectral imagery that aligns the student's pretraining objective with the contrastive self-distillation paradigm of modern optical vision foundation models (VFMs). Our approach combines a multispectral teacher with an optical VFM teacher, enabling coherent cross-modal representation learning. Experiments across diverse optical and multispectral benchmarks show that our model adapts to multispectral data without compromising performance on optical-only inputs, achieving state-of-the-art results in both settings, with an average improvement of 3.64 percentage points in semantic segmentation, 1.2 in change detection, and 1.31 in classification tasks. This demonstrates that contrastive distillation provides a principled and efficient approach to scalable representation learning across heterogeneous EO data sources. Project page: \textcolor{magenta}{https://wolfilip.github.io/DEO/}.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种双教师对比蒸馏框架，用于多光谱地球观测（EO）基础模型训练。该方法结合多光谱教师和光学视觉基础模型（VFM）教师，通过对比自蒸馏对齐学生模型的预训练目标，在多光谱和光学基准上均取得最优结果，语义分割提升3.64个百分点，变化检测提升1.2，分类提升1.31。摘要强调对比蒸馏为异构EO数据的可扩展表征学习提供了高效途径。
Motivation: 现有EO预训练主要依赖掩码图像建模，侧重局部重建但缺乏对全局语义结构的控制；同时，多传感器和多模态的多样性使得单一通用模型不现实，亟需高效的跨模态知识迁移方法。
Method: 提出双教师对比蒸馏框架：一个多光谱教师网络和一个光学VFM教师网络同时指导学生模型，利用对比自蒸馏（contrastive self-distillation）范式对齐表示，实现跨模态表征学习。
Result: 在多光谱和光学基准上均达到最优：语义分割提升3.64个百分点，变化检测提升1.2个百分点，分类提升1.31个百分点，且多光谱性能不牺牲光学输入上的表现。
Conclusion: 对比蒸馏为异构EO数据源的规模化表征学习提供了原则性且高效的方案，未来可扩展到更多传感器和模态。

papers.title: Toward Manifest Relationality in Transformers via Symmetry Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Transformer models contain substantial internal redundancy arising from coordinate-dependent representations and continuous symmetries, in model space and in head space, respectively. While recent approaches address this by explicitly breaking symmetry, we propose a complementary framework based on symmetry reduction. We reformulate representations, attention mechanisms, and optimization dynamics in terms of invariant relational quantities, eliminating redundant degrees of freedom by construction. This perspective yields architectures that operate directly on relational structures, providing a principled geometric framework for reducing parameter redundancy and analyzing optimization.
papers.comment: V2, 14 pages, 2 columns, Accepted for publication in APS Open Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Transformer模型中由坐标相关表示和连续对称性引起的内部冗余问题，提出基于对称性约化（symmetry reduction）的互补框架。该框架将表示、注意力机制和优化动力学重新表述为不变关系量，从根本上消除冗余自由度，从而产生直接操作于关系结构的架构，为减少参数冗余和分析优化提供几何基础。
Motivation: Transformer模型存在大量由坐标相关表示和连续对称性导致的内部冗余，现有方法通过显式打破对称性来解决，但缺乏系统性的几何框架。
Method: 提出对称性约化框架，将Transformer的表示、注意力机制和优化重新表述为不变关系量，通过构造消除冗余自由度，使架构直接基于关系结构运行。
Result: 该方法提供了减少参数冗余和简化优化分析的几何框架，但摘要未报告具体数值实验结果。
Conclusion: 该框架为理解Transformer的对称性与冗余提供了互补视角，可推动更高效、更几何化的架构设计，但目前仅停留在理论层面。

papers.title: CompilerKV: Risk-Adaptive KV Compression via Offline Experience Compilation
papers.abstract_en: Prefill-only KV compression freezes a token subset at the end of prefill and decodes from it without further eviction. The retention decision is therefore irreversible, yet existing methods estimate the corrective signals it relies on, per-head reliability and prompt-level compression sensitivity, online from a single noisy prompt. We argue this is the wrong statistical unit: these signals exhibit far higher cross-prompt regularity than within-prompt signal-to-noise. We introduce \textsc{CompilerKV}, a KV-retention policy whose corrective tables are compiled offline from a calibration corpus, reducing online correction after the standard observation-window scan to $O(1)$ lookups plus a budget clamp. We find that compiled retention tables behave as portable architectural priors: rankings transfer across disjoint corpora on four backbones (mean Spearman $\barρ{=}0.90$), and direct model-to-model table transfer costs only $0.4$--$0.8$ LongBench points on average. At a 512-token budget, \textsc{CompilerKV} attains compressed-SOTA on all four backbones, improving over the strongest prefill-only baseline by $+1.67$ points on average (task-bootstrap 95\% CI $[+1.08,+2.37]$). Pressure regimes amplify the gap: under a fixed $512/32k$ cache ratio, CompilerKV remains the strongest compressed method through 128k RULER ($\sim\!73$ vs.\ FullKV $\sim\!79$, SnapKV $\sim\!38$); on 32k NIAH it reaches $0.89$ vs.\ SnapKV $0.42$; and at 32k input, retaining only $1.56\%$ of the prefill KV, batch-16 serving remains feasible where FullKV is OOM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CompilerKV，一种用于大语言模型预填充阶段 KV 缓存压缩的策略。该策略通过离线编译校准语料库得到修正表，从而在推理时仅需 O(1) 查找和预算裁剪，避免了在线估计。实验表明，该策略在多个 backbone 和长上下文基准上达到了压缩 SOTA，且修正表具有良好的跨模型可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有预填充 KV 压缩方法需要在线从单个有噪声的 prompt 中估计每个头的可靠性和 prompt 级压缩敏感性，这些信号实际上具有更高的跨 prompt 规律性而不是 prompt 内部信噪比，因此在线估计是低效的。
Method: 从校准语料库离线编译 KV 保留策略的修正表，每个 token 的保留决策基于离线计算的优先级，在线阶段仅需在标准观测窗口扫描后进行 O(1) 查找和预算约束裁剪。
Result: 在 512 token 预算下，CompilerKV 在所有四个 backbone 上达到压缩 SOTA，平均比最强预填充基线高 1.67 分（95% CI [1.08, 2.37]）；在 128k RULER 和 32k NIAH 上表现优于 SnapKV；在仅保留 1.56% KV 时仍可行。
Conclusion: 离线编译的保留表可作为可移植的架构先验，跨不同语料库的排序转移平均 Spearman 相关系数为 0.90，模型间直接转移仅损失 0.4-0.8 LongBench 点。该方法在极端压缩率下仍保持有效性。

papers.title: LinguistAgent Technical Report: A Reflective Multi-Model Platform for Automated Linguistic Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Data annotation remains a significant bottleneck in the field of humanities and social sciences, particularly for complex linguistic tasks such as metaphor identification. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise, a significant gap remains between the theoretical capability of LLMs and their practical utility for researchers. This paper introduces LinguistAgent, an integrated, user-friendly platform that leverages a reflective multi-model architecture to automate linguistic annotation. The platform comprises an Annotator and an optional Reviewer to simulate a peer-review process. This platform supports comparative experiments across three main paradigms: Prompt Engineering (Zero-shot/Few-shot/Chain-of-thought), Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and Fine-tuning. We demonstrate LinguistAgent's efficacy by replicating the task of metaphor identification from a published study, which provides real-time token-level evaluation (F1 and Cohen's kappa) against human gold standards. The application and codes are released on https://github.com/Bingru-Li/LinguistAgent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 LinguistAgent，一个面向语言学标注的集成平台，采用反思性多模型架构，支持提示工程、检索增强生成和微调三种范式。通过复现一项已发表的隐喻识别任务，平台在 token 级别上评估 F1 和 Cohen's kappa。
Motivation: 人文社科领域的数据标注，尤其是复杂语言学任务（如隐喻识别），存在显著瓶颈。尽管大语言模型有潜力，但其理论能力与研究人员实际应用之间仍有差距。
Method: LinguistAgent 平台由标注器和可选的评审器组成，模拟同行评审过程。支持三种范式：提示工程（零样本/少样本/思维链）、检索增强生成和微调。
Result: 通过复现隐喻识别任务，平台提供实时的 token 级别评估，包括 F1 和 Cohen's kappa，与人工黄金标准进行比较。
Conclusion: LinguistAgent 是一个易用的集成平台，旨在缩小 LLMs 在语言学标注中的理论能力与实际应用之间的差距。

papers.title: Fluid Reasoning Representations
papers.abstract_en: Frontier large language models increasingly solve complex tasks involving abstract concepts through extended test-time thinking. Yet we lack a mechanistic account of how extended thinking changes hidden-state representations over the course of a reasoning trace. We introduce \textit{Fluid Reasoning Representations} (FRRs), a representation-level account of how LLMs organize action and predicate concepts during self-generated reasoning, and test them on obfuscated planning, symbolic, and mathematical tasks where task-relevant words are replaced while problem structure is preserved. Across open-weight base, instruction-tuned, and extended-thinking LLMs, representations of the same action or predicate become more similar across wordings and move toward the corresponding unobfuscated concepts over the reasoning trace. Causal probes show that these representations affect behavior: cross-naming steering improves held-out accuracy beyond Gaussian and shuffled controls, symbolic patching retains more action information than shuffled patching, and subtracting refined directions degrades accuracy; together, these results suggest that extended thinking strengthens a representation dynamic already present at lower magnitude in base and instruction-tuned LLMs. Our codebase is open-sourced \href{https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Fluid-Reasoning-Representation}{here}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出流体推理表示（FRRs），一种从表示层面解释LLM在自生成推理过程中如何组织行动和谓词概念的方法，并在混淆规划、符号和数学任务上测试，其中任务相关单词被替换但问题结构保留。实验发现，在开放权重的基座、指令微调和扩展思考LLM中，相同动作或谓词的表示在不同措辞下变得更相似，并向对应的未混淆概念移动。因果探针表明这些表示影响行为：交叉命名操控提升保留准确率，符号修补保留更多动作信息，减去精炼方向降低准确率，表明扩展思考强化了基座和指令微调LLM中已经存在的表示动态。
Motivation: 缺乏对扩展思考如何改变推理轨迹中隐藏状态表示的机制性解释。
Method: 提出FRRs，一种表示层面的分析方法，在混淆任务上评估不同LLM系列（基座、指令微调、扩展思考）的推理表示动态，并使用因果探针（交叉命名操控、符号修补、方向减法）验证表示与行为的因果关系。
Result: 实验显示，在混淆任务上，扩展思考LLM中相同概念的不同措辞表示更相似且向未混淆概念移动；因果探针表明这些表示影响行为：交叉命名操控提升准确率，符号修补保留动作信息，减法降低准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调扩展思考强化了基座和指令微调LLM中已经存在的表示动态，但未详细说明方法本身的局限性或适用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Training and Simulation of Quadrupedal Robot in Adaptive Stair Climbing and Descending for Indoor Firefighting: An End-to-End Reinforcement Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Quadruped robots are used for primary searches during the early stages of indoor fires. A typical primary search involves quickly and thoroughly looking for victims under hazardous conditions and monitoring flammable materials. However, situational awareness in complex indoor environments and rapid stair climbing and descending across different staircases remain the main challenges for robot-assisted primary searches. In this project, we designed a two-stage end-to-end deep reinforcement learning (RL) approach to optimize both navigation and locomotion. In the first stage, the quadrupeds, Unitree Go2, were trained to climb and descend stairs in Isaac Lab's pyramid-stair terrain. In the second stage, the quadrupeds were trained to climb and descend various realistic indoor staircases in the Isaac Lab engine, with the learned policy transferred from the previous stage. These indoor staircases are straight, L-shaped, and spiral, to support climbing and descending tasks in complex environments. This project explores how to balance navigation and locomotion and how end-to-end RL methods can enable quadrupeds to adapt to different stair shapes. Our main contributions are: (1) A two-stage end-to-end RL framework that transfers climbing/descending skills from abstract pyramid terrain to realistic indoor stair topologies. (2) A centerline-based navigation formulation that enables unified learning of navigation and locomotion without hierarchical planning. (3) Demonstration of policy generalization across diverse staircases using only local height-map perception. (4) An empirical analysis of success, efficiency, and failure modes under increasing stair difficulty.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, 43rd International Symposium on Automation and Robotics in Construction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段端到端深度强化学习方法，让Unitree Go2四足机器人学习适应不同室内楼梯（直梯、L型、螺旋梯）的攀爬与下降，在Isaac Lab模拟器中训练，并将策略从抽象金字塔地形迁移到真实楼梯拓扑。摘要报告了成功率和效率的实证分析。
Motivation: 室内消防初期搜索中，四足机器人在复杂环境中的态势感知和快速爬楼梯是主要挑战，现有方法难以平衡导航与运动。
Method: 两阶段端到端RL：第一阶段在金字塔楼梯地形训练基础攀爬技能，第二阶段在多种真实楼梯形状（直、L型、螺旋）中微调；采用中心线导航公式统一学习导航与运动，无需分层规划。
Result: 摘要称通过局部高度图感知实现了策略对不同楼梯形状的泛化，并提供了成功率、效率和失败模式的实证分析。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了端到端RL使四足机器人适应不同楼梯形状的潜力，但未提及实际消防场景的验证。

papers.title: Fly0: Persistent Metric Anchoring for Zero-Shot Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Current Visual-Language Navigation (VLN) methodologies face a trade-off between semantic understanding and control precision. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer superior reasoning, deploying them as low-level controllers leads to high latency, trajectory oscillations, and poor generalization due to weak geometric grounding. To address these limitations, we propose Fly0, a framework that decouples semantic reasoning from geometric planning. The proposed method operates through a three-stage pipeline: (1) an MLLM-driven module for grounding natural language instructions into 2D pixel coordinates; (2) a geometric projection module that utilizes depth data to localize targets in 3D space; and (3) a geometric planner that generates collision-free trajectories. This mechanism enables robust navigation even when visual contact is lost. By eliminating the need for continuous inference, Fly0 reduces computational overhead and improves system stability. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that Fly0 outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, improving the Success Rate by over 20\% and reducing Navigation Error (NE) by approximately 50\% in unstructured environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/xuzhenxing1/Fly0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fly0 提出了一种解耦语义推理与几何规划的零样本空中视觉语言导航框架。通过三阶段流水线（MLLM 驱动的二维坐标定位、深度数据几何投影、碰撞避免轨迹规划），在无连续推理的情况下实现鲁棒导航。模拟和真实环境实验表明，在非结构化环境中成功率提升超过 20%，导航误差降低约 50%。
Motivation: 现有 VLN 方法在语义理解与控制精度之间存在权衡，MLLM 作为低层控制器会导致高延迟、轨迹振荡和泛化差，主要问题在于缺乏几何基础。
Method: 三阶段流水线：MLLM 将自然语言指令映射为 2D 像素坐标；几何投影模块利用深度数据将目标定位到 3D 空间；几何规划器生成无碰撞轨迹。无需持续推理，降低计算开销。
Result: 在仿真和真实环境中，Fly0 优于现有基线，成功提升超过 20%，导航误差降低约 50%。
Conclusion: Fly0 有效解耦语义与几何，在失去视觉接触时仍能鲁棒导航，为零样本空中导航提供了高效解决方案。

papers.title: Beyond Content: Behavioral Policies Reveal Actors in Information Operations
papers.abstract_en: The detection of online influence operations -- coordinated campaigns by malicious actors to spread narratives -- has traditionally depended on content analysis or network features. These approaches are increasingly brittle as generative models produce convincing text, platforms restrict access to behavioral data, and actors migrate to less-regulated spaces. We introduce a platform-agnostic framework that identifies malicious actors from their behavioral policies by modeling user activity as sequential decision processes. We apply this approach to 12,064 Reddit users, including 99 accounts linked to the Russian Internet Research Agency in Reddit's 2017 transparency report, analyzing over 38 million activity steps from 2015-2018. Activity-based representations, which model how users act rather than what they post, consistently outperform content models in detecting malicious accounts. When distinguishing trolls -- users engaged in coordinated manipulation -- from ordinary users, policy-based classifiers achieve a median macro-F1 of 94.9\%, compared to 91.2\% for text embeddings. Policy features also enable earlier detection from short traces and degrade more gracefully under evasion strategies or data corruption. These findings show that behavioral dynamics encode stable, discriminative signals of manipulation on Reddit's IRA-linked campaign, and point to resilient detection strategies in the era of synthetic content and limited data access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个不依赖平台内容的框架，通过将用户活动建模为序列决策过程来提取行为策略，用于识别信息操纵行为。在Reddit 2015-2018年超过3800万活动步的数据上（包含99个IRA关联账号），基于行为策略的分类器达到94.9%的macro-F1，优于内容嵌入的91.2%，且对短序列和逃逸策略更鲁棒。
Motivation: 传统检测依赖内容或网络特征，但生成式AI使内容分析失效，平台限制数据访问，亟需不依赖内容、跨平台的鲁棒方法。
Method: 将用户在线活动视为序列决策过程，通过建模其行为策略（而非发布内容）来提取行为特征，并训练分类器识别恶意行为者。
Result: 在Reddit数据上，策略分类器median macro-F1达94.9%，文本嵌入为91.2%；行为特征在短活动痕迹下仍保持高检测率，并对逃逸策略和数据损坏更鲁棒。
Conclusion: 行为动态编码了稳定、可区分的操纵信号，为合成内容和数据受限环境下的信息操纵检测提供了可行方向。

papers.title: RAPT: Model-Predictive Out-of-Distribution Detection and Failure Diagnosis for Sim-to-Real Humanoid Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Deploying learned control policies is risky because policies that appear robust in simulation can confidently enter out-of-distribution (OOD) states after Sim-to-Real transfer, causing silent failures and potential hardware damage. Existing anomaly detectors often fail to meet the requirements of high-rate control, extremely low false-positive rates, and interpretable failure feedback. We present \textbf{RAPT} (Recurrent Anomaly Probabilistic Trajectory Model), a lightweight, self-supervised $50$\,Hz deployment monitor that learns nominal execution from large-scale simulation and produces calibrated, per-dimension predictive-deviation signals online. RAPT enables OOD detection under strict false-positive constraints while localizing \emph{when and where} real execution departs from nominal behavior. For post-hoc diagnosis, RAPT combines temporal saliency, joint-kinematic summaries, and LLM-based semantic reasoning to classify likely failure causes in a zero-shot setting. In simulation across four Isaac Lab tasks, RAPT improves TPR by $37\%$ over the strongest baseline at $0.5\%$ episode-level FPR; on hardware, it achieves $89\%$ TPR across $78$ trials with fewer false positives than high-frequency-compatible baselines, and reaches $75\%$ semantic failure diagnosis accuracy across $21$ categories on a challenging OOD subset. Project website, code, and videos: https://humphreymunn.github.io/RAPT/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAPT（循环异常概率轨迹模型），一种轻量级、自监督的50 Hz部署监视器，用于检测Sim-to-Real转移后人形机器人控制策略的分布外状态。RAPT通过从大规模仿真中学习标称执行，产生校准的逐维预测偏差信号，在严格假阳性约束下实现OOD检测，并能定位偏差发生的时间和位置。结合时间显著性、关节运动学摘要和基于LLM的语义推理，RAPT在零样本设置下对可能的故障原因进行分类。在四个Isaac Lab仿真任务中，RAPT在0.5%回合级FPR下将TPR提升37%；硬件实验中，78次试验达到89% TPR，假阳性少于高频兼容基线，并在挑战性OOD子集上实现75%的语义故障诊断准确率。
Motivation: Sim-to-Real迁移后，仿真中表现鲁棒的控制策略可能自信地进入分布外状态，导致无声故障和硬件损坏。现有异常检测器难以同时满足高频率控制、极低假阳性率和可解释故障反馈的需求。
Method: RAPT是一种轻量级自监督部署监视器，基于循环神经网络预测标称轨迹，产生校准的逐维预测偏差信号；结合时间显著性、关节运动学摘要和大语言模型的语义推理，实现零样本故障原因分类。
Result: 仿真中，在0.5%回合级假阳性率下，RAPT的TPR比最强基线高37%；硬件上，78次试验达到89% TPR，假阳性少于高频兼容基线；在21类挑战性OOD子集上，语义故障诊断准确率达75%。
Conclusion: RAPT提供了一种满足高频率控制、极低假阳性和可解释反馈要求的OOD检测与故障诊断方法，适用于Sim-to-Real人形机器人部署。

papers.title: SKETCH: Semantic Key-Point Conditioning for Long-Horizon Vessel Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate long-horizon vessel trajectory prediction remains challenging due to compounded uncertainty from complex navigation behaviors and environmental factors. Existing methods often struggle to maintain global directional consistency, leading to drifting or implausible trajectories when extrapolated over long time horizons. To address this issue, we propose a semantic-key-point-conditioned trajectory modeling framework, in which future trajectories are predicted by conditioning on a high-level Next Key Point (NKP) that captures navigational intent. This formulation decomposes long-horizon prediction into global semantic decision-making and local motion modeling, effectively restricting the support of future trajectories to semantically feasible subsets. To efficiently estimate the NKP prior from historical observations, we adopt a pretrain-finetune strategy. Extensive experiments on real-world AIS data demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, particularly for long travel durations, directional accuracy, and fine-grained trajectory prediction.
papers.comment: Final Camera-Ready Version. Accepted by ICML 2026 (PMLR Vol. 306)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对船舶轨迹长期预测中方向漂移和轨迹不合理的难题，提出了一种基于语义关键点条件化的轨迹建模框架。该方法通过预测一个高层级的“下一个关键点”（NKP）来捕捉航行意图，将长期预测分解为全局语义决策与局部运动建模，从而将未来轨迹限制在语义可行的子集内。在真实AIS数据上的实验表明，该方法在长时间预测、方向准确性和细粒度轨迹预测上持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有船舶轨迹预测方法在长时间外推时难以保持全局方向一致性，导致轨迹漂移或不合实际，亟需一种能引入高层导航意图约束的建模方式。
Method: 提出语义关键点条件化轨迹建模框架：先预测一个表示航行意图的“下一个关键点”（NKP），再基于该关键点条件化预测完整轨迹；采用预训练-微调策略从历史观测中高效估计NKP先验。
Result: 在真实AIS数据集上，该方法在所有评估指标上优于现有方法，特别是在长预测时长下的方向准确性和细粒度轨迹预测上提升显著。
Conclusion: 将长期预测分解为全局语义决策与局部运动建模可以有效限制轨迹的语义可行子集，提升预测的合理性与准确性。

papers.title: Aligned Stable Inpainting: Mitigating Unwanted Object Insertion and Preserving Color Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Generative image inpainting can produce realistic results even with large, irregular masks, but existing methods still suffer from two common problems: (1) Unwanted object insertion: hallucinate artifacts that do not match the surrounding context. (2) Color inconsistency: noticeable color shifts that lead to smeared textures. We analyze the causes of these issues and propose Aligned Stable inpainting with UnKnown Areas prior (ASUKA), a post-hoc framework for pre-trained inpainting models. To reduce unwanted object insertion, we use reconstruction-based priors to guide the generative model, suppressing hallucinated objects while preserving generative flexibility. To address color inconsistency, we design a specialized VAE decoder that formulates latent-to-image decoding as a local harmonization task. We implement ASUKA on both U-Net-based and DiT-based inpainting models with lightweight modifications. Experiments on Places2 and MISATO, our proposed benchmark, show that ASUKA effectively suppresses object hallucination and improves color consistency, outperforming existing diffusion- and rectified flow-based inpainting methods. The dataset, models, and code will be released on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式图像修复中常见的两种问题——不想要的物体插入和颜色不一致——提出了ASUKA（Aligned Stable inpainting with UnKnown Areas prior）后处理框架。该框架利用重建先验抑制生成模型中的幻觉物体，并通过专门设计的VAE解码器将潜在表示解码为图像，转化为局部协调任务，以改善颜色一致性。实验表明，ASUKA在Places2和提出的MISATO基准上有效减少了物体幻觉并提升了颜色一致性，优于现有扩散和整流流方法。
Motivation: 现有图像修复方法即使在大面积不规则掩膜下也能生成逼真结果，但仍存在两个常见问题：生成与周围上下文不匹配的幻觉物体，以及导致纹理模糊的显著颜色偏移。
Method: 提出ASUKA后处理框架，包含两部分：1）使用重建先验引导生成模型，抑制幻觉物体并保留生成灵活性；2）设计专门VAE解码器，将潜在到图像的解码形式化为局部协调任务。该框架可轻量修改应用于U-Net和DiT架构的修复模型。
Result: 在Places2和提出的MISATO基准上，ASUKA有效抑制物体幻觉并改善颜色一致性，优于现有扩散和整流流图像修复方法。
Conclusion: ASUKA是一种轻量级后处理框架，可提升预训练修复模型在物体插入抑制和颜色一致性方面的表现，代码和模型将开源。

summary_sections.method: 提出ASUKA后处理框架，包含两部分：1）使用重建先验引导生成模型，抑制幻觉物体并保留生成灵活性；2）设计专门VAE解码器，将潜在到图像的解码形式化为局部协调任务。该框架可轻量修改应用于U-Net和DiT架构的修复模型。
summary_sections.result: 在Places2和提出的MISATO基准上，ASUKA有效抑制物体幻觉并改善颜色一致性，优于现有扩散和整流流图像修复方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: ASUKA是一种轻量级后处理框架，可提升预训练修复模型在物体插入抑制和颜色一致性方面的表现，代码和模型将开源。

papers.title: MVGD-Net: A Novel Motion-aware Video Glass Surface Detection Method
papers.abstract_en: Glass surface ubiquitous in both daily life and professional environments presents a potential threat to vision-based systems, such as robot and drone navigation. To solve this challenge, most recent studies have shown significant interest in Video Glass Surface Detection (VGSD). We observe that objects in the reflection (or transmission) layer appear farther from the glass surfaces. Consequently, in video motion scenarios, the notable reflected (or transmitted) objects on the glass surface move slower than objects in non-glass regions within the same spatial plane, and this motion inconsistency can effectively reveal the presence of glass surfaces. Based on this observation, we propose a novel network, named MVGD-Net, for detecting glass surfaces in videos by leveraging motion inconsistency cues. Our MVGD-Net features three novel modules: the Cross-scale Multimodal Fusion Module (CMFM) that integrates extracted spatial features and estimated optical flow maps, the History Guided Attention Module (HGAM) and Temporal Cross Attention Module (TCAM), both of which further enhances temporal features. A Temporal-Spatial Decoder (TSD) is also introduced to fuse the spatial and temporal features for generating the glass region mask. Furthermore, for learning our network, we also propose a large-scale dataset, which comprises 312 diverse glass scenarios with a total of 19,268 frames. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our MVGD-Net outperforms relevant state-of-the-art methods.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by the 40th AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-26). It contians 9 pages, 11 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频玻璃表面检测（VGSD）问题，提出一种基于运动不一致性线索的新型网络MVGD-Net。该网络利用玻璃表面反射/透射物体运动较慢的特性，集成跨尺度多模态融合模块（CMFM）、历史引导注意力模块（HGAM）和时间交叉注意力模块（TCAM），并引入时空解码器（TSD）生成玻璃区域掩膜。作者还构建了一个包含312个场景、19268帧的大规模数据集，实验表明MVGD-Net优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 玻璃表面在日常生活和专业环境中普遍存在，对基于视觉的系统（如机器人和无人机导航）构成潜在威胁。现有方法局限于单帧图像，忽略了视频中的运动线索。
Method: 提出MVGD-Net，包括三个新模块：跨尺度多模态融合模块（CMFM）融合空间特征与光流图，历史引导注意力模块（HGAM）和时间交叉注意力模块（TCAM）增强时序特征，以及时空解码器（TSD）融合时空特征生成玻璃区域掩膜。此外，构建了一个大规模视频玻璃表面检测数据集（312场景，19268帧）。
Result: 在提出的大规模数据集上，MVGD-Net在玻璃表面检测性能上优于相关最先进方法。
Conclusion: 视频中玻璃表面反射/透射物体与非玻璃区域物体的运动不一致性可以有效揭示玻璃表面，基于此提出的MVGD-Net能够有效检测视频玻璃表面。

papers.title: Dr. Zero: Self-Evolving Search Agents without Training Data
papers.abstract_en: As high-quality data becomes increasingly difficult to obtain, self-evolution without curated training data has emerged as a promising paradigm. This approach allows large language models (LLMs) to autonomously generate and solve complex problems, thereby improving their reasoning capabilities. However, multi-turn search agents struggle in this setting due to limited question diversity and the substantial compute required for multi-step reasoning and tool use. In this work, we introduce Dr. Zero, a framework that enables search agents to effectively self-evolve without human-annotated training data, relying solely on an external search engine as their knowledge environment. In particular, we design a self-evolution feedback loop where a proposer generates structurally diverse questions to train a solver initialized from the same base model. As the solver evolves, it incentivizes the proposer to produce increasingly difficult yet solvable tasks, thus establishing an automated curriculum to refine both agents. To enhance training efficiency, we also introduce hop-grouped relative policy optimization (HRPO). This method clusters structurally similar questions to construct group-level baselines, effectively minimizing the sampling overhead in evaluating each query's individual difficulty and solvability. Consequently, HRPO significantly reduces the compute requirements for proposer training and reward estimation without compromising performance or stability. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that Dr. Zero matches or surpasses fully supervised search agents on several question answering benchmarks, showing that strong agentic search and evidence-grounded reasoning can emerge solely through self-evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dr. Zero 框架，使搜索代理在没有人工标注训练数据的情况下自我进化，仅依赖外部搜索引擎作为知识环境。通过提议者与求解器的反馈循环生成结构多样的训练问题，并引入 hop-grouped 相对策略优化 (HRPO) 提升训练效率。实验表明，该方法在多个问答基准上匹配或超越完全监督的搜索代理。
Motivation: 高质量训练数据获取困难，自进化范式虽无需人工数据，但多轮搜索代理因问题多样性不足和计算开销大而难以有效应用。
Method: 设计自进化反馈循环：提议者生成结构多样的训练问题，求解器从相同基础模型初始化并训练；随着求解器进化，提议者被激励生成更难但可解的任务，形成自动课程。同时提出 hop-grouped 相对策略优化 (HRPO)，聚类结构相似问题以构建组级基线，减少采样开销。
Result: 在多个问答基准上，Dr. Zero 匹配或超越了使用完全监督数据的搜索代理，表明强代理搜索和基于证据的推理可通过自进化涌现。
Conclusion: 自进化框架无需训练数据即可达到有监督性能，HRPO 显著降低计算需求且不牺牲性能或稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PRISP: Privacy-Safe Few-Shot Personalization via Lightweight Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) personalization aims to adapt general-purpose models to individual users. Most existing methods, however, are developed under data-rich and resource-abundant settings, often incurring privacy risks. In contrast, realistic personalization typically occurs after deployment under (i) extremely limited user data, (ii) constrained computational resources, and (iii) strict privacy requirements. We propose PRISP, a lightweight and privacy-safe personalization framework tailored to these constraints. PRISP leverages a Text-to-LoRA hypernetwork to generate task-aware LoRA parameters from task descriptions, and enables efficient user personalization by optimizing a small subset of task-aware LoRA parameters together with minimal additional modules using few-shot user data. Experiments on a few-shot variant of the LaMP benchmark demonstrate that PRISP achieves strong overall performance compared to prior approaches, while reducing computational overhead and eliminating privacy risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRISP，一种面向部署后场景的轻量级、隐私安全的少样本个性化框架，利用Text-to-LoRA超网络生成任务感知的LoRA参数，并通过少量用户数据优化少量参数实现高效个性化。在LaMP基准的少样本变体上，PRISP在降低计算开销和消除隐私风险的同时取得强性能。
Motivation: 现有LLM个性化方法大多假设数据丰富、资源充足且不考虑隐私风险，但实际部署后面临用户数据极其有限、计算资源受限和严格隐私要求的三重约束。
Method: PRISP采用Text-to-LoRA超网络从任务描述生成任务感知的LoRA参数，然后在个性化阶段仅优化少量任务感知LoRA参数和极小附加模块，使用少量用户数据进行微调。
Result: 在LaMP基准的少样本变体上，PRISP相比先前方法取得强整体性能，同时降低计算开销并消除隐私风险。
Conclusion: PRISP为隐私安全、资源高效的少样本个性化提供了一种可行方案，特别适用于部署后的实际约束场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WHU-PCPR: A cross-platform heterogeneous point cloud dataset for place recognition in complex urban scenes
papers.abstract_en: Point Cloud-based Place Recognition (PCPR) demonstrates considerable potential in applications such as autonomous driving, robot localization and navigation, and map update. In practical applications, point clouds used for place recognition are often acquired from different platforms and LiDARs across varying scene. However, existing PCPR datasets lack diversity in scenes, platforms, and sensors, which limits the effective development of related research. To address this gap, we establish WHU-PCPR, a cross-platform heterogeneous point cloud dataset designed for place recognition. The dataset differentiates itself from existing datasets through its distinctive characteristics: 1) cross-platform heterogeneous point clouds: collected from survey-grade vehicle-mounted Mobile Laser Scanning (MLS) systems and low-cost Portable helmet-mounted Laser Scanning (PLS) systems, each equipped with distinct mechanical and solid-state LiDAR sensors. 2) Complex localization scenes: encompassing real-time and long-term changes in both urban and campus road scenes. 3) Large-scale spatial coverage: featuring 82.3 km of trajectory over a 60-month period and an unrepeated route of approximately 30 km. Based on WHU-PCPR, we conduct extensive evaluation and in-depth analysis of several representative PCPR methods, and provide a concise discussion of key challenges and future research directions. The dataset and benchmark code are available at https://github.com/zouxianghong/WHU-PCPR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WHU-PCPR，一个面向地点识别的跨平台异质点云数据集，包含来自车载MLS和便携式PLS系统的多传感器点云，覆盖60个月、82.3公里轨迹和30公里不重复路径的城市与校园场景。基于该数据集评估了多种代表性方法，并讨论了关键挑战与未来方向。
Motivation: 现有地点识别数据集在场景、平台和传感器多样性上不足，限制了相关研究发展。
Method: 构建WHU-PCPR数据集：收集自测量级车载MLS系统和低成本便携式PLS系统，配备不同机械与固态LiDAR；包含城市和校园道路场景的实时与长期变化；覆盖大规模空间轨迹。
Result: 基于WHU-PCPR对多种代表性PCPR方法进行了广泛评估与分析，并提供了基准代码。
Conclusion: 该数据集有助于推动跨平台异质点云地点识别研究，并指出了关键挑战和未来方向。

papers.title: MATANet: A Multi-context Attention and Taxonomy-Aware Network for Fine-Grained Underwater Recognition of Marine Species
papers.abstract_en: Accurate fine-grained recognition of marine organisms is important for scalable biodiversity monitoring and ecological assessment using underwater imagery. However, existing methods mainly focus on target appearance and make limited use of surrounding environmental cues and biological taxonomy. We propose the Multi-Context Attention and Taxonomy-Aware Network (MATANet) for region-of-interest (ROI)-guided marine organism recognition. MATANet contains two complementary components. The Multi-Context Environmental Attention Module uses the ROI representation as a query to aggregate spatial patch features from ROI-centered contextual views at multiple scales, enabling target-conditioned modeling of the surrounding environment. Level-wise auxiliary classifiers further incorporate higher taxonomic ranks during training, encouraging hierarchically consistent representations without changing the finest-label prediction space or inference procedure. On the official FathomNet 2025 Private test split, MATANet achieves a hierarchical distance of 1.570 with the base backbone and 1.423 with the large backbone, substantially outperforming the strongest benchmark value of 2.603. On FishCLEF2015, MATANet achieves an accuracy of 0.793 and a hierarchical distance of 1.120, outperforming the strongest benchmark values of 0.766 and 1.327, respectively. Ablation studies show that surrounding scene information provides complementary evidence beyond repeated multi-scale observations of the target and that target-conditioned aggregation outperforms direct multi-view concatenation. Additional experiments on FAIR1M v2.0 examine the applicability of the proposed design beyond underwater imagery. In post-detection evaluation, MATANet improves fine-grained classification accuracy on matched detector-generated ROIs from 0.828 to 0.959 supporting its engineering applicability to automated marine monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多上下文注意力与分类学感知网络 (MATANet)，用于水下海洋生物细粒度识别。该方法通过ROI引导的多尺度环境上下文聚合和层次化辅助分类器，在FathomNet 2025和FishCLEF2015上显著优于现有基准。
Motivation: 现有水下生物识别方法主要依赖目标外观，未充分利用环境线索和生物分类学信息，导致细粒度识别精度受限。
Method: 提出MATANet，包含多上下文环境注意力模块，以ROI表示为查询，聚合多尺度ROI中心上下文视图的空间块特征；同时引入层次化辅助分类器，在训练时融入高阶分类信息，不改变最终预测空间。
Result: 在FathomNet 2025私有测试集上，MATANet基础骨干层次距离1.570，大骨干1.423，优于基准2.603；在FishCLEF2015上准确率0.793，层次距离1.120，优于基准0.766和1.327。
Conclusion: 周围场景信息提供了互补证据，目标条件聚合优于直接多视图拼接；该方法在FAIR1M v2.0上验证了泛化性，并提升了检测后分类准确率。

papers.title: M-RAG: Semantic Key-Value Indexing for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) turns external documents into evidence for large language models. In practice, this is also a data access problem: a system must decide what to index, what to retrieve, and what evidence to place in the context under a token budget. Most RAG pipelines use text chunks for both lookup and generation. This couples two different objectives. Retrieval benefits from compact and discriminative records, while generation needs contextual and faithful evidence. As a result, small chunks may fragment answer-bearing information, whereas large chunks may introduce noise and waste the context budget. We propose M-RAG, a semantic key-value indexing layer for budget-constrained RAG query processing. M-RAG extracts meta-markers from complete documents, where each record contains a retrieval key, an information value, and provenance pointers. Online retrieval operates over the key field, which can be searched by dense vector retrieval or sparse lexical retrieval; the paired values are returned as generation payloads and assembled under the token budget. Provenance pointers further support coverage validation and position-aware context ordering. This design separates the physical index entry from the evidence payload without changing the underlying retriever or generator. Experiments on LongBench QA subtasks show that M-RAG achieves competitive or better accuracy than representative chunk-based baselines, especially under tight token budgets. Further analyses show high document coverage, stronger robustness under expanding candidate corpora, and lower online retrieval latency. These results suggest that semantic key-value indexing is a practical access method for RAG workloads.

TL;DR: 论文提出M-RAG，一种语义键值索引方法，用于预算约束的RAG查询处理，通过将索引与证据分离，在LongBench QA任务上取得竞争性结果。
Motivation: 现有RAG使用文本块同时用于检索和生成，导致小块碎片化信息，大块引入噪声，浪费上下文预算。
Method: M-RAG从完整文档中提取元标记，每个记录包含检索键、信息值和来源指针；在线检索在键字段上进行，返回值作为生成内容，在令牌预算下组装。
Result: 在LongBench QA子任务上，M-RAG在紧令牌预算下达到竞争性或更好的准确率，并展示了高文档覆盖、更强的鲁棒性和更低的在线检索延迟。
Conclusion: 语义键值索引是RAG工作负载的一种实用访问方法。

papers.title: GH-ESD: Grounded Hypothesis-Driven Error Slice Discovery for Instance-Level Vision Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Systematic failures of vision models on semantically coherent subsets, known as error slices, reveal limitations in robustness and evaluation. Existing slice discovery approaches largely model slices as clusters in representation space or combinations of predefined attributes. While effective for image-level classification, such formulations are insufficient for instance-level tasks such as object detection and segmentation, where failures often arise from contextual relational and spatially grounded visual patterns. We propose GH-ESD (Grounded Hypothesis-Driven Error Slice Discovery), a generate and verify framework that reformulates slice discovery as grounded hypothesis generation and statistical verification. GH-ESD constructs relational failure hypotheses using LLM priors and grounded visual evidence, discovers hypothesis slices at the instance level via Vision Language Models, and verifies them through statistical trend analysis over instance-level errors. We also introduce GESD (Grounded Error Slice Dataset), a new benchmark for instance-level error slice discovery, providing expert-defined and spatially grounded slices derived from detection and segmentation failures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GH-ESD consistently outperforms baselines, improving Precision@10 by 0.10 (0.73 vs. 0.63) on the GESD benchmark for detection tasks, while also supporting segmentation scenarios. GH-ESD identifies interpretable slices that facilitate actionable model improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GH-ESD，一个基于假设生成与验证的框架，用于实例级视觉任务（如目标检测和分割）中的错误切片发现。GH-ESD利用大语言模型先验和视觉语言模型构建关系性失败假设，并通过统计趋势分析验证。同时引入GESD基准数据集，实验表明GH-ESD在检测任务上Precision@10提升0.10（0.73 vs. 0.63），并支持分割场景。
Motivation: 现有错误切片发现方法主要针对图像级分类，无法有效处理实例级任务中因上下文关系和空间模式导致的失败。
Method: 提出生成-验证框架：使用LLM先验和视觉证据生成关系性失败假设，通过视觉语言模型发现实例级假设切片，再对实例级错误进行统计趋势分析验证。
Result: 在GESD基准上，检测任务Precision@10从0.63提升至0.73，分割场景也取得改进。
Conclusion: GH-ESD能识别可解释的错误切片，有助于指导模型改进，但仅针对实例级视觉任务。
