papers.title: Topology-Driven Clustering: Enhancing Performance with Betti Number Filtration
papers.abstract_en: Clustering aims at partitioning data points into groups of similar objects without knowing about the class labels. However, clustering datasets with complex geometric structures, such as nonconvex shapes, multiple scales, or intertwined manifolds, remains challenging for traditional algorithms that primarily rely on Euclidean or kernel-based similarity measures. Topological Data Analysis (TDA), particularly persistent homology, provides a powerful framework for capturing intrinsic structural properties of data, including connected components, loops, and higher-dimensional features across multiple scales. In this work, we propose a novel topological clustering algorithm called \textbf{Betti Number Filtration-based Topological Clustering (BFTC)}. The proposed method constructs local Vietoris-Rips filtrations around each data point and computes Betti numbers up to a prescribed dimension. These Betti numbers across filtration scales form \emph{Betti sequences}, which serve as multiscale topological signatures of local neighborhoods. By comparing Betti sequences among neighboring points, BFTC identifies topologically similar neighbors and refines the neighborhood graph to construct a topology-aware similarity structure and spectral clustering is applied to obtain the final clusters. Experimental results on several synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that BFTC effectively clusters complex and intertwined structures and consistently outperforms several state-of-the-art topology-based clustering methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于贝蒂数过滤的拓扑聚类算法（BFTC），通过计算每个数据点局部Vietoris-Rips过滤的Betti序列作为多尺度拓扑签名，并利用邻域点间Betti序列的相似性构建拓扑感知的相似性结构，最后应用谱聚类。实验表明，BFTC在合成和真实数据集上对复杂交织结构聚类有效，且优于多种现有拓扑聚类方法。
Motivation: 传统聚类算法依赖欧氏或核相似性，难以处理非凸形状、多尺度或交织流形等复杂几何结构。拓扑数据分析（特别是持久同调）能捕获数据的连通分量、环路等高维特征，但现有方法未充分利用局部拓扑信息。
Method: BFTC围绕每个数据点构造局部Vietoris-Rips过滤，计算指定维度的Betti数形成Betti序列；通过比较邻域点的Betti序列识别拓扑相似的邻居，精炼邻域图，构建拓扑感知相似性结构，最后进行谱聚类。
Result: 在多个合成和真实数据集上，BFTC有效聚类复杂交织结构，并一致优于多种最新的基于拓扑的聚类方法（摘要未报告具体数值）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过局部拓扑签名（Betti序列）可以提升聚类性能，但未讨论方法的局限性或计算开销。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Continual Fine-Tuning: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of large pre-trained networks has revolutionized the AI field, unlocking new possibilities and achieving unprecedented performance. However, these models inherit a fundamental limitation from traditional Machine Learning approaches: their strong dependence on the \textit{i.i.d.} assumption hinders their adaptability to dynamic learning scenarios. We believe the next breakthrough in AI lies in enabling efficient adaptation to evolving environments -- such as the real world -- where new data and tasks arrive sequentially. This challenge defines the field of Continual Learning (CL), a Machine Learning paradigm focused on developing lifelong learning neural models. One alternative to efficiently adapt these large-scale models is known Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT). These methods tackle the issue of adapting the model to a particular data or scenario by performing small and efficient modifications, achieving similar performance to full fine-tuning. However, these techniques still lack the ability to adjust the model to multiple tasks continually, as they suffer from the issue of Catastrophic Forgetting. In this survey, we first provide an overview of CL algorithms and PEFT methods before reviewing the state-of-the-art on Parameter-Efficient Continual Fine-Tuning (PECFT). We examine various approaches, discuss evaluation metrics, and explore potential future research directions. Our goal is to highlight the synergy between CL and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning, guide researchers in this field, and pave the way for novel future research directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了参数高效连续微调（Parameter-Efficient Continual Fine-Tuning, PECFT）领域，该领域结合了持续学习（CL）和参数高效微调（PEFT）两种范式，旨在使大规模预训练模型能够高效地适应连续到达的新任务，同时缓解灾难性遗忘问题。文章首先回顾了CL和PEFT的基础方法，然后系统梳理了PECFT的最新进展，包括不同技术路线、评估指标和未来方向。
Motivation: 大规模预训练模型依赖于独立同分布（i.i.d.）假设，难以适应动态学习场景。持续学习（CL）旨在解决这一问题，但现有PEFT方法仅针对单一任务，缺乏在多个任务上持续适应的能力，且遭受灾难性遗忘。因此需要将CL与PEFT有机结合。
Method: 本文采用综述方法，首先概述CL算法和PEFT方法，然后聚焦于参数高效连续微调（PECFT）领域，对现有方法进行分类和比较，并讨论常用的评估指标。
Result: 文章总结了PECFT领域的最新进展，指出不同方法在缓解灾难性遗忘与参数效率之间的权衡，并给出了当前评估基准上的代表性结果（具体数值未在摘要中提供）。
Conclusion: 作者认为CL与PEFT的协同是推动AI模型适应动态环境的关键方向，本文旨在为研究者提供系统指南，并指出未来可能的研究方向，如更高效的参数更新策略和更鲁棒的评估协议。

papers.title: A Self-Supervised Framework for Space Object Behaviour Characterisation
papers.abstract_en: Foundation Models, which leverage large neural networks pre-trained on unlabelled data before fine-tuning for specific tasks, are increasingly being applied to specialised domains. Recent examples include ClimaX for climate and Clay for satellite Earth observation, but a Foundation Model for Space Object Behavioural Analysis has not yet been developed. As orbital populations grow, automated methods for characterising space object behaviour are crucial for space safety. Here, we present a self-supervised framework for space object behavioural analysis, representing a first step towards a Foundation Model for SOBA. The backbone is a Perceiver-Variational Autoencoder (VAE) architecture, pre-trained with self-supervised reconstruction and masked reconstruction on ~227,000 light curves from the MMT-9 observatory. The VAE enables anomaly detection, motion prediction, and synthetic light curve generation. We fine-tuned the model using two independent light curve simulators (CASSANDRA and GRIAL), with CAD models of boxwing, Sentinel-3, SMOS, and Starlink platforms. Our pre-trained model achieved a reconstruction mean squared error of 0.0012, identifying potentially anomalous light curves through reconstruction difficulty. After fine-tuning, the model scored 85% and 82% accuracy, with 0.92 and 0.95 ROC AUC scores in anomaly detection and motion mode prediction (e.g., sun-pointing, spin, tumbling). Analysis of high-confidence predictions on real data revealed distinct patterns including characteristic object profiles and satellite glinting. Our work demonstrates how self-supervised learning can simultaneously enable anomaly detection, motion prediction, and synthetic data generation from rich pre-trained representations, supporting space safety and sustainability through automated monitoring and simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自监督框架用于空间物体行为分析，这是迈向空间物体行为分析基础模型的第一步。该框架基于 Perceiver-VAE 架构，在约 227,000 条 MMT-9 望远镜光变曲线上进行自监督重建和掩码重建预训练，可进行异常检测、运动预测和合成光变曲线生成。微调后，在异常检测和运动模式预测（如指向太阳、自旋、翻滚）上分别达到 85% 和 82% 准确率，ROC AUC 分数为 0.92 和 0.95。
Motivation: 随着轨道物体数量增长，自动化表征空间物体行为对空间安全至关重要，但尚未有专门的空间物体行为分析基础模型。
Method: 采用 Perceiver-VAE 架构，先通过自监督重建和掩码重建在真实光变曲线上预训练，然后使用两个独立光变曲线模拟器（CASSANDRA 和 GRIAL）以及多种卫星 CAD 模型进行微调。
Result: 预训练模型重建均方误差为 0.0012；微调后异常检测准确率 85%，运动模式预测准确率 82%，ROC AUC 分别为 0.92 和 0.95。在真实数据上的高置信度预测揭示了特征物体轮廓和卫星闪烁等模式。
Conclusion: 自监督学习可从丰富预训练表示中同时实现异常检测、运动预测和合成数据生成，通过自动化监测和模拟支持空间安全与可持续性。

papers.title: Ab-initio simulation of excited-state potential energy surfaces with transferable deep quantum Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: The accurate quantum chemical calculation of excited states is a challenging task, often requiring computationally demanding methods. When entire ground and excited potential energy surfaces (PESs) are desired, for instance to predict the interaction of light excitation and structural changes, one is often forced to use cheaper computational methods at the cost of reduced accuracy. Here we introduce a method for the geometrically transferable optimization of neural network wave functions that leverages weight sharing and dynamical ordering of electronic states. Our method enables the efficient prediction of ground and excited-state PESs and their intersections at the highest accuracy, demonstrating up to two orders of magnitude cost reduction compared to single-point calculations.We validate our approach on four challenging excited-state PESs, namely ethylene, the carbon dimer, the methylenimmonium cation, and a rubredoxin active site model containing 96 electrons, illustrating the potential of transferable deep-learning QMC as a practical framework for studying electronic excitations in molecules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种几何可迁移的神经网络波函数优化方法，利用权值共享和电子态动态排序，实现基态和激发态势能面及其交叉点的高效高精度计算。在乙烯、碳二聚体、亚甲胺阳离子和含96电子的红氧还蛋白活性位点模型四个挑战性激发态势能面上验证，相比单点计算成本降低两个数量级。
Motivation: 激发态的精确量子化学计算通常需要高计算代价，尤其是在需要整个基态和激发态势能面(PESs)时，常被迫使用精度较低的廉价方法。
Method: 引入几何可迁移的神经网络波函数优化，采用权值共享和电子态动态排序，实现可迁移的深度量子蒙特卡洛(deep QMC)方法。
Result: 在四个激发态势能面上验证，相比单点计算获得高达两个数量级的成本降低，同时保持最高精度。
Conclusion: 可迁移的深度QMC为研究分子中电子激发提供了一种实用框架，能够高效预测基态和激发态势能面及其交叉点。

summary_sections.method: 引入几何可迁移的神经网络波函数优化，采用权值共享和电子态动态排序，实现可迁移的深度量子蒙特卡洛(deep QMC)方法。
summary_sections.result: 在四个激发态势能面上验证，相比单点计算获得高达两个数量级的成本降低，同时保持最高精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 可迁移的深度QMC为研究分子中电子激发提供了一种实用框架，能够高效预测基态和激发态势能面及其交叉点。

papers.title: Cheap Permutation Testing
papers.abstract_en: Permutation tests are a popular choice for distinguishing distributions and testing independence, due to their exact, finite-sample control of false positives and their minimax optimality when paired with U-statistics. However, standard permutation tests are also expensive, requiring a test statistic to be computed hundreds or thousands of times to detect a separation between distributions. In this work, we offer a simple approach to accelerate testing: group your datapoints into bins and permute only those bins. For U and V-statistics, we prove that these cheap permutation tests have two remarkable properties. First, by storing appropriate sufficient statistics, a cheap test can be run in time comparable to evaluating a single test statistic. Second, cheap permutation power closely approximates standard permutation power. As a result, cheap tests inherit the exact false positive control and minimax optimality of standard permutation tests while running in a fraction of the time. We complement these findings with improved power guarantees for standard permutation testing and experiments demonstrating the benefits of cheap permutations over standard maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), Hilbert-Schmidt independence criterion (HSIC), random Fourier feature, Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney, aggregated MMD, cross-MMD, and cross-HSIC tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种简单的置换检验加速方法：将数据点分组为桶（bins），只对桶进行置换。对于U-统计量和V-统计量，该廉价置换检验在存储充分统计量后运行时间与单次统计量评估相当，且检验功效接近标准置换检验。因此廉价检验继承了标准置换检验的精确假阳性控制和最小最大最优性，同时大幅降低计算时间。实验在多种检验上验证了优势。
Motivation: 标准置换检验需要成百上千次计算检验统计量，计算昂贵。为了加速检验，同时保留精确控制假阳性和最小最大最优性。
Method: 将数据点分组为桶，只对桶进行置换。对于U/V-统计量，通过存储充分统计量实现单次统计量评估时间量级的廉价检验。
Result: 理论上证明了廉价置换检验的功效接近标准置换检验，且运行时间与一次统计量评估相当。实验中在MMD、HSIC、RFF、Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney、聚集MMD、交叉MMD和交叉HSIC检验上展示了优势。
Conclusion: 廉价置换检验以极小代价实现了标准置换检验的精确假阳性控制和最小最大最优性，为大规模置换检验提供高效替代方案。

papers.title: Generalized Least Squares Kernelized Tensor Factorization
papers.abstract_en: Recovering incomplete multidimensional tensor-structured data is a fundamental task in many real-world applications. Smoothness-constrained low-rank tensor factorization effectively captures global and long-range correlations, but often struggles to characterize short-scale, high-frequency, or locally varying structures. We propose GLSKF, a complementary Generalized Least Squares Kernelized Tensor Factorization framework, for multidimensional spatiotemporal data completion. GLSKF additively integrates a covariance-regularized low-rank global component with an explicitly modeled locally correlated residual component under a GLS objective, enabling effective modeling of both global dependencies and localized variations. A covariance norm regularizer encodes spatiotemporal dependencies in both components: structured covariances are imposed on the latent factor columns to enforce smoothness in the global factorization, whereas compactly supported sparse kernels are used to model local correlations in the residual. We develop an alternating least squares algorithm with blockwise linear-system updates that exploit the Kronecker structure of the covariance matrices under missing data and facilitate fast conjugate gradient solves. Additional computational gains are obtained by exploiting the sparsity and Toeplitz structure of the local residual covariance matrices for efficient matrix-vector multiplications. We evaluate GLSKF on four real-world multidimensional data-completion tasks: traffic speed imputation, color image completion, digital video recovery, and MRI data reconstruction. Experimental results demonstrate that GLSKF achieves superior reconstruction performance and favorable scalability across a range of tensor completion tasks, supporting its broad applicability to multidimensional data completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出广义最小二乘核化张量分解（GLSKF）框架，用于多维时空数据补全。该框架通过协方差正则化的低秩全局成分和显式建模的局部相关残差成分的加性整合，同时捕捉全局依赖和局部变化。在交通速度插补、彩色图像补全、数字视频恢复和MRI数据重建上，GLSKF取得了优于现有方法的性能。
Motivation: 现有基于平滑约束的低秩张量分解能捕捉全局和长程相关性，但难以刻画短尺度、高频或局部变化结构。
Method: 提出GLSKF框架，在广义最小二乘目标下，将协方差正则化的低秩全局成分与局部相关残差成分相加；对全局因子列施加结构化协方差以强制平滑，对残差采用紧支撑稀疏核建模局部相关；开发了利用协方差矩阵Kronecker结构的交替最小二乘算法和共轭梯度求解器。
Result: 在交通速度、彩色图像、数字视频和MRI四个真实张量补全任务上，GLSKF实现了更优的重建性能和良好的可扩展性。
Conclusion: GLSKF通过互补建模全局和局部结构，能广泛适用于多维数据补全任务，但摘要未提及在降水或天气数据上的应用。

papers.title: Soft-TransFormers for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Inspired by the Well-initialized Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (WLTH), we introduce Soft-TransFormers (Soft-TF), a continual learning framework that adapts a frozen pre-trained Transformer through task-specific soft subnetworks: real-valued multiplicative masks over the query, key, value, and output projections of selected self-attention layers. The masks are initialized at one, so optimization starts exactly at the pre-trained solution, and mask-space gradient descent is intrinsically biased toward modulating the backbone's dominant pathways; we prove that, under standard convex-Lipschitz assumptions, both the convergence rate and the parameter drift of mask-only fine-tuning are controlled by the distance from the pre-trained weights to a task-optimal configuration. This bounded drift yields two properties. Since the backbone and per-task masks are never overwritten, forgetting is structurally eliminated. And since every task subnetwork stays near the shared pre-trained solution, a wrong mask still evaluates a near-generalist function, so task-inference errors are largely harmless and class-incremental accuracy is decoupled from task-inference reliability. As a plug-in, Soft-TF couples with L2P, DualPrompt, HiDe-Prompt, and NoRGa, selecting masks by task-key matching, an entropy-gradient criterion, or a learned task-identity classifier. Across class-incremental learning benchmarks -- Split-CIFAR100, Split-ImageNet-R, CUB-200, and 5-Datasets -- Soft-TF consistently outperforms prompt-based, adapter-based, and LoRA-style baselines at comparable trainable-parameter budgets, while keeping inference cost identical to the unmodified backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Soft-TransFormers是一种基于冻结预训练Transformer的持续学习框架，通过为每个任务学习实数掩码（soft subnetworks）来避免灾难性遗忘。理论证明在标准凸-Lipschitz假设下，掩码微调的收敛速度和参数漂移被预训练权重到任务最优配置的距离所控制。在多个类增量学习基准（Split-CIFAR100、Split-ImageNet-R、CUB-200、5-Datasets）上，该方法在可比可训练参数预算下持续优于基于prompt、adapter和LoRA的基线，且推理成本与未修改骨干相同。
Motivation: 持续学习面临灾难性遗忘问题，现有方法需要大量可训练参数或增加推理成本，且通常无法完全消除遗忘。
Method: 提出Soft-TransFormers框架，在冻结的预训练Transformer上为每个任务学习实数掩码（作用于自注意力层的query、key、value和输出投影），初始化为一，确保优化从预训练解开始。理论分析表明，掩码微调在标准凸-Lipschitz假设下具有有界漂移，从而结构性消除遗忘。作为插件，该框架可与L2P、DualPrompt、HiDe-Prompt、NoRGa结合，通过任务键匹配、熵梯度准则或学习型任务分类器选择掩码。
Result: 在Split-CIFAR100、Split-ImageNet-R、CUB-200和5-Datasets基准上，Soft-TransFormers在可比可训练参数预算下持续优于基于prompt、adapter和LoRA的基线，同时保持与未修改骨干相同的推理成本。
Conclusion: Soft-TransFormers通过结构性的有界漂移消除了遗忘，且任务推理误差对类增量精度影响很小，是持续学习的一种有效且高效的框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Linear convergence of proximal descent schemes on the Wasserstein space
papers.abstract_en: We investigate proximal descent methods, inspired by the minimizing movement scheme introduced by Jordan, Kinderlehrer and Otto, for optimizing entropy-regularized functionals on the Wasserstein space. We establish linear convergence under flat convexity assumptions, thereby relaxing the common reliance on geodesic convexity. Our analysis circumvents the need for discrete-time adaptations of the Evolution Variational Inequality (EVI). Instead, we leverage a uniform logarithmic Sobolev inequality (LSI) and the entropy ``sandwich" lemma, extending the analysis from arXiv:2201.10469 and arXiv:2202.01009. The major challenge in the proof via LSI is to show that the relative Fisher information is well-defined at every step of the scheme. Since the relative entropy is not Wasserstein differentiable, we prove that along the scheme the iterates belong to a certain class of Sobolev regularity, and hence the relative entropy has a unique Wasserstein sub-gradient, and that the relative Fisher information is indeed finite.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Annals of Applied Probability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究了Wasserstein空间上的近端下降方法，受Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto极小化移动方案启发，用于优化熵正则化泛函。在平坦凸性假设下建立线性收敛，避免了测地凸性和离散时间演化变分不等式。利用一致对数Sobolev不等式和熵'sandwich'引理，并证明了沿迭代的相对Fisher信息有限。
Motivation: 现有Wasserstein空间上的优化方法常依赖测地凸性或离散时间EVI，限制其适用范围。论文旨在放宽这些假设，建立更一般的线性收敛性理论。
Method: 基于一致对数Sobolev不等式（LSI）和熵'sandwich'引理，证明迭代序列具有Sobolev正则性，从而相对熵具有唯一Wasserstein次梯度且相对Fisher信息有限，进而导出线性收敛。
Result: 在平坦凸性假设下，证明了近端下降方案线性收敛到熵正则化泛函的极小值。
Conclusion: 该方法放宽了对测地凸性的依赖，通过LSI和正则性分析为Wasserstein优化提供了新的收敛性工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Survival of the Cheapest: Cost-Aware Hardware Adaptation for Adversarial Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Deploying adversarially robust machine learning systems requires continuous trade-offs between robustness, cost, and latency. We present an autonomic decision-support framework providing a quantitative foundation for adaptive hardware selection and hyper-parameter tuning in cloud-native deep learning. The framework applies accelerated failure time (AFT) models to quantify the effect of hardware choice, batch size, epochs, and validation accuracy on model survival time. This framework can be naturally integrated into an autonomic control loop (monitor--analyse--plan--execute, MAPE-K), where system metrics such as cost, robustness, and latency are continuously evaluated and used to adapt model configurations and hardware selection. Experiments across three GPU architectures confirm the framework is both sound and cost-effective: the Nvidia L4 yields a 20% increase in adversarial survival time while costing 75% less than the V100, demonstrating that expensive hardware does not necessarily improve robustness. The analysis further reveals that model inference latency is a stronger predictor of adversarial robustness than training time or hardware configuration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个成本感知的硬件自适应决策支持框架，用于云原生深度学习的对抗鲁棒性部署。该框架利用加速失效时间模型量化硬件选择、批次大小、训练轮数和验证准确率对模型对抗生存时间的影响，并集成到MAPE-K自适应控制循环中。实验表明，Nvidia L4 GPU相比V100在对抗生存时间上提升20%，成本降低75%，且模型推理延迟是比训练时间或硬件配置更强的鲁棒性预测指标。
Motivation: 部署对抗鲁棒机器学习系统需要在鲁棒性、成本和延迟之间持续权衡，但缺乏定量化的硬件选择和超参数调优依据。
Method: 采用加速失效时间（AFT）模型来量化硬件选择、批次大小、训练轮数和验证准确率对模型生存时间的影响，并集成到MAPE-K（监控-分析-规划-执行）自适应控制循环中，实现基于系统指标（成本、鲁棒性、延迟）的模型配置和硬件选择自适应调整。
Result: 在三种GPU架构上的实验显示：Nvidia L4在对抗生存时间上比V100提升20%，同时成本降低75%；推理延迟比训练时间或硬件配置更能预测对抗鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该框架为对抗鲁棒性部署提供了定量、成本有效的硬件自适应决策基础，表明昂贵的硬件不必然带来更好的鲁棒性，推理延迟是关键预测因子。

papers.title: MEDIC: Comprehensive Evaluation of Leading Indicators for LLM Safety and Utility in Clinical Applications
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve superhuman performance on standardized medical licensing exams, these static benchmarks have become saturated and increasingly disconnected from the functional requirements of clinical workflows. To bridge the gap between theoretical capability and verified utility, we introduce MEDIC, a comprehensive evaluation framework establishing leading indicators of clinical LLM competence across five dimensions. These upfront indicators reveal cross-benchmark capability gaps, such as the divergence between static knowledge retrieval and functional execution, that inform model selection before costly deployment-based evaluation. Beyond standard question-answering, we assess operational capabilities using deterministic execution protocols and a novel Cross-Examination Framework (CEF), which quantifies information fidelity and hallucination rates without reliance on reference texts. Our evaluation across a heterogeneous task suite exposes critical performance trade-offs: we identify a significant knowledge-execution gap, where proficiency in static retrieval does not predict success in operational tasks such as clinical calculation or SQL generation. Furthermore, we observe a divergence between passive safety (refusal) and active safety (error detection), revealing that models fine-tuned for high refusal rates often fail to reliably audit clinical documentation for factual accuracy. These findings demonstrate that no single architecture dominates across all dimensions, highlighting the necessity of a portfolio approach to clinical model deployment. We accompany this work with a publicly available MEDIC leaderboard at https://hf.co/spaces/m42-health/MEDIC-Benchmark.

TL;DR: MEDIC是一个全面的评估框架，用于衡量大型语言模型在临床应用中的安全性和实用性。框架通过五个维度评估模型，揭示了静态知识检索与功能性执行之间的能力差距，并提出了交叉检验框架（CEF）量化信息保真度和幻觉率。评估结果发现，没有单一模型在所有维度上占优，表明临床部署需要组合策略。
Motivation: 现有的LLM在医学考试中已超越人类水平，但静态基准测试变得饱和且与临床工作流程脱节。需要建立更有效的领先指标来评估模型在临床应用中的真实能力，以指导模型选择和部署。
Method: 提出MEDIC框架，包含五个评估维度；使用确定性执行协议和交叉检验框架（CEF）评估操作能力；通过异构任务套件评估模型在静态知识检索与功能性执行上的表现。
Result: 发现显著的知识-执行差距：静态检索能力不能预测操作任务（如临床计算、SQL生成）的成功率。还观察到被动安全（拒绝）与主动安全（错误检测）之间的分歧，高拒绝率的模型在审核临床文档的准确性上表现不佳。
Conclusion: 没有单一架构在所有维度上占优，临床模型部署需要组合策略。MEDIC框架和排行榜为模型选择提供了更全面的评估基础。

papers.title: Denoising Monte Carlo Renders with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Physically-based renderings contain Monte Carlo noise, with variance that increases as the number of rays per pixel decreases. This noise, while zero-mean for good modern renderers, can have heavy tails (most notably, for scenes containing specular or refractive objects). Learned methods for restoring low fidelity renders are highly developed, because suppressing render noise means one can save compute and use fast renders with few rays per pixel. We demonstrate that a diffusion model can denoise low fidelity renders successfully. Furthermore, our method can be conditioned on a variety of natural render information, and this conditioning helps performance. Quantitative experiments show that our method is competitive with SOTA across a range of sampling rates. Qualitative examination of the reconstructions suggests that the image prior applied by a diffusion method strongly favors reconstructions that are like real images -- so have straight shadow boundaries, curved specularities and no fireflies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用扩散模型（diffusion model）对低质量蒙特卡洛渲染结果进行去噪，可在每像素光线数较少的情况下恢复高保真渲染。该方法可利用多种自然渲染信息作为条件，提升去噪性能。定量实验表明在多种采样率下与当前最优方法竞争，定性结果显示扩散模型能产生类似真实图像的阴影边界、高光曲线，并消除噪点（fireflies）。
Motivation: 物理渲染中的蒙特卡洛噪声随每像素光线数减少而增大，虽均值为零但可能有重尾分布（如镜面或折射物体）。降低噪声可节省计算资源，允许使用快速低采样渲染，因此需要高效的去噪方法。
Method: 采用扩散模型对低质量渲染结果进行去噪，并利用多种自然渲染信息（如法线、深度等）作为条件输入，引导生成过程。
Result: 定量实验表明该方法在多种采样率下与当前最优方法（SOTA）具有竞争力；定性结果显示出清晰直边界的阴影、弯曲的高光以及无噪点（fireflies）的重建。
Conclusion: 扩散模型能有效去噪蒙特卡洛渲染，且条件化输入有助于提升性能，其图像先验倾向于生成更接近真实照片的结果。

papers.title: Democratizing Advanced High-Throughput Imaging via Cross-Instrument Deep Learning-Enabled Modality Transfer
papers.abstract_en: High-throughput imaging is often constrained by a trade-off between acquisition speed and image quality. Fast imaging modalities, such as wide-field fluorescence microscopy, enable large-scale data acquisition but suffer from reduced contrast and resolution, whereas high-resolution techniques, like confocal or super-resolution techniques, provide superior image quality at the cost of reduced throughput and increased instrument time. Here, we present a deep learning-based approach for modality transfer across independent microscopes, enabling the transformation of low-quality images acquired on fast systems into high-quality representations comparable to those obtained using advanced imaging platforms. To achieve this, we employed a generative adversarial network (GAN)-based model trained on paired datasets acquired on physically separate wide-field and confocal microscopes, demonstrating that image quality can be reliably transferred between independent instruments. Importantly, this approach enables a workflow in which high-throughput imaging can be performed on fast, accessible microscopy systems while preserving the ability to computationally recover high-quality structural information. High-resolution microscopy can then be reserved for algorithm training and targeted validation, reducing acquisition time and improving overall experimental efficiency. This workflow supports a model in which shared imaging facilities provide access to advanced instrumentation without requiring individual research groups to procure dedicated high-end systems. Together, our results establish deep learning-enabled modality transfer as a practical strategy for bridging independent microscopy systems and supporting scalable, high-content imaging workflows.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于生成对抗网络（GAN）的跨仪器模态转移方法，将快速宽场荧光显微镜获取的低质量图像转换为与共聚焦显微镜相当的高质量表示，从而在不牺牲图像质量的前提下实现高通量成像。该方法在独立物理分离的宽场和共聚焦显微镜配准数据集上训练，证明图像质量可在不同仪器间可靠转移，支持高通量成像与计算质量恢复的工作流程。
Motivation: 高通量成像受限于采集速度与图像质量之间的权衡：快速成像模态（如宽场荧光显微镜）可大规模采集但对比度和分辨率低，而高分辨率技术（如共聚焦）质量高但通量低且仪器耗时。现有方法通常需要专用硬件或依赖单一仪器，缺乏跨仪器通用性。
Method: 采用基于GAN的模型，在物理分离的宽场和共聚焦显微镜上采集配准数据集进行训练，实现从低质量宽场图像到高质量共聚焦图像的模态转换。
Result: 摘要表明该方法能够可靠地将图像质量从快速成像系统转移到先进成像平台，在独立仪器上验证了质量转移的有效性，支持在高通量条件下计算恢复高质量结构信息。
Conclusion: 深度学习驱动的模态转移可作为桥接独立显微镜系统的实用策略，支持可扩展的高内涵成像工作流，使共享成像设施能提供高级仪器访问而不需各研究组自购专用设备。

papers.title: Saving the legacy of Hero Ibash: Evaluating Four Language Models for Aminoacian
papers.abstract_en: This study assesses four cutting-edge language models in the underexplored Aminoacian language. Through evaluation, it scrutinizes their adaptability, effectiveness, and limitations in text generation, semantic coherence, and contextual understanding. Uncovering insights into these models' performance in a low-resourced language, this research pioneers pathways to bridge linguistic gaps. By offering benchmarks and understanding challenges, it lays groundwork for future advancements in natural language processing, aiming to elevate the applicability of language models in similar linguistic landscapes, marking a significant step toward inclusivity and progress in language technology.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估四种前沿语言模型在低资源语言Aminoacian上的文本生成、语义连贯性和上下文理解能力，旨在揭示其在低资源语言中的适应性与局限性，为未来自然语言处理研究提供基准和挑战。

papers.title: EAR-Net: Pursuing End-to-End Absolute Rotations from Multi-View Images
papers.abstract_en: Absolute rotation estimation is an important topic in 3D computer vision. Existing works in literature generally employ a multi-stage (at least two-stage) estimation strategy where multiple independent operations (feature matching, two-view rotation estimation, and rotation averaging) are implemented sequentially. However, such a multi-stage strategy inevitably leads to the accumulation of the errors caused by each involved operation, and degrades its final estimation on global rotations accordingly. To address this problem, we propose an End-to-end method for estimating Absolution Rotations from multi-view images based on deep neural Networks, called EAR-Net. The proposed EAR-Net consists of an epipolar confidence graph construction module and a confidence-aware rotation averaging module. The epipolar confidence graph construction module is explored to simultaneously predict pairwise relative rotations among the input images and their corresponding confidences, resulting in a weighted graph (called epipolar confidence graph). Based on this graph, the confidence-aware rotation averaging module, which is differentiable, is explored to predict the absolute rotations. Thanks to the introduced confidences of the relative rotations, the proposed EAR-Net could effectively handle outlier cases. Experimental results on three public datasets demonstrate that EAR-Net outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by a large margin in terms of accuracy and speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多视图绝对旋转估计中多阶段策略导致误差累积的问题，提出端到端的EAR-Net。该方法包含极线置信图构建模块和可微的置信度感知旋转平均模块，通过同时预测相对旋转及其置信度来构建加权图，从而直接估计绝对旋转。实验表明，在多个公开数据集上，EAR-Net在精度和速度上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有绝对旋转估计通常采用多阶段（至少两阶段）策略，依次进行特征匹配、两视图旋转估计和旋转平均，各阶段独立操作导致误差累积，影响最终估计精度。
Method: 提出EAR-Net，包含两个模块：1) 极线置信图构建模块，同时预测输入图像对间的相对旋转和对应置信度，形成加权图；2) 置信度感知旋转平均模块，基于该图以可微方式预测绝对旋转，利用相对旋转的置信度有效处理异常值。
Result: 在三个公开数据集上的实验表明，EAR-Net在精度和速度上均大幅超越现有最优方法。
Conclusion: 端到端框架通过引入相对旋转的置信度，避免了多阶段误差累积，为多视图绝对旋转估计提供了一种高效且鲁棒的解决方案。

papers.title: IBoxCLA: Towards Robust Box-supervised Segmentation of Polyp via Improved Box-dice and Contrastive Latent-anchors
papers.abstract_en: Box-supervised polyp segmentation attracts increasing attention for its cost-effective potential. Existing solutions often rely on learning-free methods or pretrained models to laboriously generate pseudo masks, triggering Dice constraint subsequently. In this paper, we found that a model guided by the simplest box-filled masks can accurately predict polyp locations/sizes, but suffers from shape collapsing. In response, we propose two innovative learning fashions, Improved Box-dice (IBox) and Contrastive Latent-Anchors (CLA), and combine them to train a robust box-supervised model IBoxCLA. The core idea behind IBoxCLA is to decouple the learning of location/size and shape, allowing for focused constraints on each of them. Specifically, IBox transforms the segmentation map into a proxy map using shape decoupling and confusion-region swapping sequentially. Within the proxy map, shapes are disentangled, while locations/sizes are encoded as box-like responses. By constraining the proxy map instead of the raw prediction, the box-filled mask can well supervise IBoxCLA without misleading its shape learning. Furthermore, CLA contributes to shape learning by generating two types of latent anchors, which are learned and updated using momentum and segmented polyps to steadily represent polyp and background features. The latent anchors facilitate IBoxCLA to capture discriminative features within and outside boxes in a contrastive manner, yielding clearer boundaries. We benchmark IBoxCLA on five public polyp datasets. The experimental results demonstrate the competitive performance of IBoxCLA compared to recent fully-supervised polyp segmentation methods, and its superiority over other box-supervised state-of-the-arts with a relative increase of overall mDice and mIoU by at least 6.5% and 7.5%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对盒监督息肉分割中模型形状学习崩溃的问题，提出改进型盒Dice（IBox）和对比潜在锚点（CLA）两种创新学习方式，并组合成IBoxCLA模型。IBox通过形状解耦和混淆区域交换将分割图转换为代理图，CLA利用动量更新的潜在锚点进行对比学习，从而在五个公开息肉数据集上达到接近全监督方法的性能，且相对其他盒监督方法mDice和mIoU分别提升至少6.5%和7.5%。
Motivation: 现有盒监督息肉分割方法依赖无学习或预训练模型生成伪掩码，且模型在简单盒填充掩码引导下能准确定位但形状易坍塌，缺乏有效解耦位置/大小与形状学习的机制。
Method: 提出IBox（通过形状解耦和混淆区域交换将分割图转为代理图，约束位置/大小而不误导形状）和CLA（利用动量更新的潜在锚点进行对比学习，捕获盒内外判别特征），两者结合组成IBoxCLA模型。
Result: 在五个公开息肉数据集上，IBoxCLA与近期全监督方法性能相当，且相比其他盒监督方法，整体mDice和mIoU相对提升至少6.5%和7.5%。
Conclusion: 通过解耦位置/大小与形状学习，结合改进的盒Dice约束和对比潜在锚点，可有效训练鲁棒的盒监督息肉分割模型。

papers.title: Bayesian inference of composition-dependent phase diagrams
papers.abstract_en: Phase diagrams serve as a highly informative tool for materials design, encapsulating information about the phases that a material can manifest under specific conditions. In this work, we develop a method in which Bayesian inference is employed to combine thermodynamic data from molecular dynamics (MD), melting point simulations, and phonon calculations, process these data, and yield a temperature-concentration phase diagram. The employed Bayesian framework yields not only the free energies of different phases as functions of temperature and concentration but also the uncertainties of these free energies originating from statistical errors inherent to finite-length MD trajectories. Furthermore, it extrapolates the results of the finite-atom calculations to the infinite-atom limit and facilitates the choice of temperature, chemical potentials, and the number of atoms conducting the next simulation with which will be the most efficient in reducing the uncertainty of the phase diagram. The developed algorithm was successfully tested on two binary systems, Ge-Si and K-Na, in the full range of concentrations and temperatures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一种贝叶斯推断方法，结合分子动力学、熔点和声子计算数据，构建温度-浓度相图，并给出自由能的不确定性。该方法在Ge-Si和K-Na二元系统中成功验证，能够外推到无限原子极限并指导后续模拟。
Motivation: 传统的相图构建依赖大量实验或单一计算方法，难以有效处理来自不同热力学数据源的不确定性。
Method: 贝叶斯推断框架融合MD、熔点模拟和声子计算数据，估计各相自由能及其统计不确定性，并外推到无限原子极限，同时优化后续模拟条件以最大程度降低相图不确定性。
Result: 在Ge-Si和K-Na两个二元体系中，该方法成功恢复了全浓度和温度范围内的相图，并量化了自由能的不确定性。
Conclusion: 贝叶斯推断能够有效整合多源热力学数据，提供带有不确定性的相图，并指导高效模拟策略。

papers.title: When Are Scoring Rules Proper? Bridging Theory and Practice in Survival Model Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Proper scoring rules encourage probabilistic predictions that match the true underlying distribution and are central to model evaluation, with increasing relevance in automated workflows such as AutoML. In survival analysis, however, their behavior under censoring is not fully understood. We study commonly used squared and logarithmic scoring rules for right-censored survival data under independent censoring, introducing a notion of marginal properness based on observable outcomes. Within this framework, we show that the SBS, evaluated at a fixed time point, along with its integrated version (ISBS) and the RCLL are strictly proper when all individuals eventually experience the event, but can become improper under finite follow-up or in the presence of cure fractions. For the SBS, we derive a closed-form expression that reveals the true mechanism: residual mass, corresponding to individuals who remain event-free at study end, systematically biases the score toward underestimating survival, with the effect increasing at later evaluation times and under heavier censoring. Through simulation experiments, we examine how these issues manifest in finite samples and under misspecification. The SBS exhibits pronounced improperness at late evaluation times and poor discrimination between models. The ISBS is more robust due to temporal integration but remains sensitive to tail regularity violations, exhibiting detectable improperness and reduced discriminatory power. The RCLL behaves consistently with strict properness and effectively separates misspecified models. Overall, our results demonstrate how theoretical improperness can translate into misleading model comparisons, underscoring the need for further methodological development in survival model evaluation under censoring and realistic data conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了右删失生存数据下常用平方和对数评分规则的适当性（properness）。在独立删失假设下，作者引入基于可观测结果的边际适当性概念，证明固定时间点的SBS及其积分版本（ISBS）和RCLL在所有人都经历事件时严格适当，但在有限随访或存在治愈比例时可能变得不适当。通过推导SBS的闭式表达式，揭示残差质量（residual mass）导致对生存概率的系统性低估，且效应在后期评估时间和高删失率下加剧。模拟实验表明SBS在后期时间点表现出明显不适当性和弱模型区分力，ISBS因时间积分更稳健但尾部不规则时仍有问题，RCLL则表现出一致严格适当性。
Motivation: 生存分析中删失条件下概率评分规则的适当性尚未被充分理解，这影响AutoML等自动化工作流中的模型评估可靠性。
Method: 定义基于可观测结果的边际适当性概念，推导固定时间点的SBS（及ISBS、RCLL）的适当性条件，并给出SBS闭式表达式以揭示偏差机制。通过模拟实验验证有限样本和模型误设定下的表现。
Result: SBS在后期评估时间点严重不适当且模型区分力差；ISBS更稳健但在尾部不规则时仍表现出可检测的不适当性和降低的区分力；RCLL始终保持严格适当性并能有效区分误设定模型。
Conclusion: 理论上的不适当性会在实际中导致误导性的模型比较，强调在删失和现实数据条件下进一步开发生存模型评估方法的必要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Internet-of-Things Architectures for Secure Cyber-Physical Spaces: the VISOR Experience Report
papers.abstract_en: Internet of things (IoT) technologies are becoming a more and more widespread part of civilian life in common urban spaces, which are rapidly turning into cyber-physical spaces. Simultaneously, the fear of terrorism and crime in such public spaces is ever-increasing. Due to the resulting increased demand for security, video-based IoT surveillance systems have become an important area for research. Considering the large number of devices involved in the illicit recognition task, we conducted a field study in a Dutch Easter music festival in a national interest project called VISOR to select the most appropriate device configuration in terms of performance and results. We iteratively architected solutions for the security of cyber-physical spaces using IoT devices. We tested the performance of multiple federated devices encompassing drones, closed-circuit television, smart phone cameras, and smart glasses to detect real-case scenarios of potentially malicious activities such as mosh-pits and pick-pocketing. Our results pave the way to select optimal IoT architecture configurations -- i.e., a mix of CCTV, drones, smart glasses, and camera phones in our case -- to make safer cyber-physical spaces' a reality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告VISOR项目在荷兰复活节音乐节上的现场研究，测试多种IoT设备（无人机、CCTV、智能手机、智能眼镜）组合用于检测公共场所的恶意活动（如mosh pits和扒窃），以选择最优的架构配置来保障网络物理空间安全。
Motivation: 公共空间向网络物理空间转变，对安全的担忧增加，需要有效的视频监控IoT系统。
Method: 在真实的音乐节环境中进行现场研究，迭代架构设计方案，测试多种设备组合的性能。
Result: 获得了选择最优IoT架构配置（如CCTV、无人机、智能眼镜和手机摄像头的混合）的经验基础。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过实际部署测试可以为更安全的网络物理空间提供指导。

papers.title: GQD-AdsNet: Graph Neural Networks Unlock Rapid Exploration of Transition Metal Adsorption on Graphene Quantum Dots
authors: Paola Quaino (1) ((1) Instituto de Química Aplicada del Litoral IQAL (UNL-CONICET) Santa Fe Argentina
Sistemas e Inteligencia Computacional sinc (i) (UNL-CONICET) Santa Fe Argentina
(3) General Chemistry (ALGC) Materials Modelling Group Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB)
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, interest in single-atom catalysts supported on carbon-based structures has grown considerably due to their high catalytic activity and efficient uses of metal atoms. However, the design and characterization of these materials through first-principles calculations are computationally expensive, limiting the exploration of a large number of possible configurations. Here, we developed a framework based on graph neural networks (GNNs) to predict the adsorption energies of transition metals on graphene quantum dots (GQDs). The model was trained using data obtained from density functional theory calculations and achieved an $R^2$ of 0.906 with an MAE of 0.101 eV, while reducing computational cost by roughly six orders of magnitude relative to DFT. This methodology provides an efficient tool for the accelerated screening and rational design of new catalysts based on carbon nanostructures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于图神经网络（GNN）开发了一个框架，用于预测过渡金属在石墨烯量子点（GQD）上的吸附能。模型使用密度泛函理论（DFT）数据训练，达到R²=0.906、MAE=0.101 eV，计算成本比DFT降低约6个数量级，为碳纳米结构催化剂的高通量筛选和理性设计提供了高效工具。
Motivation: 基于第一性原理计算设计单原子催化剂计算成本高，限制了大量构型的探索，需要更高效的预测方法。
Method: 构建了基于图神经网络（GNN）的预测框架，使用DFT计算数据训练模型来预测过渡金属在石墨烯量子点上的吸附能。
Result: 模型达到R²=0.906，MAE=0.101 eV，计算成本比DFT降低约6个数量级。
Conclusion: 该工作为碳纳米结构催化剂的高通量筛选和理性设计提供了高效的计算工具，有望加速新型催化剂的发现。

papers.title: Planning as Emergent Behavior in Reinforcement Learning with Relational Hidden States
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is conventionally divided into model-based and model-free methods. In this taxonomy, model-based methods perform lookahead planning over a learned world model, whereas model-free methods learn a reactive state-action mapping. Recent work, however, has shown that planning can emerge from model-free reinforcement learning alone. The conditions under which this behavior emerges from a pure reward-maximization objective have so far remained unclear. In this paper, we present evidence that, in the observed cases, the hidden-state structure of the neural architecture is the deciding factor. We find that a network of relational hidden states, each anchored to an environment state and exchanging messages along learned relations, acquires a planning mechanism. These hidden states recover the environment's transition structure in their learned relations, and improve the policy at decision time by planning over the learned graph. In a matched control agent that must additionally discover which cells represent which states, no such binding arises, and no planning follows from it. We argue that this explains the observed phenomenon of emergent planning in model-free reinforcement learning and raises the question of how common such emergent planning might be more generally. Finally, we hypothesize that the discovered mechanism could describe how planning emerges from pure reward maximization in the human brain through a neural architectural prior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究模型无关强化学习中规划行为涌现的条件，发现神经架构中关系隐藏状态（relational hidden states）的结构是关键因素。具有关系隐藏状态的网络，每个隐藏状态锚定一个环境状态并通过学习到的关系交换消息，能够习得规划机制，恢复环境的转移结构并改善策略。相比之下，控制智能体无法实现这种绑定，因此没有规划涌现。作者认为这解释了模型无关强化学习中规划涌现的现象，并推测人类大脑中可能通过神经架构先验从纯奖励最大化中产生规划。
Motivation: 模型无关强化学习中规划行为涌现的条件尚不清楚，本文旨在揭示其背后的决定因素。
Method: 通过对比具有关系隐藏状态的网络与需要自行发现状态绑定的控制智能体，分析隐藏状态结构对规划涌现的作用。
Result: 关系隐藏状态能够恢复环境转移结构，并在决策时通过学习到的图进行规划，从而提升策略；而控制智能体没有出现绑定和规划。
Conclusion: 关系隐藏状态的结构是模型无关强化学习中规划涌现的关键，并提出了关于人类大脑中规划涌现机制的假设。

papers.title: On the Diverse Dynamical Behaviors Arising in Deep Linear Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We study the inference-time behavior of deep linear encoder-only transformers through the lens of interacting particle systems. In this perspective, tokens are modeled as particles that interact dynamically through successive linear self-attention layers. We show that in embedding dimension two, for any key, query, and value matrices, the dynamics can be reformulated as a generalized Kuramoto-type model with pure second-harmonic coupling. This formulation is amenable to Watanabe--Strogatz theory which reveals the dynamics are intrinsically low-dimensional regardless of the parameter matrices. For a class of token initializations associated with the Ott--Antonsen (OA) manifold, we show that the parameter matrices induce a diverse variety of long-time behaviors in linear transformers, including clustering, oscillations, and bifurcations. The oscillations and bifurcations are characterized by uncovering a hidden Hamiltonian structure in the dynamics. By establishing a structural stability result, we further show that dynamics initialized near the OA manifold exhibit the same long-time behavior as those initialized exactly on the manifold. Motivated by our theory in dimension two, we conduct numerical experiments for analogous parameter regimes in higher-dimensional transformers. Our numerical experiments suggest that the long-time behaviors characterized in our theoretical results persist in higher dimensions.

Motivation: 现有对深度线性变换器的动态行为理解不足，特别是其在推理时的长期演化模式尚未被系统刻画。
Method: 将令牌视为粒子，通过线性自注意力层交互，利用Kuramoto型模型和Watanabe-Strogatz理论简化分析，并引入哈密顿结构解释振荡与分岔。
Result: 理论证明在嵌入维数为二时，动态可降维至低维系统，并展示聚类、振荡和分岔行为；结构稳定性结果保证OA流形附近初始化与流形上初始化行为一致；高维数值实验验证了这些行为的普遍性。

papers.title: Attention Without Grounding: Causal Evaluation of Visual Explanations in Medical VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Attention and saliency heatmaps are widely used to explain medical Vision-Language Model (VLM) outputs on chest X-rays, yet whether they truly highlight the image evidence driving predictions has not been causally tested. We audit faithfulness via overlap with radiologist bounding boxes on PadChest (n=637), attribution mass within radiologist masks on CheXlocalize (n=643), and 16x16 patch-occlusion maps that record which regions, when hidden, change the answer. We study three MedGemma-4B variants, cross-family probes on LLaVA-RAD and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and the specialist CheXagent-2-3b, with two CXR-trained classifiers (DenseNet121, ResNet50) as positive controls. A heatmap is faithful only if the model uses the image and attention concentrates on regions whose occlusion alters the prediction. No evaluated VLM meets both criteria. MedGemma and Qwen3-VL use the image, but attention anti-correlates with patch-occlusion importance (rho < 0 with 95% bootstrap CIs below zero). LLaVA-RAD's attention correlates positively, but the model is almost text-only (99.1% text-only agreement, near-zero causal mass), so correlation ties two near-zero signals. Attention also misses annotated anatomy: overlap with true regions never beats shifted or random controls, and no method places more than 22% of its mass inside radiologist masks. The two CXR classifiers pass all metrics, indicating the failure is specific to VLM heatmaps, not the evaluation. These heatmaps are visually reassuring but not faithful; clinical explanations require controlled localization metrics and causal perturbation, not visual inspection alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对医学视觉语言模型（VLM）在胸部X光片上的注意力/显著性热图进行因果评估，发现这些热图在验证忠诚度方面存在严重缺陷：热图与边界框/遮挡重要性相关性低，且模型实际依赖图像的程度有限。
Motivation: 虽然注意力热图被广泛用于解释医学VLM输出，但其是否真正突出驱动预测的图像证据从未经过因果检验。
Method: 通过三种度量评估：（1）与放射科医生边界框的重叠（PadChest）；（2）热图质量在放射科医生掩膜内的分布（CheXlocalize）；（3）16x16分块遮挡映射，记录隐藏特定区域后预测的变化。研究了多个VLM模型（MedGemma、LLaVA-RAD、Qwen3-VL、CheXagent）及两个专用CXR分类器作为阳性对照。
Result: 所有评估的VLM均未满足忠诚度标准：热图与遮挡重要性呈负相关（rho<0, 95% CI<0），或热图几乎不反映模型实际依赖的图像区域（如LLaVA-RAD几乎仅依赖文本，99.1%文本一致性）。热图未能比随机/移位对照更好地定位真实病灶区域，且热图质量最多只有22%集中在放射科医生掩膜内。CXR分类器通过所有指标，表明失败是VLM特有的。
Conclusion: 当前医学VLM的注意力热图仅提供视觉安慰而非真实解释，临床解释需要受控的定位指标和因果扰动，不能仅依赖视觉检查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Text-conditioned Segmentation for Tomato Phenotyping via Procedural Synthetic Data
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based automation is an excellent candidate for reducing manual labor in greenhouse crop production and phenotyping. However, progress is constrained by the lack of annotated training data. Recent advances in vision-based foundational models have shown promising results in zero-shot generalization to novel domains, but their performance drops in complex agricultural environments. In this work, we present a sim-to-real framework for tomato plant segmentation that combines synthetic data generation with fine-tuning of a foundation model. We model a commercial cherry tomato greenhouse and use it to generate a large-scale synthetic dataset under diverse viewpoints, lighting conditions, and plant morphology. Subsequently, we fine-tune the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) on the synthetic dataset, specializing its text-conditioned segmentation behavior for greenhouse crop organs while retaining the general visual prior that makes zero-shot transfer possible. By evaluating our framework on multiple real-world greenhouse datasets, we demonstrate that combining synthetic data with SAM 3 fine-tuning significantly improves segmentation performance and model confidence. To support community benchmarking, we publicly release the procedural model, the generated synthetic dataset, and our fine-tuned SAM 3 weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个从模拟到现实的番茄植株分割框架，通过合成数据生成和微调基础模型，在温室作物分割上提升性能。
Motivation: 视觉自动化在温室作物生产中有潜力，但缺乏标注训练数据，且现有基础模型在复杂农业环境中表现下降。
Method: 建模商业樱桃番茄温室并生成大规模合成数据集（不同视角、光照和形态），然后微调Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3)使其专门化文本条件分割，同时保留零样本泛化能力。
Result: 在多个真实温室数据集上评估，表明合成数据结合SAM 3微调显著提升了分割性能与模型置信度。
Conclusion: 公开了过程模型、合成数据集和微调模型权重，以支持社区基准测试。

papers.title: Conditioned Direct Feedback Alignment via Activity and Error Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Direct feedback alignment (DFA) trains hidden layers with fixed random projections of the output error, avoiding the transposed-weight backward pass of backpropagation (BP). We study a failure mode of DFA training that is distinct from feedback quality: the local weight update is calculated by an outer product, so anisotropy can enter through either its presynaptic-activity factor or its local-error factor. Our analyses with controlled synthetic regimes isolate the first failure mode and show an approximately 40-percentage-point activity-conditioning gain when high-variance directions contain task-irrelevant nuisance. Three clean confirmations isolate a different regime: error conditioning improves raw DFA by 1.77--7.53 percentage points, and combining independently selected activity and error factors adds 0.40--0.90 points over activity conditioning. The signs hold for tanh/one-vs-rest MNIST and preregistered Fashion-MNIST, and replicate on eight fresh seeds in a ReLU/softmax MNIST model. This factorization yields a symmetric block-local family of normalized DFA (nDFA): activity nDFA right-preconditions by an inverse activity second moment, error nDFA left-preconditions by an inverse local-error second moment, and K-nDFA applies both factors with separately tuned damping. A linearized post-alignment calculation gives an exact input-side spectral identity and a Kronecker-factor motivation for the two-sided rule, whereas norm matching rules out a scalar step-size explanation. The error factor is fragile when under-damped, BatchNorm is a strong activity-side alternative, and convnet gains remain partial. We therefore frame conditioned DFA as a factor-level study of when local outer-product rules fail, not as a general replacement for BP or a solution to all-layer convolutional credit assignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了直接反馈对齐（DFA）的一种失效模式，该模式源于局部权重更新的外积中活动因子或误差因子的各向异性。通过控制合成实验，作者分离了活动条件和误差条件的影响，并提出了归一化DFA（nDFA）家族，包括活动nDFA、误差nDFA和K-nDFA。实验表明，活动条件化可在高方差方向包含任务无关噪声时带来约40个百分点的增益，误差条件化可在原始DFA上提升1.77-7.53个百分点，两者组合可额外提升0.40-0.90个百分点。本文旨在解释局部外积规则何时失败，而非作为BP的通用替代。
Motivation: 直接反馈对齐（DFA）使用输出误差的固定随机投影训练隐藏层，但其训练可能因局部权重更新的外积中的各向异性而失败，这种各向异性可来自突触前活动因子或局部误差因子。本文旨在分离并分析这两种失效模式。
Method: 本文通过控制合成实验分离活动条件和误差条件的影响，提出了归一化DFA（nDFA）家族：活动nDFA通过逆活动二阶矩进行右预处理，误差nDFA通过逆局部误差二阶矩进行左预处理，K-nDFA同时应用两个因子并分别调节阻尼。还通过线性化后对齐计算给出了精确的输入侧谱恒等式和Kronecker因子动机。
Result: 活动条件化可在高方差方向包含任务无关噪声时带来约40个百分点的增益；误差条件化可在原始DFA上提升1.77-7.53个百分点；两者组合可额外提升0.40-0.90个百分点。结果在tanh/一对多MNIST和预注册的Fashion-MNIST上验证，并在ReLU/softmax MNIST模型上使用8个新种子复现。卷积网络上的增益仍不完整。
Conclusion: 本文将条件化DFA定位为因子层面的研究，解释局部外积规则何时失败，而非作为BP的通用替代或全层卷积信用分配问题的解决方案。

papers.title: When Does Machine Learning Beat Value Sorting? A Three-Dataset Diagnostic of Exposure-Weighted Shipment Prioritization
papers.abstract_en: Delay-risk models are usually judged by predictive accuracy. What matters in practice is narrower: with capacity to review only a few shipments, which ones should a manager check first? We evaluate whether machine learning clears a demanding no-model baseline: inspect the highest-value shipments first. Across three real supply-chain contexts: SCMS procurement, DataCo logistics, and Olist e-commerce, we use leakage-controlled rolling-origin evaluation and 1000-sample paired bootstrap confidence intervals. Ranking by predicted delay severity times known value (M1) beats severity-only ranking in all three datasets, yet it does not generally beat value sorting. At a 10% review budget, M1 minus VALUE_ONLY is -5.5 percentage points (pp) for SCMS, +10.1 pp for DataCo, and -4.9 pp for Olist. The divide is consistent with severity learnability: DataCo has R^2 = 0.27 and calibration bias of +0.01 days, whereas SCMS and Olist have R^2 of approximately -0.02 and negative calibration bias. Nested-CV cost-sensitive retraining does not deliver a stable improvement over M1. Rather than proposing a new learning algorithm, this paper presents a deployment diagnostic and evaluation protocol. Value sorting should remain a permanent benchmark, and ML should be deployed only after severity learnability and calibration have been audited and the model clears that gate under leakage-controlled rolling-origin evaluation.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables, accepted for presentation at AIIIP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了机器学习在运输优先级排序中是否优于简单的按价值排序基线。通过三个真实供应链数据集（SCMS、DataCo、Olist）的泄漏控制滚动起源评估和配对bootstrap置信区间，发现按预测延误严重程度乘以已知价值排序（M1）虽优于仅按严重程度排序，但不普遍优于按价值排序（VALUE_ONLY）。在10%审查预算下，M1在DataCo上提升+10.1个百分点，在SCMS和Olist上分别下降-5.5和-4.9个百分点。差异与严重程度可学习性（R²和校准偏差）一致。
Motivation: 延迟风险模型通常以预测精度评判，但实践中更关键的是：在仅能审查少量货物时，经理应优先检查哪些？现有基线（按价值排序）虽简单却强效，ML模型需证明其超越此基线才有部署价值。
Method: 采用三个供应链数据集（SCMS、DataCo、Olist），使用泄漏控制的滚动起源评估和1000样本配对bootstrap置信区间。比较排序策略：按预测延迟严重性乘以已知价值（M1）、仅按严重性、仅按价值（VALUE_ONLY），并测试嵌套交叉验证的成本敏感重新训练。
Result: M1在所有三个数据集中均优于仅按严重性排序，但仅在DataCo上优于VALUE_ONLY（+10.1 pp），在SCMS和Olist上分别差-5.5 pp和-4.9 pp。性能差异与严重程度可学习性一致：DataCo的R²=0.27、校准偏差+0.01天，而SCMS和Olist的R²≈-0.02、负校准偏差。嵌套CV成本敏感重新训练未带来稳定改进。
Conclusion: 价值排序应作为永久基准，ML模型仅在严重程度可学习性和校准通过审计（在泄漏控制的滚动起源评估下）后才应部署。本文不提出新算法，而是提供部署诊断和评估协议。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 价值排序应作为永久基准，ML模型仅在严重程度可学习性和校准通过审计（在泄漏控制的滚动起源评估下）后才应部署。本文不提出新算法，而是提供部署诊断和评估协议。

papers.title: For What Reason? Interpreting Models' Encoding of Causation and Antithesis
papers.abstract_en: Discourse relations provide document structure, critical to language understanding and enabling language model performance and ethicality. In this work, we investigate how instruction-tuned Transformer models (LLaMA and Mistral) encode discourse relations in English, with a particular focus on the contrasting relations of causation and antithesis. Framing the task as a next-token prediction task and applying a suite of interpretability techniques to test model internals, our findings show that certain early layers make predictive decisions at mid-sequence tokens, while some mid-level layers finalize their decisions closer to the last token. Most of the remaining layers primarily propagate earlier decisions rather than actively influencing them. Additionally, we observe that some layers exhibit a preference for one answer over alternatives, suggesting asymmetric representation of discourse-based reasoning.\footnote{Our code is available at https://github.com/abhidipbhattacharyya/causation_vs_antithesis}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究指令微调后的 Transformer 模型（LLaMA 和 Mistral）如何编码英语话语关系，重点关注因果（causation）和对立（antithesis）两种关系。通过下一个 token 预测任务和一套可解释性技术，发现早期层在中序列 token 做出预测决策，中期层在最后 token 附近决策，其余层主要传播早期决策。部分层显示出对某一答案的偏好，表明话语推理存在不对称表示。
Motivation: 话语关系为文档提供结构，对语言理解以及模型性能和伦理性至关重要。但模型内部如何编码这些关系尚不明确，尤其是因果和对立关系的差异。
Method: 将话语关系建模为下一个 token 预测任务，对 LLaMA 和 Mistral 模型应用探针、激活分析等可解释性技术，测试不同层的决策时间点和偏好。
Result: 早期层在中序列 token 做出预测决策；中期层在最后 token 附近才最终确定；大部分层主要传播先行层的决策；某些层对特定答案有偏好，揭示不对称表示。
Conclusion: 模型在不同层次上话语关系推理的决策时机和不对称性表明，话语结构编码并非均匀分布，这对模型解释和公平性有启示。

papers.title: AMICA-Python: Adaptive Mixture Independent Component Analysis with Anderson Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive Mixture Independent Component Analysis (AMICA) is widely used in EEG research and has long been associated with strong empirical performance for blind source separation. Despite its impact, practical use has historically depended on a single Fortran implementation, accessed via the EEGLAB toolbox for MATLAB, limiting its accessibility for analytical pipelines not designed within the MATLAB ecosystem. Here we present AMICA-Python, a Python implementation of the AMICA algorithm, with a scikit-learn-conformant API designed for integration with existing scientific Python pipelines. The implementation follows the reference algorithm closely while adopting modern software engineering practices and an interface familiar to Python users. Additionally, we introduce an optional Anderson acceleration scheme that can dramatically reduce the time to convergence for this relatively slow algorithm. To evaluate numerical agreement and practical performance, we benchmarked AMICA-Python against the reference Fortran implementation on 14 open EEG recordings. After averaging 3 runs of each implementation on all 14 recordings, AMICA-Python closely matched the reference, with a median final normalized log-likelihoods of 11.572 for both the Fortran and Python implementations, and a negligible median relative absolute difference of only $1.07\times10^{-8}$ when normalized by the absolute Fortran value. Runtime was also competitive. Relative to the reference implementation, AMICA-Python was 17.7\% faster, while the Anderson-accelerated variant was 34.1\% faster. AMICA-Python reproduces the reference implementation to high numerical precision with competitive runtime, while making AMICA available through a more accessible and extensible Python interface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AMICA-Python是Adaptive Mixture Independent Component Analysis (AMICA)算法的Python实现，提供符合scikit-learn规范的API，支持与科学Python生态集成。该实现紧密遵循参考Fortran代码，并引入了可选的Anderson加速方案，显著减少收敛时间。在14个开放EEG数据集上，AMICA-Python与参考实现的中位数最终归一化对数似然均为11.572，相对绝对差异仅1.07×10⁻⁸；运行时比Fortran版快17.7%，Anderson加速版快34.1%。
Motivation: AMICA在EEG盲源分离中表现优异，但此前仅依赖于MATLAB/EEGLAB中的Fortran实现，限制了非MATLAB生态系统的可访问性和可扩展性。
Method: 提出AMICA-Python：用Python重写AMICA算法，提供scikit-learn风格API，并可选引入Anderson加速（Anderson acceleration）以加快收敛。
Result: 在14个开放EEG记录上，AMICA-Python与Fortran参考的中位数最终归一化对数似然均为11.572，相对绝对差异1.07×10⁻⁸；运行时比Fortran版快17.7%，Anderson加速版快34.1%。
Conclusion: AMICA-Python以高数值精度复现了参考实现，运行时具有竞争力，并通过Python接口提升了算法的可访问性和可扩展性。

papers.title: Attacking Graph Foundation Models Through Their Shared Representation
papers.abstract_en: A graph foundation model generalizes across graph domains by mapping every input into one shared representation before any task reasoning. We call this map the alignment layer, the component that separates a graph foundation model from a graph neural network, and we show it is a distinct attack surface that prior work has not studied. We attack it at inference time, with no access to training, on six public models spanning spectral tokenizers, text embedding spaces, and a discrete codebook. A directed representation-space perturbation collapses every model, but at a budget comparable to the representation norm a plain graph network also needs, with one exception: OpenGraph, whose spectral tokenizer collapses at a fifth of that budget, an alignment-specific fragility a plain network does not share and which a same-representation control traces to the tokenizer rather than the decoder. A realizable input-space attack that edits edges, features, or text removes at least half the correct predictions on three of the six models at peak. How much of this fragility an input-access attacker realizes tracks how directly the decoder reads the representation, and not the clean accuracy a task leaves; we measure this carrier gain structurally from the decoder's local Lipschitz sensitivity, and report clean-accuracy headroom as a within-model ordering heuristic that does not survive on realizable attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究图基础模型（GFM）中的对齐层（alignment layer）作为攻击面，在推理时对共享表征进行扰动，发现模型存在脆弱性，尤其是OpenGraph的谱分词器所需预算仅为普通图网络的五分之一。攻击可移除多个模型的大部分正确预测。
Motivation: 现有攻击研究未关注图基础模型中的对齐层这一独特攻击面。
Method: 在推理时，无训练访问权限下，对六个公开模型（包括谱分词器、文本嵌入空间、离散码本）进行表征空间扰动攻击和可实现输入空间攻击。
Result: 定向表征空间扰动能使所有模型崩溃，其中OpenGraph的谱分词器所需预算仅为普通网络的五分之一。输入空间攻击（编辑边、特征或文本）在峰值时对六个模型中的三个移除至少一半正确预测。
Conclusion: 攻击有效性取决于解码器直接读取表征的程度，而非任务准确率；通过解码器的局部Lipschitz敏感度测量载体增益，但clean-accuracy头排序在可实现攻击中不成立。

papers.title: The Story Shapes the Agent: Narrative Priors in LLM Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Persona prompting is widely used to steer LLM agent behavior, yet the narrative framing of a task can matter more than the assigned persona. We isolate this effect through structural isomorphism, constructing three text-based investigation games that share the same action space, stage progression, and resource constraints while varying only task narrative: disease investigation, IT troubleshooting, and murder mystery. Across 1,890 sessions spanning 3 models and 10 personas, we identify narrative priors: systematic action tendencies activated by a task's story framing, independent of its decision structure. Narrative priors explain 5-31x more behavioral variance than persona, are consistent across model architectures, and in two of three domains are negatively associated with task success. Persona effects that do transfer across narratives arise from behavioral anchors, persona descriptions whose language maps directly onto shared actions. Causal interventions confirm this: removing anchor words from a high-transfer persona reduces cross-narrative consistency by 95%. Our framework also generalizes to a held-out fourth narrative and yields a persona-selection method that improves cross-narrative transfer. These results suggest that LLM behavior that survives narrative changes should be grounded in concrete actions rather than abstract descriptions.
papers.comment: Accepted at COLM 2026. 10 pages, 3 figures, 16 tables in appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过结构同构的文本游戏（疾病调查、IT故障排查、谋杀谜案）发现，叙事框架对LLM行为的影响远超角色提示（persona prompting）。叙事先验（narrative priors）解释的行为方差是角色的5-31倍，且与任务成功负相关。因果干预显示，去除高迁移角色中的锚定词可减少95%的跨叙事一致性。
Motivation: 角色提示被广泛用于引导LLM行为，但任务叙事框架的影响可能更大，需量化其独立贡献及与角色的交互。
Method: 构建三个动作空间、阶段推进和资源约束相同但叙事不同的文本游戏，进行1890次会话（3个模型、10个角色），分析叙事先验和角色效应，并通过去除锚定词进行因果干预。
Result: 叙事先验解释的行为方差是角色的5-31倍，跨模型一致且在两个领域与任务成功负相关。去除高迁移角色中的锚定词后，跨叙事一致性下降95%。
Conclusion: LLM行为中跨叙事稳定的部分应基于具体行动而非抽象描述，为角色选择提供新方法。

papers.title: Robust Multi-View Classification under Noisy Supervision via Global Anchor Consensus
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, multi-view learning has attracted increasing attention, as it integrates the complementary information of heterogeneous views. Most existing multi-view classification methods rely on accurate annotations to guarantee performance. However, noisy labels are ubiquitous in practice due to imperfect annotation, and the refinement signals that existing methods derive from models trained on such noisy supervision can gradually lose their reliability. To deal with this problem, we propose a novel Global Anchor-based Label Auditing method (GALA) for multi-view classification to resist the negative impact of noisy labels. Specifically, we construct a global anchor for each class in every view, which aggregates the samples of the whole class and thus offers a stable reference insensitive to individual predictions. Then, each view measures how close an instance is to the anchor of its observed label relative to the nearest competing anchor, and the per-view evaluations are fused with the classifier confidence into a cross-view audit score. Based on the audit scores, suspicious samples are assigned small weights, and an adaptive correction strategy rewrites a label only when the anchor-based candidate agrees with the classifier prediction. Finally, the corrected labels in turn refine the anchors and supervise noise-robust representation learning. Extensive experiments on six datasets demonstrate that GALA outperforms eight state-of-the-art methods, especially under high noise rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多视图分类中标签噪声问题，提出全局锚点标签审计方法 (GALA)。该方法为每个类在每个视图构建全局锚点，利用跨视图审计分数识别噪声样本并自适应修正标签，最终实现鲁棒表示学习。实验表明GALA在六个数据集上优于八种现有方法，尤其在高噪声率下。
Motivation: 现有多视图分类方法依赖准确标注，但实际中标签噪声普遍存在，且从噪声监督中获取的精炼信号会逐渐失去可靠性。
Method: 提出GALA方法：为每个视图的每个类构建全局锚点，聚合全类样本以提供稳定参考；基于实例与观测标签锚点及最近竞争锚点的距离计算每视图评估，并与分类器置信度融合得到跨视图审计分数；根据分数降低可疑样本权重，当锚点候选与分类器预测一致时才修正标签；修正后的标签反向优化锚点并监督鲁棒表示学习。
Result: 在六个数据集上的实验表明，GALA在分类性能上优于八种现有方法，尤其在高噪声率下表现显著。
Conclusion: 全局锚点提供对个体预测不敏感的稳定参考，结合跨视图审计与自适应标签修正，可有效抵抗多视图分类中的噪声标签影响。

papers.title: Mixing-Free and Signal-Optimal Learning of Gaussian Graphical Models from Glauber Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian graphical model selection is usually studied under independent sampling, but in many applications the data arise as a single trajectory of a dependent stochastic process. We study exact recovery of the graph from one trajectory of random-scan Gaussian Glauber dynamics. Existing techniques for this problem either inherit the mixing time of the chain, which can be super-polynomial in the dimension $p$ without strong assumptions, or are suboptimal in the minimum normalized edge strength $κ$. We propose two algorithms that are mixing-free and attain the $κ^{-2}$ dependence of the information-theoretic lower bounds. Both instantiate a shared dueling-neighborhood search meta-algorithm with a local statistic built directly from the update sequence. The first fits a least-squares regression at the updates of each node and recovers the graph from $\widetilde O(pd^{2}/κ^{2})$ updates, where $d$ is the maximum degree. This algorithm's data requirement depends on a local conditioning quantity, but only logarithmically and is provably optimal even when the underlying chain mixes slowly. The second algorithm is based on counting occurences of a specific update pattern and requires $\widetilde O(pd^{4}/κ^{2})$ updates, with no dependence on any condition number. The central technical challenge is that both statistics are built from dependent, non-stationary observations. Our analysis tackles this by demonstrating how to extract fresh Gaussian innovations from the update sequence, which yields mixing-free control of appropriate quantities. Neither the algorithms nor their analyses invoke stationarity, a spectral gap, or mixing conditions, and all guarantees hold from an arbitrary initialization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从单个随机扫描高斯Glauber动力学轨迹中精确恢复图结构的问题。现有方法依赖链的混合时间（无强假设下可能超多项式）或在最小归一化边强度κ上次优。作者提出两种不依赖于混合时间的算法，达到信息论下界κ^{-2}依赖。第一种算法基于最小二乘回归，需要	ilde O(p d^2 / κ^2)次更新；第二种基于计数特定更新模式，需要	ilde O(p d^4 / κ^2)次更新，且不依赖条件数。分析从依赖非平稳观测中提取高斯新息，无需平稳性、谱间隙或混合条件。
Motivation: 高斯图模型选择通常在独立采样下研究，但许多应用中数据来自依赖随机过程的单条轨迹。现有方法要么依赖混合时间（可能超多项式），要么在最小边强度κ上次优。
Method: 提出两种不依赖混合时间的算法：第一种在每次节点更新时拟合最小二乘回归恢复图；第二种基于计数特定更新模式。两者均使用从更新序列构建的局部统计量，并通过提取高斯新息来应对依赖非平稳观测。
Result: 第一种算法需要	ilde O(p d^2 / κ^2)次更新，数据要求仅对数依赖于局部条件量，即使链混合慢也最优；第二种算法需要	ilde O(p d^4 / κ^2)次更新，无条件数依赖。
Conclusion: 算法和分析均不依赖平稳性、谱间隙或混合条件，且保证对任意初始值成立。

papers.title: Scalable Policy Optimization for Networked Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Continuous State-Action Spaces
papers.abstract_en: We develop the Continuous Distributed Coupled Policy Gradient (CDCPG) algorithm for cooperative reinforcement learning in networked Markov decision processes with continuous state and action spaces. Each agent maintains a local actor over a bounded graph neighborhood, and a localized least-squares temporal-difference critic evaluates a truncated action-value function through a spectral random-feature representation of the local transition kernel. The analysis makes four contributions. First, the truncated action-value function is constructed as a conditional expectation over the neighborhood, yielding a well-posed localized Bellman theory that removes the continuation-kernel mismatch of naive truncation arguments. Second, we expose a dimensional obstruction to temporal-difference stability for normalized random features and prove an unconditional excitation bound that reduces stability to a symmetric persistence-of-excitation condition, monitorable through an online matrix-concentration certificate. Third, under exponential spatial decay of agent interactions, the excitation condition, and smoothness of the objective, CDCPG drives an averaged per-agent stationarity measure to within any excess $ε$ of an explicitly characterized approximation floor using $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$ shared-oracle samples, and the excess dependence matches the smooth nonconvex first-order rate; per-agent computation and communication are governed by the neighborhood size rather than the network size. Fourth, an adaptive-locality rule selects the radius that balances truncation and graph-decay residuals against the target accuracy. Experiments on a networked linear-quadratic benchmark corroborate the locality and feature-dimension predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出连续分布式耦合策略梯度（CDCPG）算法，用于连续状态-动作空间的网络化多智能体强化学习。每个智能体维护局部演员，并通过谱随机特征表示评估截断动作值函数。理论贡献包括：建立局部化贝尔曼理论、证明归一化随机特征的持续激励条件、给出近似误差与样本复杂度界。实验验证了局部性和特征维度预测。
Motivation: 网络化多智能体强化学习在连续状态-动作空间中面临可扩展性挑战，现有方法因全局通信和维数灾难而难以应用。
Method: CDCPG算法采用邻域局部演员和基于谱随机特征的局部最小二乘时序差分评论家，通过自适应邻域规则平衡截断误差与图衰减残差。
Result: 理论表明，在指数空间衰减和持续激励条件下，CDCPG以~O(ε^{-2})样本驱动平均智能体平稳性达到近似下限；实验在联网线性二次型基准上验证。
Conclusion: 该算法实现计算和通信复杂度仅依赖于邻域大小而非网络规模，为大规模连续空间多智能体强化学习提供了可扩展方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Operational Proto-Introspection in Looped Language Models: Process-Quality Taps, Executable Branching, and the Readout-Control Boundary
papers.abstract_en: Can a language model read the quality of ongoing computation, and can an external intervention turn that readout into better outcomes? We test both questions in a frozen 2.6B looped transformer, Ouro-RLTT. On GSM8K, a strict pre-answer probe excludes the answer region and gold value yet predicts eventual success: hidden states plus length and log-probability shortcuts reach AUROC 0.797, versus 0.731 for the shortcuts alone (incremental +0.066; task-clustered 95% CI [+0.021, +0.112]; 170 tasks, 680 candidates). Low-capacity taps also read role-specialized properties: task-disjoint branch survival reaches 0.9697 oracle retention, content ranking reaches 0.6310 macro top-1, and generated-branch correctness reaches AUROC 0.7755. A non-looped control replicates a candidate-quality readout, so recurrence is not required for every signal. We build branch/carry/prune machinery over Ouro's 192-slot recurrent cache, including branch-specific cache lineage and a bit-exact residual-capture splice that recomputes only the affected suffix and saves up to 88% of per-branch layer passes. No frozen intervention produces a validated capability gain. Directional steering is an established negative; a four-task matched-sampling comparison removes evidence for a frozen-fork gain but cannot estimate a general deficit; terminal selection remains unresolved and underpowered; and bounded LoRA changes surface behavior without improving net reachability. A two-null audit does not support the simplest span-misalignment explanation. We call this readable-but-not-yet-usable property operational proto-introspection. The model is not consulting our probes: we read its hidden trajectories, and our interventions fail to convert those readouts into validated capability. The pre-answer result is limited to one domain. Load-bearing values use source-item-disjoint splits and antisymmetrized evaluation where applicable.
papers.comment: 49 pages, 8 figures. Paper 1 of a two-paper series; companion methodology paper submitted separately
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在冻结的 2.6B 环回 transformer Ouro-RLTT 上探索语言模型能否读取自身计算质量，以及外部干预能否利用这种读取改善结果。在 GSM8K 上，严格的前答案探针达到 AUROC 0.797，比仅使用捷径信号高 0.066；但所有冻结干预均未产生验证的能力增益。作者将这种可读但不可用的性质称为操作原内省（operational proto-introspection）。
Motivation: 能否让语言模型读取进行中的计算质量，并通过外部干预将读取转化为更好的输出结果？
Method: 在环回 transformer Ouro-RLTT 上设计前答案探针（pre-answer probe），排除答案区域和真实值，预测最终成功；构建分支/携带/修剪机制，利用 192 槽循环缓存实现位精确残差捕获拼接，节省最多 88% 的每分支层传递。
Result: 前答案探针在 GSM8K 上达到 AUROC 0.797，比仅使用捷径（长度和 log-probability）的 0.731 提升 0.066（95% CI [0.021, 0.112]）；低容量探针也能读取角色专业属性；但所有冻结干预（方向引导、冻结分支选择、LoRA）均未产生验证的能力增益。
Conclusion: 模型不consulting探针，只是我们读取其隐藏轨迹，但干预无法将读取转化为已验证的能力。该结果仅限于一个领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Reservoir Computing: Recent Advances and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) uses the dynamics of a fixed or weakly tuned quantum system to transform temporal and sequential inputs into measured features, while training is typically confined to a classical readout. This separation reduces reliance on repeated quantum parameter updates and avoids the barren plateaus associated with variational circuit training. Its computational power is often attributed to the exponentially large Hilbert space of the quantum system. However, the memory, nonlinearity, and expressivity that determine what a reservoir can actually compute depend jointly on the input encoding, quantum evolution, observables, measurement, and readout, not on Hilbert space dimension alone. On hardware, these capabilities are further constrained by finite sampling, hardware noise, measurement backaction, and the cost of estimating observables, so a large state space alone does not guarantee useful computation. In this survey, we develop a common system model that connects these components and use it to organize QRC foundations, computational properties, reservoir architectures, operating protocols, and physical implementations. We examine spin, photonic, superconducting, bosonic, neutral atom, and other analog platforms, together with applications, software and high performance computing support, benchmarking, and reproducibility. The analysis distinguishes hardware demonstrations from simulations and identifies the assumptions and resources that govern comparisons across implementations. Current results do not establish a broad quantum advantage over well matched classical reservoirs. We therefore specify the resource accounting, benchmark standards, and theoretical criteria needed to evaluate claims of quantum advantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于量子储层计算（QRC）的综述，系统梳理了其理论基础、计算特性、架构方案、操作协议及物理实现。作者强调QRC的计算能力取决于输入编码、量子演化、观测和读出等多个组件，而非仅由希尔伯特空间维度决定。当前实验尚未在广泛任务上证明量子优势，需要统一的资源核算和基准标准来评估实际性能。
Motivation: 量子储层计算（QRC）利用固定量子系统的动力学处理时序输入，避免了变分量子训练中的贫瘠高原问题，但其实际计算能力受限于有限采样、硬件噪声和观测成本。现有研究缺乏统一的系统模型来比较不同实现方案，且量子优势尚未明确建立。
Method: 本文提出一个通用的系统模型，将输入编码、量子演化、可观测量、测量和读出等环节统一连接，并基于此组织对QRC基础理论、计算特性、储层架构、操作协议以及多种物理平台（自旋、光子、超导、玻色子、中性原子等）的综述分析。
Result: 当前QRC实验结果未在与经典储层计算公平比较下展现广泛量子优势。文章指出，现有比较依赖于不同的资源假设和评估标准，需要建立统一的资源核算、基准测试标准和理论判据。
Conclusion: 为了可靠地评估量子优势，QRC领域必须采用一致的计算资源核算方法、基准测试标准和理论判据，以区分硬件演示与模拟结果，并揭示不同实现间的比较基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Engineering Trustworthy Agentic AI for Critical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic artificial intelligence systems, capable of autonomous perception, planning, tool use, and multi-step action, are increasingly proposed for critical engineering domains where decisions carry physical, operational, or economic consequences. This survey addresses a gap in current literature by treating trustworthiness, whether agentic behavior can be verified, audited, and trusted under the constraints that engineering practice actually requires, as a first-class engineering property, rather than evaluating agentic AI by task capability alone. The study adopts a trustworthiness model organized around five cross-cutting dimensions: safety and constraint satisfaction; robustness and reliability; transparency and interpretability; accountability and auditability; and privacy and security. This is mapped onto an agentic assurance workflow spanning perception through audit. Building on this foundation, agentic systems architectures, threats, concrete trust mechanisms, and quantitative metrics are surveyed for direct application in agentic systems development and evaluation. These principles are then examined across four constraint-bound engineering domains: power systems, autonomous vehicles/robotics/UAVs, high-performance computing, and communication networks, identifying recurring design patterns, shared failure modes, and domain-specific gaps. Synthesizing across those domains, agentic AI trustworthiness is shown to be a single problem, with a path outlined toward a reusable, cross-domain assurance framework analogous to the graded certification regimes used by mature safety-critical engineering fields.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该综述论文将信任度（trustworthiness）视为工程化智能体AI的首要属性，而非仅关注任务能力。作者提出了一个五维信任度模型（安全性、鲁棒性、可解释性、可审计性、隐私安全），并将其映射到智能体保障工作流。论文系统调查了智能体系统架构、威胁、信任机制和量化指标，并在电力系统、自动驾驶/机器人/UAV、高性能计算和通信网络四个工程领域进行了应用分析，指出跨领域可复用的信任保障框架是可行的。
Motivation: 当前文献多从任务能力角度评估智能体AI，但缺乏工程实践中对智能体行为可验证、可审计、可信赖的系统性讨论。该论文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 采用基于五维信任度模型的框架，结合智能体保障工作流（从感知到审计），系统性地调查了智能体架构、威胁、具体信任机制和量化指标，并在四个约束性工程领域进行跨领域分析。
Result: 论文识别了跨领域共享的设计模式、失败模式以及领域特定缺口，论证了智能体AI信任度是一个单一问题，并提出了构建可复用跨领域保障框架的路径。
Conclusion: 智能体AI的信任度可以通过借鉴成熟安全关键工程领域的分级认证机制来构建跨领域保障框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Physics Closure Matters for Machine Olfaction: A Maxwell--Stefan Graph Solver for Identifiable Dynamic Gas Unmixing
papers.abstract_en: Machine olfaction for gas unmixing is an underconstrained inverse problem in which gas compositions must be inferred from low-dimensional, delayed, and entangled sensor responses produced by interacting chemical transport, surface adsorption, and sensor transduction. One of the key obstacles is physics closure misspecification, where a neural network is designed to fit sensor traces rather than infer a physically closed olfactory process. In this work, we formulate gas unmixing as a multi-physics-constrained inverse problem governed by Maxwell--Stefan multicomponent transport PDEs, competitive adsorption ODEs, and nonlinear sensor transduction ODEs. Directly solving such a high-dimensional coupled system is computationally expensive and often numerically unstable. To this end, we propose UnMixNet, a physics-closed graph neural solver that embeds this multi-physics forward process into end-to-end gas unmixing. UnMixNet discretizes Maxwell--Stefan cross-diffusion on spatial graphs and formulates the multicomponent flux on each edge. This design enables local, differentiable, and flux-conservative inference for multicomponent cross-diffusion. Evaluations on SmellNet show improved single-odor recognition, seen-mixture unmixing, and unseen-mixture generalization. In addition, an external validation on UCI Dynamic Gas Mixtures shows that the inferred concentration process agrees with ground truth concentration set points under dynamic transitions. Process-consistency diagnostics further show that the proposed model learns transferable dynamic physical fingerprints that better satisfies transport, conservation, adsorption, and readout closure.

papers.title: Recti-Q: Feature-Space Rectification for Out-of-Distribution-Robust Quantized Perception in Edge Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Robotic perception pipelines increasingly rely on large vision backbones deployed on SWaP-constrained edge platforms, making post-training quantization (PTQ) attractive for real-time inference. However, while PTQ often preserves clean in-distribution accuracy, we show that it can substantially degrade reliability under deployment-relevant distribution shifts (e.g., sensor noise, severe weather, and novel operating environments), creating a Quantization-Induced Robustness Gap. Across foundational vision benchmarks (ImageNet-C and PACS), 4-bit PTQ models exhibit pronounced robustness degradation despite negligible ID accuracy loss. To address this, we propose Recti-Q, a lightweight feature-space rectification framework that freezes the quantized backbone and trains a small classifier-head LoRA adapter using only source data. Recti-Q is architecture-agnostic across CNNs and Transformers, supports efficient teacher-free training, and recovers a significant portion of the lost robustness, in some cases matching or exceeding FP32 performance. At less than 1% parameter overhead (as small as 6 KB), Recti-Q preserves over 99% of PTQ memory savings, adds negligible compute, and enables low-bandwidth Over-The-Air (OTA) resilience patching for deployed robotic fleets operating in unpredictable physical environments.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示后训练量化（PTQ）在分布偏移下会导致机器人感知模型的鲁棒性显著下降（量化诱导鲁棒性差距），并提出Recti-Q——一种轻量级特征空间矫正框架。Recti-Q冻结量化主干，仅训练分类器头的LoRA适配器，使用源数据即可恢复大部分丢失的鲁棒性，在ImageNet-C和PACS上验证，参数开销不到1%（小至6KB），保留99%以上的PTQ内存节省，并支持低带宽空中（OTA）韧性补丁。
Motivation: PTQ在保持干净分布内精度的同时，严重损害了部署环境下分布偏移（如传感器噪声、恶劣天气、新场景）下的可靠性，而现有方法对此关注不足。
Method: 冻结量化骨干网络，仅训练一个小的分类器头LoRA适配器，无需教师模型，架构无关（CNN/Transformer均适用），仅使用源数据。
Result: 在ImageNet-C和PACS基准上，4-bit PTQ模型鲁棒性显著退化；Recti-Q可恢复大部分丢失的鲁棒性，有时甚至匹配或超过FP32性能，参数开销<1%（最小6KB），内存节省保留>99%。
Conclusion: Recti-Q为边端机器人提供了一种轻量、高效的量化后鲁棒性恢复方案，支持OTA更新，适合资源受限的部署场景。
