papers.title: AniGS: Bridging Rendering and Diffusion Prior for 3D Scene Animation
papers.abstract_en: Novel view rendering of large and complex reconstructed scenes is becoming increasingly photorealistic. However, most reconstructions remain static and lack the ambient motion that makes environments immersive. We present AniGS, a method for scene-level animation of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructions that adds subtle, distributed dynamics, e.g., vegetation motion, while preserving rigid structures. Unlike existing 3D animation techniques which are limited to object-centric subjects or small regions, AniGS is designed for large, cluttered, navigable scenes. AniGS represents the scene with a canonical 3DGS and models motion using a time-conditioned deformation field. To animate the entire scene, we leverage a pretrained video diffusion model and introduce an iterative dataset--model update strategy that progressively expands viewpoint coverage and repeatedly updates camera-fixed training videos using a render-and-refine scheme. To prevent artifacts from unintended motion in static areas, we further introduce a composed video-to-video refinement scheme that restricts motion to desired regions. Experiments on five real-world, large-scale outdoor scenes demonstrate that AniGS produces natural ambient dynamics and high-quality novel view videos, enabling more immersive viewing experiences of reconstructed environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AniGS，一种为大规模 3D 高斯泼溅重建场景添加细微环境动态（如植被运动）的动画方法。通过时间条件变形场和预训练视频扩散模型，结合迭代数据集-模型更新策略与组合视频到视频精炼方案，在五个真实室外场景上生成自然的环境动态和高品质新视角视频。
Motivation: 现有 3D 重建大多保持静态，缺乏环境运动，而现有动画技术局限于物体中心或小区域，无法处理大型杂乱的可导航场景。
Method: 使用规范 3DGS 表示场景，通过时间条件变形场建模运动；利用预训练视频扩散模型，引入迭代数据集-模型更新策略逐步扩展视角覆盖，并采用渲染-精炼方案更新固定训练视频；提出组合视频到视频精炼方案限制运动在期望区域，防止静态区域出现伪影。
Result: 在五个真实大规模室外场景上，AniGS 产生自然的环境动态和高质量的新视角视频，提升了重建环境的沉浸式观看体验。
Conclusion: 本文方法成功将视频扩散先验与渲染结合，实现大规模场景级动画，但可能依赖预训练扩散模型的质量及对动态区域的准确指定。

papers.title: MAGE: Human-Like Macro Placement via Agentic Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Macro placement still requires substantial manual refinement in industrial physical design flows. We present MAGE (Macro Placement Agentic Engine), a multimodal multi-agent framework for macro placement refinement. MAGE decomposes the macro placement task into a six-phase workflow that combines structured floorplanning rules, visual checks, and iterative refinement. Expert floorplanning knowledge is encoded through natural-language directives and validation criteria, rather than learned from labeled placement data. A tournament-style refinement mode evaluates multiple candidate placements and propagates feedback from higher-quality solutions. We also introduce four metrics for quantifying human-likeness in macro placement: notch score, whitespace score, pocket score, and alignment score. These metrics capture structural properties used by expert designers but not directly measured by conventional PPA metrics. Across nine designs in NanGate45 and GlobalFoundries 12nm enablements, MAGE achieves geometric-mean improvements of 11.1%-19.3% in WNS and 70.0%-74.0% in TNS over commercial macro placers. On the three NanGate45 designs, for which human-expert and Hier-RTLMP baselines are available, MAGE improves WNS and TNS by 18.3% and 72.5% over the human expert, and by 47.0% and 80.4% over Hier-RTLMP, with comparable wirelength and power. On human-likeness metrics, MAGE improves the overall score by 6%-48% over all baselines. Additional case studies on anonymized netlists, unseen designs, dense rectilinear floorplans, and high-utilization settings show that the framework transfers to new placement settings without design-specific retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAGE，一个多模态多智能体框架，用于宏布局优化。它将宏布局任务分解为六阶段工作流，结合结构化规划规则、视觉检查和迭代优化，并引入四个量化类人布局的指标。在NanGate45和GlobalFoundries 12nm设计上，MAGE在WNS和TNS上相比商业宏布局器有显著改进，并在可用的对比中优于人类专家和Hier-RTLMP基线。
Motivation: 宏布局在工业物理设计流程中仍需大量手动调整，现有自动化方法缺乏类似人类专家的结构感知能力。
Method: 提出MAGE框架，通过六阶段工作流分解任务，利用自然语言指令和验证标准编码专家知识，并采用锦标赛式精炼模式评估多个候选布局并传播反馈；同时引入四个类人度量（缺口分数、空白分数、口袋分数、对齐分数）。
Result: 在九个设计上，MAGE在WNS上实现了11.1%-19.3%的几何平均改进，在TNS上实现了70.0%-74.0%的几何平均改进；在三个NanGate45设计上，相比人类专家，WNS提升18.3%，TNS提升72.5%；相比Hier-RTLMP，WNS提升47.0%，TNS提升80.4%；类人度量总分提升6%-48%。
Conclusion: MAGE框架通过结合结构化规则与可视化检查实现了类人宏布局，且无需针对特定设计重新训练即可迁移到新的布局场景。

papers.title: Censoring-Aware In-Context Learning for Generalized Supplier Lead Time Estimation in Supply Chain Planning
papers.abstract_en: Supplier lead time forecasting is a central input to material requirements planning, inventory optimization, and supply chain risk management. However, many industrial lead time datasets are naturally right-censored: at the time forecasts are required, some orders have not yet arrived. Standard regression and classification approaches discard this information, while conventional survival models require task-specific modeling. We propose LeadTime-ICL (LT-ICL), a censoring-aware in-context learning model for probabilistic lead time forecasting. LT-ICL combines a transformer backbone with a conditional normalizing-flow head, producing a full predictive distribution over lead times. The model is pretrained on synthetic right-censored lead time tasks, enabling in-context adaptation to new industrial datasets without task-specific parameter updates. We provide theoretical support for this formulation by showing that excess CRPS is bounded by prior misspecification and amortized approximation errors, providing clear direction for improving forecasting performance. We evaluate LT-ICL on 24 proprietary supply-chain datasets spanning seven industries. LT-ICL achieves the lowest point-forecasting error on 15 of the 24 datasets, and the lowest probabilistic forecasting error on 14 datasets, yielding the best average rank across both. These results support right-censored probabilistic forecasting as a practical formulation for supplier lead time prediction and demonstrate that pretrained in-context models can provide accurate, low-adaptation-cost forecasting for industrial planning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LeadTime-ICL (LT-ICL)，一种可感知右删失数据的上下文学习模型，用于供应商交货时间概率预测。模型结合Transformer骨干网络和条件归一化流头部，在合成右删失数据上预训练后，可无需参数更新地适配新工业数据集，在24个供应链数据集上取得最优平均排名。
Motivation: 工业交货时间数据常存在右删失（部分订单未到货），标准回归或分类方法丢弃这些信息，而传统生存模型需任务特定建模，导致预测精度和泛化性不足。
Method: 提出LT-ICL，使用Transformer骨干网络提取上下文信息，条件归一化流头部生成完整概率分布；设计右删失合成任务进行预训练，实现上下文中的自适应预测，无需任务特定参数更新。
Result: 在24个供应链数据集上，LT-ICL在15个数据集上取得最低点预测误差，14个数据集上最低概率预测误差，平均排名最优。
Conclusion: 右删失概率预测是供应商交货时间预测的有效范式；预训练上下文模型可提供准确且低适应成本的工业预测方案。

papers.title: EduPanel: A Three-Agent LLM Judge for Teaching Videos -- Reliability, Complementarity, and Human Trust Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Teaching videos are becoming a major medium for education, creating a growing need for scalable evaluation of their pedagogical quality. Existing automatic judges do not fully address this setting because teaching quality depends on multimodal evidence and should be evaluated with respect to the intended learner rather than as a universal property. We present EduPanel, a rubric-grounded, learner-conditioned LLM judge that decomposes evaluation across specialized agents to produce interpretable assessments for different aspects of teaching quality. Across expert studies, architecture ablations, and learner-persona analyses, EduPanel achieves reliability comparable to a median human expert. In expert evaluation, its feedback improves scoring accuracy (MAE 0.87 to 0.73), while experts remain able to detect unreliable outputs (AUC = 0.77) instead of accepting them blindly. These results suggest that EduPanel can serve as effective assistants for educational evaluation rather than replacements for human experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EduPanel，一个基于评分准则、以学习者条件化的 LLM 评判系统，通过三个专门代理分解教学视频的不同教学方面，提供可解释评估。实验表明其可靠性接近人类专家中位数，且专家能检测不可靠输出（AUC=0.77），因此可作为教育评估的辅助工具而非替代。
Motivation: 教学视频数量激增，需要可扩展的教学质量评估方法，但现有自动评判未充分处理教学评估中的多模态证据和针对目标学习者的需求。
Method: 提出由三个专门代理组成的 LLM 评判系统 EduPanel，基于评分准则且条件于学习者角色，分解评估不同方面的教学质量。
Result: 在专家研究中，EduPanel 可靠性接近中位数人类专家；其反馈将专家评分 MAE 从 0.87 降至 0.73，同时专家能检测不可靠输出（AUC=0.77），而非盲目接受。

papers.title: Adaptive Two-Stage Online Learning for Service-Affecting Failure Detection in Mobile Core Networks
papers.abstract_en: Mobile network operators monitor aggregated traffic volumes to assess the operational health of core network infrastructure. Reliable failure detection is challenging due to strong temporal structure, non-stationarity, measurement artefacts, and extreme class imbalance, which limit static threshold-based monitoring. This paper proposes a two-stage online learning framework for traffic-based failure detection in mobile core networks. Stage I incrementally models normal traffic dynamics using lightweight regression with time-aware features. Stage II analyses prediction residuals together with contextual indicators to detect genuine service-affecting network failures. The framework operates fully online under a prequential evaluation protocol, enabling continuous adaptation with low computational overhead. Across linear and non-linear models, the proposed two-stage architecture achieves the best precision-recall trade-off, attaining the highest recall, F1-score, and AUC at acceptable false positive rates. These results demonstrate the importance of explicit residual decomposition for reliable failure detection in streaming mobile core network data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对移动核心网络中基于流量的故障检测问题，提出了一种自适应两阶段在线学习框架。第一阶段使用轻量级回归模型对正常流量动态进行增量建模，第二阶段分析预测残差和上下文指标以检测真正的服务影响故障。该框架在预序评估协议下完全在线运行，具有低计算开销，并在线性和非线性模型上取得了最佳精度-召回率权衡。
Motivation: 移动核心网络故障检测面临强时间结构、非平稳性、测量伪影和极端类别不平衡等挑战，静态阈值方法效果有限。
Method: 提出两阶段在线学习框架：第一阶段使用时间感知特征的轻量级回归增量建模正常流量；第二阶段结合预测残差和上下文指标检测服务影响故障。
Result: 在流式移动核心网络数据上，该架构实现了最高的召回率、F1分数和AUC，同时保持可接受的假阳性率，优于线性和非线性模型。
Conclusion: 显式的残差分解对于流式移动核心网络数据的可靠故障检测至关重要，两阶段方法能有效适应动态环境。

papers.title: Signed Rectified Flow: Negativity-Controlled Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Signed Rectified Flow (Signed RF), a generalization of Rectified Flow that targets the signed measure $π^{sign} = (1+α)π^+ - απ^-$, where $α>0$, $π^+$ is the distribution to promote, and $π^-$ is the distribution to suppress. Although direct sampling from a signed measure is not well-defined, Signed RF induces a valid generative process that concentrates probability in regions where the signed measure is positive while provably excluding regions dominated by its negative component. It therefore provides a principled framework for incorporating negative information and exclusion constraints into generative modeling. We analyze the signed continuity equation underlying Signed RF and use a charged-particle interpretation to explain how negative mass forms exclusion barriers. This theory further motivates practical adaptive guidance algorithms. Across several applications, Signed RF improves the fidelity-diversity trade-off on ImageNet, reduces nearest-neighbor similarity in anti-memorization experiments, and reduces nudity induced by adversarial prompts in Stable Diffusion 3.5 while preserving CLIP and aesthetic scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Signed Rectified Flow (Signed RF)，将整流流推广到带符号测度，通过正负分布结合实现生成控制。理论分析了符号连续性方程和带电粒子解释，并设计自适应引导算法。在ImageNet上改善保真度-多样性权衡，在反记忆实验中降低最近邻相似度，在Stable Diffusion 3.5中减少对抗性提示导致的裸露内容。
Motivation: 现有生成模型缺乏纳入负信息（即要抑制的分布）的框架，难以实现排除约束和负控制。
Method: 定义符号测度π^{sign}=(1+α)π^+ - απ^-，通过整流流诱导合法生成过程，利用符号连续性方程和带电粒子类比解释负质量的排斥效应，并导出自适应引导算法。
Result: 在ImageNet上改进保真度-多样性权衡；在反记忆实验中降低最近邻相似度；在Stable Diffusion 3.5中减少对抗性提示导致的裸体内容，同时保持CLIP分数和美学评分。
Conclusion: Signed RF为生成建模中的负信息整合和排除约束提供了理论基础，但摘要未讨论大规模部署中的计算开销或对其他模态的泛化性。

papers.title: Automated Data Engineering and Feature Selection for the Case Study of Warpage Detection in Fused Deposition Modeling
papers.abstract_en: This study contributes toward development of an Automated Data Processing (ADP) framework designed to evaluate and reinforce optimal machine learning model-feature combinations for predictive tasks in fused deposition modeling (FDM) process datasets. The methodology is centered around a reinforcement learning-inspired policy updating mechanism, where multiple machine learning models are trained on both full feature sets and feature subsets selected through Shapley-based Explainable AI (SHAP XAI) across 217 datasets. At each episode, the framework assesses the predictive accuracy and F1-scores of each model-feature pair, computes a scalar reward, and updates $Q$ values to guide future model selection. SHAP XAI feature importance was employed to generate reduced yet informative feature subsets to enable the framework to explore performance with dimensionality. The policy was shown to evolve over multiple episodes, with reward distributions used to visualize performance stability. Overall, results indicate that leveraging the ADP framework through XAI algorithms successfully converges toward optimal model-feature configurations with improved accuracy and stability. Specifically, the proposed framework improves the test-set AUC from 0.9248 to 0.9731 and increases the mean reward value by more than fifty percent compared with the baseline full-feature configuration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动化数据处理框架，用于熔融沉积建模过程中的翘曲检测预测任务。框架利用强化学习策略更新机制，结合基于Shapley的可解释AI进行特征选择，在217个数据集上评估模型-特征组合的精度和F1分数，并更新Q值以指导后续选择。结果显示，该框架将测试集AUC从0.9248提升至0.9731，平均奖励值相比全特征基线提高超过50%。
Motivation: 熔融沉积建模过程中，手动特征工程和模型选择耗时且难以保证最优，需要自动化方法来高效评估并强化机器学习模型与特征的最佳组合。
Method: 提出基于强化学习的自动化数据处理框架，每个回合训练多个机器学习模型于完整特征集和通过SHAP XAI选择的子集，计算标量奖励并更新Q值，从而引导模型选择。
Result: 测试集AUC从0.9248提升至0.9731，平均奖励值比全特征基线提高超过50%。
Conclusion: 通过可解释AI算法，该自动化框架成功收敛到最优模型-特征配置，提升了预测精度和稳定性。

papers.title: Querying Multimodal Scientific Papers with AI: Practices and Preferences Across Blind, Low-Vision, and Sighted Scientists
papers.abstract_en: Visual diagrams, figures, and tables are central to scientific papers, and convey information beyond what is captured in text. While blind or low-vision (BLV) scientists have traditionally relied on static alternative text to access figures in papers, the rise of artificial intelligence (AI) has made interactive question-answering (QA) a feasible paradigm for visual exploration; yet little is known about how scientists use visual QA in practice or how to improve its accessibility. In this work, we interview five BLV and five sighted scientists across different STEM fields to understand how they use two AI tools, ChatGPT and Gemini, to query multimodal scientific documents. Our findings characterize how scientists review multimodal content, including existing practices (along with accessibility workarounds) for engaging with visuals, and feedback on the suitability of AI-generated responses to multimodal queries. We further find that vague or incomplete image descriptions, as well as incorrect AI outputs more broadly, can cause both BLV and sighted scientists to abandon AI workflows. To support future research, we additionally contribute a dataset of 115 queries and responses from our participants' interactions with the AI tools for papers in their field. We close by discussing implications for AI-powered scientific QA systems, emphasizing considerations for access across abilities and domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究通过访谈五名盲人或低视力（BLV）科学家和五名视力正常科学家，探索他们使用ChatGPT和Gemini等AI工具查询多模态科学论文（包含图表）的实践与偏好。研究发现两组科学家均因模糊的图像描述或错误的AI输出而放弃使用AI，并贡献了一个包含115条查询和响应的数据集，最后讨论了面向不同能力和领域的AI科学问答系统的设计启示。
Motivation: 科学家在论文中依赖图表获取文中未含的信息，而BLV科学家传统上仅能访问静态替代文本；AI使交互式视觉问答成为可能，但学界对科学家如何使用视觉QA以及如何提升其可访问性了解甚少。
Method: 对五名BLV和五名视力正常科学家进行半结构化访谈，观察他们使用ChatGPT和Gemini查询本领域多模态论文的过程，收集用户的查询、AI响应及反馈，并整理为数据集。
Result: 发现两组科学家均采用现有做法（及可访问性变通方案）与图表交互；AI生成的回复中模糊或不完整的图像描述以及错误输出会导致用户放弃AI工作流；共收集115条查询-响应对。
Conclusion: 强调了设计跨能力和领域可访问的AI科学问答系统的必要性，尤其需改进图像描述准确性和AI输出可靠性。

papers.title: DuSPiT: Dual-Branch Sub-Patch Pixel Diffusion Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers achieve strong image generation performance, but most operate in compressed latent spaces. Pixel-space diffusion avoids this information loss, yet existing approaches map each raw image patch to a single token, forcing one representation to handle both global communication and fine-grained details. We address this issue by proposing a new architecture, \textbf{DuSPiT}, a \textbf{Du}al-branch \textbf{S}ub\textbf{P}atch \textbf{Pi}xel \textbf{T}ransformer. This model separates global structural reasoning from local appearance modeling. DuSPiT uses a compact base branch for efficient global reasoning and a parallel, high-capacity pixel branch, organized into subpatch groups, to preserve detailed appearance, with the two branches interacting through cross-attention. Our results show that DuSPiT generates images with richer details and stronger fine-grained structures, while also achieving a better quality--efficiency trade-off than prior pixel-space diffusion transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DuSPiT，一种双分支子块像素扩散变换器，用于像素空间图像生成。该架构分离了全局结构推理与局部外观建模：紧凑的基础分支负责高效全局推理，高容量的像素分支通过子块分组保留细节，两分支通过交叉注意力交互。实验表明，DuSPiT生成的图像细节更丰富、结构更精细，且在质量-效率权衡上优于先前的像素空间扩散变换器。
Motivation: 现有像素空间扩散模型将每个原始图像块映射为一个token，迫使单一表示同时处理全局通信和细粒度细节，导致信息损失或效率低下。
Method: 提出双分支架构：基础分支（base branch）用于高效全局推理，像素分支（pixel branch）通过子块分组（sub-patch groups）保留详细外观，两分支通过交叉注意力（cross-attention）交互。
Result: 摘要报告DuSPiT生成的图像细节更丰富、结构更精细，并在质量-效率权衡上优于先前的像素空间扩散变换器，但未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 分离全局推理与局部建模的双分支设计可有效提升像素空间扩散模型的生成质量与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Style over Substance: A Shortcut Audit of Emotion-Description Preference Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Preference over model-generated emotion descriptions is emerging as a standard evaluation metric for multimodal emotion understanding, exemplified by the MER2026 MER-Prefer track on EmoPrefer. Such benchmarks assume that predicting the preferred description requires grounded cross-modal understanding of the video. We conduct a systematic shortcut audit of EmoPrefer using content-blind probes. A simple logistic regression using only description length and generator identity, without processing the text, video, or audio, performs comparably to LoRA-finetuned 7B text and audio-visual judges (65.8 versus 66.8 WAF on EmoPrefer-V2). Generator identity is recoverable from description text with 99.5 percent accuracy, every candidate pair contrasts two distinct generators, and the human preference labels agree with a fold-exclusive per-generator win-rate prior on 66 percent of the evaluated pairs. When the human label conflicts with this prior, trained judges still follow the style prior on 63 to 80 percent of the pairs. On a length-matched subset that neutralizes verbosity bias, the tested media configurations yield no statistically significant improvement, while an ODIN-inspired diagnostic that decouples the style shortcut leaves its content head near chance. These results do not imply that human preferences are inherently stylistic or that the descriptions contain no emotional information. Instead, they show that the current scores can be reached without verifying either description against the video. We recommend source-balanced pairing, strict length control, counter-stereotypical sliced reporting, and multi-annotator consensus for future cross-generator evaluations. Code is available at https://github.com/jiabingyang01/EmoPrefer-Audit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对情感描述偏好评估基准EmoPrefer进行了系统性的捷径审计，发现仅使用描述长度和生成器身份等表面特征（不处理视频内容）即可达到与微调大模型相当的准确率，表明当前评估指标存在严重偏差，不能反映跨模态理解能力。
Motivation: 当前多模态情感理解的评估基准（如EmoPrefer）假设偏好预测需要真实的跨模态理解，但可能被表面统计特征（如生成器风格）所欺骗。
Method: 使用内容盲探针（仅基于描述长度和生成器身份的逻辑回归）、生成器身份恢复（99.5%准确率）、长度匹配子集分析以及ODIN启发式诊断来系统审计捷径。
Result: 简单逻辑回归达到65.8 WAF（微调7B模型为66.8 WAF）；人类偏好与固定每个生成器胜率先验一致的比例为66%；当冲突时，训练模型仍63-80%遵循风格先验；长度匹配后媒体配置无显著提升；内容头性能接近随机。
Conclusion: 当前分数无需验证描述与视频的对应关系即可达到，建议未来评估采用源平衡配对、严格长度控制、反刻板切片报告和多标注者共识。

papers.title: Now We Know? A Systematic Comparison of TerraMind and THOR
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) increasingly rank models by aggregate score, but such rankings obscure why models differ: how much of the gap is architecture, how much is decoder capacity, and how much is a use-case-specific artefact? This study addresses that gap through a controlled comparison of two GFMs developed under European Space Agency's $Φ$-lab with contrasting design philosophies: THOR, which introduces a compute-adaptive architecture supporting variable patch sizes and unifies Sentinel-1, -2, and -3 data at their native resolutions; and TerraMind, a multimodal generative GFM pretrained with a dual-scale token/pixel objective that enables any-to-any cross-modal generation (Thinking-in-Modalities) to infer missing sensors at inference time. Rather than reporting a single leaderboard, we investigate the axes along which the two architectures actually differ - patch size, decoder complexity, finetuning regime, input modality, and model scale - across ten use cases spanning segmentation and regression in diverse domains, including climate disaster response, methane leak detection, snow monitoring, or sea ice mapping. We find that architectural design choices - patch size and decoder type in particular - explain more performance variance than model identity itself, that the two models embody complementary investment strategies (pretraining-time scale for TerraMind versus inference-time tokenisation for THOR), and that correctly interpreting results requires dataset-level characterisation. The resulting picture is not a single winner but a set of hypotheses and a diagnostic ablation methodology that we expect to generalise to future GFMs beyond THOR and TerraMind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了两种地理空间基础模型（GFMs）——THOR和TerraMind，它们由欧洲航天局Φ-lab开发，设计哲学相反。THOR采用计算自适应架构，支持可变块大小，统一处理Sentinel-1、-2、-3数据；TerraMind是多模态生成式GFM，使用双尺度token/pixel目标进行预训练，支持任意到任意跨模态生成。研究跨越十个用例，涵盖分割和回归任务，发现架构选择（尤其是块大小和解码器类型）比模型身份更能解释性能差异，两者代表了互补的投资策略。
Motivation: 现有地理空间模型基准测试倾向于报告聚合分数，但隐藏了模型差异的原因（如架构、解码器容量还是特定用例的产物）。本文旨在通过受控比较揭示这些差异的根源。
Method: 采用受控比较方法，在十个跨领域用例（包括气候灾害响应、甲烷泄漏检测、雪监测、海冰测绘）中，沿块大小、解码器复杂度、微调方式、输入模态和模型规模等轴比较THOR和TerraMind。
Result: 发现架构选择（尤其是块大小和解码器类型）比模型身份更能解释性能差异；两个模型代表了互补的投资策略（TerraMind侧重预训练规模，THOR侧重推理时标记化）；正确解释结果需要数据集层面的特征描述。
Conclusion: 结论不是有一个单一的获胜者，而是提出了一套假设和诊断性消融方法，预计可推广到THOR和TerraMind之外的未来GFMs。

papers.title: Towards an Automated Test of LLM Security Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for a range of software, hardware and human-centered security tasks. Consequently, LLM performance on security tasks is an active area of measurement and research, often with a focus on identifying areas in which LLM security ``knowledge'' may be insufficient. Popular strategies for identifying LLM security knowledge gaps include building corpora of challenge questions or task benchmarks, strategies that require substantial manual work and security expertise to design and execute. We introduce a partially-automated method for assessing LLM knowledge of a security area.The method uses authoritative information from Consumer Protection Agencies (CPAs) to identify instability in LLM responses that can be indicative of knowledge gaps. We demonstrate the method for 2 security topics, identity theft and impostor scams, and 5 LLMs in 2 leading LLM families, Gemini and GPT, using publicly available information about identity theft and impostor scams from 6 CPAs.The method distinguishes between models that have and don't have sufficient knowledge to accurately identify the security topics in text narratives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种部分自动化的方法，利用消费者保护机构的权威信息来评估大语言模型在特定安全领域（如身份盗窃、冒充诈骗）的知识水平。该方法通过检测LLM回答中的不稳定性来识别知识缺口，并在2个安全主题和5个LLM上进行了验证。
Motivation: 现有评估LLM安全知识的方法依赖人工构建挑战问题或基准测试，耗费大量人力和专业知识。
Method: 提出部分自动化方法，使用消费者保护机构的公开信息生成测试问题，通过分析LLM回答的不稳定性来评估其安全知识。
Result: 该方法在身份盗窃和冒充诈骗两个主题上，能够区分对不同LLM是否具备足够准确识别安全主题的知识。
Conclusion: 该方法可减少人工评估成本，但仅限于已获取权威信息的领域，且依赖CPA数据的时效性和覆盖范围。

papers.title: Attractor Geometry Determines the Identifiability Limits of System Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic discovery of governing equations from data is limited not only by algorithm design and data volume, but by the geometry of the attractor: what the long-run dynamics allow to be recovered. Using a within-system design on Lorenz-84, where one forcing parameter drives fixed-point, limit-cycle, and chaotic regimes while the governing equations and library stay fixed, we show that a single number, $λ_{\min}(M)$, the smallest eigenvalue of the invariant-measure moment matrix, sets the identifiability ceiling for both sparse regression (SINDy) and evolutionary symbolic regression (PySR). Derived from the Birkhoff ergodic theorem and obtained from a short reference trajectory before any run, $λ_{\min}(M)$ measures how fully the attractor covers function space: where it vanishes, recovery is impossible for any algorithm, sparse or combinatorial alike; as it grows, both algorithms improve. Chaos raises $λ_{\min}(M)$ by spreading the attractor, but also enlarges it and amplifies noise; because noise enters SINDy's regression bottleneck linearly and PySR's discrimination channel superlinearly, the same transition can push the two methods in opposite directions, so deeper chaos is not uniformly better. Parameter-free mechanistic scores from this framework transfer without refitting to a held-out Lorenz-96 system, confirming mechanism rather than curve-fitting; a criterion read from the equations predicts when added chaos will not improve conditioning. We also introduce Soft F1, a coefficient-weighted structural metric that resolves performance differences invisible to binary-success and predictive scores. The first question of discovery is then not which algorithm, but what the attractor permits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明系统发现的可识别性上限由吸引子的几何结构决定，具体由不变测度矩矩阵的最小特征值 λ_min(M) 衡量。通过在 Lorenz-84 系统上的实验，该指标预测了稀疏回归（SINDy）和进化符号回归（PySR）的性能，并在 Lorenz-96 系统上得到验证。混沌可通过扩展吸引子提高 λ_min(M)，但也放大噪声，对两种算法的影响不同。
Motivation: 现有方法关注算法和数据量对系统发现的影响，但忽略了吸引子几何所施加的固有限制。本文旨在回答：吸引子允许我们恢复什么？
Method: 使用 Lorenz-84 系统（控制参数驱动固定点、极限环和混沌状态），计算 λ_min(M) 作为可识别性上限指标，并比较 SINDy 和 PySR 的性能。引入 Soft F1 度量，并跨系统验证（Lorenz-96）。
Result: λ_min(M) 为零时任何算法都无法恢复方程；随着 λ_min(M) 增长，两种算法均改进。混沌的影响是非单调的：通过扩展吸引子提高 λ_min(M)，但噪声在 SINDy 中线性放大、在 PySR 中超线性放大，因此深度混沌并非总是更好。
Conclusion: 系统发现的首要问题不是选择哪种算法，而是吸引子允许什么。λ_min(M) 提供算法无关的可识别性天花板，且参数无关的机制评分可迁移到其他系统。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: The Open Ant: A Robot Platform for Reinforcement Learning Research
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) research has demonstrated success in both physical and simulated domains; however, the predominant methodology remains rooted in simulations. The predominance of simulations makes translating research to physical reality uncertain for both algorithms and researchers. We propose a physical platform that is designed to simplify the transition. In this paper, we present the Open Ant: a physical variant of the commonly used Gymnasium Ant environment, along with a simulation. We demonstrate that competent walking policies can be learned from scratch in approximately one hour directly from the physical robot's experience for two substantially different RL algorithms: SARSA($λ$) and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). Separately, we show policies that were learned in simulation transfer to reality. We also examine how well the platform supports a nimble experimental ecosystem. Specifically, we observe the speed with which new users from diverse backgrounds achieve their first success with the platform, and how easily the platform can be repaired and updated when hardware issues arise. Both the hardware design and software are available as open-source on GitHub for ease of customization. In summary, we advocate for the use of the Open Ant for RL researchers who frequently use simulated environments, so they can more easily include robot experiments in their evaluations.
papers.comment: Published in the Reinforcement Learning Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Open Ant 机器人平台，它是 Gymnasium Ant 环境的物理变体，并附带仿真环境。摘要表明，两个不同的强化学习算法（SARSA(λ) 和 Soft Actor-Critic）可以在约一小时内直接从物理机器人经验中学会行走策略，仿真中学习的策略也能成功迁移到真实机器人。此外，平台设计易于新手快速上手和硬件维修，所有软硬件开源。
Motivation: 强化学习研究目前主要基于仿真，但仿真结果向物理现实迁移具有不确定性，缺少一个能简化这种过渡的标准化物理平台。
Method: 设计并开源一个物理机器人平台 Open Ant，它是 Gymnasium Ant 环境的物理对应物，同时提供对应的仿真环境，支持从零学习策略和仿真到现实的迁移。
Result: 两个差异较大的算法（SARSA(λ) 和 SAC）均在约一小时内直接从物理机器人经验学会行走；仿真训练的策略也可迁移至物理机器人；不同背景的新用户能快速获得首次成功，硬件易于修复和更新。
Conclusion: 作者倡导强化学习研究者（尤其是常用仿真环境的研究者）使用 Open Ant 平台，以更简单地将机器人实验纳入评估。

papers.title: Trusted Credentials, Untrusted Behavior: Benchmarking LLM-Agent Security in High-Performance Computing
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are starting to take on routine work in high-performance computing (HPC), including monitoring Slurm jobs, diagnosing failed builds, inspecting simulation output, and coordinating scientific workflows. To do this work, an agent commonly acts under its user's credentials and inherits the user's access to files and the scheduler. This arrangement creates a failure mode that ordinary account-level controls do not capture. Adversarial instructions in a log, tool description, shared file, or peer-agent message may redirect the agent beyond the task the user assigned, even though every resulting command is authenticated and permitted for that account. We refer to this as the hijacked authorized agent problem. Existing agent-security studies explain relevant mechanisms, such as indirect prompt injection and tool misuse, but generally evaluate them in web, enterprise, or personal-assistant settings. HPC security, by contrast, has mature controls for identity and isolation but does not ordinarily represent the intent of a particular task. This paper defines the threat model in the HPC setting, identifies attack surfaces created by schedulers, shared storage, multi-project accounts, and scientific workflows, and examines where current controls fall short. It concludes with a research agenda and a plan for an empirical benchmark, TaskBound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文聚焦高性能计算（HPC）中LLM代理的安全问题，提出“授权代理被劫持”（hijacked authorized agent）的威胁模型，并分析了调度器、共享存储、多项目账户等攻击面。摘要指出现有账户级安全控制无法防范此类攻击，并规划了名为TaskBound的实证基准。
Motivation: 现有HPC安全机制（身份隔离、访问控制）无法捕捉LLM代理因恶意指令而执行未授权操作的威胁，尽管每条命令均为账户所允许。
Method: 定义HPC场景下的威胁模型，识别调度器、共享存储、科学工作流等攻击面，并提出研究议程和实证基准TaskBound的计划。
Result: 摘要中未报告具体实验结果，仅提出基准计划和研究方向。
Conclusion: HPC需要新的安全机制来防止代理被劫持，现有控制不足以应对这类威胁。

papers.title: Governing Well in the Algorithmic Age: The Foundations of Digital Statecraft
authors: David Uriel Socol de la Osa
papers.abstract_en: The digital substrate of states -- data, algorithms, infrastructure, platforms, applications -- is being governed without adequate conceptual foundations. The ability and legitimacy required to govern this substrate, and to govern with it, are simultaneously misaligned, contested, and structurally absent. We introduce digital statecraft as the organising concept for this emerging field, arguing that 'digital' reconstitutes the statecraft question rather than merely extending its domain. The concept operates on two dimensions - statecraft over digital systems, concerning the authority and capacity of the state in relation to the digital substrate itself, and statecraft with digital systems, concerning the deployment of algorithmic tools as instruments of governing authority. And it rests on two foundational requirements, technical coherence and legitimate authority, that are genuinely in tension. We derive ten principles of digital statecraft from these foundations, each naming a condition whose absence produces an identifiable and structural governance failure: public interest first, human-machine complementarity, governability by design, systemic coherence, hybrid institutions, adaptive governance, human centricity and civic agency, accountable and traceable authority, judgment across time, and the non-delegable core. This article takes the state as the starting point, the institutional form that developed historically in response to the problem of effective and legitimate public governance, and the only current candidate for which the full set of legitimacy conditions is institutionally available. But the digital statecraft programme holds open a deeper question than just whether states can reform themselves: governing well in the algorithmic age may require rethinking the boundaries, scale, and affiliative basis of statehood itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“数字治国术 (digital statecraft)”作为组织概念，认为数字技术重新定义了国家治理问题，而非仅仅扩展其领域。该概念涵盖两个维度：对数字系统的治理（国家相对于数字基座的权威与能力）和借助数字系统的治理（算法工具作为治理手段的运用），并依赖两个基础要求——技术连贯性与合法权威——两者存在本质张力。由此推导出十项原则，每项对应一种可识别的结构性治理失败。文章以国家为起点，但指出算法时代良好治理可能需要重新思考国家本身的边界、规模与归属基础。
Motivation: 当前国家数字基座（数据、算法、基础设施、平台、应用）缺乏足够的概念基础来进行治理，治理所需的能力和合法性既缺失又存在结构性问题。
Method: 通过理论分析引入“数字治国术”概念框架，提出两个维度（对数字系统的治理、借助数字系统的治理）和两个基础要求（技术连贯性、合法权威），并从中推导出十项原则。
Result: 论文未提供实证结果；其贡献在于概念框架和十项原则的理论推导。
Conclusion: 文章强调数字治理的根本挑战在于算法时代可能需要重新构想国家本身的边界、规模与归属基础，而不仅仅是国家自我改革。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hybrid Latent-Structural Fusion (HLSF) for Cyber Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Malicious anomalous activity detection is a fundamental challenge for cyber security systems. Both tensor decomposition under statistical framework with CANDECOMP-PARAFAC alternating Poisson regression (CP-APR) and normalizing flows have proven to be powerful unsupervised machine learning methods that model multi-dimensional data and capture complex and multi-faceted details of behavior profiles in cyber security applications. In this study, we propose Hybrid Latent-Structural Fusion (HLSF), a weighted anomaly fusion framework integrating CP-APR structural anomaly scores with latent-space density scores derived from normalizing flows. In our experiments, we show that the HLSF framework improves anomaly detection performance on a dataset of real-world compromised user credentials collected from the large enterprise network of Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL) during a red-teaming exercise, compared with using CP-APR or normalizing flows alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对网络安全中的恶意异常检测问题，提出混合潜在-结构融合框架 (HLSF)，该框架加权融合了基于CANDECOMP-PARAFAC交替泊松回归 (CP-APR) 的结构异常分数和基于归一化流 (normalizing flows) 的潜在空间密度分数。在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室 (LANL) 企业网络红队演练中收集的真实受损用户凭证数据集上，HLSF 相比单独使用 CP-APR 或归一化流取得了更优的异常检测性能。
Motivation: 恶意异常活动检测是网络安全系统的基本挑战，现有无监督方法（如张量分解和归一化流）各有优劣，需要一种融合方法来综合其优势。
Method: 提出HLSF框架，通过加权融合将CP-APR的结构异常分数与归一化流的潜在空间密度分数结合起来，得到最终的异常检测得分。
Result: 在LANL真实受损用户凭证数据集上，HLSF相比单独使用CP-APR或归一化流，异常检测性能得到提升。
Conclusion: 融合结构异常分数和密度分数可以改善网络安全场景中的异常检测效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structured Output Collapses Answer Diversity Across 44 Language Models
papers.abstract_en: When a language model must choose one answer from a large space of equally valid options, a format clause -- "Reply with JSON only" -- changes which answer it chooses. We re-run the One-Word Census (arXiv:2607.12796): 31 wide-answer-space category prompts asked of 44 models, now with the reply requested in JSON -- no schema enforcement, no constrained decoding, only the request. Convergence deepens sharply: on the unconstrained "Pick a word" prompt the modal answer rises from 41% to 64% of the pool and distinct answers fall from 52 to 36; mean answer-choice surprisal drops from 1.80 to 1.58 bits. The tax is progressive: six of 44 models move individually (BH-FDR q=.10), all toward the mode, led by the most distinctive models, while the conformist floor is immobile. It is a sharpener, not a re-indexer -- the plain-chat modal answer survives in 28 of 31 categories. Defaults are register-indexed: a within-run re-sample (n=20) finds JSON shifts 53% of a model's stable chat defaults, mostly back to the crowd, and installs defaults absent from chat (Claude Fable 5 answers "cerulean" for colour 0% of the time in chat, 100% in JSON). Full-battery controls reveal a register gradient: compression is significant and specific to the answer-delivery formats models are trained to speak (JSON -0.22 bits, p=.0002; XML -0.19, p=.002), absent for YAML and CSV, and reversed for an arbitrary bracket wrapper (+0.13, p=.009) -- weighing the mechanism toward tool-use post-training. Enforcing the schema at the decoder (response_format) compresses no further than the request (-0.03 bits): the collapse lives in the model's response to the register, not the decoder. Structured output is how software consumes language models, and that surface is served by a measurably more homogeneous model than the chat surface on which models are evaluated, compared, and chosen.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 1 figure. Companion to the One-Word Census (arXiv:2607.12796). Code, data, and interactive explorer: https://github.com/tap2k/modelun/tree/main/studies/structured
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过重做“一词普查”（One-Word Census）实验，研究结构化输出格式（如JSON）对44个语言模型答案多样性的影响。研究发现，仅要求模型以JSON格式回答（无需强制schema或约束解码）就显著降低了答案多样性：模态答案比例从41%升至64%，不同答案数量从52降至36，平均答案选择信息量从1.80 bits降至1.58 bits。这种压缩效应是渐进式的，且主要影响原本最具差异性的模型；而强制解码端schema（response_format）不会进一步压缩。机制分析表明，压缩与模型训练时习得的工具使用注册表（register）相关，JSON和XML请求有效，YAML和CSV无效，任意括号包装甚至增加了信息量。结论是：结构化输出使得模型表面比其聊天表面更加同质化。
Motivation: 语言模型在开放式回答中常存在答案多样性问题，而实际应用中常用结构化输出格式（如JSON）来调用模型，但该格式是否会影响模型内部的选择多样性尚不清楚。本文旨在量化结构化输出请求对模型答案多样性的影响。
Method: 采用One-Word Census框架，对44个语言模型使用31个宽答案空间类别提示，要求模型以JSON格式回答（仅文本请求，无schema强制或约束解码）。通过对比无格式请求下的基线，计算模态答案比例、不同答案数量、平均答案选择信息量等指标。还进行了控制实验（XML、YAML、CSV、括号包装）和寄存器重采样实验。
Result: JSON请求使模态答案比例从41%升至64%，不同答案从52降至36，平均信息量从1.80降至1.58 bits。六个模型的个体变化显著（BH-FDR q=0.10），均朝向模式。控制实验发现压缩效应具有格式特异性：JSON（-0.22 bits, p=0.0002）和XML（-0.19, p=0.002）显著，YAML和CSV不显著，括号包装反而增加信息量（+0.13, p=0.009）。强制解码端schema未进一步压缩信息量（-0.03 bits）。
Conclusion: 结构化输出请求本身就能显著降低语言模型的答案多样性，且这一效应源于模型对特定格式注册表的响应，而非解码器强制。这意味着在实际使用结构化输出时，模型的表现可能比聊天评估时更加同质化，对模型比较和选择有重要影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RRPO: Reference-Relative Policy Optimization with Stratified Conditional Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has shown strong effectiveness in reinforcement learning from verifiable feedback, where sampled rollouts can be compared within a group using task-provided correctness signals. However, extending group-relative optimization beyond verifiable settings is challenging because success in many tasks is not captured by a single correctness criterion. We propose \textbf{Reference-Relative Policy Optimization (RRPO)}, which generalizes GRPO by replacing direct correctness-based advantage construction with reference-relative contrastive comparisons. RRPO first uses \emph{stratified conditional rollouts} to construct positive and negative anchor sets, and then trains a metric projection head with a set-contrastive objective to compare candidate rollouts against these anchors. The resulting alignment scores directly define contrastive advantages: during policy optimization, the projection head is frozen, and the scores are centered within each rollout group in a standard group-relative objective. We evaluate RRPO using anchor-based contrastive advantages throughout policy optimization, without relying on task ground-truth verifiers. Across verifiable reasoning, open-ended generation, and post-SFT settings, RRPO remains competitive with verifier-based optimization, improves over weakly supervised baselines, and provides additional gains after supervised fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出参考相对策略优化（RRPO），将GRPO从可验证反馈扩展到非可验证任务。通过分层条件 rollout 构建正负锚点，使用集合对比目标训练投影头，将对齐分数作为对比优势用于策略优化。在可验证推理、开放生成和SFT后设置中，RRPO与基于验证器的优化方法竞争力相当，并优于弱监督基线。
Motivation: GRPO在可验证反馈中有效，但许多任务的成功无法由单一正确性标准衡量，难以扩展到非可验证场景。
Method: 提出分层条件 rollout 构建正负锚点，训练度量投影头进行集合对比，冻结投影头后使用对齐分数作为对比优势，在每组 rollout 内中心化后用于策略优化。
Result: 在可验证推理、开放生成和SFT后设置中，RRPO与基于验证器的优化方法竞争力相当，优于弱监督基线，并在SFT后带来额外提升。
Conclusion: RRPO通过参考相对对比优势泛化GRPO，不依赖任务真实验证器，在多种设置下有效。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Weak-to-Strong Learning in Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: Many operational decisions rely on predictive models that estimate uncertain outcomes conditional on observable contexts. Training such models, however, often faces a fundamental data asymmetry: labeled outcomes are scarce or costly to obtain, while contextual covariates are abundant. Motivated by this data asymmetry, we develop a decision-aware weak-to-strong (W2S) framework that leverages both labeled and unlabeled data to improve contextual stochastic optimization. Specifically, we first train a weak model using limited labeled data and then use it to generate predicted outcome distributions on unlabeled contexts. These distributions provide soft supervision for training a strong model. We establish a non-asymptotic upper bound on the excess decision risk of W2S and a complementary lower bound for a strong-only benchmark. Their comparison yields explicit sufficient conditions under which W2S improves downstream decision performance. The key quantity is the correlation dimension between the weak and strong feature representations: when it is small, abundant unlabeled data reduce the effect of teacher errors along non-overlapping directions. A synthetic newsvendor experiment and a comment moderation experiment based on real-world data provide empirical evidence consistent with the theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对决策问题中标签数据稀缺但上下文特征丰富的数据不对称现象，提出一种决策感知的弱到强学习框架（W2S）。该框架先用少量标签数据训练弱模型，再在无标签数据上生成预测结果分布作为软标签来训练强模型，并通过理论分析给出W2S改善下游决策性能的充分条件。合成报童问题和真实评论审核实验验证了理论。
Motivation: 实际运营决策中，预测模型常面临标签数据稀缺而上下文特征丰裕的数据不对称问题，导致传统监督学习方法性能受限。
Method: 提出弱到强（W2S）学习框架：先利用有限标签数据训练弱模型，再用弱模型在无标签数据上生成预测分布作为软监督信号来训练强模型，并建立了过剩决策风险的非渐近上界和下界。
Result: 理论表明弱-强特征表示的关联维度较小是W2S提升决策性能的关键条件；合成报童问题与真实评论审核实验提供了一致实证证据。
Conclusion: W2S通过有效利用无标签数据可改善数据不对称下的决策表现，其提升幅度取决于弱-强表示之间的关联维度。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: W2S通过有效利用无标签数据可改善数据不对称下的决策表现，其提升幅度取决于弱-强表示之间的关联维度。

papers.title: ECoNGS: Efficient Compressive Neural Gaussian Splats for Volume Visualization
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in differentiable Gaussian splatting have highlighted the potential of primitive-based approaches as alternative scene representations for interactive, high-quality, volume visualization (VolVis) of large datasets. However, the explicit nature of current primitive-based methods, combined with isolated optimization for each VolVis scene, results in redundant, non-compact representations. We present ECoNGS, an efficient compressive neural Gaussian splatting framework for VolVis scene representation. ECoNGS employs lightweight neural networks to dynamically predict implicit, editable Gaussian splats from explicit anchor points, effectively combining model compactness and parameter efficiency of implicit representations with high-performance rendering of explicit primitives. We explore a joint learning strategy that clusters geometrically similar scenes and shares parameters across them, significantly reducing overall training time and model size while maintaining reconstruction fidelity. To achieve a more compact scene representation, we further compress the explicit anchor attributes using a neural entropy model that estimates their probability distributions, enabling compact storage via entropy coding. We systematically investigate Gaussian initialization strategies and propose a simple yet effective scheme tailored for VolVis scenes, improving reconstruction accuracy and accelerating convergence. We evaluate ECoNGS qualitatively and quantitatively across various univariate and multivariate VolVis scenes, highlighting its superior performance over prior methods in training time, reconstruction quality, and model size. In particular, compared with the prior method iVR-GS, ECoNGS improves reconstruction quality by up to 2.2 dB in PSNR while reducing the model size by up to 6.1x and the training time by up to 5.9x. The code is available at https://github.com/TouKaienn/ECoNGS.
papers.comment: To be published in Proceedings of IEEE VIS 2026, IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ECoNGS，一种高效的压缩神经高斯泼溅框架，用于体积可视化场景表示。它利用轻量级神经网络从显式锚点动态预测隐式高斯泼溅，结合了隐式表示的紧凑性和显式原语的高效渲染。通过联合学习策略和神经熵模型压缩，在训练时间、重建质量和模型大小上优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有基于原语的体积可视化方法存在表示冗余、不紧凑，且每个场景单独优化耗时。
Method: 采用轻量级神经网络从显式锚点预测隐式高斯泼溅；联合学习几何相似场景并共享参数；利用神经熵模型压缩显式锚点属性；提出适合体积可视化的高斯初始化方案。
Result: 与iVR-GS相比，ECoNGS在PSNR上提升高达2.2 dB，模型大小减少6.1倍，训练时间减少5.9倍。
Conclusion: ECoNGS在高斯泼溅体积可视化中实现了更紧凑、高效的表示，具有优越性能。

papers.title: AHEAD: Advancing Multi-Class Label Aggregation with Interpretable Cross-Annotator Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Crowdsourced labeling provides valuable labeled data for domains across natural language processing, computer vision, and video. Label aggregation aims to infer latent true labels from noisy and biased annotations, with the key lying in annotator reliability estimation. Despite promising progress, existing approaches struggle with one real-world bottleneck: most individual annotators label only a small subset of tasks, making accurate annotator estimation highly intractable. In this paper, we focus on the considerably more challenging multi-class label aggregation and propose AHEAD (cross-Annotator learning and High-confidEnce Annotator-guideD label aggregation), a cross-annotator learning framework that advances annotator reliability estimation by leveraging the population-level data. Specifically, AHEAD first learns high-dimensional cross-annotator contexts via a graph neural network, deriving multi-view, complementary annotator embeddings by aggregating individual-level annotator features with contextual information. These embeddings are then decoded into interpretable annotator-specific confusion matrices to fit the observed labels. We formulate a composite objective incorporating high-confidence annotators to alleviate the unsupervised training issues faced by prior models. Experiments on 10 real-world datasets spanning NLP, CV, Video, and Audio show that AHEAD substantially improves label accuracy, increasing average accuracy from 68.75% to 73.23%, with gains of up to 14.9% in the best case. Meanwhile, scalability experiments on the largest dataset further demonstrate the overall superiority of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对众包标注中多数标注者仅标注少量任务导致准确性估计困难的问题，提出AHEAD（跨标注者学习和高置信度标注者指导的标签聚合），使用图神经网络学习跨标注者上下文，生成可解释的混淆矩阵。在10个真实数据集上（NLP/CV/Video/Audio）将平均准确率从68.75%提升至73.23%，最佳提升14.9%。

Method: 提出AHEAD框架：首先用图神经网络聚合个体标注者特征和上下文信息得到多视图互补的标注者嵌入，然后解码为可解释的混淆矩阵；结合高置信度标注者的复合目标缓解无监督训练问题。
Result: 在10个真实数据集上平均准确率从68.75%升至73.23%，最佳提升14.9%；可扩展性实验表明整体优越性。

papers.title: Competitive and Complementary Tools
papers.abstract_en: Humans have always externalized thought onto tools, from the tally and the abacus to the map and, now, large language models. I model the agent, the tool, and the task as one dynamical system in which competence (what the user retains) and reliance (what the user outsources) co-evolve, and find that the outcome is bistable. Above a critical tool availability the competent state is destroyed and competence collapses toward a low dependent floor as the user outsources completely. Lowering availability does not reverse the collapse until a far lower threshold, so history of practice rather than the current tool fixes the state. Two users with the same present access can therefore occupy opposite and lasting states, one competent and one dependent, decided only by which they built first. The collapse threshold depends jointly on the competence a user brings to a task and on the tool's transparency, the fraction of its working a user can reconstruct. In the case where an agent faces an uncertain goal, a tool can cause agency itself to transfer to the tool and the human-agent becomes an agentic-instrument, irreversibly, because the tool's model is too large to internalize. The model is tested against several independent data sets, including GPS and map use, arithmetic expertise, and language models. These results reframe how tools should be built, how artificial intelligence is deployed, and what a tool-resistant education might require.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过动态系统模型研究人类与工具（如大语言模型）的协同演化，发现工具可用性超过临界值时用户能力会崩溃到依赖状态，且降低可用性不能逆转，呈现双稳态。模型在GPS、算术、语言模型等数据集上验证，结论对工具构建、AI部署和教育有启示。
Motivation: 人类长期将思维外化到工具上，但工具过度依赖可能导致能力不可逆的崩溃，本文旨在建模这一动态过程并揭示其临界条件。
Method: 将代理、工具和任务视为一个动态系统，其中用户能力（ competence）与依赖（reliance）共同演化，通过数学分析得出双稳态和滞后现象，并利用多个数据集（包括GPS、算术、语言模型）进行验证。
Result: 模型表明，当工具可用性超过某一阈值时，用户能力会崩溃到低依赖水平；即使之后降低可用性，也无法恢复到先前的高能力状态，除非降至更低的阈值。崩溃阈值取决于用户初始能力和工具透明度。在不确定目标的情况下，工具可能导致代理权完全转移。
Conclusion: 工具应具备高透明度（用户能重建其工作原理），教育应培养工具抵抗能力，以避免不可逆的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Estimating Rare Events in Language Models with Proper Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying the risk of rare failures in language models, such as those triggered by adversarial distribution shifts or very large-scale deployments, requires estimating probabilities far too small for random sampling. While recent work has formalized Low Probability Estimation, existing pipelines remain fragile in the rarest regimes: estimators can suffer zero-estimate collapse or systematic bias, and standard evaluation losses can become unstable or poorly matched to asymmetric safety costs. In this work, we introduce Gradient Activation Adaptive Multi-Level Splitting (GA-AMLS), which adapts rare-event Monte Carlo methods to the continuous activation space of language models. Specifically, GA-AMLS uses a gradient-based MCMC kernel to navigate activation space, eliminating the zero-estimate collapse of input-space search and replacing the independence assumptions of prior activation-space estimators with conditional sampling under an explicit, heavier-tailed activation prior. We also propose the Shifted-Power Bregman (SPB) Loss, a proper scoring rule that remains finite for zero-estimates and offers tunable asymmetry between underestimation and overestimation penalties. Experiments on small transformer models reveal a bias-variance tradeoff: GA-AMLS achieves the lowest loss under symmetric evaluation, reducing average log-space squared error relative to the strongest baseline across model sizes, while methods with overestimation bias prevail under asymmetric penalties. Our findings highlight that estimator choice should be matched to deployment context. More broadly, our work establishes activation space as a tractable domain for rare-event estimation in language models, circumventing the brittleness of discrete input-space search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型中罕见事件概率估计的挑战，提出GA-AMLS方法，利用梯度引导的MCMC在连续激活空间中进行自适应多层分裂，并设计了SPB损失函数。实验表明GA-AMLS在对称评估下表现最好，但估计器选择应匹配部署场景。
Motivation: 现有低概率估计方法在极罕见区域容易出现零估计崩溃或系统偏差，标准评估损失不稳定且不对称。
Method: 提出GA-AMLS，结合梯度引导的MCMC在语言模型连续激活空间中采样，使用显式重尾激活先验的条件采样；以及SPB损失，一种对零估计有限且可调不对称惩罚的适当评分规则。
Result: 在小规模Transformer实验上，GA-AMLS在对称评估下达到最低损失，降低了对数空间平方误差；而具有高估偏差的方法在不对称惩罚下占优。
Conclusion: 强调估计器的选择应与部署上下文匹配，并建立了激活空间作为语言模型中罕见事件估计的可行域。

papers.title: CANDOR: Chance-Calibrated Discordance in Frozen Foundation Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Frozen encoders are chosen by how well a lightweight head reads a finding from their features, not whether the geometry separates it. Nearest-neighbor discordance does, but with unequal banks the opposite-label neighbor wins on density, not geometry, so prevalence alone makes an uninformed encoder look blind. We introduce CANDOR, a discordance measure whose equal-size banks are symmetric under a label swap, fixing its chance level at exactly one half. Across 22 encoders, 20 datasets from 7 domains, and 605,443 images, this correction reverses the conclusion. Collapse falls below chance almost everywhere, so no encoder is blind, yet all are weak: the best chest model reads pneumothorax at 84.5 AUROC and still places 18.4% of those positives nearer an opposite-label film than its own kind in the same hospital. The same encoder that resolves bird species at 4.5 leaves chest findings at 42.8 and glaucoma at 49.8, at chance and worse than random weights. Such a case caps the normalized margin of any Lipschitz head, yet some head among eleven is correct on all but 2.8% of cases where one head misses 35.9%: the deficit is selection, not information. Erasure retention is associated with collapse; we detect no association with the objective, scale, recency, or size of the finding. Because the chance level is fixed, CANDOR can be read before any head is trained, flagging which findings a frozen encoder supports poorly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CANDOR，一种基于机会校准的不一致性度量，用于评估冰冻编码器（frozen encoders）的特征几何分离能力。通过对称标签交换的等大小样本库，将机会水平固定在1/2。在22个编码器、20个数据集、605443张图像上的实验表明，大多数编码器的特征塌陷低于机会水平，但所有编码器性能都很弱：最好的胸部模型在气胸检测上AUROC为84.5，仍有18.4%的正样本更接近反标签。该方法可在训练任何分类头之前预测编码器对特定发现的支持程度。
Motivation: 现有冰冻编码器评估依赖分类头性能，但无法反映特征几何分离能力，且最近邻不一致性受类别不平衡影响，无法区分信息缺失与编码器盲视。
Method: 提出CANDOR（Chance-Calibrated Discordance），通过构建等大小对称样本库并交换标签，使随机不一致性固定为0.5，从而校正类别不平衡偏差。
Result: 在22个编码器、20个数据集上的实验表明，几乎所有编码器的特征塌陷低于机会水平，但性能仍弱：最佳模型在气胸检测中AUROC为84.5，却将18.4%的正样本更接近反标签；同一编码器在鸟类物种分类中表现优异，但在胸部疾病和青光眼上接近随机。
Conclusion: CANDOR可独立于分类头评估编码器能力，揭示编码器对特定发现支持不足是由于选择而非信息缺失；擦除保留与塌陷相关，与目标、规模、时效等无关。

papers.title: PathReportEval: A Systematic Benchmark for Pathology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Pathology report generation from whole-slide images (WSIs) is a rapidly growing multimodal learning problem, yet progress is difficult to measure because existing studies use heterogeneous datasets, model settings, visual encoders, and evaluation protocols. Moreover, commonly used natural language generation metrics, including BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR, primarily reward lexical similarity and often fail to detect clinically consequential errors such as omitted diagnoses, hallucinated findings, or discordant tumor attributes. We present a standardized benchmark and evaluation framework for pathology report generation. The benchmark evaluates four representative methods across three datasets (TCGA, HistAI, and REG 2025) using three pathology foundation encoders (CONCHv1.5, UNI2-h, and H-Optimus-1). Our framework standardizes preprocessing, feature extraction, training, decoding, and evaluation, enabling fair comparison across models while providing a modular platform for integrating new methods, datasets, and encoders. A central contribution is the Clinical Report Quality Score (CRQS), a clinically grounded metric for evaluating factual correctness. CRQS maps reference and generated reports into structured clinical attributes and measures four complementary dimensions: clinical fact coverage, key information recall, hallucination rate, and clinical discordance, producing both an overall score and interpretable sub-scores. Experiments demonstrate that conventional language-generation metrics are weakly aligned with clinical correctness and frequently overestimate report quality. In contrast, CRQS reveals clinically meaningful differences between models and encoders that lexical metrics fail to capture. Together, the benchmark, public plug-and-play framework, and CRQS establish a reproducible foundation for rigorous evaluation of pathology report generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个用于病理报告生成的标准化基准和评估框架PathReportEval，包括三个数据集、四种代表性方法和三个病理学基础编码器，并引入临床报告质量评分（CRQS）来评估事实正确性。实验表明传统NLG指标与临床正确性弱对齐，而CRQS能揭示临床差异。
Motivation: 现有病理报告生成研究使用异构数据集和评估协议，且常用NLG指标（如BLEU）无法检测临床错误，阻碍进展测量。
Method: 提出标准化基准，统一预处理、特征提取、训练、解码和评估流程；提出CRQS指标，将报告映射到结构化临床属性，测量四个维度。
Result: 实验显示传统词法指标与临床正确性弱对齐，常高估质量；CRQS揭示了模型和编码器之间的临床差异。
Conclusion: 该基准、框架和CRQS为病理报告生成的可重复评估提供了基础。

papers.title: ChainMark: Model-Free LLM Watermarking with Closed-Form Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Regulatory regimes such as the EU AI Act mandate machine-readable marking of synthetic text, but existing watermark detectors rely on the generating LM and on heuristic thresholds with no closed-form calibration. We introduce ChainMark, an active watermark that partitions the vocabulary into S states via keyed SHA-256 and forces a hard Markov transition on a fraction rho of positions; the detector replays the partition from the same key in O(n) hash operations, with no LM access. We derive a closed-form S*(n, rho, alpha) mapping a target FPR, text length, and budget to the minimum state count (Theorem 1), prove a universal robustness threshold delta* = 1 - 1/sqrt(2) approximately 29.3% that is invariant in (S, rho, n) (Theorem 2), and generalise both to any k-regular transition topology (Theorem 3). Across three instruction-tuned LLMs and four domains, ChainMark strictly dominates KGW and SWEET under translation and random-substitution attacks at matched budget; a one-corpus empirical recalibration restores the 1% target FPR on natural-language text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ChainMark，一种无需访问语言模型的无模型LLM水印方法。它通过keyed SHA-256将词汇表划分为S个状态，在rho比例的位置强制硬马尔可夫转移，检测器仅需O(n)哈希操作。文中推导了状态数S的闭式解、通用鲁棒性阈值约29.3%及其推广形式。实验表明，在三个指令微调LLM和四个领域上，ChainMark在相同预算下优于KGW和SWEET，且单语料库重新校准可恢复目标FPR。
Motivation: 现有水印检测方法依赖于生成式语言模型和启发式阈值，缺乏闭式校准，不符合EU AI Act等法规对机器可读标记的要求。
Method: 提出ChainMark主动水印：通过keyed SHA-256将词汇表划分为S个状态，在rho比例的位置施加硬马尔可夫转移；检测器使用相同密钥重放划分，无需LM参与。推导了S*(n, rho, alpha)的闭式公式、通用鲁棒性阈值delta* = 1 - 1/sqrt(2) ≈ 29.3%，并推广到任意k-正则转移拓扑。
Result: 在三个指令微调LLM和四个领域中，ChainMark在相同预算下严格优于KGW和SWEET，且在自然语言文本上通过单语料库经验重新校准可恢复1%的目标FPR。
Conclusion: ChainMark提供了一种无模型、可校准的LLM水印方案，理论上保证了鲁棒性阈值与闭式校准，适合监管合规场景。

papers.title: Relay-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Multi-Domain Reasoning Chains
papers.abstract_en: Introducing Relay-Bench, an unsaturated, holistic, text-only benchmark that measures LLMs' ability to complete an assortment of tasks from distinct domains in a single prompt. The leading model, GPT-5.5 (xHigh), scores 43.3%. The test set entirely consists of composite problems: groups of single-domain subproblems that are strung together into challenges that require reasoning across multiple domains in combination. Many of these problems then have layers of complexity added through prompt encoding and deliberate context bloat. Domains tested include visual reasoning, coding, math, information extraction (with a focus on web search), problem-solving, general knowledge, and data analysis. No restrictions are imposed outside of the model harness, and models are explicitly encouraged to leverage code-execution, web searches, and all available tools. All problems are composed of two to thirteen subproblems and do not require multi-modal input or output.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Relay-Bench是一个新的文本基准，用于评估LLM在单个提示中完成跨多个不同领域子问题的推理链能力。测试集由2到13个单领域子问题组成的复合问题构成，并通过提示编码和上下文膨胀增加复杂度。目前最佳模型GPT-5.5 (xHigh)得分仅43.3%，表明该任务仍有很大提升空间。
Motivation: 现有基准可能未能全面评估LLM在多个领域间组合推理的能力，Relay-Bench旨在提供一个未饱和且全面的评估。
Method: 构建由多个单领域子问题（涉及视觉推理、编码、数学、信息提取、问题解决、常识和数据分析）组成的复合问题，并采用提示编码和上下文膨胀增加问题复杂性。不限制模型使用代码执行、网页搜索等工具，仅限文本输入输出。
Result: GPT-5.5 (xHigh)在Relay-Bench上达到43.3%的准确率，为当前最高分。
Conclusion: LLM在跨领域推理链任务上表现仍有限，该基准为未来模型改进提供了挑战。

papers.title: Surprise Forcing: What to Remember, When to Skip in Long Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Streaming autoregressive diffusion makes minute-scale video synthesis practical, but its bounded context and fixed denoising schedule allocate resources uniformly across a highly non-stationary sequence. A rolling key-value cache forgets distant visual evidence even when that evidence remains important, while every generated chunk receives the same number of denoising passes irrespective of its actual difficulty. We introduce Surprise Forcing, a training-free framework that treats both limitations as online resource-allocation problems. A Surprise-Gated Memory Bank summarizes evicted frames with value-token descriptors, evaluates them using complementary global-deviation and nearest-neighbor novelty signals, and regulates admission through a feedback-controlled budget in normalized score space. Priority-based replacement and relevance-aware routing then keep the external memory compact and useful. In parallel, Surprise-Aware Denoising estimates chunk difficulty from the maximum adjacent-frame cosine distance after the first denoising pass and uses a local percentile scheduler to skip intermediate steps for comparatively easy chunks. Experiments on VBench, VBench-Long, and VBench-2.0 show that the proposed allocation strategy improves long-horizon consistency and visual quality while retaining real-time streaming throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长视频生成中流式自回归扩散模型（streaming autoregressive diffusion）的固定上下文和均匀去噪调度问题，提出无训练框架Surprise Forcing。该方法包含两个组件：Surprise-Gated Memory Bank通过价值标记描述符（value-token descriptors）和反馈控制预算管理被驱逐帧，实现紧凑且有用的外部记忆；Surprise-Aware Denoising根据第一遍去噪后的最大相邻帧余弦距离估计块难度，用局部百分位调度器跳过简单块的中间步骤。实验表明该方法在VBench、VBench-Long和VBench-2.0上提升了长期一致性和视觉质量，同时保持了实时流式吞吐。
Motivation: 现有流式自回归扩散模型为长视频生成分配固定上下文和均匀去噪步数，导致重要视觉证据被遗忘，且困难帧与简单帧获得相同计算资源，造成效率低下。
Method: 提出Surprise Forcing，包含Surprise-Gated Memory Bank和Surprise-Aware Denoising。前者用价值标记描述符总结被驱逐帧，通过全局偏差和最近邻新颖性信号评估，并采用反馈控制预算在归一化分数空间中调节准入；后者在第一遍去噪后计算相邻帧最大余弦距离作为难度估计，用局部百分位调度器跳过简单块的中间去噪步骤。
Result: 在VBench、VBench-Long和VBench-2.0基准上，该方法提升了长期一致性（long-horizon consistency）和视觉质量，同时保持实时流式吞吐。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将长视频生成中的上下文和计算资源分配视为在线优化问题，通过基于惊讶度（surprise）的门控记忆和自适应去噪调度，可以在不增加训练代价的情况下改善生成质量。

papers.title: Intelligence from Learnable Novelty
papers.abstract_en: Intelligence appears under different names in different fields: as data compression in statistics and machine learning, as universal computation in dynamical systems, and as adaptive behavior in agents. Each field carries its own objective, and the two most influential drives often fail in mirror image: novelty search, which seeks surprise, is transfixed by a noisy television screen, while the free-energy principle, which avoids surprise, is most content in a dark room. Both failures have a single cause: each objective treats as one quantity the surprise a learner can convert into knowledge and the surprise it never can. Here we show that the learnable part of that information, which we call learnable novelty, yields the seemingly disparate projections of intelligence, and we give a closed-form estimator of it built on a cheap and differentiable reservoir computer. Used as a measure, with no supervision of any kind, the estimator recovers decades of complexity classification, ranking the Turing-complete rule~110 highest among the elementary cellular automata. Used as an objective, its gradient carries a neural cellular automaton from simple dynamics into a regime of solitons, the traveling, colliding structures by which rule~110 computes, as well as organizes the representation of an image encoder around the ten digit classes of MNIST, fully unsupervised: no label ever enters training. Handed to a reinforcement-learning agent as an intrinsic reward, it supplies the exploration that task rewards lack, improving on the task baseline in nine of ten environments and collapsing in none. Complexity generation, abstraction, and exploration, ordinarily pursued with unrelated objectives in separate fields, thus emerge from ascent on one differentiable quantity, and the projections of intelligence gain a common quantitative footing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可学习新奇性（learnable novelty）的概念，并给出基于可微储层计算机的闭合形式估计器。该估计器作为度量可恢复复杂性分类（Turing-complete rule 110 在初等细胞自动机中排名最高），作为目标可驱动神经细胞自动机产生孤立子、无监督组织图像编码器的MNIST数字表征，作为内在奖励可改进强化学习在9/10环境中的探索。
Motivation: 新奇性搜索和自由能原则各自存在缺陷（前者被噪声吸引，后者偏好黑暗），根本原因在于两者都将可转化为知识的惊奇与不可转化的惊奇混为一谈。
Method: 定义可学习新奇性，并基于廉价可微的储层计算机（reservoir computer）推导其闭合形式估计器，该估计器可作为度量或目标函数使用。
Result: 估计器在初等细胞自动机中正确识别出Turing-complete rule 110为最高复杂类；梯度上升使神经细胞自动机产生孤立子；无监督下使图像编码器围绕MNIST十类数字组织表征；作为强化学习内在奖励在10个环境中9个超过任务基线。
Conclusion: 复杂性生成、抽象和探索这些通常在不同领域用不同目标处理的问题，可统一为对一个可微量的上升，从而为智能的不同投影提供共同的定量基础。

papers.title: Using binary silver labels in electronic health records-based computable phenotyping algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Gold-standard phenotype labels are often unavailable at scale in electronic health record (EHR) studies because they require manual chart review. Weakly supervised phenotyping methods instead use silver-standard labels, such as diagnosis-code counts, natural language processing (NLP) mentions, medication indicators, or laboratory thresholds. PheNorm is widely used for this purpose, but its original formulation was designed for count-valued silver labels and relies on log transformation, utilization normalization, and Gaussian mixture modeling. These steps are not directly suited to binary silver labels, which are common and may be highly informative. We propose Binary PheNorm, an extension that uses binary silver labels directly in the corruption-and-regression denoising step and produces a continuous phenotype score without EM calibration. We also consider a lasso-regularized version for high-dimensional EHR settings and combined models using both binary and count labels. In simulations, Binary PheNorm achieved strong discrimination using binary labels alone and often improved performance when combined with count labels. In anaphylaxis, AUC increased from 0.793 for an epinephrine-mention indicator to 0.891-0.892 after Binary PheNorm. In acute pancreatitis, AUC increased from 0.736 for a lipase-threshold indicator to 0.805-0.819. These results support Binary PheNorm as a practical weakly supervised approach when informative binary silver labels are available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了Binary PheNorm，扩展了PheNorm算法以直接处理电子健康记录中的二进制银标准标签（如诊断代码、NLP提及等），无需对数变换或EM校准。在模拟和真实数据中，Binary PheNorm单独使用二进制标签即可获得强区分能力，与计数标签结合时进一步提升性能。
Motivation: 现有的PheNorm算法针对计数型银标签设计，不适合广泛存在的二进制银标签，导致信息利用不充分。
Method: 提出Binary PheNorm，直接利用二进制银标签进行腐败回归去噪，生成连续表型评分；还包括lasso正则化版本和结合二进制与计数标签的组合模型。
Result: 模拟中Binary PheNorm使用二进制标签取得强区分能力；真实数据中，过敏反应AUC从0.793提升至0.891-0.892，急性胰腺炎AUC从0.736提升至0.805-0.819。
Conclusion: Binary PheNorm是一种实用的弱监督方法，适用于存在信息量丰富的二进制银标签的电子健康记录研究。

summary_sections.method: 提出Binary PheNorm，直接利用二进制银标签进行腐败回归去噪，生成连续表型评分；还包括lasso正则化版本和结合二进制与计数标签的组合模型。
summary_sections.result: 模拟中Binary PheNorm使用二进制标签取得强区分能力；真实数据中，过敏反应AUC从0.793提升至0.891-0.892，急性胰腺炎AUC从0.736提升至0.805-0.819。
summary_sections.conclusion: Binary PheNorm是一种实用的弱监督方法，适用于存在信息量丰富的二进制银标签的电子健康记录研究。

papers.title: Adversarial Robustness of Phishing Email Detection: A Comparative Study of TF-IDF + Logistic Regression and Fine-Tuned DistilBERT
papers.abstract_en: Phishing emails remain one of the most persistent cybersecurity threats, and machine-learning classifiers are widely used to detect them. Most reported detection accuracies, however, are measured on clean, in-distribution test data rather than on emails deliberately altered to evade detection. This paper reports a controlled, pairwise comparison of two phishing-detection approaches a TF-IDF + Logistic Regression baseline and a fine-tuned DistilBERT transformer trained on a unified corpus of 82,255 emails drawn from six public datasets and evaluated under three conditions: normal in-distribution, synthetic phishing, and adversarial phishing. Both models exceeded 98% accuracy on clean data yet degraded sharply under adversarial testing: TF-IDF + LR fell to 64.00% (a 34.59-percentage-point drop) and DistilBERT fell to 63.64% (a 35.40-percentage-point drop) a gap of only 0.36 percentage points, equivalent to a single email in the 275-sample adversarial test set. LIME, SHAP, and attention-rollout analysis indicate the two models relied on different evidence yet showed similar vulnerability. Pairwise error analysis shows the models agreed on 54.9% of adversarial samples but each made a similar number of exclusive errors (24 and 25 respectively), indicating partly complementary rather than identical failure modes. The results show that clean-data accuracy does not predict adversarial robustness, and that adversarial testing should be a standard part of phishing-detection evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对TF-IDF+逻辑回归和微调DistilBERT两种钓鱼邮件检测方法进行了对比研究，在包含82255封邮件的统一语料上评估了正常、合成钓鱼和对抗钓鱼三种条件下的性能。两种方法在干净数据上均超过98%准确率，但对抗测试中分别降至64.00%和63.64%，下降约35个百分点，差距仅0.36个百分点。LIME、SHAP和注意力分析表明两者依赖不同证据但脆弱性相似，错误分析显示部分互补的失败模式。
Motivation: 现有钓鱼邮件检测研究多报告干净数据上的准确率，而忽略了对刻意规避检测的对抗样本的鲁棒性评估，导致实际部署中性能可能大幅下降。
Method: 构建统一语料库（6个公开数据集，82255封邮件），训练TF-IDF+逻辑回归基线模型和微调DistilBERT模型，并在正常、合成钓鱼和对抗钓鱼三种测试条件下进行对比评估，使用LIME、SHAP和注意力展开分析模型解释。
Result: 两种模型在干净数据上均超过98%准确率，但在对抗测试中TF-IDF+LR降至64.00%（下降34.59个百分点），DistilBERT降至63.64%（下降35.40个百分点），两者差距仅0.36个百分点；错误分析显示模型对54.9%的对抗样本一致错误，各自独有错误分别为24和25个。
Conclusion: 干净数据准确率不能预测对抗鲁棒性，对抗测试应成为钓鱼邮件检测评估的标准环节。

papers.title: PAC--Bayes Bounds on Quotient Parameter Spaces: Geometry-induced Implicit-Bias Priors
papers.abstract_en: Overparameterized models often have continuous parameter symmetries, so different parameters define the same predictor. We show that PAC--Bayesian analysis should be performed on the quotient predictor space: pushing a prior and posterior to the quotient preserves the empirical and population Gibbs risks while removing the nonnegative KL contribution caused solely by how the two distributions differ among parameterizations of the same predictor. Quotienting alone does not determine which prior to use. We construct a canonical choice of one parameterization for each predictor and account for the geometric volume of its equivalent parameterizations. This transforms a neutral reference prior into a data-independent prior that reflects the model's implicit bias. It approximates the ideal but inadmissible posterior-matched prior, which would minimize the KL term by depending on the training data. The resulting certificate is tighter exactly when this geometry-induced prior has smaller KL divergence from the learned quotient posterior than the neutral prior. We test this prediction in Fourier regression with a Hadamard parameterization and in Query-Key attention, using ordinary SGD without an explicit regularizer. The implicit-bias prior reduces the mean quotient-space KL by \(40.69\%\) and the mean PAC--Bayes certificate by \(21.40\%\) in the Fourier-Hadamard experiment. The smaller, prior-scale-dependent improvement in Query-Key attention confirms the predicted conditional nature of the effect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究过参数化模型中的连续参数对称性，指出PAC-Bayesian分析应在商预测空间上进行，通过商化去除参数化差异带来的KL散度。提出一种几何诱导的隐偏差先验，该先验近似理想但不可行的后验匹配先验，并在傅里叶回归和Query-Key注意力实验中验证了其紧致性。
Motivation: 过参数化模型存在连续参数对称性，不同参数定义相同预测器，导致传统PAC-Bayes边界中KL散度被参数化方式而非预测性能膨胀，需要消除这种无关贡献。
Method: 将先验和后验推到商预测空间，保留经验风险和总体风险，消除仅由参数化差异引起的KL散度。通过选择每个预测器的规范参数化并考虑等价参数化的几何体积，将中性参考先验转换为反映模型隐偏差的数据无关先验。
Result: 在傅里叶-哈达玛实验中，隐偏差先验使商空间KL平均降低40.69%，PAC-Bayes证书平均降低21.40%；Query-Key注意力实验中改善较小且依赖于先验尺度。
Conclusion: 商化预测空间和几何诱导先验能有效收紧PAC-Bayes边界，但改进程度依赖于模型结构是否产生显著的隐偏差先验效应。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Hard conservation correctors can hide a degrading model when training autoregressive emulators
papers.abstract_en: AI weather and climate emulators increasingly incorporate physical principles into their formulation. One approach is to apply hard correctors that modify network outputs so that global mass, water, or energy budgets close. Prior work introduced such training-time correctors in the CREDIT framework and reported reduced precipitation bias and improved stability. Motivated by those results, we fine-tuned a global atmosphere emulator with a water-budget corrector, using the corrected prediction in the supervised loss and evaluating through post-correction budget closure. By that measure, training appeared successful. Every delivered field closed the moisture budget to machine precision. However, raw precipitation developed a growing global low bias over 18 training epochs, while the required correction increased from about 2% to roughly 24%. The cause is a scale degeneracy. A uniform change in raw precipitation amplitude is offset by a compensating change in the correction factor, leaving the corrected field, and therefore the supervised loss, unchanged. This invariance removes the restoring force on raw precipitation amplitude, allowing other training pressures to drive drift. Two changes recovered stable behavior. We supervised the pre-correction prediction and penalized its raw budget imbalance, while the hard correction remained in place for the delivered field. The required correction returned to less than 1% within the next epoch. A controlled 2x2 ablation showed that the runaway occurred only when corrected-output supervision was combined with no imbalance penalty. Exact post-correction closure therefore says little about whether the raw model has learned the budget. When a corrector removes information from the loss, the raw fields and the applied correction need to be tracked.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现，在训练AI天气仿真器时，硬性水预算修正器（hard water-budget corrector）会掩盖原始模型的退化。原始降水出现全球低偏差，但修正器通过补偿使校正后的场保持预算闭合，导致监督损失不变，从而允许模型持续退化。通过监督原始预测并惩罚原始预算不平衡，可以恢复稳定行为。
Motivation: AI天气仿真器常采用硬性修正器强制预算闭合，但这类修正器是否真正帮助模型学习预算尚不清楚，需要验证其潜在副作用。
Method: 在CREDIT框架下微调全球大气仿真器，使用水预算修正器，对比两种训练策略：仅监督校正后输出，以及同时监督预校正预测并惩罚原始预算不平衡。
Result: 仅监督校正后输出时，原始降水偏差从约2%增长到24%，而修正量相应增加，损失不变；增加预校正监督和不平衡惩罚后，所需修正量在一个epoch内降至1%以下。
Conclusion: 后修正预算闭合不能保证原始模型学到了预算，必须跟踪原始场和修正量。
Relevance: 75

papers.title: Scalable and Efficient Joint Spiking Embedding Predictive Architecture for Large-Scale Dynamic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic graph learning aims to capture evolving structural and semantic patterns in real-world systems, such as fraud detection and recommender systems. Due to the scarcity of labeled data in real-world dynamic graphs, recent studies have introduced generative or contrastive paradigms (e.g., masked graph autoencoders or graph contrastive learning) to generate task-agnostic graph embeddings. However, these methods typically rely on complex edge-level reconstruction objectives and tailored graph augmentation strategies. This incurs substantial computational overhead when scaling to large-scale dynamic graphs. In this paper, we propose SG-JEPA, a joint spiking embedding predictive architecture for large-scale dynamic graphs. In contrast to existing self-supervised methods, SG-JEPA partitions nodes into context and target sets along the temporal dimension to learn embeddings that are predictive of each other via additional spatial-temporal information. Furthermore, through encoding sequential inputs into coarse-to-fine spike count embeddings, spiking neurons enable SG-JEPA to adapt to the varying computational constraints of downstream tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SG-JEPA achieves competitive or even superior performance over discriminative baselines on node classification, while effectively scaling to the dynamic graph with 13 million edges. SG-JEPA avoids the complex machinery (negative sampling, graph augmentations, edge-level reconstruction, etc.), resulting in superior training efficiency and memory scalability compared with prior self-supervised dynamic graph baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SG-JEPA，一种用于大规模动态图的联合尖峰嵌入预测架构。与现有自监督方法不同，SG-JEPA 沿时间维度将节点分为上下文集和目标集，通过空间-时间信息学习可相互预测的嵌入。尖峰神经元将序列输入编码为从粗到细的尖峰计数嵌入，适应下游任务的不同计算约束。实验表明，SG-JEPA 在节点分类上达到有竞争力甚至更优的性能，可扩展到 1300 万条边的动态图，并避免负采样、图增强、边级重建等复杂机制，训练效率和内存可扩展性优于先前自监督动态图基线。
Motivation: 现有动态图自监督方法（如掩码图自编码器、图对比学习）依赖复杂的边级重建目标和定制图增强策略，导致扩展到大规模动态图时计算开销大。
Method: 提出 SG-JEPA，一种联合尖峰嵌入预测架构。沿时间维度划分节点为上下文集和目标集，利用额外空间-时间信息学习可相互预测的嵌入；通过尖峰神经元将序列输入编码为从粗到细的尖峰计数嵌入，适应不同计算约束。
Result: SG-JEPA 在节点分类任务上达到与判别式基线相当甚至更优的性能，可有效扩展到 1300 万条边的动态图，并相较于先前自监督动态图基线具有更优的训练效率和内存可扩展性。
Conclusion: SG-JEPA 通过预测范式替代重建和对比范式，大幅简化动态图自监督学习，同时保持甚至提升性能，适合大规模动态图场景。

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic Meta-Policies for Temporal Knowledge-Graph Memory under Partial Observability
papers.abstract_en: Partially observable reinforcement learning requires deciding what to retain, retrieve, and forget over time. We introduce a neuro-symbolic meta-policy that learns which symbolic memory heuristic to apply at each decision point while keeping execution symbolic. Our setting uses temporal knowledge-graph memory in RoomKG, where hidden state and observations are represented as Resource Description Framework (RDF) graphs and memory is augmented with temporal RDF triple annotations. The model combines knowledge-graph encoding of memory contents with value heads for question answering, exploration, and forgetting, yielding a controller that is both adaptive and inspectable. This gives the work a direct Semantic Web grounding through RDF-based representation, annotation-compatible graph semantics, and graph-based symbolic operations over explicit memory state. On train/test room splits at long-term memory capacity of 512, the qualifier-aware StarE-GNN configuration achieves the best held-out performance among the compared symbolic, neural, and neuro-symbolic systems while preserving step-level traceability of memory-management decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号元策略（neuro-symbolic meta-policy），用于部分可观测强化学习中的时间知识图谱记忆管理，在RoomKG环境中使用RDF图表示状态和观测，通过学习选择符号记忆启发式，实现可检查的自适应控制。在长期记忆容量512的测试分割中，qualifier-aware StarE-GNN配置在保持步骤级可追溯性的前提下取得了最佳性能。
Motivation: 部分可观测强化学习需要智能体在处理观测序列时决定保留、检索和遗忘哪些信息，现有方法缺乏符号可解释性和结构化记忆表示。
Method: 提出一种神经符号元策略，在每个决策点学习选择符号记忆启发式（如问题回答、探索、遗忘），结合知识图谱编码和值函数头，使用RDF三元组和时间注解增强记忆，并以StarE-GNN作为图编码器。
Result: 在RoomKG的train/test房间分割、长期记忆容量512的设置下，qualifier-aware StarE-GNN配置在对比的符号、神经和神经符号系统中取得了最佳的保留集性能（held-out performance），同时保持了记忆管理决策的步骤级可追溯性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过RDF基础和符号操作实现了可检查的知识图谱记忆管理，为部分可观测RL提供了结构化的记忆优化范式。

papers.title: AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling -- Full Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Unlike conventional video game development, which relies on labor-intensive pipelines for asset production, animation, physics, and programming, video world models generate interactive environments from user inputs instantly. It enable us to create customized, explorable, and continuously evolving virtual world from text, an image, or video. Realizing this vision requires four tightly coupled capabilities: interaction, persistent spatiotemporal consistency, stable long-horizon generation, and efficient response. We present AlayaWorld, an interactive long-horizon video world model that generates 24-fps video at 540p and 720p. Built on a 15B video diffusion transformer, AlayaWorld generates short latent chunks autoregressively under camera trajectories and switchable text prompts. Its bounded visual context combines a persistent sink frame, compressed temporal history, geometry-aligned spatial memory, and recent-frame conditioning. To reduce long-term drift, the model is trained with corrupted histories and prediction residuals collected from its own roll-outs. We further introduce a discrete autoregressive distillation formulation that combines distribution-matching distillation, self-forcing++, and consistency distillation, reducing inference from approximately 30 sampling steps to four steps per chunk. On iWorld-Bench, AlayaWorld achieves the best performance over long-horizon generation. Conceived as a full-stack, open-source, and long-term project, AlayaWorld is intended to provide an extensible foundation for future research on interactive video world models.

TL;DR: AlayaWorld是一个交互式长时域视频世界模型，能够从文本、图像或视频生成可探索的虚拟世界。它基于15B参数的视频扩散Transformer，以24fps生成540p或720p视频，通过自回归生成短潜在块，并采用有界视觉上下文（包括持久吸收帧、压缩时间历史、几何对齐空间记忆和最近帧条件）来保持一致性。通过训练损坏历史和自滚动预测残差减少长期漂移，并引入离散自回归蒸馏配方（结合分布匹配蒸馏、self-forcing++和一致性蒸馏）将每块推理从约30步减少到4步。在iWorld-Bench上取得最佳长时域生成性能。
Motivation: 传统视频游戏开发依赖劳动密集型的资产制作、动画、物理和编程管线，而视频世界模型可以即时从用户输入生成交互环境。实现这一愿景需要交互性、持久时空一致性、稳定长时域生成和高效响应四个紧密耦合的能力。
Method: 提出AlayaWorld模型，基于15B视频扩散Transformer，自回归生成短潜在块，使用有界视觉上下文（持久吸收帧、压缩时间历史、几何对齐空间记忆和最近帧条件）。通过训练损坏历史和自滚动残差减少漂移，并采用离散自回归蒸馏（分布匹配蒸馏、self-forcing++、一致性蒸馏）将推理步数从约30减少到4。
Result: 在iWorld-Bench上取得最佳长时域生成性能，以24fps生成540p和720p视频。
Conclusion: AlayaWorld作为全栈、开源、长期项目，旨在为交互式视频世界模型的未来研究提供可扩展基础。
