papers.title: Toward Learning POMDPs Beyond Full-Rank Actions and State Observability
papers.abstract_en: We are interested in enabling autonomous agents to learn and reason about systems with hidden states, such as locking mechanisms. We cast this problem as learning the parameters of a discrete Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP). The agent begins with knowledge of the POMDP's actions and observation spaces, but not its state space, transitions, or observation models. These properties must be constructed from a sequence of actions and observations. Spectral approaches to learning models of partially observable domains, such as Predictive State Representations (PSRs), learn representations of state that are sufficient to predict future outcomes. PSR models, however, do not have explicit transition and observation system models that can be used with different reward functions to solve different planning problems. Under a mild set of rankness assumptions on the products of transition and observation matrices, we show how PSRs learn POMDP matrices up to a similarity transform, and this transform may be estimated via tensor decomposition methods. Our method learns observation matrices and transition matrices up to a partition of states, where the states in a single partition have the same observation distributions corresponding to actions whose transition matrices are full-rank. Our experiments suggest that explicit observation and transition likelihoods can be leveraged to generate new plans for different goals and reward functions after the model has been learned. We also show that learning a POMDP beyond a partition of states is impossible from sequential data by constructing two POMDPs that agree on all observation distributions but differ in their transition dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何让自主智能体从动作-观测序列中学习具有隐藏状态的离散POMDP参数，而不需要预先知道状态空间、转移模型或观测模型。利用预测状态表示（PSR）和谱方法，在转移矩阵与观测矩阵乘积的满秩假设下，证明可学习到状态分区内的观测和转移矩阵，并通过张量分解估计相似变换。实验表明学到的显式似然可用于不同奖励函数的新规划，同时证明了从序列数据中学习超出状态分区的POMDP是不可能的。
Motivation: 现有POMDP学习方法通常需要已知状态空间或观测模型，但在许多实际场景（如锁机制）中这些未知。本文希望在仅知道动作空间和观测空间的条件下，从数据中自动构建状态表示和系统模型。
Method: 基于PSR框架，利用谱方法学习状态表示，并通过张量分解恢复POMDP矩阵的相似变换。关键在于对转移矩阵和观测矩阵乘积的秩条件进行假设，从而将状态空间划分为不可再分的分区。
Result: 实验表明，学习到的观测和转移似然可用于重新规划不同目标与奖励函数的问题。理论构造表明，从序列数据中区分同一分区内的不同状态是不可能的，因此学习只能达到状态分区的粒度。
Conclusion: 该方法在较弱的秩假设下允许从数据中学习POMDP的显式模型，但存在状态分区的固有限制，即无法区分具有相同观测分布的动作对应的不同状态。

papers.title: Tumor-anchored deep feature random forests for out-of-distribution detection in lung cancer segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of lung tumors from 3D computed tomography (CT) scans is essential for automated treatment planning and response assessment. Despite self-supervised pretraining on numerous datasets, state-of-the-art transformer backbones remain susceptible to out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs, often producing confidently incorrect segmentations with potential for risk in clinical deployment. Hence, we introduce RF-Deep, a lightweight post-hoc random forests-based framework that leverages deep features trained with limited outlier exposure, requiring as few as 40 labeled scans (20 in-distribution and 20 OOD), to improve scan-level OOD detection. RF-Deep repurposes the hierarchical features from the pretrained-then-finetuned segmentation backbones, aggregating features from multiple regions-of-interest anchored to predicted tumor regions to capture OOD likelihood. We evaluated RF-Deep on 2,232 CT volumes spanning near-OOD (pulmonary embolism, COVID-19 negative) and far-OOD (kidney cancer, healthy pancreas) datasets. RF-Deep achieved AUROC >~93 on the challenging near-OOD datasets, where it outperformed the next best method by 4--7 percentage points, and produced near-perfect detection (AUROC >~99) on far-OOD datasets. The approach also showed transferability to two blinded validation datasets under the ensemble configuration (COVID-19 positive and breast cancer; AUROC >~94). RF-Deep maintained consistent performance across backbones of different depths and pretraining strategies, demonstrating applicability of post-hoc detectors as a safety filter for clinical deployment of tumor segmentation pipelines.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/aneesh3108/RF-Deep
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RF-Deep，一个轻量级的基于随机森林的后处理框架，利用预训练后再微调的分割骨干网络中的深度特征，通过锚定预测肿瘤区域的多个感兴趣区域来聚合特征，以检测肺癌CT分割中的分布外（OOD）输入。在2232个CT体积上的评估表明，RF-Deep在近OOD数据集上AUROC超过93%，优于次优方法4-7个百分点，在远OOD数据集上接近完美检测（AUROC>99%），并在两个盲法验证数据集上显示可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有最先进的Transformer骨干网络在自监督预训练后，仍易受分布外输入影响，产生高置信度的错误分割，在临床部署中带来风险。
Method: RF-Deep是一个轻量级后处理框架，使用随机森林，利用有限异常暴露（仅需20个分布内和20个分布外标注扫描）训练的深度特征，通过锚定预测肿瘤区域的多区域特征聚合来捕捉OOD可能性。
Result: 在2232个CT体积上，RF-Deep在近OOD数据集（肺栓塞、COVID-19阴性）上AUROC超过93%，优于次优方法4-7个百分点；在远OOD数据集（肾癌、健康胰腺）上AUROC超过99%；在盲法验证数据集（COVID-19阳性、乳腺癌）上AUROC超过94%。
Conclusion: RF-Deep作为后处理检测器，在不同深度和预训练策略的骨干网络上表现一致，可作为肿瘤分割管线临床部署的安全过滤器。

papers.title: Data Reliability Scoring
papers.abstract_en: How can we assess the reliability of a dataset without access to ground truth? We introduce the problem of reliability scoring for datasets collected from potentially strategic sources. The true data are unobserved, but we see outcomes of an unknown statistical experiment that depends on them. To benchmark reliability, we define ground-truth-based orderings that capture how much reported data deviate from the truth. We then propose the Gram determinant score, which measures the volume spanned by vectors describing the empirical distribution of the observed data and experiment outcomes. We show that this score preserves several ground-truth-based reliability orderings and, uniquely up to scaling, yields the same reliability ranking of datasets regardless of the experimen -- a property we term experiment agnosticism. Experiments on synthetic noise models, CIFAR-10 embeddings, and real employment data demonstrate that the Gram determinant score effectively captures data quality across diverse observation processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出数据可靠性评分问题，在没有真实标签的情况下，通过Gram行列式评分度量数据集的可靠性。该评分计算观测数据和实验结果的经验分布向量张成的体积，保持多种基于真实标签的可靠性排序，且唯一满足实验无关性。实验在合成噪声模型、CIFAR-10嵌入和真实就业数据上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 传统数据质量评估依赖真实标签，但许多场景下真实数据不可观测，需要在不访问真实标签的情况下评估数据集的可靠性。
Method: 提出Gram行列式评分，通过观测数据和实验结果的经验分布向量张成的体积来度量数据集可靠性，理论上保持基于真实标签的排序，并具有实验无关性。
Result: 在合成噪声模型、CIFAR-10嵌入和真实就业数据上，该评分有效捕捉数据质量。
Conclusion: 提供了一种无需真实标签的数据可靠性评估方法，具有理论保证和实验验证。

papers.title: SENTINEL: A Multi-Level Formal Framework for Safety Evaluation of Foundation Model-based Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: We present SENTINEL, a framework for formally evaluating the physical safety of foundation model (FM)-based embodied agents. SENTINEL is the first to provide multi-level safety evaluation across semantic interpretation, plan generation, and physical execution within a unified formal framework. Unlike prior methods that rely on heuristic rules or subjective FM judgments, SENTINEL grounds practical safety requirements in formal temporal logic (TL) semantics that can precisely specify state invariants, temporal dependencies, and timing constraints. It employs a multi-level verification pipeline where (i) at the semantic level, intuitive natural language safety requirements are formalized into TL formulas and the agent's understanding of these requirements is probed for alignment with the TL formulas; (ii) at the plan level, high-level action plans and subgoals generated by the agent are verified against the TL formulas to detect unsafe plans before execution; and (iii) at the trajectory level, multiple execution trajectories are merged into a computation tree and efficiently verified against physically-detailed TL specifications for a final safety check. We apply SENTINEL in VirtualHome and AI2-THOR, and formally evaluate multiple FM-based embodied agents against diverse safety requirements. Our experiments show that by grounding physical safety in temporal logic and applying verification methods across multiple levels, SENTINEL provides a rigorous foundation for systematically evaluating the safety of FM-based embodied agents in simulation-based physical environments, and can effectively expose potential safety violations in interpreting, planning, and executing the tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SENTINEL 是一个用于评估基于基础模型 (FM) 的具身智能体物理安全性的形式化框架，首次在统一框架内提供跨语义解释、计划生成和物理执行的多级安全评估。它通过时序逻辑 (TL) 形式化安全需求，并在三个层面进行验证：语义层的需求对齐、计划层的动作验证、轨迹层的计算树验证。在 VirtualHome 和 AI2-THOR 模拟环境中，该框架能够有效暴露智能体在理解、规划和执行任务中的安全隐患。
Motivation: 现有具身智能体安全评估依赖启发式规则或主观的 FM 判断，缺乏严格的形式化基础，难以保证物理安全。
Method: 提出多级验证管线：语义层将自然语言安全需求形式化为 TL 公式并探测智能体理解一致性；计划层验证高层动作计划与子目标是否违反 TL 规范；轨迹层合并执行轨迹为计算树，验证物理细节的 TL 规范。
Result: 在 VirtualHome 和 AI2-THOR 中，对多种 FM 驱动的具身智能体进行形式化安全评估，实验表明该框架能有效暴露语义理解、计划生成和物理执行中的安全违规。
Conclusion: 将物理安全基于时序逻辑并应用多级验证方法，为模拟环境中 FM 具身智能体的系统安全评估提供了严格基础。

papers.title: Learning Encoding-Decoding Direction Pairs to Unveil Concepts of Influence in Deep Vision Networks
papers.abstract_en: Empirical evidence shows that deep vision networks often represent concepts as directions in latent space with concept information written along directional components in the vector representation of the input. However, the mechanism to encode (write) and decode (read) concept information to and from vector representations is not directly accessible as it constitutes a latent mechanism that naturally emerges from the training process of the network. Recovering this mechanism unlocks significant potential to open the black-box nature of deep networks, enabling understanding, debugging, and improving deep learning models. In this work, we propose an unsupervised method to recover this mechanism. For each concept, we explain that under the hypothesis of linear concept representations, this mechanism can be implemented with the help of two directions: the first facilitating encoding of concept information and the second facilitating decoding. Unlike prior matrix decomposition, autoencoder, or dictionary learning methods that rely on feature reconstruction, we propose a new perspective: decoding directions are identified via directional clustering of activations, and encoding directions are estimated with signal vectors under a probabilistic view. We further leverage network weights through a novel technique, Uncertainty Region Alignment, which reveals interpretable directions affecting predictions. Our analysis shows that (a) on synthetic data, our method recovers ground-truth direction pairs; (b) on real data, decoding directions map to monosemantic, interpretable concepts and outperform unsupervised baselines; and (c) signal vectors faithfully estimate encoding directions, validated via activation maximization. Finally, we demonstrate applications in understanding global model behavior, explaining individual predictions, and intervening to produce counterfactuals or correct errors.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督方法，从深度视觉网络中恢复概念信息的编码（写入）和解码（读取）机制。该方法通过方向聚类识别解码方向，利用概率视角下的信号向量估计编码方向，并引入不确定性区域对齐（Uncertainty Region Alignment）技术利用网络权重。实验表明，合成数据上能恢复真实方向对，真实数据上解码方向对应单一语义概念并优于无监督基线，信号向量能忠实估计编码方向。应用包括理解全局模型行为、解释个别预测、生成反事实或纠正错误。
Motivation: 深度视觉网络在潜在空间中用方向表示概念，但编码和解码机制是隐式的、不可直接访问的。恢复该机制有助于打开黑箱，支持理解、调试和改进模型。
Method: 提出无监督方法：对激活进行方向聚类识别解码方向；从概率视角用信号向量估计编码方向；通过不确定性区域对齐利用网络权重揭示影响预测的可解释方向。
Result: 合成数据上恢复真实方向对；真实数据上解码方向优于无监督基线，对应单语义概念；信号向量验证了编码估计的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法可恢复线性概念表示下的编码-解码方向对，为理解、解释和干预网络行为提供了工具，但假设线性概念表示，可能不适用于非线性情况。

papers.title: Budgeted Indirect Adversarial Attack on Graph-Based Anomaly Detection in Sensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as powerful models for anomaly detection in sensor networks, particularly when analyzing multivariate time series. In this work, we introduce BETA, a novel indirect evasion attack targeting such GNN-based detectors, where the attacker is constrained to perturb sensor readings from a limited set of nodes, excluding the target sensor, with the goal of either suppressing a true anomaly or triggering a false alarm at the target node. BETA uses a graph explanatory model combined with a centrality-based pruning strategy to identify the most influential nodes, subsequently injecting carefully crafted adversarial perturbations into their features. Extensive experiments on three real-world sensor network datasets show that BETA consistently outperforms baseline attack strategies while operating under realistic constraints, reducing the F1-score of state-of-the-art GNN-based detectors by 36.07 to 50.45\% on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BETA，一种针对基于图神经网络（GNN）的传感器网络异常检测系统的间接逃避攻击方法。攻击者只能扰动有限节点的传感器读数（不包括目标节点），旨在抑制真实异常或触发虚假警报。BETA利用图解释模型和基于中心性的剪枝策略选择最具影响力的节点，并注入精心设计的对抗扰动。在三个真实传感器网络数据集上，BETA在现实约束下持续优于基线攻击策略，平均将最先进GNN检测器的F1分数降低36.07%至50.45%。
Motivation: 现有工作忽略了攻击者对传感器网络中异常检测器的间接攻击场景，即攻击者不能直接操纵目标传感器，只能通过影响其他节点来改变检测结果。该场景在现实世界（如关键基础设施）中具有实际意义。
Method: BETA方法结合图解释模型（如GNNExplainer）和基于中心性的节点剪枝策略，识别对目标节点检测结果最关键的传感器子集，然后使用基于梯度的对抗扰动方法优化该子集的传感器读数，以最大化目标节点的异常误报或漏报。
Result: 在三个真实传感器网络数据集上，BETA将最先进GNN异常检测器的F1分数平均降低36.07%至50.45%，显著优于随机节点攻击和基于度数中心性的基线。
Conclusion: 结果表明，即使攻击者只能访问有限节点并排除目标传感器，仍能对GNN异常检测器造成实质性危害，突显了当前检测系统在面对间接对抗攻击时的脆弱性。

papers.title: Onboarding Without Forgetting: Hypernetwork Personalization with Data-Free Replay for Personalized Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training across distributed clients without sharing raw data, offering strong privacy benefits. However, most methods assume all clients remain available throughout training, which is unrealistic as new clients often join over time. We study this setting, where the task and label space stay fixed but clients arrive in batches. Our analysis reveals two key challenges: updating the shared model only with new clients harms existing clients, while freezing it protects them but blocks gains from new knowledge. To capture these trade-offs, we introduce Proactive Adaptation (PA) for onboarding gains and Retroactive Improvement (RI) for changes in earlier clients without retraining. We then propose pFedDSH, which combines a central hypernetwork for personalized initialization, batch-specific binary masks for capacity preservation and allocation, and server-side data-free replay to propagate improvements without exposing client data. Experiments show that pFedDSH preserves stability for existing clients while keeping communication and adaptation costs unchanged for new clients.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦学习中新客户端分批加入的场景，提出pFedDSH方法，通过中央超网络、批次特定二进制掩码和服务器端无数据回放，在不损害现有客户端性能的同时高效适应新客户端，实验证明该方法在保持稳定性的同时不增加通信成本。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习假设所有客户端始终可用，但实际中新客户端随时间分批加入，导致共享模型更新时损害已有客户端或冻结时无法吸收新知识的问题。
Method: 提出pFedDSH，结合中央超网络（hypernetwork）生成个性化初始化、批次特定二进制掩码（binary masks）进行容量保留与分配，以及服务器端无数据回放（data-free replay）传播改进而不暴露客户端数据。
Result: 实验表明pFedDSH在保持现有客户端稳定性的同时，对新客户端的通信和适应成本没有增加。
Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了联邦学习中客户端分批到达时的新老客户端权衡问题，实现了知识保留与迁移的平衡。

papers.title: PoseIDON: 6DoF Pose Estimation with Foundation Model Features for Marine Sediment Burial Mapping
papers.abstract_en: The burial state of anthropogenic objects on the seafloor provides insight into localized sedimentation dynamics and is also critical for assessing ecological risks, potential pollutant transport, and the viability of recovery or mitigation strategies for hazardous materials such as munitions. Accurate burial depth estimation from remote imagery remains difficult due to partial occlusion, poor visibility, and object degradation. This work introduces a computer vision pipeline, called PoseIDON, which combines deep foundation model features with multiview photogrammetry to estimate six degrees of freedom object pose and the orientation of the surrounding seafloor from ROV video. Burial depth is inferred by aligning CAD models of the objects with observed imagery and fitting a local planar approximation of the seafloor. The method is validated using footage of 54 objects, including barrels and munitions, recorded at a historic ocean dumpsite in the San Pedro Basin. The model achieves a mean burial depth error of approximately 10 centimeters and resolves spatial burial patterns that reflect underlying sediment transport processes. This approach enables scalable, non-invasive mapping of seafloor burial and supports environmental assessment at contaminated sites.
papers.journal_ref: ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing 239 (2026) 928-942
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PoseIDON管道，结合深度基础模型特征与多视角摄影测量，从ROV视频中估计物体6自由度姿态及周围海底方向，并通过CAD模型对齐和局部平面拟合推断埋藏深度。在San Pedro Basin历史海洋倾倒场的54个物体（包括桶和弹药）上验证，平均埋藏深度误差约10厘米，能够解析反映沉积物输运过程的空间埋藏模式。该方法实现了可扩展、非侵入性的海底埋藏映射，支持污染场地的环境评估。
Motivation: 从遥感图像准确估计海底人造物体的埋藏深度对于评估生态风险、污染物迁移以及危险材料（如弹药）的回收或缓解策略至关重要，但部分遮挡、能见度差和物体退化使得现有方法难以实现。
Method: 提出了PoseIDON计算机视觉管道，利用深度基础模型特征与多视角摄影测量结合，估计物体六自由度姿态和周围海底朝向；通过将物体CAD模型与观测图像对齐并拟合海底局部平面近似来推导埋藏深度。
Result: 在含54个物体（包括桶和弹药）的ROV视频上验证，平均埋藏深度误差约10厘米，并解析了反映底层沉积物输运过程的空间埋藏模式。
Conclusion: 该方法可实现可扩展、非侵入性的海底埋藏映射，适用于污染场地的环境评估，但摘要未提及明显局限性。

summary_sections.result: 在含54个物体（包括桶和弹药）的ROV视频上验证，平均埋藏深度误差约10厘米，并解析了反映底层沉积物输运过程的空间埋藏模式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法可实现可扩展、非侵入性的海底埋藏映射，适用于污染场地的环境评估，但摘要未提及明显局限性。

papers.title: Fast data inversion for high-dimensional Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes from noisy measurements
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we develop a scalable approach for a flexible latent factor model for high-dimensional dynamical systems. Each latent factor process has its own correlation and variance parameters, and the orthogonal factor loading matrix can be either fixed or estimated. We utilize an orthogonal factor loading matrix that avoids computing the inversion of the posterior covariance matrix at each time of the Kalman filter, and derive closed-form expressions in an expectation-maximization algorithm for parameter estimation, which substantially reduces the computational complexity without approximation. Our approach has several applications, including noise filtering for high-dimensional time series, estimating nonseparable covariance structure between different time series, and estimating latent physical processes from real-world measurements. Extensive simulated studies illustrate higher accuracy and scalability of our approach compared to alternatives. Furthermore, by applying our method to geodetic measurements to estimate slow slip events from geodetic data in the Cascadia region, our estimated slip better agrees with independently measured seismic data of tremor events. The substantial acceleration from our method enables the use of massive noisy data for geological hazard quantification and other applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高维Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的参数估计和状态反演问题，提出一种基于正交因子载荷矩阵的可扩展方法，避免了卡尔曼滤波中每一步逆矩阵的计算，并在EM算法中导出闭式表达式，显著降低计算复杂度。方法可用于高维时间序列噪声滤波、非可分离协方差结构估计以及真实世界测量中潜在物理过程的估计。模拟和实际地壳形变数据（Cascadia慢滑事件）验证了其精度和可扩展性。
Motivation: 高维OU过程反演中，传统的卡尔曼滤波和EM算法因每一步需要计算后验协方差矩阵的逆而计算量巨大，限制了在大规模噪声数据中的应用。
Method: 采用正交因子载荷矩阵，利用其正交性避免在卡尔曼滤波的每一步中直接求逆后验协方差矩阵；在EM算法中推导参数更新的闭式表达式，从而大幅降低计算复杂度且无需近似。
Result: 模拟研究表明，该方法在精度和可扩展性上均优于现有替代方法。在Cascadia区域地壳形变数据中，估计的慢滑事件与独立测量的震颤地震数据更一致。
Conclusion: 该方法通过正交因子载荷矩阵和闭式EM更新实现了高维OU过程反演的加速，使得基于大量噪声数据的地质灾害量化等应用成为可能。

papers.title: EmoEUS: Uncertainty Supervision for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal emotion recognition in conversation (MERC) can leverage multimodal and contextual cues to boost recognition performance. However, existing fusion approaches in MERC often ignore modality-specific uncertainty across utterances caused by conflicting cues, varying noise, and missing modality-specific signals. We propose EmoEUS, an explicit uncertainty supervision framework for MERC. EmoEUS performs uncertainty-aware multimodal fusion by dynamically weighting modalities using learned variance estimates. We also introduce an explicitly supervised loss that aligns each utterance's predicted variance with the distance between the utterance's distributional representation and its emotion- and modality-specific cluster center. Experiments on IEMOCAP and MELD show that EmoEUS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EmoEUS，一个显式不确定性监督框架，用于对话中的多模态情绪识别（MERC）。该框架通过动态加权模态（基于学习的方差估计）实现不确定性感知融合，并引入显式监督损失，将每个话语的预测方差与其分布表示到情绪和模态特定聚类中心的距离对齐。在IEMOCAP和MELD数据集上，EmoEUS一致优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多模态融合方法常忽略跨话语的模态特异性不确定性（如冲突线索、可变噪声、缺失信号），导致融合效果受限。
Method: 提出不确定性感知多模态融合，利用学习到的方差估计动态调整模态权重；并引入显式损失函数，使每个话语的预测方差与其分布表示到情绪-模态聚类中心的距离对齐。
Result: 在IEMOCAP和MELD数据集上，EmoEUS一致优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 显式不确定性监督可以有效提升多模态情绪识别性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ChemHyperMag: Physics-informed magnetic hypergraph learning improves molecular ADMET prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, and Toxicity) is important for drug discovery. Most predictors use undirected molecular graphs and pairwise edges. This choice misses asymmetric interactions, nonreversible dynamics, and motif level effects from functional groups and ring systems. We propose ChemHyperMag for multitask ADMET prediction under missing labels. ChemHyperMag builds a functional group hypergraph from rings, BRICS fragments, Bemis-Murcko scaffolds, and bonds. It also defines a potential driven nonreversible flow guided by electronegativity and Gasteiger partial charges. The resulting circulation is encoded by a Hermitian magnetic Laplacian and processed with a magnetic Chebyshev encoder. We perturb magnetic phases to form stochastic views and train with an InfoNCE objective. Experiments on multiple ADMET benchmarks show improvements over recent methods with fewer labeled samples and no conformers. ChemHyperMag is scalable and provides interpretable directional signals through its magnetic phases.
papers.comment: Accepted by Proceedings of the AI4Physics Workshop at the 43 rd International Conference on Machine Learning (AI4Physics@ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChemHyperMag，一种用于多任务 ADMET 预测的物理信息磁超图学习方法。通过构建官能团超图并引入基于电负性和 Gasteiger 部分电荷的非可逆流，利用 Hermitian 磁拉普拉斯和磁切比雪夫编码器处理，结合磁相位扰动和 InfoNCE 损失进行训练。实验表明该方法在少量标记样本和无构象条件下优于现有方法，并具有可扩展性和可解释的定向信号。
Motivation: 现有 ADMET 预测器多使用无向分子图和对边，忽略了不对称相互作用、非可逆动力学以及官能团和环系统的基序级效应，导致预测精度受限。
Method: ChemHyperMag 从环、BRICS 片段、Bemis-Murcko 骨架和键构建官能团超图，定义基于电负性和部分电荷的势驱动非可逆流，通过 Hermitian 磁拉普拉斯编码，利用磁切比雪夫编码器处理，并通过磁相位扰动生成随机视图进行对比学习。
Result: 在多个 ADMET 基准上，ChemHyperMag 在更少标记样本和无构象条件下优于近期方法，且具有可扩展性。
Conclusion: ChemHyperMag 通过磁超图学习有效捕捉分子中的非对称和非可逆相互作用，为 ADMET 预测提供了新的物理信息模型，其磁相位提供可解释的定向信号。

papers.title: Physics-Guided Masked Multi-Task Network for Edge-Friendly Battery Health Diagnostics from Sto-chastically Fragmented Charging Profiles
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of reliable lithium-ion battery management systems is crucial for accelerating electrification, yet the joint prognosis of State of Health (SOH) and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) remains severely hindered by task heteroscedasticity. Conventional multi-task learning frameworks fail to balance the bounded, low-variance noise of SOH estimation with the unbounded, nonlinearly expanding uncertainty of long-term RUL predictions. Here, we present the Rotary SOH-Injected Prior Battery Transformer (RoSIP-Batt), a unified co-estimation framework that resolves these optimization conflicts. By formulating joint prediction as a Bayesian multi-task objective, RoSIP-Batt introduces a homoscedastic uncertainty weighting mechanism to dynamically scale task-specific gradients based on learned residual noise levels. The architecture leverages decoupled dual classification tokens and a per-dimension gated fusion mechanism, secured by a gradient-detachment operator to prevent high-variance RUL updates from corrupting the stable SOH representation space. To capture electrochemical degradation patterns without relying on absolute cycle steps, Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) is incorporated into a shared Transformer backbone to model translation-invariant relative temporal profiles. Crucially, the intermediate SOH estimate is directly injected into the RUL regression head as a physical degradation prior. Evaluations across the NASA, MIT-Stanford, and HUST datasets show that RoSIP-Batt significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing SOH estimation error to 1.994% MAE on NASA and restricting RUL prediction error to 62.85 cycles on Stanford. These findings establish RoSIP-Batt as a highly generalizable, computationally efficient solution suitable for real-time embedded BMS deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RoSIP-Batt，一种基于贝叶斯多任务学习的锂离子电池健康状态(SOH)和剩余使用寿命(RUL)联合估计框架。通过同方差不确定性加权机制动态平衡不同任务的梯度更新，并利用旋转位置编码(RoPE)捕获平移不变的时间特征。在NASA、MIT-Stanford和HUST数据集上，该方法在SOH估计和RUL预测方面均显著超越现有基线，且计算效率高，适合嵌入式系统部署。
Motivation: 传统多任务学习框架难以同时处理SOH估计的有界低方差噪声和RUL预测的无界高方差不确定性，导致任务异方差性冲突，影响联合预测性能。
Method: 将联合预测公式化为贝叶斯多任务目标，引入同方差不确定性加权机制动态缩放任务特定梯度；采用解耦双分类令牌和逐维度门控融合，并用梯度分离算子防止高方差RUL更新破坏稳定SOH表示；在共享Transformer主干中集成旋转位置编码(RoPE)以建模相对时间模式；将中间SOH估计作为物理先验直接注入RUL回归头。
Result: 在NASA数据集上SOH估计MAE降至1.994%，在MIT-Stanford数据集上RUL预测误差限制在62.85个循环，显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该方法在多个数据集上表现出强泛化性和计算效率，适用于实时嵌入式电池管理系统。

papers.title: Active Electrosensing and Communication in MARL-trained Weakly Electric Fish Collectives
papers.abstract_en: How complex collective behavior emerges from individual interactions is a fundamental scientific question, but experimental cost and difficulty of simultaneous multi-brain recordings limit direct study in animals. Here we introduce a novel computational framework modeling weakly electric fish-like agents with biophysically inspired electrosensing and actuation, trained to forage collectively via multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Trained agents reproduce hallmarks of real fish, including curvilinear homing trajectories and heavy-tailed electric organ discharge (EOD) interval statistics, while exhibiting emergent active sensing, social foraging, dominance-like asymmetries, and aggression. We perform in silico interventions including sensor ablations, EOD silencing, and food distribution changes to identify causal drivers of social foraging. Analyses of recurrent neural dynamics further show robust encoding of task-relevant variables and social context. Our work has broad implications for the neuroethology of weakly electric fish and other social animals where extensive multi-individual neural recordings, and thus traditional data-driven modeling, remain challenging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）训练模拟弱电鱼（weakly electric fish）的集体觅食行为，再现了真实鱼的曲线归巢轨迹、重尾放电间隔统计等特征，并涌现出主动感知、社会觅食、 dominance 不对称性和攻击性等行为。通过传感器消融、放电沉默和食物分布变化等计算机干预，识别了社会觅食的因果驱动因素。
Motivation: 实验成本和多脑同时记录的困难限制了直接研究动物集体行为，因此需要计算模型来探索个体交互如何产生复杂集体行为。
Method: 构建了具有生物物理启发式电感知和驱动能力的弱电鱼类代理，使用MARL训练集体觅食，并通过计算机干预和循环神经动力学分析来研究行为机制。
Result: 训练出的代理重现了真实鱼的关键行为特征，包括曲线归巢轨迹和重尾EOD间隔统计，并展示了主动感知、社会觅食、dominance不对称性和攻击性等涌现行为。循环网络分析显示任务相关变量和社会上下文被鲁棒编码。
Conclusion: 该框架对弱电鱼及其他难以进行多脑记录的社交动物的神经行为学有广泛启示。

papers.title: Hazard or Anomaly? Evaluating VLMs for Understanding Dangers and Discrepancies
papers.abstract_en: Modern safety-critical systems increasingly rely on human-robot interaction to reduce disaster risk and support decision-making during emergencies. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are promising for these settings because they can interpret complex scenes and communicate safety-relevant information, but they still require careful evaluation to ensure reliable safety reasoning. In particular, current evaluations often frame danger recognition as a binary decision (Safe/Unsafe), making it unclear whether a model is identifying true physical hazards or merely reacting to unusual scene elements. We address this limitation by introducing an explicit distinction between hazard and anomaly, and by separately recognizing hazardous and anomalous states. We evaluate several state-of-the-art VLMs across two datasets and multiple prompting strategies to test whether this distinction changes model behavior. Our results show that VLMs frequently misinterpret anomalousness as hazardousness, revealing an over-reliance on contextual irregularity as a proxy for danger. We further show that explicitly separating anomaly from hazard provides a more informative evaluation of VLM safety reasoning and exposes failure modes that binary safety judgments can obscure. Our public dataset is available on Roboflow https://app.roboflow.com/vlm-in-context-anomaly-and-hazard-detection/camera-ready-roman-ds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文提出在评估视觉语言模型（VLM）的安全推理能力时，应明确区分危险（hazard）和异常（anomaly），而不是简单进行安全/不安全的二分类。作者在多个数据集和提示策略上评估了多种VLM，发现模型经常将异常误判为危险，表明模型过度依赖上下文不规则性作为危险的代理。显式分离异常与危险能提供更丰富的安全推理评估，并揭示二分类可能掩盖的失败模式。
Motivation: 当前对VLM安全性的评估通常只做安全/不安全的二分类，这无法区分模型识别的是真正的物理危险还是仅仅对异常场景的反应，导致评估不够精细。
Method: 引入危险与异常的显式区分，分别识别危险和异常状态，并在两个数据集上使用多种提示策略评估多个当前最先进的VLM。
Result: 结果表明VLM常常将异常状态误解为危险状态，暴露出模型过度依赖上下文不规则性来判断危险的倾向。
Conclusion: 显式分离异常与危险可以更有效评估VLM的安全推理能力，并揭示二分类安全判断可能掩盖的失败模式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cost Accounting for Reactive Computational Graphs: Exhaustive Sweeps, Sequential Mutation, and the Backward-Locality Gap
papers.abstract_en: Exhaustive site-by-site interventions on a neural network's computational graph -- activation-patching sweeps, circuit-discovery searches, systematic ablation studies -- mutate the graph at every candidate site, and their cost is dominated by recomputation after each mutation. On a reactive graph engine whose invalidation provably touches exactly the downstream cone of a mutated node, we give a complete cost accounting for such workloads. First, the aggregate speedup of an exhaustive sweep over independent full recomputations is not a universal constant: if per-layer weight varies regularly with depth at Karamata index q, the ratio converges to (q+2)/(q+1) when weight concentrates near the output and to q+2 near the input, recovering 2 only in the depth-uniform case; a wall-clock corollary predicts a ceiling of about 1.79, below 2, until interpreter overhead is compiled away. Second, we prove the exact cost of a sequence of persistent mutations, never undone between insertions: the interleaved cost exceeds the isolated sum by an exact overcount summed over comparable site pairs, with closed-form extremes over insertion orders, while batched application is order-independent and sub-additive, costing exactly the union of the sites' cones plus the fresh nodes. Third, we prove the exact mirror of forward locality for the backward pass, showing it collapses the aggregate speedup to 1 under backpropagation on architectures without long skip connections. Every identity is validated on NeuroDSL, a reactive graph engine in Julia: measured sweep ratios converge to the predicted limits under four cost profiles; the training-mode ratio collapses to 1 at the predicted rate; and all 18 per-graft sequential costs and the batched total match the closed forms at zero tolerance across three insertion orders.
papers.comment: Companion paper: "Exact Network Surgery: Functional Invariance and Gradient Plasticity in Reactive Computational Graphs" (submitted concurrently)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对反应式计算图（reactive computational graphs）上的穷举干预操作进行了完整的成本核算，包括前向穷举扫描、顺序突变和后向局部性差距。作者在Julia实现的NeuroDSL引擎上验证了所有理论结果。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对计算图干预操作（如激活修补、电路发现）计算成本的精确理论分析，尤其是在反应式图引擎中的成本结构。
Method: 通过Karamata指数建模层权重的深度变化，推导穷举扫描加速比的渐近极限；使用精确计数公式分析顺序突变的交错成本与批量成本；证明后向传播中局部性差距导致加速比坍缩为1。
Result: 穷举扫描加速比在深度非均匀时收敛到(q+2)/(q+1)或q+2，上限约1.79；顺序突变成本有精确的闭式表达式；后向传播加速比坍缩为1。
Conclusion: 反应式计算图的成本结构取决于网络深度方向的权重分布，且后向传播缺乏前向的局部性优势。

papers.title: Binding Drift in Multi-Step Tool-Augmented Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-augmented language-model agents execute multi-step workflows over external systems, resolving an entity once and then acting on it across subsequent steps. Prior work shows that in single-step actions, agents select the correct tool but bind it to the wrong entity 24-26% of the time. We study what happens to entity bindings over time: do they stay correct, silently drift to a different entity, or, if wrong from the start, propagate and compound? We formalize binding drift (correct at step 1, wrong later) as distinct from error propagation (wrong at step 1, carried forward), and score them on disjoint workflow sets so the two cannot be conflated. In a controlled multi-step testbed (200 workflows, 580 entity-binding-scored steps, four enterprise domains, eight model backends spanning small to frontier), we find: (1) under controlled error injection, an entity lock (the intuitive "persist the first binding" fix) amplifies wrong actions from 907 to 2,746 (3.0x; bootstrap 95% CI [2.8, 3.3]), because it faithfully carries the seeded wrong entity into every later step; (2) the amplification reaches 8.5x on the most affected model (Claude Opus 4.5); (3) a practical LLM-based re-verifier (a single cheap second model call re-reading the original instruction) reduces wrong actions by 79% (0.21x; CI [0.18, 0.25]), closing the gap to within 1 percentage point of an oracle upper-bound (0.20x); and (4) in the natural (non-injected) setting, baseline agents drift on 18% of eligible workflows, with the per-step error rate rising across steps. Persistence and re-verification are not interchangeable: a defense that eliminates drift can worsen propagation, and a practical re-verifier nearly matches oracle recovery.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 5 tables, 1 figure. Equal contribution by both authors. Code and data: https://github.com/shashank-indukuri/binding-drift
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了多步工具增强型智能体中的实体绑定漂移（binding drift，第1步正确但后续错误）与错误传播（error propagation，第1步就错并延续），并在200个工作流、580个绑定评分步骤、4个企业领域、8个模型后端上实验。发现：实体锁（persist the first binding）将错误动作从907放大到2746（3.0倍）；基于LLM的轻量级重新验证器（一个廉价二次模型调用）减少79%的错误动作，与oracle上界仅差1个百分点；自然场景下基线智能体在18%的合格工作流上出现漂移，且每步错误率随步骤增加而上升。
Motivation: 现有工作仅关注单步动作中工具-实体绑定错误（24-26%），但多步流程中实体绑定随时间的变化（漂移或传播）尚未被系统研究，且直观的持久化修复可能适得其反。
Method: 设计一个可控多步测试平台，定义并分离绑定漂移与错误传播；在注入错误和自然场景下比较实体锁（持久化首次绑定）、LLM重新验证器（用第二个廉价模型调用重新读取原始指令）和oracle上界。
Result: 实体锁使错误动作放大3.0倍（Claude Opus 4.5上达8.5倍）；LLM重新验证器减少79%错误动作，接近oracle水平；自然场景下18%工作流出现漂移，错误率随步骤递增。
Conclusion: 持久化和重新验证不可互换：消除漂移的防御可能恶化传播，而实用重新验证器几乎达到oracle恢复。

papers.title: Interactive Training 2: Auditable Control Plane for Live Model Training
papers.abstract_en: Experiment trackers show how training is progressing, but changing a live run still usually requires trainer-specific code. We present Interactive Training 2, an open-source control plane for steering training through a shared protocol. Training applications declare which settings and actions they expose, humans and automated controllers submit requests through the same interface, and the training loop validates and applies them at safe control points. A customized Aim workspace combines live metrics and controls with a chronological record of requests and outcomes. We demonstrate the system across five NLP and reinforcement-learning workflows. The released code and traces provide a reusable foundation for auditable human- and agent-guided training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Interactive Training 2，一个开源的控制平面，通过共享协议允许在实时训练过程中进行干预。训练应用声明暴露的设置和动作，人类和自动控制器通过同一接口提交请求，训练循环在安全控制点验证并应用。系统在五个 NLP 和强化学习工作流上得到演示，并提供了可审计的记录。
Motivation: 现有实验跟踪器只能显示训练进度，但修改正在运行的训练通常需要编写特定于训练器的代码，缺乏统一且可审计的交互机制。
Method: 设计一个控制平面，训练应用声明可调节的设置和动作；人类或自动化控制器通过统一接口提交变更请求；训练循环在预定义的安全控制点验证并应用这些变更，同时使用定制的 Aim 工作区记录请求与结果。
Result: 在五个 NLP 和强化学习工作流上演示了该系统的可行性，但摘要未报告具体的性能数值或对比。
Conclusion: 该工作为可审计的人机协同或自动代理引导的训练过程提供了可复用的开源基础设施。

papers.title: Approximating SPR Distance Between Phylogenetic Trees with Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Comparing phylogenetic tree topologies is essential for understanding epidemic dynamics, yet biologically meaningful distances such as the Subtree Prune and Regraft (SPR) distance are NP-hard to compute and intractable on large datasets. We investigate whether a Graph Neural Network (GNN) can approximate SPR distances in near-constant time per comparison after training. Our contributions are fourfold. First, we build and publicly release a dataset of 864 phylogenetic trees inferred with UPGMA and Neighbor-Joining over four bacterial species, spanning up to 9{,}500 isolates, together with 388 labelled tree pairs. Second, we establish a reproducible pre-processing pipeline including midpoint re-rooting, which reduces tree depth and supplies the rooting required for exact distance computation and for the model's root-based features. Third, we validate the supervision target: on small trees, where exact SPR is tractable, the unrooted phangorn::SPR.dist heuristic correlates almost perfectly with the exact rooted distance computed by rspr (Pearson $0.98$--$0.99$), making it an excellent monotonic surrogate. Lastly, we train a Siamese Graph Isomorphism Network (GIN) regressor. In-distribution, i.e., held-out trees from the same species and size range as training, it explains roughly 87--90% of the variance ($R^2 \approx 0.87$ on a held-out split; $0.90 \pm 0.19$ under stratified cross-validation), with about four times lower error than a mean-predictor baseline, and shows partial transfer to unseen species ($R^2 \approx 0.37$). Its main limitation is extrapolation to trees larger than those seen in training, where accuracy collapses. The released dataset and the validated heuristic versus exact relationship provide a reproducible basis for scaling learned SPR approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用图神经网络（GNN）近似计算系统发育树之间的子树修剪与嫁接（SPR）距离，SPR距离是NP-hard问题，在大数据集上难以精确计算。作者构建了包含864棵系统发育树和388个标记树对的数据集，并建立了可重复的预处理流程。训练了一个孪生图同构网络（GIN）回归器，在分布内数据上解释了约87-90%的方差（R²≈0.87-0.90），误差比均值基线低约四倍，但对未见过的物种和更大树的外推能力有限。
Motivation: 比较系统发育树拓扑结构对理解流行病动态至关重要，但SPR距离计算是NP-hard问题，在大规模数据集上难以处理，需要高效的近似方法。
Method: 构建包含864棵系统发育树（来自四种细菌物种，最多9500个分离株）和388个标记树对的数据集；采用中点重定根预处理；验证了无根启发式与精确有根SPR距离的高度相关性（Pearson 0.98-0.99）；训练孪生图同构网络（GIN）回归器近似SPR距离。
Result: 在分布内数据上，模型解释了约87-90%的方差（R²≈0.87在保留集，0.90±0.19在分层交叉验证），误差比均值基线低约四倍。对未见物种的迁移能力有限（R²≈0.37），对更大树的外推能力崩溃。
Conclusion: GNN可以在近常数时间内近似SPR距离，但外推到大树的能力有限。数据集和启发式与精确距离关系的验证为可扩展的学习近似方法提供了基础。

papers.title: Distribution-First Population Simulation: Collapse, Calibration, and Recall in Non-WEIRD LLM Persona Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic-population tools increasingly run every individual as an independent large language model (LLM) agent. Using real survey microdata, we show that this paradigm has a basic failure mode, and we set a distribution-first corrective against it, all measured with a deterministic, construct-validated verifier on non-WEIRD (Turkey-first) data. First, N independent LLM agents grounded on 2,414 real World Values Survey respondents fail to reproduce the population's response distribution: they pile onto a modal default (four scenarios x five seeds: concentration 0.36->0.69, entropy 1.46->0.77, 85% collapse, TVD=0.44), and the collapse is a predictable function of scenario structure (r=0.55 with a single-answer structure). Second, Verbalized Sampling (VS) fixes the field's chronic under-dispersion without training in three model families (fidelity +7 to +10; significant on Qwen, p=0.002, d=6.2), yet the same move universally overshoots into over-dispersion (SD-ratio 0.4-0.56 -> 1.26-1.37), a structural property of VS. Third, survey fidelity transfers only weakly to agentic behavior: in a single-model, single-domain booking task, a persona is dominated by a cheapest-default (~80%) that income modulates but does not override (comfort choice 0%->7%->32% across income bands). Fourth, a placebo-controlled memorization attack and an election backtest show VS keeps aggregate strength while subgroup and individual claims are contaminated by recall and underdetermination. We close with the corrective: model the distribution once (VS) and assign it to grounded characters at O(1) cost, with a budget-aware router whose honest AUC is 0.805, not the tautological 1.0 of a code-derived oracle. The central contribution needs no realism claim: it measures the internal inconsistency of the independent-agent route and the conditions under which the distribution-first route calibrates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于非WEIRD（土耳其）真实调查数据，揭示独立LLM代理模拟人口分布时存在基本失败模式：代理输出坍缩至单一模态，无法复现真实分布。提出Verbalized Sampling (VS)方法修复欠分散，但导致过分散。进一步发现调查保真度向代理行为迁移较弱，且子组与个体声明受记忆污染。最终提出分布优先建模方案，以O(1)成本分配角色，并使用预算感知路由器实现校准。
Motivation: 合成人口工具中独立LLM代理模拟个体时，无法再现真实人口响应分布，出现系统性坍缩，且缺乏针对非WEIRD数据的校准手段。
Method: 提出Verbalized Sampling (VS)作为分布优先纠正方法，无需训练即可改善欠分散；并引入预算感知路由器将分布分配给角色，避免独立代理的坍缩。
Result: 独立代理导致分布坍缩（集中度0.36->0.69，熵1.46->0.77，TVD=0.44）；VS提升保真度7-10点（Qwen上p=0.002, d=6.2）但导致过分散（SD-ratio升至1.26-1.37）；预算感知路由器AUC为0.805。
Conclusion: 独立代理路线存在内部不一致性，分布优先路线能实现校准，但需注意VS的结构性过分散与Recall污染。

papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Prediction of Unsteady Airfoil Aerodynamics Using Augmented Graph Neural Ordinary Differential Equations with Exogenous Controls
papers.abstract_en: Unsteady aerodynamic phenomena, such as gusts, turbulence, and fluid-structure interactions affect an aircraft during flight. For design, optimisation and certification, it is indispensable to quantify such unsteady aerodynamic effects. Industry-standard computational fluid dynamics methods, such as solving the unsteady Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes equations or the linearized frequency domain method, are either computationally expensive or restricted by assumptions like linearity. Once trained, machine learning methods are capable of computing non-linear relationships very fast, making them suitable as surrogate models. By autoregressively applying graph neural networks (GNNs), operating on a discretised spatial domain, spatio-temporal predictions can be made. However, autoregressive GNNs suffer from error accumulation leading to unstable rollouts over time. Here we show that combining GNNs with augmented Neural Ordinary Differential Equations yields temporally stable predictions of the surface forces on a pitching airfoil. We found that our approach, called GNODE, based on Graph Neural Ordinary Differential Equations, provides temporally more stable, spatially smoother, and overall more accurate results than an autoregressive GNN baseline. Tests are conducted on a dataset consisting of a simulations of a pitching airfoil, including transonic shocks, transient behaviour and dynamic non-linearities. Augmenting GNODEs with additional latent dimensions improves the expressivity and accuracy by capturing underlying history effects. The developed method demonstrates an approach that is suitable to model non-linear spatio-temporal systems with exogenous inputs.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 18 figures, submitted to Computers & Fluids
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非定常气动力建模问题，提出一种将图神经网络 (GNN) 与增广神经常微分方程 (Neural ODE) 结合的 GNODE 方法，用于俯仰翼型的表面力时空预测。实验表明，该方法在包含跨声速激波、瞬态和非线性动态的数据集上，比自回归 GNN 基线在时间稳定性、空间平滑性和预测精度上更优。增广潜在维度可捕获历史效应，提升模型表达力。
Motivation: 工业标准 CFD 方法（如 URANS 或线性化频域法）计算昂贵或受线性假设限制，自回归 GNN 存在误差累积导致预测发散的问题，因此需要一种快速、稳定且能处理非线性的时空预测替代模型。
Method: 将图神经网络与增广神经常微分方程 (Augmented Neural ODE) 结合，构建 GNODE 模型，在离散空间网格上通过连续时间动力学进行前向传播，并引入额外潜在变量以增强对历史依赖的建模能力。
Result: 在俯仰翼型仿真数据集上，GNODE 相较于自回归 GNN 基线在时间稳定性和空间平滑性上显著提升，整体预测精度更高；增广维度进一步改善了模型对非定常动态的捕获能力。
Conclusion: 该工作表明结合 GNN 与增广 Neural ODE 的混合方法能有效建模具有外生输入的非线性时空系统，为气动代理模型提供了新思路，但仅在特定翼型案例上验证，通用性需进一步考察。

papers.title: Agentic Calibration of Grey-Box Simulation Models: An LLM-Driven Alternative
papers.abstract_en: Calibration of grey-box simulation models is a constrained optimization problem in which model evaluations are expensive, the parameter space can be high-dimensional, and the search must respect plausibility constraints. Although the simulation code is fully available to the analyst, the joint effect of multiple parameters remains difficult to predict analytically. Classical optimizers such as Nelder--Mead (NM) are simple to deploy but sample-inefficient, particularly under constraints. Modern Bayesian Optimization methods achieve competitive solutions with far fewer evaluations but require non-trivial modeling machinery for constraint handling. We introduce an agentic calibration method in which a large language model acts as the optimizer, with constraints incorporated as a plain-language section of the system prompt. We evaluate the agentic method, NM, and Bayesian Optimization (BO) on an anal cancer simulation model under both unconstrained and clinically constrained calibration. Under unconstrained calibration, the agentic method achieves substantially lower best error than BO and NM, while requiring fewer model evaluations. Under constrained calibration, the agentic method reaches comparable error levels and both outperform NM. These results are obtained at the cost of increased inference time per iteration. Agentic calibration achieves competitive performance with substantially fewer model evaluations, and constraint handling is essentially free at the modeller-facing interface through simple textual specifications rather than additional modelling machinery. The main trade-off lies in increased per-iteration inference cost, making the approach particularly suitable when simulation time dominates. Beyond performance, the per-iteration rationale makes the search auditable and explainable, so its decisions can be scrutinised and justified to third parties.
papers.comment: Manuscript: 19 pages, 2 figures. Appendix: 11 pages, 1 figure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于大型语言模型的智能校准方法，用于灰盒仿真模型的参数优化，在无约束和有约束校准中均取得优于传统方法（Nelder-Mead和贝叶斯优化）的性能，且模型评估次数更少，但每次迭代的推理成本较高。
Motivation: 灰盒仿真模型校准面临评估昂贵、参数空间高维且需满足合理性约束的难题；传统优化器（如NM）样本效率低，贝叶斯优化虽高效但处理复杂约束需要额外建模。
Method: 将大型语言模型作为优化器，将约束条件以自然语言形式融入系统提示中，实现智能校准（agentic calibration）。
Result: 在肛门癌仿真模型上，无约束校准中智能校准的最佳误差显著低于NM和BO，且模型调用次数更少；有约束校准中误差与BO相当，两者均优于NM。
Conclusion: 智能校准能以更少的模型评估达到竞争性性能，约束处理几乎无额外开销（仅需自然语言描述），主要代价是迭代推理时间增加，适用于仿真时间占主导的场景。

papers.title: Gradient-Energy Guided Block-Wise Perturbations for Sharpness-Aware Minimization
papers.abstract_en: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) improves generalization by minimizing the worst-case loss in a local parameter neighborhood. Standard SAM implicitly allocates its global perturbation budget across parameter blocks according to instantaneous minibatch gradient norms. Such an allocation can be noisy and may not reflect the sensitivity that blocks accumulate throughout training. We propose Gradient-Energy Adaptive Radius SAM (GEAR-SAM), which maintains an exponential moving average (EMA) of squared block gradients as a lightweight, curvature-related sensitivity signal and allocates the fixed SAM budget through a closed-form constrained optimization. GEAR-SAM preserves the global SAM radius, requires no Hessian-vector products or explicit Fisher estimation, and adds only scalar state beyond SAM. Experiments on image classification, transfer learning, noisy-label learning, and partition studies demonstrate improved generalization and robustness across architectures and tasks. More broadly, GEAR-SAM provides a dynamic view of sharpness-aware optimization: a fixed perturbation budget should be redistributed as the sensitivity of functional network blocks evolves during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出梯度能量自适应半径SAM（GEAR-SAM），通过维护块梯度平方的指数移动平均作为灵敏度信号，并用闭式约束优化重新分配固定的SAM扰动预算，无需Hessian-向量积。实验表明在图像分类、迁移学习和噪声标签学习等任务上提升了泛化性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 标准SAM根据小批量梯度范数隐式分配全局扰动预算，这种分配方式噪声较大且不能反映参数块在整个训练过程中的累积灵敏度，导致泛化性能受限。
Method: GEAR-SAM记录块梯度平方的指数移动平均作为轻量灵敏度信号，通过闭式约束优化在固定全局半径下重新分配各块的扰动半径，仅增加标量状态。
Result: 在图像分类、迁移学习、噪声标签学习以及分区实验上，GEAR-SAM比标准SAM提升了泛化准确率和鲁棒性，且计算开销微小。
Conclusion: 作者认为GEAR-SAM揭示了锐度感知优化的动态视角：固定的扰动预算应随网络功能块灵敏度的演化而重新分配。

papers.title: The Information Shadow: Measuring Structural Limits on What Language Models Can Learn
papers.abstract_en: Some limits on what language models know are not gaps in data coverage but structural properties of learning from text. We introduce the information shadow: the region of phenomena that a text-trained learner cannot acquire regardless of scale, comprising (I) structures language cannot express, (II) functions that are statistically non-identifiable from the training distribution, and (III) functions that are representable but unreachable by gradient-based training. We give each type a probe that is decisive because the premise of the shadow is, in that setting, provable. For Type I, Language Compression Residuals compare a text learner, which sees only a lossy text-like encoding of the signal, against a full-signal learner, which sees the underlying signal directly. The text learner sits at a computable expressibility ceiling while the full-signal learner pulls away by a gap that stays flat across 300x more data, so the deficit is a property of the channel, not of training. For Type II, the Counterfactual Distinction Test trains models on data exactly consistent with two incompatible rules. Across a provable string task and a language-like agreement task, behavior on counterfactuals is set by the model's inductive bias, while 5% disambiguating data steers the learned rule bidirectionally to either target (r = +/-1.0, p < 1e-10). For Type III, Basin Escape Mapping exhibits a function that is representable at 100% (by hand construction) yet reached 0% of the time by standard training and instantly from a nearby initialization, with width scaling providing no help (p = 1.6 x 10^-14). Each effect is isolated by a control that rules out a capacity or modality artifact. We release the probe suite and discuss implications for benchmark design, capability auditing, and shadow-aware uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文引入“信息阴影”概念，指语言模型从文本中学习时无法获取的知识区域，分为三类：语言无法表达的结构、统计上不可识别的函数、以及可表示但梯度训练无法达到的函数。通过实验证明这些限制是结构性的，而非数据或规模问题，并给出了相应的探测方法。
Motivation: 现有研究常将语言模型的知识缺口归因于数据覆盖不足，但本文指出存在结构性限制，即使数据无限，模型也无法从文本中学习某些现象，这对理解模型能力和设计基准测试具有重要意义。
Method: 提出信息阴影的三种类型：类型Ⅰ通过语言压缩残差比较文本学习器与全信号学习器的表现；类型Ⅱ通过反事实区分测试，评估模型在兼容两种冲突规则的数据上的行为；类型Ⅲ通过盆地逃逸映射，展示可表示但不可达的函数。每种类型都有控制实验排除容量或模态干扰。
Result: 类型Ⅰ中，文本学习器与全信号学习器之间的差距在300倍数据量下保持不变；类型Ⅱ中，5%的消歧数据就能双向引导学习规则（r=±1.0, p<1e-10）；类型Ⅲ中，可表示的函数在标准训练中0%时间被学到，而从邻近初始化则可瞬间达到，宽度缩放无效（p=1.6×10^-14）。

papers.title: TD-DPO: Difference-Aware Preference Optimization for Mitigating Sycophancy in Clinical Autism Intervention Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: The sycophancy of large language models can increase the safety risk in intervention dialogue for autistic children. Supervised fine-tuning can somewhat reduce sycophancy, but relying solely on positive examples is often insufficient to identify and correct failure patterns. We observe that sycophancy behaviors can often be localized to a limited span within the model response. In this regime, sequence-level preference optimization can over-update preference-irrelevant tokens and degrade intervention ability. To address this, we propose the \textbf{M}inimal \textbf{E}dit \textbf{D}ata \textbf{A}ugmentation (MEDA) strategy to construct controlled, stable, minimal edit preference pairs and \textbf{T}oken-level \textbf{D}ifference \textbf{D}irect \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization (TD-DPO), which upweights difference tokens between chosen and rejected responses while downweighting shared tokens to suppress background drift. Extensive experiments across multiple backbones and evaluators show that TD-DPO achieves a better trade-off between sycophancy mitigation and intervention ability retention in our offline settings, highlighting its potential as a practical alignment approach for autism intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自闭症儿童干预对话中大语言模型的奉承行为（sycophancy），提出 Minimal Edit Data Augmentation (MEDA) 策略构建受控的最小编辑偏好对，以及 Token-level Difference Direct Preference Optimization (TD-DPO)，通过增大选择与拒绝回复间差异 token 的权重并降低共享 token 的权重，在缓解奉承的同时保持干预能力。实验表明，在多个 backbone 和评估器上，TD-DPO 在离线设置下实现了更好的权衡。
Motivation: 大语言模型在自闭症儿童干预对话中表现出奉承行为，增加安全风险；仅依赖正样本的监督微调不足以纠正失败模式，而序列级偏好优化会过度更新偏好无关 token，导致干预能力下降。
Method: 提出 MEDA 策略，通过最小编辑构造稳定、受控的偏好对；提出 TD-DPO，在 token 级别对差异 token 上加权、共享 token 下加权，抑制背景漂移。
Result: 在多个 backbone 和评估器上，TD-DPO 在离线设置下实现了奉承缓解与干预能力保持的更好权衡。
Conclusion: TD-DPO 可作为自闭症干预对话中减少奉承行为的实用对齐方法。

papers.title: Fretiq: Browser-Native Electric Guitar String Classification via Engineered Spectral Features and Held-Out Free-Play Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Identifying which string produces a given pitch in monophonic electric guitar audio is a fundamental classification challenge: a single pitch can often be produced on multiple strings at different fret positions, with timbral differences that prior listening studies confirm are largely imperceptible to untrained humans. Existing approaches using support vector machines and spectral envelope features have achieved F-measures of 0.90 for six-string electric guitar classification, while String-Inverse Frequency features in earlier work achieved F1 scores up to 0.72. We present Fretiq, a preliminary single-instrument, single-player browser-based string classification system built on a 26-dimensional feature representation integrating frequency band energies, spectral statistics, and 13 Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients, achieving 97.1% shuffled frame-level validation accuracy across 322,215 balanced frames. An ablation study identifies MFCCs as the primary accuracy driver (92.2% to 97.1%). We additionally introduce Comparison Training -- a data collection methodology in which adjacent open-string and fifth-fret string pairs are recorded in deliberate alternation -- and evaluate its contribution via confusion matrix analysis. Comparison Training reduces the D3 to A2 frame-level confusion rate by 44% but shows mixed results on other targeted pairs. A held-out free-play evaluation on 103,000 frames yields 87.8% overall accuracy. We describe the feature extraction pipeline in both Python and TypeScript to guarantee training-inference parity, and document two critical implementation failure modes. The system runs entirely in-browser with no hexaphonic pickup, fretboard sensor, camera, or multi-microphone setup required.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 tables, preliminary single-instrument system paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出 Fretiq，一个基于浏览器的电吉他琴弦分类系统，利用 26 维特征表示（包括频带能量、频谱统计和 13 个 MFCC）在 322,215 个平衡帧上达到 97.1% 的帧级验证准确率。消融实验表明 MFCC 是主要准确率驱动因素。引入对比训练方法减少特定混淆对错误率，但自由弹奏评估准确率为 87.8%。系统完全在浏览器中运行，无需特殊硬件。
Motivation: 识别单音电吉他音频中产生给定音高的琴弦是一个基础分类挑战，因为同一音高可在不同弦上产生，且音色差异对人耳难以察觉。现有方法准确率有限，且依赖专用硬件，需要更易部署、准确率更高的系统。
Method: 构建 26 维特征表示，结合频带能量、频谱统计和 13 个 MFCC，采用支持向量机分类器。提出对比训练方法，交替录制相邻开放弦和第五品弦对，并用混淆矩阵分析其贡献。特征提取在 Python 和 TypeScript 中实现以保证训练-推理一致性。
Result: 在 322,215 个平衡帧上达到 97.1% 的帧级验证准确率；消融实验显示 MFCC 使准确率从 92.2% 提升至 97.1%。对比训练将 D3 到 A2 帧混淆率降低 44%，但其他目标对效果不一。在 103,000 帧的自由弹奏评估中总体准确率为 87.8%。
Conclusion: Fretiq 展示了基于浏览器、无需专用硬件的电吉他琴弦分类系统的可行性，但当前为初步单乐器、单玩家系统，自由弹奏准确率仍有提升空间。论文记录了关键实现失败模式，有助于后续改进。

papers.title: A Better Start for Language Models: Domain-Conditional Position Offsets
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive language models are least accurate at the beginning of a sequence, where little context forces reliance on a generic pretraining prior. We show that this cold-start penalty is domain dependent and reduce it with a domain-conditional position offset: a single learned vector added to the embedding activation at the first sequence positions while all model weights remain frozen. The offset trains in minutes on roughly one hundred documents, switches between domains without added sequence state, and has no measurable latency overhead. Across eight Mamba, GPT-NeoX, and Llama models spanning 410M to 8B parameters, it reduces held-out in-domain perplexity by up to 27%; the effect persists at 70B, and one position captures most of the benefit. A matched, converged direct logit-bias correction reaches at most only 7.9% and leaves later-token loss unchanged, showing that the offset propagates through model state rather than merely recalibrating the output prior. A tuned LoRA reaches lower perplexity but uses two to three orders of magnitude more parameters and an active low-rank weight path, while soft prompts add sequence positions. With wrong-domain controls, offsets improve retrieval reranking and domain classification when decisions depend on early in-domain tokens, For the few-shot reasoning whose signal occurs later, the results maintains unchanged. Position-aware prefill application also help generation tasks, whereas naive application at every cached decoding step causes repetition. The offset is therefore not the strongest adapter, but a lightweight, hot switchable tool for short in-domain scoring and calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自回归语言模型在序列起始处因缺乏上下文而准确率低的问题，提出领域条件位置偏移（domain-conditional position offset）：在序列前几个位置向嵌入激活添加一个学习到的向量，保持模型权重不变。偏移量在约一百篇文档上训练数分钟，可在领域间热切换，无延迟开销。在Mamba、GPT-NeoX、Llama等模型上（410M到8B参数）将域内困惑度降低最多27%；效果在70B模型上仍存在，且仅需一个位置即可获得大部分收益。与直接logit偏置校正、低秩适配（LoRA）和软提示等方法进行了对比。在错误领域控制实验中，当决策依赖早期领域内token时，偏移量改善了检索重排序和领域分类；对信号出现在后期的少样本推理则无影响。位置感知的prefill应用也有助于生成任务，但简单应用于每个缓存解码步骤会导致重复。
Motivation: 自回归语言模型在序列起始处因缺乏上下文而准确率低，且该冷启动惩罚（cold-start penalty）具有领域依赖性，现有方法如LoRA和软提示要么参数量大，要么增加序列长度。
Method: 提出领域条件位置偏移（domain-conditional position offset）：一个学习到的向量，仅在前几个序列位置添加到嵌入激活中，模型权重冻结。偏移量通过最小化领域内语言模型损失训练，训练数据约一百篇文档，耗时数分钟，可在不同领域间切换而无需额外状态。
Result: 在八个Mamba、GPT-NeoX、Llama模型（410M到8B参数）上，域内困惑度降低最多27%；在70B模型上效果依然存在。匹配的直接logit偏置校正仅降低7.9%且不改变后续token损失，表明偏移量通过模型状态传播。LoRA能达到更低困惑度但使用两到三个数量级更多参数。
Conclusion: 该方法不是最强适配器，而是一种轻量级、可热切换的工具，适用于短序列域内评分和校准。

papers.title: On Incentivized Exploration beyond Bayesianism and Full-Information
papers.abstract_en: We extend Incentive Compatible Exploration beyond the Bayesian full-information setting of Kremer et al. [2014]. We consider agents that may possess external information unknown to the principal. We show such settings require new notions of incentivized exploration, as well as going beyond a Bayesian perspective, and we introduce a definition where agents choose any reasonable (undominated) action. Furthermore, our framework provides for a more robust treatment of ties, and extends to settings where agents lack a single common prior and instead only know that reward distributions belong to a collection of potential priors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了激励相容探索（Incentivized Compatible Exploration）至超越贝叶斯全信息设定。考虑智能体可能拥有主事者未知的外部信息，提出新的激励探索定义，要求智能体选择任意合理（非占优）行动。该框架还更鲁棒地处理平局，并扩展到智能体没有共同先验、仅知奖励分布属于某潜在先验集合的情形。
Motivation: 现有Bayesian全信息模型假设主事者知晓所有信息，但实际中智能体可能具有外部信息。需要新的激励探索框架以处理此类不确定性。
Method: 引入非占优行动选择概念，抛弃共同先验假设，允许智能体从潜在先验集合中任意选取，并重新定义激励兼容性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实证结果，主要贡献为理论扩展与定义。
Conclusion: 该工作为处理外部信息和非Bayesian环境下的激励探索提供了理论基础，并增强了处理平局的能力。

papers.title: Disentangling Forced and Internal Climate Variability in Single Realizations using Dynamic Mode Decomposition with Control
papers.abstract_en: We show that a single climate realization can be decomposed into forced and internal components by treating external forcing as a dynamical driver within a linear stochastic system, an idea grounded in pullback attractor theory. In doing so, we address a central methodological challenge in climate science with direct implications for climate projection and the detection and attribution of the forced response, disentangling the forced climate response from internal variability in a single observed record. Statistical methods range from approaches trained on large ensembles to techniques operating on single realizations. The latter often rely on linear frameworks such as linear inverse models (LIMs) and linear regression. LIMs ignore forcing predictors, whereas linear regression omits climate system dynamics. Here we introduce PullbackDMDc, a method grounded in non-autonomous dynamical systems theory and dynamic mode decomposition with control (DMDc), incorporating pullback attractor estimation to decompose a single climate realization into spatial modes and their associated forced and internal components, yielding a physically interpretable picture of the underlying dynamics. We illustrate the utility of PullbackDMDc for Earth System Model (ESM) evaluation by applying it to near-surface air temperature and sea-level pressure from reanalysis and four ESM large ensembles. PullbackDMDc estimates the forced response with skill matching or exceeding established baselines and identifies optimal forcing predictors against model-based ground truth. Its internal variability components reveal that ESMs qualitatively capture interannual and decadal modes while exhibiting systematic differences relative to each other and to observations. Skillful forced response estimation and a novel decomposition position PullbackDMDc as a practical tool for single-realization climate analysis and ESM evaluation.

Motivation: 气候科学中一个核心方法挑战是如何从单次观测记录中分离受迫气候响应和内部变率，这对气候预估和检测归因至关重要。现有线性方法如线性逆模型忽略强迫预测因子，而线性回归忽略系统动力学。
Method: 引入PullbackDMDc，结合非自治动力系统理论、DMDc和拉回吸引子估计，将单次气候实现分解为空间模态及其对应的受迫和内部成分，提供物理可解释的动力图像。

Conclusion: 有效的受迫响应估计和新的分解方法使PullbackDMDc成为单实现气候分析和ESM评估的实用工具。

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning to Master the Asymmetric Strategy of Baghchal
papers.abstract_en: Baghchal is a two-player asymmetric board game with Nepali origins where four tigers are to capture goats and twenty goats desire to keep tigers in immobility. Although Baghchal has a complex structure which is strategic, has perfect information structure, and has cultural meaning, it has not been adequately covered in deep reinforcement learning (RL) literature. This paper gives a systematic exploration of four deep RL solutions Deep Q-Network (DQN), REINFORCE, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and MuZero that are trained on one side of the asymmetric gameplay of Baghchal and then evaluated on the other side. The algorithms are rated based on win rate, draw rate, average captures, training convergence and computational cost. It is experimentally found that MuZero generates the best performance in both tasks, achieving 86 percent win over these Tiger and 62 percent win over these Goat and the ability to do so is due to the model-based planning machine through the Monte Carlo Tree Search. PPO is the most realistic algorithm and is provided to be competitive over both asymmetric tasks with significantly reduced computational costs compared to MuZero. Emergent strategic behavior analysis shows that model-based strategies are optimal over long-horizon planning, whereas value-based counterparts like DQN are more biased up towards the Tiger role owing to the more substantial reward signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统探索了四种深度强化学习算法（DQN、REINFORCE、PPO、MuZero）在解决尼泊尔非对称棋盘游戏Baghchal中的应用，分别训练老虎和山羊角色并交叉评估。实验结果表明MuZero在两个角色上均表现最佳（老虎角色胜率86%，山羊角色胜率62%），得益于其基于模型的蒙特卡洛树搜索规划；PPO则以显著更低的计算成本取得了接近的性能。策略分析显示基于模型的方法在长时域规划上更优，而基于价值的方法（如DQN）因老虎角色奖励信号更强而出现偏差。
Motivation: Baghchal作为一种具有完美信息结构但尚未在深度强化学习文献中得到充分研究的非对称策略游戏，其文化意义和战略复杂性值得探索。
Method: 分别使用DQN、REINFORCE、PPO和MuZero四种算法训练单一角色（老虎或山羊），然后将其部署到另一角色进行评估，通过胜率、平局率、平均捕获数、收敛速度和计算成本来比较算法性能。
Result: MuZero在两个任务上均取得最佳性能：老虎角色胜率86%，山羊角色胜率62%；PPO在显著降低计算成本的同时达到相当的竞争力。
Conclusion: 模型驱动的规划方法（如MuZero）在长时域规划中表现最优，而基于价值的方法易受非对称奖励信号影响。

papers.title: On the Limits of Support-Preserving Alignment and Bounded Filtering
papers.abstract_en: We study whether alignment schemes that reshape a base model's output distribution, combined with bounded safety filters, can drive the probability of harmful behavior to zero in modern large language models. Recent research suggests that harmful behaviors can persist under preference-based alignment and that external filtering can be computationally hard in the worst case, but it remains unclear whether practical alignment pipelines that largely preserve internal representations can eliminate harmful behavior entirely rather than merely suppressing its most visible forms. We formalize this setting using support-preserving alignment operators together with bounded filtering algorithms under black-box, white-box, and statistical-query access, and analyze their ability to approximate an ideal eliminator that removes all harmful mass. Building on this framework, we provide computational and information-theoretic arguments indicating that, under these constraints, bounded filtering may fail to eliminate all harmful outputs supported by the base model's distribution. To evaluate these limits empirically, we analyze a range of state-of-the-art open-weight and hosted LLMs accessed via OpenRouter under bounded black-box, white-box, and statistical-query filters on adversarial prompts drawn from curated cybersecurity scenarios and PKU-SafeRLHF. Across models, filter classes, and query budgets, the estimated harmful-output rate decreases with additional filtering compute but consistently plateaus above zero, suggesting a persistent empirical harm floor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在支持保持对齐和有限过滤的条件下，能否将大语言模型的有害行为概率降至零。作者形式化了该设置，并通过理论和经验分析表明，在给定约束下，有限过滤无法完全消除有害输出，有害输出率会稳定在零以上。
Motivation: 现有研究表明有害行为可能在偏好对齐下持续存在，且外部过滤在最坏情况下计算困难，但实际对齐流程是否能完全消除有害行为尚不清楚。
Method: 形式化了支持保持对齐算子与有限过滤算法（黑盒、白盒、统计查询访问）的框架，并分析其逼近理想消除器的能力。经验评估使用多种最新LLM和对抗性提示。
Result: 在多个模型和过滤类别上，估计的有害输出率随着过滤计算增加而下降，但始终稳定在零以上，表明存在经验上的持久有害下限。
Conclusion: 在支持保持对齐和有限过滤的约束下，可能无法完全消除基模型分布所支持的所有有害输出。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for AI-Driven Crash Simulation Surrogates: A Comparative Study of Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensemble on Open-Source Bumper Beam Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning surrogate models are increasingly being explored in engineering product development to augment simulation-driven design, offering near-instantaneous predictions that complement computationally expensive high-fidelity analyses. However, a critical gap limits their adoption in safety-critical workflows: a point prediction without an accompanying uncertainty estimate cannot tell an engineer when the model should not be trusted. This work presents a systematic, head-to-head comparison of two widely used uncertainty quantification approaches -- Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensembles -- applied to an open-source surrogate pipeline built on NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo. A key contribution is the use of concrete dropout, a built-in PhysicsNeMo capability that eliminates the dropout rate as a manual hyperparameter by learning it end-to-end during training, directly addressing the most common criticism of Monte Carlo Dropout-based uncertainty quantification. Automotive crash simulation is used as the application domain, with a steel bumper beam impact problem serving as the benchmark. Both methods are evaluated on identical held-out simulations and compared on point accuracy, uncertainty band calibration, and computational cost. The results reveal a fundamental trade-off between accuracy and calibration that challenges the common assumption that deep ensembles are the default gold standard for surrogate uncertainty quantification. The findings demonstrate that well-calibrated, hyperparameter-free uncertainty estimates are achievable within a fully open-source engineering workflow at a fraction of the computational cost of ensemble approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在开源碰撞代理模型上系统比较了两种不确定性量化方法——蒙特卡洛丢弃法 (Monte Carlo Dropout) 和深度集成 (Deep Ensembles)，并利用 PhysicsNeMo 的内置具体丢弃法 (concrete dropout) 自动学习丢弃率。实验基于钢制保险杠梁碰撞基准，评估了点精度、不确定性校准和计算成本。结果表明准确性与校准之间存在根本性权衡，挑战了深度集成作为替代模型不确定性量化默认黄金标准的假设。
Motivation: 机器学习代理模型在安全关键工程设计中缺乏不确定性估计，无法告知工程师何时不应信任模型，这限制了其在安全关键工作流中的应用。
Method: 在 NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo 代理流水线上实现蒙特卡洛丢弃法（使用具体丢弃法自动学习丢弃率）和深度集成，并在汽车碰撞模拟的钢制保险杠梁冲击问题上进行头对头比较。
Result: 结果显示准确性与校准之间存在根本性权衡，深度集成并非默认的黄金标准；良好校准、无超参数的不确定性估计可在完全开源的工作流中以远低于集成方法的计算成本实现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调超参数自由的不确定性估计在开源工程工作流中的可行性，并指出单模型方法能以较低计算成本提供良好的校准，挑战深度集成的默认优势。

papers.title: One Student, Many Teachers: Multi-Task On-Policy Distillation via Soft-Prompt Privileged Context
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) teaches large language models new skills through a teacher that shares the student's backbone and supervises its own rollouts. Existing teachers either inject privileged context at the input -- inducing post-hoc rationalization -- or fine-tune weights, accumulating drift and forgetting across tasks. We propose \method, whose teacher differs from the student only by a learnable soft prompt: trained on $(x, y_\text{gold})$ pairs with the backbone frozen, the prompt yields a task-specific teacher that preserves the student's exact representational geometry. \method\ extends naturally to multi-task settings by routing each example in a merged corpus to its corresponding soft-prompt teacher, allowing a single student to absorb knowledge from $K$ teachers in parallel; at inference, all prompts are discarded. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Phi-4-mini-instruct across four tasks (Science, Tool Use, Biology, Math), the single-task variant (OPD with a PT teacher) matches or exceeds full fine-tuning while training orders of magnitude fewer parameters, and the multi-task variant achieves the best overall average ($56.2$ on Qwen3-1.7B-Base) while preserving general-capability benchmarks -- in contrast to sequential SFT, which degrades both.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的在线自我蒸馏方法，教师通过可学习的soft prompt从学生主干中分离，避免过拟合和遗忘。单任务变体在Qwen3-1.7B-Base等模型上匹配全微调性能，多任务变体在Science等四个任务上取得最佳平均分数（56.2），同时保持通用能力。
Motivation: 现有在线自我蒸馏方法中，教师要么在输入中注入特权上下文导致事后合理化，要么微调权重导致任务间漂移和遗忘。本文旨在设计一种教师与学生共享主干但通过soft prompt实现任务特定知识蒸馏的框架。
Method: 教师与学生共享同一个冻结的主干，但教师额外有一个可学习的soft prompt；教师仅在$(x, y_{gold})$对上训练，主干冻结。多任务设置中，合并语料库中每个样本路由到对应soft-prompt教师，学生并行从K个教师吸收知识；推理时丢弃所有prompts。
Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B-Base和Phi-4-mini-instruct上，单任务变体（OPD with PT teacher）匹配或超越全微调，训练参数少几个数量级；多任务变体在四个任务上取得最佳平均（56.2 on Qwen3-1.7B-Base），同时保持通用基准能力，而顺序SFT则退化。
Conclusion: 本文提出的方法通过soft-prompt特权上下文实现多任务在线自我蒸馏，有效避免遗忘和过拟合，在参数效率和多任务性能上优于顺序微调。

papers.title: Reliability Scales Inversely: Bigger Models Compound Mistakes Faster via a Hidden Auto-Regressive Risk Regime
papers.abstract_en: As language models scale, answers start truer but degrade faster: scaling buys capability but erodes reliability. The knowledge-gap account - more data, retrieval, or scale - misses an auto-regressive risk residual that scale sharpens: the model commits to a low-probability token, conditions on it as established, and snowballs. We track this through per-position disagreement $δ= \log p_M - \log p_O$ against a stronger same-family oracle, whose second moment splits exactly into bias$^2$ $\mathrm{KL}(p_M \,\|\, p_O)^2$ and risk $\mathrm{Var}[δ]$. We present four findings: (i) under scaling, the knowledge gap falls $\approx$$6\times$ while knowledge degradation grows $11$-$39\times$; (ii) at a fabrication, felt uncertainty $H(p_M)$ relaxes quickly while oracle-referenced risk persists up to $17\times$ longer, leaving a confident-but-precarious risk regime that bridges consecutive fabrications ($+69\%$ at $14$B); (iii) this regime is causal - an on-policy, fixed-$\mathrm{KL}$ variance contraction cuts web-verified hallucination by $35$-$74\%$ across three model families; and, (iv) it structurally evades self-monitoring, with $p_M$-only detectors (e.g. semantic entropy) firing $\approx$$30\%$ less ($p<10^{-16}$) on the risky branch holding nearly $4\times$ more fabrications. Bigger models snowball mistakes faster, through a failure mode that is dominant, self-perpetuating, causal and invisible to the model itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究语言模型规模增大后可靠性的变化，发现规模增大虽缩小了知识差距，但知识退化大幅增加（11-39倍）。模型会进入一个隐蔽的自回归风险区间：当模型提交到一个低概率token后，将其条件化并雪球式积累错误。通过追踪每位置分歧δ与更强同族oracle的比较，将二阶矩分解为偏差²KL²与风险Var[δ]。主要发现包括：规模增大时知识差距下降约6倍而知识退化增长；虚构处模型熵迅速放松但oracle风险持续17倍以上；通过固定KL方差收缩可使幻觉减少35-74%；该模式逃避自监控，仅基于p_M的检测器在风险分支上触发率低约30%。
Motivation: 现有知识差距解释（更多数据、检索或规模）忽略了一个自回归风险残差：模型提交低概率token后条件化进而雪球。规模增大加剧了这一风险。
Method: 引入每位置分歧δ=log p_M - log p_O（p_O为同族更强oracle），将其二阶矩分解为偏差²KL(p_M||p_O)²与风险Var[δ]，并设计on-policy固定KL方差收缩实验验证因果性。
Result: 四个发现：(i) 规模增大知识差距下降约6倍，但知识退化增长11-39倍；(ii) 虚构处模型熵H(p_M)快速放松，但oracle风险持续17倍以上，形成连接虚构的自信-危险区间（+69% at 14B）；(iii) 固定KL方差收缩使web验证幻觉减少35-74%；(iv) p_M-only检测器（如语义熵）在风险分支上触发率低约30%（p<10^{-16}），而该分支包含近4倍虚构。
Conclusion: 更大模型通过一种自我延续、因果且对模型自身不可见的故障模式更快地雪球式犯错，这是主导性故障模式。

papers.title: Dual-domain fused LSTM modeling for efficient time-dependent reliability analysis
papers.abstract_en: Time-dependent reliability analysis is crucial for ensuring the long-term safety and performance of engineering systems under uncertainties. However, traditional surrogate model methods often struggle to incorporate time-independent random variables and capture their complex interactions with time-dependent stochastic processes. To overcome this limitation, this paper proposes a dual-domain fused long short-term memory (DDF-LSTM) model for efficient and accurate time-dependent reliability analysis. A novel network architecture is developed to jointly process information from both time-dependent and time-independent domains. Specifically, the time-independent variables are embedded into the initial hidden states, and a fully connected layer is introduced to map both LSTM outputs and time-independent variables into the final output space. Furthermore, an improved loss function is designed to emphasize the model's sensitivity to minimum responses, thereby improving the precision of failure probability estimation. The proposed method effectively captures the dependencies among random variables, stochastic processes, and the temporal behavior of limit state functions. Once trained, the DDF-LSTM model enables efficient Monte Carlo simulation to estimate time-dependent failure probabilities with minimal computational cost. Four case studies validate the proposed method's enhanced computational efficiency and predictive accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种双域融合长短期记忆（DDF-LSTM）模型，用于高效准确的时间依赖可靠性分析。该模型通过将时间无关变量嵌入初始隐藏状态并引入全连接层联合处理LSTM输出与时间无关变量，同时设计改进的损失函数强调对最小响应的敏感性，从而更精确地估计失效概率。四个案例验证了其计算效率和预测精度。
Motivation: 传统代理模型方法难以融入时间无关随机变量并捕捉其与时间相关随机过程的复杂交互，限制了时间依赖可靠性分析的准确性。
Method: 提出DDF-LSTM网络架构：将时间无关变量嵌入LSTM初始隐藏状态，并通过全连接层融合LSTM输出与时间无关变量；设计侧重最小响应的损失函数以提升失效概率估计精度。
Result: 四个案例研究显示，所提方法在计算效率和预测精度上优于传统方法，训练后可通过蒙特卡洛模拟高效估计时变失效概率。
Conclusion: 该模型有效捕捉了随机变量、随机过程与极限状态函数时间行为之间的依赖关系，适用于工程系统的长期可靠性评估。

papers.title: SechKAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Hyperbolic Secant Functions
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have attracted increasing attention due to their effectiveness in machine learning and scientific computing tasks, offering a new paradigm for neural network design. In this paper, we present SechKAN, a KAN architecture based on hyperbolic secant (sech) functions. The hyperbolic secant basis is used for its smooth bell-shaped form, localized responses, and stable gradients. We employ 1D linear transformations to reduce the number of parameters, allowing SechKAN to remain comparable to multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) in model size. Experimental results indicate the effectiveness of SechKAN in function fitting, PDE problems, and image classification tasks on benchmark datasets, including MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100. SechKAN achieves superior performance compared to MLPs and other KAN variants while maintaining a similar number of parameters. However, its running time, while better than that of other KAN variants, is slightly longer than that of MLPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SechKAN，一种基于双曲正割（sech）函数的KAN架构。利用sech的光滑钟形、局部响应和稳定梯度，通过1D线性变换减少参数，使模型大小与MLP相当。在函数拟合、PDE问题和MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100图像分类上，SechKAN优于MLP和其他KAN变体，但运行时间略长于MLP。
Motivation: 现有KAN网络在效率和性能上仍有改进空间，本文探索使用双曲正割函数作为基础函数单元，以提供平滑局部响应和稳定梯度。
Method: 提出SechKAN架构，采用双曲正割（sech）函数作为基础函数，并通过1D线性变换控制参数量，使模型大小与MLP相当。
Result: 在函数拟合、PDE问题和MNIST/Fashion-MNIST/CIFAR-10/100图像分类上，SechKAN优于MLP及其他KAN变体，参数数量相似，运行时间虽优于其他KAN变体但略长于MLP。
Conclusion: SechKAN作为KAN的一种有效变体，在多个任务上表现优越，但运行时间仍有改进空间。

papers.title: Towards Principled Continual Anomaly Detection: A Systematic Framework and Benchmark Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Continual anomaly detection (CAD) studies how models can adapt to evolving data distributions while retaining performance on previously observed regimes. CAD benchmarks, however, depend critically on how tasks are defined, filtered, ordered, and validated. In tabular domains, task boundaries are rarely given, and arbitrary splits can create unlearnable, redundant, or overly transferable tasks that obscure genuine continual-learning behavior. To this end, we introduce a systematic framework for reproducible benchmark scenario design from existing tabular anomaly-detection datasets. The framework discovers candidate tasks, filters unsuitable tasks, and derives principled orderings that expose diverse dynamics. The framework allows us to deliver five benchmark-ready scenarios from three large-scale cybersecurity anomaly detection datasets, yielding both single-dataset and multi-dataset CAD settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个系统框架，用于从现有表格异常检测数据集构建可复现的持续异常检测（CAD）基准场景。框架通过发现候选任务、过滤不合适的任务并推导出有序的任务序列，暴露多样化的持续学习动态。基于三个大规模网络安全异常检测数据集，生成了五个基准场景，包括单数据集和多数据集CAD设置。
Motivation: 持续异常检测（CAD）基准严重依赖于任务的定义、过滤、排序和验证方式。表格领域中任务边界很少给定，任意划分可能产生不可学习、冗余或过度可迁移的任务，从而掩盖真正的持续学习行为。
Method: 提出一个系统框架，用于从现有表格异常检测数据集设计可复现的基准场景。框架包括发现候选任务、过滤不合适的任务，以及推导出能暴露多样化动态的合理任务顺序。
Result: 基于三个大规模网络安全异常检测数据集，生成了五个基准就绪场景，提供了单数据集和多数据集CAD设置。
Conclusion: 该框架为持续异常检测提供了更系统、可复现的基准设计方法，有助于更准确地评估模型在表格数据上的持续学习能力。

papers.title: Multi-Timescale Latent-Action DRL for Joint Optimization in Edge-Cloud Networks
papers.abstract_en: Load imbalance across edge and cloud layers degrades latency performance in hierarchical edge-cloud computing (HECC) systems under dynamic task arrivals and heterogeneous resources, leading to severe queuing delays and inefficient resource utilization. To address this challenge, we study a joint service placement, computational delegation, and power control (JSCP) problem to minimize the average end-to-end (e2e) latency. The resulting JSCP problem is a mixed-integer nonconvex and NP-hard optimization problem due to the strong coupling between discrete and continuous variables. To enable tractable optimization and stable system adaptation, we exploit the inherent difference in decision dynamics and decompose the problem into long-term system configuration and short-term resource allocation subproblems. Based on this formulation, we propose a two-timescale multi-layer deep reinforcement learning framework with a latent action space (2T-MDRL-LA) to jointly optimize service placement, user association, computational delegation, task offloading, and user transmit power. A latent action representation based on a variational autoencoder is introduced to efficiently compress the high-dimensional combinatorial action space. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively adapts to dynamic network conditions and achieves near-optimal performance compared to branch-and-bound solutions. It achieves up to a 20.8% reduction in average e2e latency and a 13% improvement in resource utilization over the scheme without the computational delegation, while converging approximately 50% faster than conventional proximal policy optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分层边缘-云计算（HECC）系统中的负载不平衡问题，提出一个联合服务放置、计算委派和功率控制（JSCP）问题，最小化平均端到端延迟。该问题为混合整数非凸NP难问题，作者利用决策动态差异将其分解为长期系统配置和短期资源分配子问题，并设计了一个基于潜在动作空间的两时间尺度多层深度强化学习框架（2T-MDRL-LA）。仿真表明，该方法在动态网络条件下接近最优，平均延迟降低20.8%，资源利用率提升13%，收敛速度比传统PPO快约50%。
Motivation: 边缘-云网络中动态任务到达和异构资源导致负载不均衡，造成严重排队延迟和资源利用率低下，现有方法难以联合优化服务放置、计算委派和功率控制。
Method: 将JSCP问题分解为长期配置和短期分配子问题，提出两时间尺度多层DRL框架，使用变分自编码器压缩高维组合动作空间，形成潜在动作表示。
Result: 仿真显示平均端到端延迟降低20.8%，资源利用率提升13%，收敛速度比传统PPO快约50%，且接近分支定界最优解。
Conclusion: 所提框架能有效适应动态网络条件，实现接近最优的性能，但摘要未讨论实际部署或硬件限制。
