papers.title: BearingNAS: Obtaining In-Sensor Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Systems for Bearings Using a Laptop
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces BearingNAS, a Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search (HW-NAS) framework designed to shift the intelligence directly onto the sensor die via in-sensor processing. BearingNAS frames the search as a constrained optimization problem targeting extreme micro-budgets (4 to 8 kiB of RAM and 16 to 32 kiB of Flash). To eliminate the reliance on expensive discrete GPUs, we propose a lightweight, derivative-free search strategy paired with a single data-flow search space that leverages a decaying kernel growth formulation to prevent parameter explosion. We evaluate our framework on the Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) bearing benchmark, optimizing architectures for three STMicroelectronics targets: two commodity microcontrollers and the LSM6DSO16IS Intelligent Sensor Processing Unit (ISPU). Running entirely on a laptop CPU, the search converges in less than an hour. The resulting best in-sensor architecture achieves a highly competitive diagnostic accuracy of 99.50\% on the ISPU. These results demonstrate the viability of shifting the machine learning workload inside the sensor package, enabling low-cost, production-scale bearing fault diagnosis.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE COINS 2026 in Special Session 7: Edge AI technologies
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BearingNAS，一种硬件感知神经架构搜索（HW-NAS）框架，旨在通过传感器内处理将智能直接迁移到传感器芯片上。搜索被建模为约束优化问题，面向极小的内存预算（4到8 KiB RAM，16到32 KiB Flash）。为消除对昂贵离散GPU的依赖，提出轻量级无导数搜索策略和单数据流搜索空间，利用衰减核增长防止参数爆炸。在CWRU轴承基准上评估，针对三个STMicroelectronics目标优化，搜索在笔记本电脑CPU上运行不到一小时，最佳传感器架构在ISPU上达到99.50%的诊断精度。
Motivation: 现有轴承故障诊断通常依赖离散GPU进行机器学习工作负载，成本高且不适合传感器内处理。本文旨在实现低成本、生产规模的轴承故障诊断，将机器学习直接集成到传感器封装中。
Method: BearingNAS将搜索构建为约束优化问题，针对4-8 KiB RAM和16-32 KiB Flash的微预算；采用轻量级无导数搜索策略和单数据流搜索空间，使用衰减核增长公式防止参数爆炸。
Result: 在CWRU轴承基准上，针对三个STMicroelectronics目标（两个商用微控制器和LSM6DSO16IS智能传感处理单元）优化，最佳传感器架构在ISPU上达到99.50%的诊断精度，搜索在笔记本电脑CPU上不到一小时收敛。
Conclusion: 结果表明将机器学习工作负载移到传感器芯片内部是可行的，支持低成本、生产规模的轴承故障诊断。

papers.title: Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Runtime-Tunable Transit Signal Priority
papers.abstract_en: Transit signal priority (TSP) requires balancing competing objectives: reducing bus delay while limiting adverse impacts on non-bus traffic and avoiding extreme waits for a subset of vehicles. Existing reinforcement-learning (RL) approaches to TSP typically encode transit-aware features (e.g., occupancy and schedule deviation) but optimize a fixed reward or fixed scalarization, which limits operational flexibility when agency priorities change across time-of-day or disruption conditions. We present a preference-conditioned TSP controller, $π(a \mid s,w)$, that selects the next signal phase under minimum/maximum green and transition-feasibility constraints and can be tuned at runtime via a preference parameter $w$ to trade off bus-priority emphasis against overall traffic delay without retraining. We implement this on top of IntersectionZoo by introducing a constrained signal-control/TSP wrapper, and we extend scenario generation with bus-prevalence augmentation and timetable-based bus insertion to address sparse transit-priority events during training. Experiments against fixed-time control, a rule-based TSP overlay, and fixed-weight PPO specialists show that a single learned conditioned policy spans a smooth empirical trade-off frontier across runtime preferences, outperforms fixed-time and rule-based baselines, and maintains constraint feasibility, while tail-delay diagnostics reveal that non-bus externalities remain limited for moderate preference settings but can increase substantially under high bus-priority weights. The source code of this work is available at https://github.com/urbanAIthi/morl-tsp.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 29th IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC 2026). Code: https://github.com/urbanAIthi/morl-tsp
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种偏好条件多目标强化学习控制器，用于运行时可调的公交信号优先（TSP），通过单一策略参数w在运行时平衡公交优先与整体交通延误，无需重新训练。在IntersectionZoo上实现，实验显示其优于固定时间、规则和固定权重PPO基线，并保持约束可行性。
Motivation: 现有TSP的强化学习方法通常优化固定奖励或固定标量化，无法灵活适应不同时段或干扰条件下的机构优先级变化，缺乏运行时调优能力。
Method: 提出偏好条件TSP控制器π(a|s,w)，在最小/最大绿灯和过渡可行性约束下选择下一信号相位，通过运行时偏好参数w调节公交优先与总体延误的权衡，并扩展公交普及增强和时间表插入的场景生成。
Result: 实验显示单个学习到的条件策略在运行时偏好上覆盖平滑的经验权衡前沿，优于固定时间、规则基线和固定权重PPO，同时非公交外部性在中等偏好设置下有限，但在高公交优先级权重下增加。
Conclusion: 该方法通过单一策略实现运行时灵活调优，适用于多目标TSP问题，但高公交权重可能增加非公交车辆延迟。

papers.title: Edge-Efficient Transformer for End-to-End RF Spectrum Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: We present E-SpecFormer (Edge Spectrum monitoring Transformer) for end-to-end automatic modulation and covert channel (CC) recognition. We introduce LiTAN (Linear Tanh Attention Network), a Softmax- and LayerNorm-free attention mechanism that reduces complexity while increasing accuracy in RF tasks. E-SpecFormer is parameterized in four scalable variants (Nano, Small, Medium, Large) to accommodate diverse hardware constraints. Using the RadioML2018 dataset for modulation recognition, the Nano variant achieves 86.5% average accuracy for Signal-to-Noise Ratios (SNRs)>0 dB, and on the hardware Trojan (HT)-based CC dataset it reaches 94.2% accuracy, both with fewer than 10k parameters and up to speed of 92 μs per frame on FPGA/CPU co-execution, surpassing state-of-the-art edge models at a fraction of their cost. These results establish E-SpecFormer as an edge-efficient solution for real-time spectrum intelligence on Internet of Things (IoT) devices. GitHub link to the repository: https://github.com/zsniko/E-SpecFormer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 E-SpecFormer，一种用于端到端自动调制识别和隐蔽信道（CC）识别的边缘高效 Transformer。通过引入无 Softmax 和 LayerNorm 的 LiTAN 注意力机制，降低复杂度并提升射频任务精度。该模型提供四个可扩展变体，在 RadioML2018 和基于硬件木马的 CC 数据集上，以不足 10k 参数和每帧 92 μs 的速度达到优于现有边缘模型的准确率。
Motivation: 现有边缘设备上的射频智能模型在计算效率和精度之间难以平衡，需要一种更轻量且高精度的端到端方案。
Method: 提出 E-SpecFormer 架构，核心是 LiTAN（线性 Tanh 注意力网络），一种无需 Softmax 和 LayerNorm 的注意力机制，并设计四个参数化变体（Nano、Small、Medium、Large）以适应不同硬件约束。
Result: Nano 变体在 RadioML2018 数据集上（SNR>0 dB）达 86.5% 平均准确率，在基于硬件木马的 CC 数据集上达 94.2% 准确率，参数量少于 10k，FPGA/CPU 协同执行速度达 92 μs/帧，超越现有边缘模型。
Conclusion: E-SpecFormer 被验证为适用于物联网设备实时频谱智能的边缘高效解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Compressing What Matters: Neuron Importance Meets Data-Aware Low Rank Approximation for Language Model Compression
papers.abstract_en: To excel at their domain large language models are comprised of billions of parameters. Yet this comes at the cost of huge memory requirements restricting their applicability in resource-constrained environments. To address the problem of neural network (NN) compression Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) has played a key role as a fundamental component for matrix compression through decomposition. To minimize compression error and to maximize the efficacy of the compressed model on the downstream tasks previous works focused on low-rank approximation of the NN's weight matrices either from the perspective of parameter importance or per-layer functional equivalence. While previous works studied the aforementioned perspectives in isolation in this work we are investigating the effectiveness of an approach that combines ideas from these two perspectives in a single objective. In parallel to this an important aspect that affects the compression quality is the distribution of the compression rate across layers and NN parameters. Earlier works mostly considered distributing the compression rate uniformly across layers and network weights or relied on computationally expensive heuristic search. Contrary to them in this work we propose an enhanced and computationally efficient algorithm for dynamic compression rate allocation. Experimental results support the efficacy of the proposed approach which performs on par or substantially better than the previous state-of-the-art especially under high compression ratios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合神经元重要性和数据感知低秩近似的语言模型压缩方法，并通过动态压缩率分配算法提高压缩效率。实验表明，该方法在高压缩比下与先前最优方法性能相当或更优。
Motivation: 大型语言模型参数庞大，内存需求高，限制其在资源受限环境中的应用。现有压缩方法要么仅考虑参数重要性，要么仅考虑逐层功能等价，且压缩率分配多采用均匀分配或计算昂贵的启发式搜索。
Method: 提出融合参数重要性与数据感知低秩近似的单一目标，以及一种计算高效的动态压缩率分配算法。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在高压缩比下与先前最优方法性能相当或更优。
Conclusion: 结合参数重要性和数据感知的低秩近似，并采用动态压缩率分配，可以有效提升模型压缩质量。

papers.title: FedCC: A Low-Resource Federated Adaptation of Foundation Models for Robust Corpus Callosum localization in Fetal Ultrasound Images
papers.abstract_en: Accurate localization of the corpus callosum (CC) in fetal ultrasound (US) images is crucial for the early identification of neurodevelopmental abnormalities. However, this task remains highly challenging due to the intrinsic limitations of US imaging, including low contrast, speckle noise, and the considerable anatomical variability of the CC. We propose FedCC, a federated learning (FL)-based framework for CC localization in fetal US images, specifically designed for realistic multi-center and resource-constrained clinical settings without requiring data sharing. The framework integrates a frozen DINOv2 backbone with a lightweight YOLO-based detection head. To enable parameter-efficient adaptation, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) modules are incorporated, allowing only a small subset of parameters to be optimized and exchanged among clients. This strategy substantially reduces both computational and communication overhead, making the framework suitable for low-resource environments. The proposed approach was evaluated on a multi-center dataset comprising 10,970 ultrasound frames acquired from 58 pregnant women during routine neurosonographic examinations across three clinical sites using heterogeneous imaging devices. The proposed framework achieved strong performance in the federated setting. In particular, the combination of DINOv2 and LoRA under the FedAvg strategy achieved an average mAP@50 of 0.857 and an F1-score of 0.803, outperforming both full fine-tuning and encoder-freezing baselines. Notably, the proposed approach reduced the number of trainable parameters to 2.9M compared with 24.4M in full fine-tuning, corresponding to an approximately 8.5$\times$ reduction in communication cost. These findings represent a promising step toward scalable, privacy-preserving, and clinically deployable AI systems for fetal neurosonography.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FedCC，一种基于联邦学习（FL）的框架，用于胎儿超声（US）图像中胼胝体（CC）的定位。该框架集成了冻结的DINOv2骨干网络和轻量级YOLO检测头，通过低秩适应（LoRA）模块实现参数高效微调，仅优化和交换少量参数，大幅降低计算和通信开销。在多中心数据集（10,970帧超声图像）上，结合DINOv2、LoRA和FedAvg策略的方法达到了平均mAP@50为0.857、F1-score为0.803，可训练参数从24.4M降至2.9M，通信成本降低约8.5倍。
Motivation: 胎儿超声图像中胼胝体定位对于早期识别神经发育异常至关重要，但超声图像的低对比度、散斑噪声和胼胝体解剖变异使得该任务极具挑战性。现有方法需要数据共享，不适用于多中心且资源受限的临床环境。
Method: 提出FedCC框架，采用冻结的DINOv2作为视觉骨干，搭配轻量级YOLO检测头，并引入LoRA模块进行参数高效微调。联邦学习使用FedAvg聚合策略，仅更新和交换LoRA参数，从而减少计算和通信开销。
Result: 在多中心数据集（10,970帧来自58名孕妇，三个临床站点，使用不同成像设备）上，DINOv2+LoRA+FedAvg方法达到平均mAP@50为0.857、F1-score为0.803。可训练参数减少至2.9M（全微调为24.4M），通信成本降低约8.5倍。
Conclusion: FedCC在资源受限的联邦学习场景下实现了有竞争力的胼胝体定位性能，为可扩展、隐私保护且可临床部署的胎儿神经超声AI系统迈出了有希望的一步。

papers.title: ALAS: Additive Learnable Alpha-Stable Kernels for Flexible Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian Optimization is widely used for expensive black-box optimization, yet its success often depends on choosing a kernel that matches the objective's unknown structure. In this work, we propose ALAS, a flexible Gaussian Process kernel family built from symmetric $α$-stable spectral components. By learning the stability parameter $α$, ALAS adapts its effective smoothness from data, capturing both smooth trends and sharp irregularities. We present two parameterizations: ALAS, a single stationary component with joint spectral modulation, and ALAS-Sep, a separable variant that learns dimension-wise tail behavior to improve robustness on approximately decomposable objectives. Experiments on standard benchmarks and real-world surrogates demonstrate strong and robust performance across diverse settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ALAS，一种基于对称α稳定谱成分的灵活高斯过程核族。通过学习稳定性参数α，ALAS能够自适应地从数据中调整有效平滑度，捕捉平滑趋势和尖锐不规则性。引入了两种参数化：ALAS（单一平稳分量联合谱调制）和ALAS-Sep（可分离变体，学习维度级尾行为以提高对近似可分解目标的鲁棒性）。标准基准和真实代理上的实验展示了跨多种设置的强健性能。
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化成功与否常依赖于选择匹配目标未知结构的核函数，而现有核函数灵活性不足，难以适应不同平滑度需求。
Method: 提出ALAS核族，基于可学习的对称α稳定谱分量，通过优化α参数自动调整核的平滑度。包含ALAS（联合谱调制）和ALAS-Sep（可分离维度级学习）两种变体。
Result: 在标准基准和真实代理实验中，ALAS在多种设置下表现出强且稳健的性能。

papers.title: Position: The Inevitable Transition to Machine Learning in Quantum Chemistry
papers.abstract_en: Finding exact solutions to the quantum many-body problem is computationally intractable (QMA-hard). Traditional approximations for electrons in an atom or molecule -- density functional theory and wavefunction methods -- have been indispensable, but their development shows signs of saturation: DFT functionals have proliferated without converging toward the exact functional, and strong correlation remains largely unsolved after decades of effort. This position paper argues that machine learning represents the most promising path forward -- not as a proof of logical necessity, but as a decision-theoretic argument: ML succeeds whether the underlying problems are truly hard or merely lack simple analytical solutions. We reframe recent traditional method development as ``hand-crafted machine learning'' that has exhausted the hypothesis space accessible to human intuition. Significant challenges remain, but these have clear research paths forward, unlike the fundamental barriers facing traditional approaches. ML-based approaches merit strategic priority in quantum chemistry's next phase.
papers.comment: Accepted as a position paper at ICML 2026. OpenReview forum: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Mq1oTEIwp4
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证机器学习在量子化学中的必然性，认为传统方法（如DFT和波函数方法）已渐趋饱和，而机器学习能突破人类直觉假设空间的局限。尽管存在挑战，但ML路径比传统方法更有前景。
Motivation: 量子多体问题计算困难（QMA-hard），传统近似方法发展饱和，DFT泛函虽多但未趋近精确泛函，强关联问题数十年未解。
Method: 提出决策论观点：无论底层问题真实困难与否，机器学习都能有效应对，并将传统方法进步重新解释为'手工机器学习'。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果，主要基于理论论证。

papers.title: Beyond Single-Dimensional Compression: The Compound Sparsity Frontier of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are often compressed through static parameter pruning or dynamic token-level computation, yet aggressive sparsification can trigger rapid performance degradation beyond an essential sparsity boundary. This work asks \emph{whether combining these two mechanisms can delay such degradation by distributing the compression burden}. We study a minimalist compound sparsity framework that first applies low-rank approximation and channel pruning to obtain a statically compressed backbone, and then introduces lightweight routers for per-token dynamic layer skipping. This design enables independent control of parameter sparsity and token-level computation sparsity. Experiments across language understanding and modeling benchmarks show that compound sparsity consistently outperforms single-mechanism compression under the same total sparsity, delaying the decay point on understanding tasks and preserving stronger modeling performance. Further analysis reveals cross-dimensional interference between parameter pruning and token skipping, and shows that near-balanced allocation is most effective under a fixed sparsity budget. These results demonstrate that compound compression provides a practical way to improve LLM compression, while revealing a broader cross-dimensional sparsity boundary that ultimately limits further compression. Code will be available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）压缩中结合静态参数剪枝和动态token级层跳过的复合稀疏性方法。通过低秩近似、通道剪枝获得静态压缩骨干，再引入轻量路由器实现逐token动态层跳过，在相同总稀疏度下，复合压缩优于单一压缩机制。实验在语言理解和建模基准上验证了其效果，并揭示了参数剪枝与token跳过的跨维度干扰，近平衡分配效果最佳。
Motivation: 现有LLM压缩通常单独使用静态参数剪枝或动态token计算，但两者各自存在稀疏性边界，导致性能快速退化。本文探索组合两种机制是否能通过分散压缩负担来延缓退化。
Method: 提出一个最小化复合稀疏框架：先通过低秩近似和通道剪枝获得静态压缩骨干，再引入轻量路由器实现逐token动态层跳过，从而独立控制参数稀疏度和token级计算稀疏度。
Result: 在语言理解和建模基准上，复合压缩在相同总稀疏度下持续优于单一压缩，推迟理解任务的衰减点并保持更强的建模性能；分析表明参数剪枝与token跳过存在跨维度干扰，且近平衡分配在固定稀疏预算下最有效。
Conclusion: 复合压缩提供了改进LLM压缩的实用方法，同时揭示了跨维度稀疏性边界最终限制了进一步压缩。

papers.title: Beyond Output-Space Calibration: Spectral Evidence Bundling for Selective Reliability Estimation in Time-Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc calibration for time-series classification usually remaps output scores, but deployment decisions such as trust, abstention, and review depend on whether a confident prediction is supported by the current temporal signal. We address three time-series reliability gaps: identical confidence values can hide different temporal support, average calibration can miss false high-confidence errors, and output-space recalibration offers limited input-linked auditability. We introduce a validation-gated fixed-label reliability policy that keeps the backbone prediction unchanged while estimating whether it should be trusted. The method combines output-side cues with whole-sample spectral descriptors, including band energy, entropy, peak dominance, period support, and phase stability, to form a scalar reliability estimate and diagnostic band-level evidence. A validation gate enables spectral conditioning only when correctness ranking improves without breaching FalseConf@0.9 or AURC tolerances; otherwise it reverts to the safer output-space baseline. Across eight heterogeneous UCR/UEA datasets, eight time-series backbone families, and standard recalibrators, the unconstrained method improves fixed-label selective-reliability metrics on the matched evaluation subset, raising Corr-AURC from 0.693 to 0.779. The validation-gated policy further improves Corr-AURC to 0.786 and reduces FalseConf@0.9 to 0.094. These results suggest that reliability estimation for time-series classifiers benefits from bundling output confidence with spectral evidence, while validation gating prevents unsupported spectral conditioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列分类中后处理校准无法反映时间信号支持的问题，提出了结合输出置信度与整体样本频谱描述符（如频带能量、熵、峰值主导性、周期支持和相位稳定性）的可靠性估计方法。通过验证门控机制，仅在正确率排序提升且不违反FalseConf@0.9或AURC容忍度时启用频谱条件，否则回退到输出空间基线。在8个UCR/UEA数据集、8种时间序列骨干网络和标准校准器上，该方法将Corr-AURC从0.693提升至0.786，并将FalseConf@0.9降至0.094。
Motivation: 现有时间序列分类的后处理校准无法区分相同置信度下不同的时间信号支持，平均校准可能掩盖错误的高置信度预测，且输出空间重新校准缺乏输入相关的可审计性。
Method: 提出验证门控的固定标签可靠性策略：保持骨干网络预测不变，结合输出侧提示与整个样本的频谱描述符（频带能量、熵、峰值主导性、周期支持、相位稳定性）形成标量可靠性估计和诊断级频谱证据。通过验证门控，仅在正确率排序提升且不违反FalseConf@0.9或AURC容忍度时启用频谱条件，否则回退到输出空间基线。
Result: 在8个UCR/UEA数据集、8种时间序列骨干网络和标准校准器上，无约束方法将Corr-AURC从0.693提升至0.779；验证门控策略进一步将Corr-AURC提升至0.786，并将FalseConf@0.9降至0.094。
Conclusion: 时间序列分类器的可靠性估计受益于将输出置信度与频谱证据捆绑，而验证门控可防止无支持的频谱条件介入。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: FALCON-Discover: Discovering Concentrated False-Confidence Regions for Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Calibration is usually evaluated in aggregate, but the most dangerous failures are often local: predictions that remain highly confident despite being wrong. We study this failure mode as false-confidence concentration, the extent to which confident errors occupy compact, discoverable regions of prediction space. We introduce FALCON-Discover, a post-hoc, model-agnostic framework that ranks predictions using discrepancy signals from confidence, local support, neighborhood agreement, and perturbation stability. Across seven binary tabular datasets, four seeds, five-fold cross-fitting, and strong learners including XGBoost and CatBoost, we find that false-confidence concentration is recurrent but regime-dependent. At the main confidence threshold, discrepancy-based ranking substantially outperforms the strongest validation-selected calibration or trust-scoring baseline in the strongest regimes, while raw confidence recovers little dangerous-error mass. The best detector varies across datasets: learned discrepancy is strongest when multiple cues must be combined, whereas stability-centered ranking works best when local decisional fragility dominates. These results show that dangerous overconfidence is better treated as a family-level discovery problem than as a single-score calibration problem, and motivate calibration strategies that explicitly target regions where confidence, support, and stability diverge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FALCON-Discover框架，用于检测分类器中局部且高度自信的错误（假信度集中）。通过置信度、局部支持、邻域一致性和扰动稳定性等差异信号对预测进行排序，在七个二分类表格数据集上发现假信度集中现象普遍存在但依赖数据分布。基于差异的排序在强验证场景下显著优于校准或信任分数基线。
Motivation: 传统校准评价关注全局聚合指标，但最危险的错误往往是局部性的：预测高度自信却错误。这类错误在预测空间中形成紧凑的可发现区域，现有方法未能有效定位。
Method: 提出后处理、模型无关的FALCON-Discover框架，利用置信度、局部支持、邻域一致性和扰动稳定性四个差异信号对预测进行排序，识别假信度集中区域。
Result: 在七个二分类表格数据集上（含XGBoost和CatBoost强学习器），采用四种子样本和五折交叉拟合，发现基于差异的排序在主要置信阈值下显著优于最强的验证选择校准或信任分数基线，而原始置信度几乎无法捕获危险错误。最佳检测器因数据集而异：学习到的差异在需组合多线索时最强，稳定性排序在局部决策脆弱性主导时最佳。
Conclusion: 危险过度自信应视为一个家族级别的发现问题（family-level discovery problem）而非单一分数校准问题，需针对置信度、支持度和稳定性分化的区域设计专门的校准策略。

papers.title: A Calculus of Discernment: Decision-Relevant Insight, Sequence Value, and Forgetting as Higher-Order Learning
papers.abstract_en: In a world of generative AI, candidate insights are abundant; what is scarce is the capacity to discern which matter, to act on them in the right amount and order, and to forget the rest so the system can adapt. We argue these scarcities are governed by one object and build a framework around it. We define an insight strictly as a lever with an identified, measurable effect on an objective, and rank candidates by decision-relevance via the expected value of information rather than novelty. We show action carries an order, not only a size: under realistic belief dynamics, content "touches" are non-commuting operators, so a fixed plan delivered in different orders yields different outcomes, defining a sequence premium. We observe that the value of any lever is a shadow price, unifying pharmaceutical marketing, equity selection, and manufacturing as one leverage-discovery problem. Most speculatively, we propose APOHA, a theory in which forgetting is not the disposal of knowledge but the operator by which value is learned: the value of a retained item is the counterfactual cost of forgetting it, a learning system is the residue of maximal forgetting subject to preserved value, and higher-order value is the structure that survives repeated forgetting (a renormalisation-relevant invariant), with consolidation as its conjugate. We state the central open problem (a non-trivial attractor with a spectral gap) and test the forgetting theory: operationalising APOHA as an agent on a non-stationary obesity-treatment decision world over 30 seeds, adaptive forgetting cut cumulative decision-regret by 24-32% against never-forget and a fixed half-life, kept a ~6x smaller, cleaner memory, and converged stably; notably, blind forgetting was worse than never forgetting, so the benefit is specific to value-aware forgetting. A multi-disciplinary critique stress-tests the whole.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Includes a pre-registered empirical study (30 seeds x 100 iterations) and a reference implementation; a companion interactive demo is available from the author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个关于决策相关洞察、序列价值和遗忘作为高阶学习的理论框架。定义洞察为对目标有可测量影响的杠杆，通过期望信息价值而非新颖性排序。证明行动顺序影响结果，提出遗忘不是知识丢弃而是价值学习算子的APOHA理论，并在非平稳肥胖治疗决策环境中验证自适应遗忘可降低24-32%的累积决策遗憾。
Motivation: 生成式AI时代洞察丰富，但辨别哪些重要、以正确顺序和数量行动以及遗忘其余以保持系统适应性的能力稀缺。现有框架缺乏对这些稀缺性的统一处理。
Method: 构建基于决策相关性的洞察排序框架，定义洞察为有可测量影响的杠杆，通过期望信息价值排序。提出APOHA理论：遗忘是价值学习算子，保留项的价值是遗忘它的反事实成本，学习系统是遗忘的残差。在非平稳肥胖治疗决策环境进行30种子实验验证。
Result: 自适应遗忘在非平稳决策环境中比从不遗忘和固定半衰期遗忘减少24-32%的累积决策遗憾，保持约6倍小且更干净的记忆，并稳定收敛；盲目遗忘比从不遗忘更差，证明收益来自价值感知遗忘。
Conclusion: 遗忘应是价值感知而非盲目，APOHA理论将遗忘视为高阶学习算子，提出中心开放问题（具有谱间隙的非平凡吸引子）。论文包括多学科批判性压力测试。

papers.title: Domain Design for the Cops and Robbers Problem
papers.abstract_en: Cops and Robbers is a well-studied problem in graph theory. The setting consists of a robber and one or more cops placed on an undirected graph. Taking turns moving throughout the graph, the cops try to capture the robber. The property of interest is whether $k$ cops suffice to ensure at least one cop occupies the same vertex as the robber, after a finite number of turns, given any configuration of their initial placement; if successful, the graph is referred to as ``$k$-copwin''. In this work, we cast the problem of determining whether a graph is $k$-copwin as a non-deterministic planning problem and use state-of-the-art planners to compute this property. The cop movement is cast as non-deterministic movement (to capture all possible strategies), while the robber movement is deterministic in nature. We also extend the base model using several variations from the graph theory literature.

papers.title: Market Strategy Evaluation for Prosumers in Local Electricity Markets
papers.abstract_en: Prosumers equipped with distributed generation and flexible loads form autonomous cyber-physical energy systems that control local resources and participate in local energy markets with minimal human intervention. This work develops and evaluates an agent-based simulation platform in which agents, representing prosumer households with photovoltaic systems, battery storage systems, electric vehicles, and heat pumps, participate in a uniform-price double-sided call auction. The effect of individual bidding strategies on community-level efficiency and prosumer-level financial outcomes is incompletely understood, particularly when prosumers with heterogeneous portfolios interact in one market. Four market strategies of increasing complexity are compared: a zero-intelligence constrained baseline, a boundary-price strategy, an extended storage cascade, and a market-adaptive pricing strategy. The simulation is conducted on a community of 33 prosumers at 15-minute resolution, spanning summer, winter, and spring to characterize seasonal variation. Results show that rule-based resource control substantially reduces community energy expenditure: the extended storage cascade achieves a total cost of 39.06 EUR compared to 62.38 EUR under the zero-intelligence baseline, a reduction of 37.4 %. The market-adaptive strategy yields the highest aggregate community financial gain through local energy market participation (14.40 EUR vs. 10.28 EUR for the baseline, a gain of 40.1 %) under summer conditions. Strategy effectiveness depends on both portfolio composition and seasonal supply conditions, requiring joint evaluation of resource control and pricing decisions.

TL;DR: 论文开发了一个基于智能体的仿真平台，模拟配备光伏、电池、电动汽车和热泵的产消者（prosumers）在统一价格双向叫拍市场中的交易行为；比较了四种报价策略（零智能约束基线、边界价格策略、扩展储能级联、市场自适应定价策略）对社区效率和产消者财务结果的影响。结果显示扩展储能级联可将总成本从62.38欧元降至39.06欧元（降幅37.4%），而市场自适应策略在夏季条件下实现最高社区总收益（14.40欧元对比基线的10.28欧元，增幅40.1%）。策略有效性取决于投资组合组成和季节性供应条件。
Motivation: 现有研究对拥有异构资产组合的产消者在本地电力市场中的个体报价策略如何影响社区效率和个体财务结果理解不足。
Method: 构建基于智能体的仿真平台，产消者代理参与统一价格双向叫拍拍卖；对比四种复杂度递增的策略：零智能约束基线、边界价格策略、扩展储能级联、市场自适应定价策略。在33个产消者的社区内以15分钟分辨率模拟夏季、冬季和春季场景。
Result: 扩展储能级联策略使总成本从62.38欧元降至39.06欧元（降幅37.4%）；市场自适应策略在夏季条件下使社区总收益从10.28欧元提升至14.40欧元（增幅40.1%）。

papers.title: Using LLMs for Explainable, Data-Driven Insight Generation from Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasts are widely used in decision-critical domains, where they are rarely consumed without accompanying explanations. Producing such explanations is usually a manual and costly process, and attempts to automate it using large language models often suffer from hallucination when applied to temporal data. We propose a domain-agnostic framework for grounded natural language explanation generation for time series forecasts, illustrated in Figure 1. The framework consists of three components: (i) extraction of structured explanatory factors from historical analyst-written explanations, (ii) evidence-conditioned explanation generation, and (iii) scalable evaluation for readability, logical consistency, and persuasiveness. The design explicitly constrains generation to verifiable evidence, reducing unsupported claims. We evaluate the framework on a financial forecasting case study involving the NASDAQ-100 index and a freight pricing case study using data from Vortexa. Results show that generated explanations approached analyst-written explanations in terms of readability, consistency and persuasiveness. These findings demonstrate that grounded explanation generation for time series forecasting can be achieved at scale without domain-specific fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个与领域无关的框架，利用大语言模型从时间序列预测中生成基于证据的自然语言解释。框架包括三个组件：从历史分析师解释中提取结构化解释因子、基于证据的条件生成、以及可扩展的评估方法。在NASDAQ-100指数和Vortexa货运定价两个案例上，生成的解释在可读性、一致性和说服力上接近分析师撰写的解释。
Motivation: 时间序列预测的解释通常依赖昂贵的人工过程，自动化方法常因幻觉问题而不准确。本文旨在构建一个可扩展的、基于证据的解释生成框架，避免大语言模型在时间序列数据上的不实生成。
Method: 提出一个三组件框架：1）从历史分析师解释中提取结构化解释因子；2）基于证据条件生成解释；3）用可读性、逻辑一致性和说服力进行可扩展评估。设计上强制生成必须基于可验证证据。
Result: 在NASDAQ-100指数金融预测和Vortexa货运定价两个案例中，生成的解释在可读性、一致性和说服力上接近分析师撰写的解释，表明该框架无需领域特定微调即可规模化实现。
Conclusion: 该框架证明无需领域特定微调即可为时间序列预测生成基于证据的可解释解释，适用于多种决策关键领域。

papers.title: Trajectory-Aware Clinical Risk Prediction via Severity-Grounded Knowledge Graphs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: While Electronic Health Records (EHRs) offer a wealth of clinical data, effectively augmenting a patient's records with heterogeneous external knowledge to predict the patient's clinical risk remains a significant challenge. Existing methods fail to capture disease severity, treatment responses, and nuanced clinical progression, due to data sparsity and the underutilization of unstructured clinical notes. To address these challenges, we propose TRACER (a trajectory-aware and clinically grounded prediction framework) that (1) constructs a medical knowledge graph enriched with severity information from medical literature, (2) retrieves clinically relevant, severity-weighted paths of a patient's progression from the knowledge graph, (3) extracts clinically relevant events from unstructured clinical notes, and (4) augments patient context with similar peer cases. Experiments on the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets demonstrate large gains over state-of-the-art baselines, with up to 28.5% increase in Macro F1 score for the mortality prediction task, and 19.7% increase for the readmission prediction task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRACER框架，通过构建融合严重程度信息的医学知识图谱，检索患者进展的严重性加权路径，从非结构化临床笔记中提取事件，并利用相似病例增强患者上下文，用于轨迹感知的临床风险预测。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上，死亡率预测的Macro F1提升最高达28.5%，再入院预测提升19.7%。
Motivation: 现有方法未能有效捕获疾病严重程度、治疗反应和临床进展的细微变化，数据稀疏且未充分利用非结构化临床笔记。
Method: TRACER框架包含四个步骤：构建含严重程度知识的医学知识图谱、检索严重性加权的患者进展路径、从非结构化笔记中提取临床相关事件、以及用相似病例增强患者上下文。
Result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上，死亡率预测的Macro F1提升28.5%，再入院预测提升19.7%，均超过现有最优基线。
Conclusion: TRACER通过融合严重程度知识和非结构化数据显著提升了临床风险预测性能。

papers.title: Wisdom of LLM Crowds: Aggregation and Contamination in Language Model Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: The wisdom of crowds -- the finding that aggregating judgments across individuals often outperforms the best individual -- has been extensively studied with human forecasters. Whether the same phenomenon emerges when the ``crowd'' consists of large language models (LLMs) is an open question with both theoretical and practical implications. We elicited probability estimates from 15 LLMs on 254 binary prediction market questions and evaluated classical and learned aggregation methods. Learned aggregators -- a multilayer perceptron and a logistic regression -- outperformed all individual models and classical methods. The logistic regression was found to match the neural network, suggesting that the benefit of learned aggregation derives from learning a linear combination of diverse model outputs rather than from nonlinear interactions. Symbolic regression applied to the neural network's learned mapping recovered a pure model-disagreement signal as the lowest-complexity useful formula on the Pareto frontier, further supporting this interpretation. Training cutoff contamination proved a pervasive confound: the apparent capability gap between frontier cloud models and smaller local models collapsed from 35.8% to 8.9% on a clean subset of questions resolving after all models' training cutoffs, and individual model rankings showed only moderate stability. Even when the prediction market is evaluated at each model's training cutoff, LLMs remained substantially less accurate, indicating a genuine gap in collective information aggregation. These findings suggest that LLM crowds can exhibit wisdom-of-crowds effects, but that contamination-free evaluation is essential for reliable assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究了大语言模型（LLM）群体智慧现象，即聚合多个LLM的判断是否优于单个最佳模型。通过在254个二元预测市场问题上收集15个LLM的概率估计，发现学习型聚合方法（如多层感知机和逻辑回归）优于所有单个模型和经典聚合方法，其中逻辑回归与神经网络性能相当，表明收益主要来自线性组合而非非线性交互。符号回归进一步揭示模型分歧信号是最优简化公式。此外，训练数据污染是一个普遍混淆因素：在干净子集上，前沿云模型与小模型的差距从35.8%缩小到8.9%，且模型排名不稳定。即使考虑训练截止日期，LLM仍欠准确，表明集体信息聚合存在实质性差距。
Motivation: 人类群体智慧现象已被广泛研究，但LLM是否表现出类似特性仍是开放问题，这对理论和实践都有重要意义。
Method: 收集15个LLM在254个二元预测市场问题上的概率估计，并评估经典聚合方法（如平均）与学习型聚合方法（多层感知机、逻辑回归），以及应用符号回归分析神经网络所学映射。
Result: 学习型聚合方法（逻辑回归和多层感知机）优于所有单个模型和经典方法；逻辑回归与神经网络性能匹配，表明收益来自线性组合。符号回归发现模型分歧信号是最优简化公式。训练污染使云模型与小模型差距从35.8%降至8.9%，且排名不稳定。即使在训练截止日期后，LLM仍欠准确。
Conclusion: LLM群体可以展现群体智慧效应，但无污染评估对可靠评估至关重要。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Fence: Specialized SLM Guardrails for LLM Applications
papers.abstract_en: Real-world applications that use closed-source large language models (LLMs) need advanced safety measures that go beyond the basic content filters. Content moderation filters such as toxicity and bias have relatively standard definitions where as application specific guardrails like hallucination, topic drift and behaviour deviation are more difficult to model and can vary by use case. Additionally, data scarcity and annotation costs, make the process of creating and testing specialized guardrails challenging. In this work, we propose using Small Language Models (SLMs) trained on synthetic data as specialized guardrails for LLM applications. We introduce a novel synthetic data generation method inspired by the design of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to generate high quality synthetic data samples which can be used to train SLMs to encode use case specific guardrail information and hence function as specialized guardrails. Our experiments demonstrate that SLM guardrails trained on high quality synthetic data show performance gains over prompt based LLM guardrails.

papers.title: The Economics of Autonomy: Real-Time Risk Indexing for Insurable AI-Driven 6G Systems
papers.abstract_en: The transition to sixth-generation (6G) networks transforms wireless infrastructure into a cognitive substrate supporting Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X), Industrial IoT (IIoT), and Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC). In this paradigm, autonomous agentic AI performs orchestration at millisecond scales, rendering traditional static governance frameworks fundamentally inadequate for risk management. This paper introduces GIRAF(Governance-Integrated Risk and Assurance Framework), a Governance-as-Code (GaC) framework for real-time risk quantification and trust modulation in agentic 6G systems. GIRAF derives a continuous Aggregate Risk Index ($R_{t}$) from machine-readable runtime signals, including epistemic confidence, network jitter, and verification latency. A core contribution is the formalization of the verification staleness trade-off, where safety mechanisms induce risk if computational latency exceeds 6G deadlines. We demonstrate that GIRAF identifies 'Confidence Gaps' discrepancies between agent reported certainty and environmental ground truth, triggering automated safety envelopes when conditions deteriorate. Crucially, GIRAF serves as the foundational governance groundwork and conceptual 'glue' that externalizes these technical risks into machine-readable telemetry. Through simulations with fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs), we validate that the framework preserves operational integrity while providing the essential actuarial baseline required for multi-stakeholder liability attribution and dynamic premium quantification in the 6G ecosystem.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IEEE 104th Vehicular Technology Conference - VTC2026-Fall
papers.summary_zh:

Result: 模拟实验表明，GIRAF能够保持运营完整性，并生成支持保险精算和动态保费的基线。

papers.title: Structured Synthetic Reasoning Data for Arithmetic Fine-Tuning of Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Small language models are attractive for local deployment, but they often struggle with multi-step arithmetic reasoning. We study whether structured synthetic reasoning data can improve this behaviour under consumer-hardware constraints. Starting from GSM8K, we generated a 21,250-example corpus of grade-school arithmetic word-problem variants using GPT-5-mini, combining natural-language solution traces, light Socratic-style cues, structural variation, and irrelevant distractor context. We then fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B with LoRA on consumer hardware (Apple M4, 16 GB RAM). Exact-match accuracy on GSM8K improved from 36.5% to 49.1% for Qwen3-0.6B and from 53.5% to 66.5% for Qwen3-1.7B. For Qwen3-1.7B, transfer to related arithmetic benchmarks was stronger, reaching 98.9% on MultiArith and 73.0% on SVAMP, compared with 54.4% and 45.3% for the base model. Qualitative analysis suggests that fine-tuned models produce shorter reasoning traces, make fewer arithmetic and distractor-use errors, and benefit more consistently from self-consistency sampling. These results show that low-cost synthetic data design can materially improve arithmetic adaptation in small language models. Because the intervention combines Socratic-style cues with other data-design choices, we interpret the gains as evidence for structured synthetic reasoning data rather than as a causal test of Socratic guidance alone.

TL;DR: 本文研究在消费级硬件约束下，使用结构化合成推理数据微调小语言模型以提升其多步算术推理能力。基于GSM8K生成21,250条包含自然语言解题轨迹、苏格拉底式提示、结构变化和无关干扰上下文的数学应用题变体，在Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-1.7B上用LoRA微调。GSM8K精确匹配准确率分别从36.5%提升至49.1%和53.5%提升至66.5%，并在MultiArith和SVAMP上取得更强迁移效果。定性分析表明微调模型推理轨迹更短、算术和干扰处理错误更少。
Motivation: 小语言模型在本地部署中具有吸引力，但常难以进行多步算术推理。
Method: 从GSM8K出发，使用GPT-5-mini生成21,250条包含自然语言解题轨迹、苏格拉底式线索、结构变化和无关干扰上下文的算术应用题变体，然后在消费级硬件（Apple M4, 16 GB RAM）上对Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-1.7B进行LoRA微调。
Result: GSM8K精确匹配准确率：Qwen3-0.6B从36.5%提升至49.1%，Qwen3-1.7B从53.5%提升至66.5%。Qwen3-1.7B在MultiArith上达98.9%，在SVAMP上达73.0%，而基础模型分别为54.4%和45.3%。微调模型推理轨迹更短，算术和干扰处理错误更少，自一致性采样收益更一致。
Conclusion: 低成本的合成数据设计能够实质性改善小语言模型的算术适应能力，且收益源于结构化合成推理数据而非单一苏格拉底式引导。

papers.title: State Compression in Two-Agent LLM Relays: A Closed-World Study of Constraint Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Long-running Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents often accumulate large intermediate traces containing audits, eliminations, and numeric calculations. In practice, this state is compressed before handing it to a downstream decision step, creating an information bottleneck in which small omissions can break strict numeric or categorical constraints. This paper evaluates hand-off compression in a closed-world travel-planning relay with two LLM agents. A Researcher audits a fixed inventory of hotels and flights for 50 goal instances, and a Booker selects a hotel--flight pair using only the goal and the hand-off payload, with the inventory withheld. We compare four hand-off conditions: no compression, narrative summarization, schema-constrained JSON extraction, and embedding-based pruning. Exhaustive enumeration over the fixed inventory provides exact feasible and optimal labels. Results show that hand-off representation strongly affects downstream feasibility under a small decision model. JSON extraction achieves the highest feasibility accuracy at 0.96, while narrative summarization, despite producing the smallest compressed hand-off payload, degrades feasibility to 0.48. Embedding-based pruning matches the uncompressed control on feasibility at 0.88 without an additional generative compression call. These findings indicate that constraint checking benefits from structured and auditable hand-off representations rather than relying on brevity alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在封闭世界的旅行规划场景中，研究了两个LLM智能体（Researcher和Booker）之间的交接压缩对约束保持的影响。通过对比四种压缩条件（无压缩、叙述性摘要、基于模式的JSON提取、基于嵌入的剪枝），发现JSON提取在可行性准确率上达到0.96，而叙述性摘要虽压缩率最高但可行性降为0.48。结论表明，结构化且可审计的交接表示比单纯追求简洁更有利于约束检查。
Motivation: 长期运行的LLM智能体会积累大量中间状态，压缩后传递给下游决策步骤可能造成信息瓶颈，导致严格数值或分类约束被违反。现有研究缺乏对交接压缩如何影响约束保持的系统评估。
Method: 设计了一个双智能体旅行规划中继实验：Researcher审计固定库存的酒店和航班，Booker仅根据目标和交接载荷选择酒店-航班对。比较四种交接条件：无压缩、叙述性摘要、模式约束JSON提取、基于嵌入的剪枝。使用穷举枚举获得准确的可行和最优标签。
Result: JSON提取的可行性准确率最高（0.96），叙述性摘要最低（0.48）。基于嵌入的剪枝在可行性上与无压缩控制组相当（0.88），且无需额外生成式压缩调用。
Conclusion: 约束检查受益于结构化且可审计的交接表示，而非单纯追求载荷精简。

papers.title: MUX: Continuous Reasoning via Multiplexed Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Language models solve complex problems by articulating intermediate reasoning steps in natural language. While effective, this process is computationally bottlenecked: each reasoning step conveys only a single subword, and many are spent expressing a thought instead of carrying out computation. We propose MUX, a simple method for high-bandwidth and compact reasoning based on distillation of discrete reasoning into continuous multiplexed tokens in a latent space. Here, each latent token is trained to represent a weighted linear superposition (multiplexing) of a span of discrete reasoning subwords, where this superposition is lossless by construction and the span can be fully recovered (demultiplexing). We prove that simple position-dependent weightings, such as suitable geometric decay, support lossless multiplexing, which in turn prevents shortcut behaviors caused by latent collapse. We further show that multiplexed reasoning can perform parallel exploration in problems that require search. Across 32 evaluation settings spanning four language models, MUX outperforms strong latent reasoning baselines. Ablation and probing analyses further show that the learned latent tokens encode faithful and interpretable reasoning. Our results suggest that lossless superposition as local learning targets constitutes a sufficient condition for achieving strong and efficient latent continuous reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MUX 方法，将离散推理步骤蒸馏为连续的多路复用 (multiplexed) 潜在 token，每个潜在 token 编码一段离散推理子词的加权线性叠加，且这种叠加在构造上是无损的，可完全恢复。作者证明简单的位置依赖权重（如几何衰减）支持无损多路复用，从而防止潜在坍缩导致的捷径行为；进一步展示多路复用推理可在需要搜索的问题中并行探索。在 32 个评估设置上，MUX 优于强潜在推理基线，消融和探针分析表明学习到的潜在 token 编码了忠实且可解释的推理过程。
Motivation: 语言模型通过自然语言中间推理步骤解决问题，但每个推理步骤仅编码一个子词，许多步骤用于表达思想而非执行计算，造成计算瓶颈。
Method: 提出 MUX，将离散推理蒸馏为连续潜在空间中的多路复用 token，每个潜在 token 训练表示一段离散推理子词的加权线性叠加，通过位置依赖权重实现无损多路复用（可完全解复用）。
Result: 在 32 个评估设置、四种语言模型上，MUX 优于强潜在推理基线；消融和探针分析表明潜在 token 编码了忠实且可解释的推理。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，作为局部学习目标的无损叠加是实现强且高效的潜在连续推理的充分条件。

papers.title: Position: AI/ML Deepfake Research is Misaligned with AI-Generated Non-Consensual Intimate Imagery (AIG-NCII)
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated non-consensual intimate imagery (AIG-NCII) is not adequately addressed in AI/ML literature regarding AI-generated media, commonly referred to as "deepfakes". While research on deepfakes currently focuses on its epistemic harms -- or harms relating to truth and authenticity -- this is misaligned with the dominant reality of generative AI abuse involving sexualized imagery. We conduct a landscape analysis of highly-cited works to demonstrate that technical interventions addressing deepfakes almost entirely ignore AIG-NCII, limiting the research ecosystem to authenticity detection tools. In this position paper, we argue that existing interventions address viewer-centric epistemic harms, such as fraud or scams, but ignore subject-centric dignity harms, such as AIG-NCII. We illustrate that knowing an image is synthetic does not mitigate harms to subjects and may, in some cases, even exacerbate them. We conclude by offering recommendations to realign the field, including updating threat models to consider subject-centric harms and addressing AIG-NCII in AI safety research. Finally, we caution that researchers should only engage in this high-risk domain if they implement safety guardrails for both subjects and researchers and establish partnerships with domain experts in sexual violence prevention.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出AI/ML领域的深度伪造（deepfake）研究严重忽视了AI生成的非自愿亲密图像（AIG-NCII）问题。通过分析高引文献，发现现有技术干预几乎只关注认识论伤害（如欺诈），而忽略了主体尊严伤害（如色情滥用），且单纯识别图像真伪无助于减轻受害者的伤害，甚至可能加剧。最后提出重新调整研究方向的建议，包括更新威胁模型、将AIG-NCII纳入AI安全研究，并强调需与性暴力预防专家合作。
Motivation: 现有深度伪造研究主要关注认识论伤害（如虚假信息、欺诈），但实际生成式AI滥用中，性化图像（AIG-NCII）占主导，技术干预却几乎完全忽略这一方向，导致研究生态与真实需求脱节。
Method: 采用文献景观分析（landscape analysis），检查高被引深度伪造研究，评估其是否涉及AIG-NCII；并基于论证提出研究范式转变的必要性。
Result: 发现几乎所有高被引深度伪造技术工作都无视AIG-NCII，专注于检测工具而非受害者的尊严伤害；仅知道图像是合成的并不能缓解主体伤害。
Conclusion: 呼吁AI/ML社区将研究重心从认识论伤害转向主体尊严伤害，更新威胁模型，将AIG-NCII纳入AI安全研究，并在高风险领域建立安全护栏和跨学科合作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProbSPARQL: Querying Knowledge Graphs with Multi-dimensional, Uncertain Numeric Data
papers.abstract_en: The SFB 1574 Circular Factory is building a shared knowledge graph infrastructure for integrating data about returned products. A central challenge is that circular-factory data include numeric measurements that (i) originate from sensors or are derived from sensor-based measurements, (ii) are frequently multi-dimensional, and (iii) are inherently uncertain, while downstream triage, validation, reliability-modeling, and reassembly-planning modules require queryable uncertainty representations. Current RDF and SPARQL technologies lack native support for harmonized querying and analysis of such uncertain numeric measurement data. To address this gap, we present ProbSPARQL, an upward-compatible SPARQL extension developed as an early-stage query-layer pilot for this infrastructure. ProbSPARQL models uncertain numeric values as random variables whose distributions are encoded by probabilistic RDF literal datatypes, and supports distribution-aware expressions, probabilistic filters, and divergence-based joins. We implement ProbSPARQL on Apache Jena ARQ and expose it through a Fuseki-compatible execution layer. We assess real-data applicability using project-derived measurement fragments covering GMM-encoded uncertainty and histogram-based empirical roughness distributions, and evaluate scalability separately on controlled ontology-conformant benchmarks with up to 5,000 angle-grinder instances and 1.5M triples. The results show feasible in-engine execution, filter-pushdown speedups over application-layer post-processing, and latency-accuracy trade-offs among divergence-join decision strategies.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Preprint. Supplementary material and reproducibility artifacts are available online
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProbSPARQL，一种向上兼容的 SPARQL 扩展，用于查询包含多维、不确定数值数据的知识图谱。它将不确定数值建模为随机变量，通过概率 RDF 字面量类型编码分布，支持分布感知表达式、概率过滤和基于散度的连接。在 Apache Jena ARQ 上实现，并通过 Fuseki 兼容执行层暴露。使用循环工厂项目中的实际测量片段和受控基准测试评估，展示了可接受的引擎内执行性能、过滤器下推加速以及散度连接决策策略的延迟-精度权衡。
Motivation: 当前 RDF 和 SPARQL 技术缺乏对不确定数值测量数据（如传感器数据）的原生支持，而循环工厂中的下游模块需要可查询的不确定性表示。
Method: 提出 ProbSPARQL，扩展 SPARQL 以支持将不确定数值建模为随机变量，使用概率 RDF 字面量类型编码分布，并引入分布感知表达式、概率过滤和基于散度的连接。在 Apache Jena ARQ 上实现。
Result: 在项目衍生的测量片段（包含 GMM 编码的不确定性和直方图经验粗糙度分布）和受控基准测试（最多 5,000 个角磨机实例和 150 万三元组）上评估，结果表明引擎内执行可行，过滤器下推比应用层后处理有加速，散度连接决策策略存在延迟-精度权衡。
Conclusion: ProbSPARQL 能够在不牺牲 SPARQL 兼容性的前提下，处理知识图谱中的多维不确定数值数据，并具有可行的执行性能。摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When JSON Is Not Enough: Semantic Reliability of Schema-Constrained LLM Ordering Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly used as transaction compilers: a user states an intent in natural language, and the model emits a structured object that an API can execute. JSON Schema and provider-level structured-output modes are useful because they remove a large class of parse failures, but they do not by themselves decide whether the object is a safe, faithful transaction. We introduce OrderBench, a deterministic benchmark for restaurant ordering agents that separates syntactic validity, schema validity, status decisions, exact item semantics, constraint preservation, and unsafe acceptances. Across 2,400 Nebius Token Factory calls to four open models in prompt-only and JSON-schema modes, we find that schema-valid output can still have large semantic error rates. In the strongest model, both modes achieve 100% schema validity, yet semantic success remains near 80%; in weaker models, schema-valid unsafe acceptances occur in double digits. The result is a concrete engineering warning: structured output is a necessary interface layer, not a substitute for domain verification and fail-closed execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OrderBench基准测试，用于评估LLM在餐厅点单场景下作为交易编译器的语义可靠性。实验发现，即使输出符合JSON Schema，语义错误率仍然很高，强模型的语义成功率仅约80%，弱模型则出现两位数的不安全接受。作者警告：结构化输出只是必要接口，不能替代领域验证和故障关闭执行。
Motivation: LLM agent常被用作交易编译器，但仅保证JSON Schema有效无法确保交易安全和语义正确。现有研究缺乏针对语义可靠性的系统评估。
Method: 设计了OrderBench确定性基准，包含语法有效性、模式有效性、状态决策、精确语义、约束保持和不安全接受等维度。通过对四个开放模型在纯提示和JSON模式下的2400次调用进行对比。
Result: 强模型两种模式均达100%模式有效性，但语义成功率接近80%；弱模型中模式有效的不安全接受率出现两位数。
Conclusion: 结构化输出是必要的接口层，但不能替代领域验证和故障关闭执行。本文提供了具体的工程警告。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FindStatBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Combinatorial Code Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We introduce FindStatBench, an execution benchmark for evaluating large language models on combinatorial code synthesis. Built from FindStat, it contains 2,329 tasks across 24 collections and 5.52M hidden instances, covering statistic synthesis, which maps objects to integers, and map synthesis, which maps objects to objects. Each task gives a mathematical description and at most five public input-output examples; a model must emit one Python solve function with no retrieval, tool use, execution feedback, voting, or reranking. Submissions are scored by exact sandboxed execution on held-out combinatorial objects. We evaluate eleven systems: four closed-source production models and seven open-weight models served through one inference provider. FindStatBench reveals three main patterns. First, the strongest open- and closed-source systems converge within 1 pp instance accuracy, and both an oracle over all systems and five-way sampling from one mid-tier model yield only limited task-accuracy gains. Second, examples can hurt: several classical bijections are solved perfectly with zero examples but fail under five-example prompts. Third, some failures reflect output-budget mechanics, as reasoning can exhaust the visible response before code is emitted. Overall, statistic synthesis is much easier than map synthesis, some collections remain near-zero, long prompts cause a sharp accuracy cliff, and exact symbolic rule induction remains brittle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FindStatBench，一个用于评估大语言模型在组合代码合成上的执行基准。基准包含2,329个任务、5.52M隐藏实例，要求模型仅根据数学描述和至多五个输入输出示例生成Python函数，通过沙箱执行评分。评估了11个系统，发现最强开源和闭源系统实例准确率差距在1个百分点以内；示例有时有害；某些失败源于输出预算机制；统计合成比映射合成容易得多，长提示导致准确率急剧下降。
Motivation: 现有代码合成基准多关注通用编程，缺乏对组合数学统计合成和映射合成的细粒度评估，且存在数据污染和评估不严格的问题。
Method: 从FindStat构建2339个任务，分为统计合成（对象到整数）和映射合成（对象到对象），每个任务提供数学描述和最多5个公开输入输出示例，要求模型输出单个Python函数，禁止检索、工具使用、执行反馈、投票或重排序，通过沙箱执行隐藏实例打分。
Result: 最强开源与闭源系统在实例准确率上差距小于1个百分点；从单个中等模型进行5次采样对任务准确率提升有限；部分经典双射在0示例时完美解决，但在5示例提示下失败；推理过程可能消耗输出预算导致代码无法生成；统计合成准确率远高于映射合成；长提示导致准确率悬崖式下降。
Conclusion: FindStatBench揭示了当前大语言模型在精确符号规则归纳上的脆弱性，示例数量、输出预算和提示长度显著影响性能，且不同合成任务难度差异巨大。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Probabilistic Concept-Aware Steering for Trustworthy LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Steering vectors (SVs), an inference-time intervention technique for large language models (LLMs), guide the generation process by adding a concept-specific direction vector to intermediate activations during inference. However, existing SV methods frequently yield representation-incoherent behaviors that undermine interpretability and fine-grained control, largely because prior work has focused on binary positive-negative steering evaluation while employing discrete clustering metrics that fail to capture the continuous spectrum of semantic alignment. In this work, we present the Probabilistic Concept-Aware Steering (PCS) framework for LLM inference. PCS preserves original task competence while providing controllable, safety-oriented semantic bias through concept-driven steering-vector retrieval and probabilistic strength calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出概率概念感知引导（PCS）框架，用于大语言模型推理时的干预，通过概念驱动的引导向量检索和概率强度校准，在保持原始任务能力的同时提供可控的安全导向语义偏置，解决了现有引导向量方法在表示一致性和细粒度控制方面的不足。
Motivation: 现有引导向量方法多基于二元的正负引导评估，使用离散聚类指标，无法捕捉语义对齐的连续谱，导致表示不一致的行为，损害可解释性和细粒度控制。
Method: 提出PCS框架，包含概念驱动的引导向量检索和概率强度校准，在推理时对中间激活添加概念特定方向向量，实现可控的安全导向语义偏置。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称PCS能在保持原始任务能力的同时提供可控的语义偏置。
Conclusion: PCS框架通过概率校准增强了引导向量的表示一致性和细粒度控制能力，适用于需要安全语义偏置的LLM推理场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: S2T-RLHF: Hierarchical Credit Assignment for Stable Preference-Based RLHF
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) with preference-based reward models often exhibits unstable training dynamics. A key contributing factor is that standard RLHF relies on a single sequence-level scalar reward, which is propagated to token-level policy updates and leaves credit assignment within a response inherently ambiguous. Recent work has attempted to address this issue by refining rewards into denser token-level supervision, often relying on the implicit assumption that finer-grained credit assignment improves optimization. We argue that this assumption is incomplete: when preference signals are noisy and only defined at the response level, overly fine-grained reward refinement can amplify reward uncertainty and destabilize learning. To address this problem, we propose a granularity-aware principle for hierarchical credit assignment, emphasizing stability-oriented reward design rather than maximal allocation precision. Under this principle, sentences serve as a natural intermediate granularity, balancing semantic coherence with robustness to token-level noise. Guided by this view, we introduce S2T-RLHF. This sentence-to-token reward decomposition framework first allocates sequence-level preference rewards across sentences and then applies bounded token-level refinement within each sentence, without reward-model retraining or token-level supervision. Experiments across multiple datasets and optimization settings show that S2T-RLHF improves training stability and robustness while maintaining competitive preference alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对偏好型RLHF训练不稳定的问题，提出S2T-RLHF框架，将序列级奖励先按句子分配，再在句子内部进行有界token级细化，无需重训练奖励模型。实验表明，该方法在多个数据集上提升了训练稳定性和鲁棒性，同时保持了偏好对齐效果。
Motivation: 标准RLHF使用序列级奖励导致token级信用分配模糊，而过度细化到token级别会放大奖励噪声，加剧训练不稳定。
Method: 提出粒度感知的层次化信用分配原则，以句子为中间粒度，先分配序列级奖励到句子，再对每个句子内的token进行有界细化，避免额外训练。
Result: 在多个数据集和优化设置下，S2T-RLHF改善了训练稳定性和鲁棒性，且偏好对齐性能与现有方法相当。
Conclusion: 强调稳定性导向的奖励设计比最大化分配精度更重要，句子作为中间粒度能平衡语义连贯性与抗噪声能力。

papers.title: Assistant or Actor? Student Trust, Control, and Delegation Regret When Using a General-Purpose AI Agent
papers.abstract_en: When AI agents shift from answering questions to taking actions, users face a new problem: deciding what to delegate, to a system whose action space they cannot fully anticipate. We call the resulting dissatisfaction delegation regret, a pattern in which users regret not that the agent erred, but that it acted beyond what they would have authorized. In a controlled study, 20 university students completed five common daily tasks using OpenClaw, a general-purpose AI agent, across tasks chosen to vary in privacy, stakes, and reversibility. For each task we measured trust, perceived control, transparency, supervision burden, and approval preference on 5-point Likert scales, and collected free-text reflections analyzed through thematic coding. Three findings emerged. First, participants calibrated trust per task rather than per agent: they granted wide autonomy for advisory and low-stakes tasks but demanded confirmation for irreversible, externally visible actions. Second, irreversibility combined with external visibility, rather than stakes alone, appeared to drive trust withdrawal: the moderate-stakes email task triggered the sharpest drop in trust (M = 3.10) and the highest demand for approval (M = 4.65), whereas a high-stakes but verifiable task did not produce the same response. Third, delegation regret appeared consistently when the agent executed actions without preview, even when the output was rated as successful. We discuss implications for agent designs that expose action boundaries, support per-task autonomy policies, and separate advisory output from agentic execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用户在使用通用型AI代理（如OpenClaw）时产生的委托后悔（delegation regret）现象，即用户因代理执行了超出其授权范围的操作而感到后悔。通过20名大学生完成五项日常任务的实验，测量信任、感知控制、透明度、监督负担和审批偏好，发现信任是任务特定的而非代理特定的，不可逆性和外部可见性共同驱动信任下降，且委托后悔在代理无预览执行操作时普遍出现。
Motivation: 当AI代理从回答问题转向采取行动时，用户面临新的挑战：决定委托哪些任务给一个行动空间不可完全预知的系统。现有研究缺乏对由此产生的委托后悔的系统性理解。
Method: 开展受控实验，20名大学生使用通用型AI代理OpenClaw完成五项日常任务（涉及隐私、风险、可逆性），通过5点李克特量表测量信任、感知控制、透明度、监督负担和审批偏好，并收集自由文本反馈进行主题编码分析。
Result: 三个主要发现：1) 参与者按任务而非按代理校准信任，对咨询性和低风险任务给予广泛自主权，但对不可逆、外部可见的操作要求确认；2) 不可逆性与外部可见性共同导致信任下降，中等风险的邮件任务信任最低（M=3.10）且审批需求最高（M=4.65），而高风险但可验证的任务未产生同样反应；3) 委托后悔在代理无预览执行操作时持续出现，即使输出被评为成功。
Conclusion: 研究结果对AI代理设计有启示：应暴露行动边界、支持按任务设定自主策略、并将咨询输出与代理执行分离。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PEARL: Solver-in-the-Loop Interactive Optimization Modeling from Natural Language
papers.abstract_en: Optimization modeling is the process of translating real-world decision problems, often described in natural language, into formal mathematical formulations and executable solver code. While recent advances in large language models have shown promise in automating this process, most existing approaches remain one-shot: a model produces a formulation once, without executing it, conditioning on solver feedback, or iteratively revising errors. This stands in sharp contrast to real-world optimization modeling, which is inherently interactive and proceeds through repeated solve-debug-revise cycles. We introduce PEARL, a system for interactive optimization modeling that uses Python execution and mathematical programming solvers inside this loop. Rather than relying on a fixed repair workflow, PEARL learns when to test partial models, how to revise from solver diagnostics, and when to stop. It operates in a multi-turn tool-integrated setting where intermediate execution results, feasibility signals, and solution checks are used to improve both formulations and solver code before finalization. Across diverse optimization benchmarks, PEARL substantially improves verified solve rates over strong one-shot and tool-augmented baselines; notably, our PEARL-Qwen3-\textbf{4B} model outperforms the much larger DeepSeek-V3.2-\textbf{685B} in both macro- and micro-averaged accuracy on optimization modeling tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PEARL 是一个交互式优化建模系统，通过将 Python 执行和数学规划求解器集成到循环中，实现多轮求解-调试-修订的自动化。摘要报告 PEARL-Qwen3-4B 模型在优化建模任务上超越 DeepSeek-V3.2-685B，显著提高验证求解率。
Motivation: 现有自动化优化建模方法大多是一次性生成，不执行求解器、不利用反馈、不迭代修正，而实际优化建模是交互式的循环过程。
Method: PEARL 采用多轮工具集成设置，利用中间执行结果、可行性信号和解检查来改进公式和求解器代码，并学习何时测试部分模型、如何从求解器诊断中修订以及何时停止。
Result: 在多个优化基准上，PEARL 的验证求解率远超一次性基线和使用工具增强的基线；PEARL-Qwen3-4B 在宏平均和微平均准确率上优于 DeepSeek-V3.2-685B。
Conclusion: 证明将求解器反馈纳入循环能有效提升自动化优化建模的性能，即使小模型也能超越大模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semantic Cooperative Games for Contribution Attribution in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Contribution attribution has become a central problem in LLM-based multi-agent systems, where final outputs are produced through multiple agents, message exchanges, and ordered workflow dependencies. Existing attribution methods often rely on counterfactual valuation, such as removing agents or comparing score changes across altered agent subsets. In language-mediated workflows, these methods require repeated model calls, introduce high variance, and do not explicitly capture the intermediate semantic states through which agents produce, preserve, and transform task-relevant information. We propose Semantic Cooperative Games (SCG), a framework that represents a realized language flow as a semantic generation hypergraph and induces an agent-level semantic value function on this structure. We define the Semantic Shapley Value (SSV) to allocate contribution over semantic support logic, and introduce SLIC, a single-trajectory algorithm that constructs the semantic hypergraph, recovers minimal semantic supports, applies Boolean absorption, and computes SSV without rerunning agent subsets. We prove that SSV reduces to the classical Shapley value under standard set-based, fully observable, and no-order-dependence conditions. On a medical benchmark satisfying these conditions, SLIC reduces computation cost by 93.3% while remaining highly consistent with a Monte Carlo Shapley baseline. In more general multi-role workflows, SSV aligns with perturbation-induced score-drop profiles and exposes cases where semantic contribution and failure impact diverge. Overall, SLIC provides a fast, counterfactual-free, and interpretable attribution method for complex LLM-based multi-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语义合作博弈（Semantic Cooperative Games, SCG）框架，用于LLM多智能体系统中的贡献归因。SCG将语言交互过程建模为语义生成超图，定义语义沙普利值（Semantic Shapley Value, SSV）分配贡献，并设计SLIC算法（无需重跑智能体子集）高效计算SSV。实验表明，SLIC在满足经典条件的医疗基准上计算成本降低93.3%且与蒙特卡洛基线高度一致；在通用多角色工作流中，SSV与扰动导致的分数下降轮廓吻合，揭示了语义贡献与失效影响的差异。
Motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统的贡献归因方法依赖反事实估值（如移除智能体或改变子集），导致重复模型调用、高方差，且无法显式捕捉智能体产生、保留和转换任务相关信息的中间语义状态。
Method: 提出语义合作博弈（SCG），将语言流程表示为语义生成超图，并定义智能体级语义价值函数。在此结构上定义语义沙普利值（SSV），并引入SLIC算法：构建语义超图、恢复最小语义支持、应用布尔吸收，无需重跑智能体子集即可计算SSV。
Result: 在满足经典条件（基于集合、完全可观察、无顺序依赖）的医疗基准上，SLIC计算成本降低93.3%且与蒙特卡洛沙普利基线高度一致。在更通用的多角色工作流中，SSV与扰动导致的分数下降轮廓吻合，并揭示了语义贡献与失效影响可能发生偏离的情况。
Conclusion: SLIC提供了一种快速、无需反事实、可解释的归因方法，适用于复杂的LLM多智能体系统。

papers.title: Cross-Dialect Generalization Without Retraining: Benchmarks and Evaluation of Schema-Derived Constrained Decoding for MLIR
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Level Intermediate Representation (MLIR) underlies modern ML compiler infrastructure (TensorFlow, JAX/StableHLO, PyTorch Inductor, IREE), yet appears only in trace amounts in code-LM pretraining corpora. MLIR is also extensible by design: new dialects ship per application domain, so a fine-tuned model per dialect does not scale. We ask whether inference-time priors derived mechanically from each dialect's Operation Definition Specification (ODS) can substitute for gradient-based adaptation. First, we release four natural-language-to-MLIR benchmarks across three dialects - MLIR-Spec-150, Linalg-Spec-30, StableHLO-Spec-30, and StableHLO-Held-Out-200 - totaling 410 in-scope NL-to-MLIR pairs, plus a 25-program out-of-grammar stress set and a hand-authored n=30 functional reference set, shipped under Apache-2.0 with Gebru datasheets and Croissant 1.0 metadata. Second, we build a three-layer schema-derived constraint stack: a CFG over op signatures(C1), type-domain splits from an ODS-extracted type lattice (C2), and an SSA-scope validator driving five-retry rejection sampling (C3). Porting from arith+func+memref+linalg to StableHLO required no new constraint-layer code. On dialects whose verifier semantics are dominated by structural constraints, schema-derived priors let SmolLM2-1.7B match or exceed 15B-34B code LMs at 8-25x the per-generation speed: on linalg, SmolLM2 reaches 80.0% verify-valid (three-seed mean, n=125), beating CodeLlama-34B, Granite-Code-34B, and StarCoder2-15B by 21-44 percentage points with non-overlapping CIs. On arith+func and on the templated parametric StableHLO-Held-Out-200, where verifier semantics turn on attribute values rather than structure, the same baselines match or beat the SLM; we scope these as non-win cells. We release benchmarks, decoder, all per-prompt generations, and a reproducibility Docker image.
papers.comment: 27 pages (9 main + bibliography + appendix), 9 figures, 9 tables. Code, benchmarks, and reproducibility Docker image at https://github.com/plawanrath/slm-to-mlir-constrained-emitter
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究MLIR跨方言通用性，提出基于模式（schema）的约束解码方法，无需微调即可泛化到新方言。发布4个NL-to-MLIR基准（共410样本）及评估集，构建三层约束：操作签名CFG、类型格分裂、SSA作用域验证。实验表明，在结构性约束为主的方言上，SmolLM2-1.7B在验证通过率上超越15B-34B模型达21-44个百分点，且速度提升8-25倍；但在属性值语义的方言上未胜出。
Motivation: MLIR在代码LM预训练语料中占比极低，且方言扩展频繁，逐个方言微调不可扩展。需要一种无需重训练的跨方言泛化方法。
Method: 从每种方言的操作定义规范（ODS）机械推导推理时先验，构建三层模式约束：操作签名上下文无关文法、ODS类型格分裂、SSA作用域五重试拒绝采样。构建4个NL-to-MLIR基准与评估集。
Result: 在linalg方言上，SmolLM2-1.7B达到80.0%验证通过率（n=125），超过CodeLlama-34B、Granite-Code-34B和StarCoder2-15B 21-44个百分点，且置信区间不重叠。在arith+func和StableHLO-Held-Out-200上，大模型匹配或超过小模型。
Conclusion: 模式派生先验可使小语言模型在结构约束主导的方言上匹配或超越大代码LM，但无法处理依赖属性值的语义验证；论文明确了适用边界并发布了完整基准与代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy and Cost: Latency-Aware LLM Query Routing for Dynamic Workloads
papers.abstract_en: Modern language query routers improve inference efficiency by assigning each query to a model that balances response quality and monetary cost. However, current query routers are largely latency-agnostic and do not consider the generation latency experienced by queries at model instances. In practice, latency is often controlled by load-balancing policies such as round-robin or join-the-shortest-queue, which do not account for model accuracy or inference cost. Incorporating query latency into routing is challenging as it depends not only on the query's prompt length, but also on the current prefill and decode workload at the model instance and the scheduling and batching policy of the serving framework. We design a lightweight latency estimator that simulates autoregressive token batch processing in the serving framework and estimates the time-to-first-token (TTFT) of queries. We incorporate this latency estimator into a latency-aware router that jointly optimizes latency, accuracy, and cost when assigning queries to model instances. Our experimental results indicate that this joint optimization yields up to 40% improvement in accuracy--cost utility while maintaining the same latencies as standard load-balancing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 设计轻量级延迟估计器，模拟服务框架中的自回归Token批处理过程，估算查询的TTFT；并将该估计器融入路由器，联合优化延迟、准确性和成本。
Result: 在保持与标准负载均衡方法相同延迟的前提下，联合优化使准确率-成本效用提升高达40%。
Conclusion: 延迟感知的联合优化在提升效用方面有效，且不牺牲标准负载均衡的延迟表现。

papers.title: MILP-Evo: Closed-Loop Fully Automatic Design of MILP Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning methods have shown that data-driven policies can accelerate mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) solvers, but many such approaches remain difficult to inspect, adapt, and deploy because the learned policy is represented as an external predictor or other opaque model. By contrast, explicit solver logic is easier to understand and integrate, but is usually hand-designed rather than learned from solver feedback. We study whether the automatic design of MILP solver logic can instead be cast as LLM-guided closed-loop search over executable white-box components evaluated directly by end-to-end solver behavior. To this end, we propose a closed-loop program evolution framework for MILP solver auto-design, implemented through PySCIPOpt, and instantiate it on the joint design of a cut selector and a branching rule. Candidate programs are iteratively generated, loaded into SCIP, and evaluated by direct execution on MILP instances, with the resulting feedback guiding performance-based selection, targeted repair, diagnostic reflection, and diversity-aware population maintenance. The method outputs explicit solver components that can be inspected, modified, and deployed within standard solver workflows. Across four benchmark families, we find that LLM-guided program evolution can discover competitive domain-specialized policies in several settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MILP-Evo，一个闭环程序进化框架，用于自动设计混合整数线性规划求解器的可解释逻辑组件。该方法通过LLM引导搜索白盒组件，直接通过求解器端到端行为评估，联合设计切割选择器和分支规则。在多个基准测试中发现可以自动发现领域特化的策略。
Motivation: 现有的数据驱动策略难以检查、适应和部署，而显式求解器逻辑通常手工设计。本文旨在将求解器逻辑自动设计视为LLM引导的闭环搜索，以白盒组件直接评估。
Method: 提出闭环程序进化框架，基于PySCIPOpt实现，迭代生成候选程序，加载到SCIP中通过执行MILP实例评估，利用反馈进行性能选择、目标修复、诊断反思和多样性维护，最终输出可检查、修改和部署的显式求解器组件。
Result: 在四个基准测试族中，LLM引导的程序进化能够在多个设置中发现具有竞争力的领域特化策略。
Conclusion: 该方法能够自动设计出可解释、可集成的MILP求解器组件，为自动求解器设计提供新范式。

papers.title: Integro-differential equations in angular stabilization of drone motion by distributed feedback control
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose angular stabilization of drone motion using distributed feedback control in the form of an integral operator. It should be stressed that the memory of this integral operator could be unbounded. It is intuitively clear that large length of the observation time open new possibilities to construct better control based on previous states of the control object. Unbounded memory in control requires the creation of a certain approach different from standard ones to the study of integro-differential equations. One of the goals of this article is to propose a certain universal approach that allows us to study the stability of integro-differential equations in the case of unbounded memory in the integral operator specifying the feedback control in stabilization. The approach we propose allows us to reduce the study of integro-differential equations to the analysis of systems of ordinary differential equations. In general, such systems can consist of an infinite number of equations. In relation to the so-called linear approximation in the problem of angle stabilization manages to limit itself to relatively simple exponential kernels in the integral control and arrive at a system with a finite number of equations. The examples explain that more complex kernels, for example, linear combinations of the exponential kernels, can enhance the stabilization capabilities. We obtain new unexpectable results on the exponential stability of integro-differential equations. Then we apply them to stabilization of drone flight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用分布式反馈控制（积分算子形式）实现无人机运动的角稳定，重点研究具有无界记忆的积分微分方程的稳定性。作者提出一种通用方法，将积分微分方程化为常微分方程组，并通过指数核简化线性近似问题，得到新的指数稳定性结果，应用于无人机飞行稳定。
Motivation: 无人机角稳定控制中，现有方法未充分利用长时间观测记忆带来的控制优势，而无界记忆控制需要新的积分微分方程稳定性分析框架。
Method: 提出将积分微分方程稳定性分析转化为常微分方程组（可能无限维）的通用方法，对于线性近似问题采用指数核以得到有限维系统，并讨论更复杂核（如指数核线性组合）的增强效果。
Result: 获得了积分微分方程指数稳定性的新结果，并应用于无人机飞行角稳定。
Conclusion: 该方法通过积分算子反馈控制及无界记忆，能够提升无人机角稳定性能，复杂核可进一步增强稳定性。

papers.title: MechAInistic: An LLM-guided Multi-Agent System for Reasoning over Genome-Scale Constraint-Based Metabolic Models
papers.abstract_en: Constraint-based metabolic modeling is a powerful way to study the mechanistic basis of cellular states and disease, but its effective use demands substantial computational expertise and careful coordination of multi-step analyses. We developed MechAInistic to lower this barrier and enable researchers to ask complex biological questions in natural language. Harnessing large language models, MechAInistic is a multi-agent system organized around an Architect-Reviewer pattern that transforms a natural-language question into an executable, model-grounded workflow and generates a structured report. The system supports a variety of tasks, including pathway comparison, perturbation analysis, drug-target exploration, and literature-grounded interpretation across paired metabolic model states. We developed and evaluated MechAInistic using two paired immune-cell metabolic-model use cases for therapeutic hypothesis generation. For Naive B cells from rheumatoid arthritis (RA) paired with healthy controls, MechAInistic identified mitochondrial metabolic rewiring and nominated Devimistat/CPI-613 as an investigational OGDH-centered hypothesis. In a paired CD4+ Th17 cell study from multiple sclerosis (MS) and healthy controls, the same workflow identified NADP-dependent isocitrate dehydrogenase as the optimal single target and proposed ivosidenib as an FDA-approved repurposing candidate. Together, these results show that MechAInistic converts natural-language biological questions into executable, model-grounded workflows for traceable therapeutic hypothesis generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了MechAInistic，一个基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，用于基因组规模约束性代谢模型的推理。该系统采用架构师-审稿人模式，将自然语言问题转化为可执行的模型驱动工作流，并生成结构化报告。在类风湿关节炎和健康对照的Naive B细胞、多发性硬化症和健康对照的CD4+ Th17细胞两个用例中，系统识别了代谢重编程和潜在药物靶点。
Motivation: 约束性代谢建模需要大量计算专业知识和多步分析协调，限制了其广泛应用。MechAInistic旨在降低门槛，使研究人员能用自然语言提出复杂生物学问题。
Method: 系统基于LLM的多智能体架构，采用架构师-审稿人模式，将自然语言问题转化为可执行的工作流，支持通路比较、扰动分析、药物靶标探索等任务。
Result: 在RA和MS的两个免疫细胞代谢模型用例中，系统识别了线粒体代谢重编程，并提出了Devimistat/CPI-613和ivosidenib等候选药物。
Conclusion: MechAInistic将自然语言生物学问题转化为可执行的模型驱动工作流，实现可追踪的治疗假设生成。

papers.title: Phionyx: A Deterministic AI Runtime Architecture with Structured State Management and Pre-Response Governance
papers.abstract_en: We present Phionyx, a deterministic AI runtime architecture derived from the broader Echoism interaction framework that introduces a governance-first approach to AI engineering: treating large language model (LLM) outputs as noisy sensor measurements rather than direct decisions. Unlike probabilistic agents, Phionyx enforces deterministic state evolution via a structured state vector governed by deterministic state-evolution equations, enabling reproducible behavior in applications requiring auditability and governance. The architecture integrates three layers: (1) a deterministic evaluation kernel processing noisy sensor measurements through a canonical 46-block pipeline, (2) a unified safety layer providing pre-response control and architectural privacy enforcement, and (3) a semantic time-based memory system implementing impact-weighted cache eviction. Experimental validation on single-instance deployments demonstrates approximately 31% reduction in computational overhead vs. post-hoc filtering (at 30% unsafe input ratio, simulated cost model) and up to 24% improvement in high-value data retention vs. LRU (72% vs. FIFO, same cache capacity, benchmark-verified), deterministic execution verified across 100 repeated runs with zero variance in control signals (hash-verified), and zero unplanned restarts in single-instance deployment testing (see Appendix C for methodology and scope). This paper presents the architecture, its analytic structure, and scoped experimental evidence; generalization to distributed or multi-tenant deployments remains future work.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Reference implementation, reproducibility pack, and evaluation artifacts available via GitHub (https://github.com/halvrenofviryel/phionyx-research) and Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20027534)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Phionyx 是一种确定性 AI 运行时架构，将 LLM 输出视为噪声传感器测量，通过结构化状态向量强制执行状态演化的确定性。架构包含三个层：46 块流水线的确定性评估内核、统一安全层（预响应控制和架构级隐私）以及基于语义时间的缓存系统。单实例实验显示，与事后过滤相比计算开销降低约 31%，高价值数据保留比 LRU 提升 24%，100 次重复运行中控制信号零方差，且无计划外重启。
Motivation: 现有概率性 AI 代理行为不可复现，难以满足审计和治理需求；论文旨在通过确定性运行时框架使 LLM 驱动的应用具备可复现性和可治理性。
Method: 提出三层架构：(1) 确定性评估内核，将 LLM 输出作为噪声测量并通过 46 块流水线处理；(2) 统一安全层，实现预响应控制和架构级隐私执行；(3) 语义时间记忆系统，采用影响加权缓存驱逐策略。
Result: 单实例部署实验显示：与事后过滤相比计算开销降低约 31%（30% 不安全输入比例下）；高价值数据保留比 LRU 提升 24%（72% vs. FIFO）；100 次重复运行中控制信号零方差（哈希验证）；零计划外重启。
Conclusion: 论文展示了 Phionyx 架构和分析结构，并提供了有范围的实验证据；分布式或多租户部署的泛化留作未来工作。

papers.title: SAAG: Structured Agent Assessment and Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Exact-match evaluation of agent-calling obscures qualitatively different failure modes: a model may select the right function yet hallucinate argument values, or satisfy a schema while choosing a agent for the wrong reason. Existing benchmarks collapse these distinctions into a single binary score, leaving practitioners unable to diagnose where agent calls fail. We propose SAAG a cascaded diagnostic framework that decomposes agent-calling evaluation into three sequential stages: registry conformance, structural completeness, and argument grounding, each producing interpretable stage-specific diagnostics. These diagnostics additionally enable iterative self-repair: on prediction failure, the stage-specific signal guides targeted correction without leaking ground-truth values. We evaluate this framework on a controlled benchmark derived from Glaive's function-calling dataset across registry sizes of 5, 10, and 15 agents using three local sub-4B-parameter models. Structured feedback consistently improves argument precision and reduces value hallucination relative to single-pass inference and uninformative binary feedback, while end-to-end F1 gains are modest and model-dependent. These results suggest that stage-decomposed diagnostic evaluation is a necessary lens for understanding and improving agent-calling reliability across model families and registry scales.
papers.comment: Accepted to KnowFM @ ACL 2026 workshop (Non-Archival). 16 pages in total
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAAG是一个级联诊断框架，将智能体调用评估分解为注册表一致性、结构完整性和参数接地三个阶段，每个阶段产生可解释的诊断信号。在Glaive函数调用数据集上的实验表明，结构化反馈持续改善了参数精度并减少了值幻觉，但端到端F1提升适中且依赖模型。
Motivation: 现有智能体调用的精确匹配评估掩盖了不同的失败模式（如选对函数但参数幻觉，或满足模式但选错智能体），无法诊断具体失败原因。
Method: 提出SAAG级联诊断框架，将评估分解为注册表一致性、结构完整性和参数接地三个阶段，每个阶段输出可解释的诊断信号，并利用这些信号进行迭代自修复。
Result: 在5、10、15个智能体规模的Glaive数据集上，使用三个本地<4B参数模型，结构化反馈一致改善了参数精度并减少了值幻觉，但端到端F1提升适中且模型依赖。
Conclusion: 阶段分解的诊断评估是理解和提高智能体调用可靠性的必要视角，适用于不同模型族和智能体规模。

summary_sections.result: 在5、10、15个智能体规模的Glaive数据集上，使用三个本地<4B参数模型，结构化反馈一致改善了参数精度并减少了值幻觉，但端到端F1提升适中且模型依赖。
summary_sections.conclusion: 阶段分解的诊断评估是理解和提高智能体调用可靠性的必要视角，适用于不同模型族和智能体规模。

papers.title: From Agent Failure Paths to Quantified Residual Risk: A Compositional Framework for Resilient Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI is crossing trust boundaries faster than current risk models can represent. Existing approaches provide one of two partial views. They either describe failure mechanisms without producing a transferable residual-risk estimate, or they produce a risk estimate while treating the internal failure path as a black box. We couple those two views by proposing CPSAINT, a seven-layer integrity decomposition over Physical state, Sensors, Data, Compute, Actuators, Environment, and Time, paired with FRIESA-K, a residual-risk functional that maps each failure path to a quantified risk instance. FRIESA-K grounds the resistance term K in a controlled absorbing Markov model so that control effectiveness is derived from state dynamics rather than assigned as an informal score. The result is a concise mechanism-to magnitude pipeline for resilient agentic and embodied AI. We report governance observability through a separate additive penalty instead of inserting governance as a new variable in the resistance functional. We formalize structural composability linking valid failure paths to well-defined risk instances and show the framework on two contrasting scenarios a hard real-time warehouse robot and a governance-instrumented financial-services agent. Across both cases, the same layer grammar, variable semantics, and dynamic-resistance construction remain intact. Thus, we obtain a compact kernel that supports cross-domain reasoning, explicit assumptions, and quantitatively grounded formalism of composable trust.

TL;DR: 本文提出CPSAINT框架，将智能体AI的故障路径分解为七层完整性（物理、传感器、数据、计算、执行器、环境、时间），并结合FRIESA-K残差风险函数，将故障路径映射为量化风险实例。该方法通过可控吸收马尔可夫模型推导阻力项K，实现从机制到风险量级的管道，并在硬实时仓库机器人和金融智能体两个场景中验证了框架的跨领域适用性。
Motivation: 现有风险模型要么只描述故障机制而无转移性风险估计，要么将故障路径视为黑箱产生风险估计。需要一种既能描述故障机制又能产生可量化风险估计的框架。
Method: 提出CPSAINT七层完整性分解和FRIESA-K残差风险函数，后者基于可控吸收马尔可夫模型建模阻力项K，并通过独立加性惩罚实现治理可观测性。
Result: 在硬实时仓库机器人和金融智能体两个对比场景上展示了框架的有效性，相同层语法、变量语义和动态阻力构造保持不变，支持跨领域推理。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一个紧凑内核，支持跨领域推理、显式假设和组合信任的量化形式化。
